jobs.title: AI Engineer II
jobs.description: **Salary Grade: 20** **SUMMARY:** The AI Engineer II is responsible for designing, developing, implementing, and supporting AI enabled applications, agentic workflows, and enterprise integrations that drive innovation and operational efficiency across Mutual Bancorp. This hands on engineering role partners with Information Technology and business teams to translate business needs into secure, scalable, and reliable AI solutions. Key responsibilities include developing AI applications and agents, integrating AI capabilities with enterprise systems and data platforms, implementing technical governance and security controls, and establishing testing, monitoring, and operational support practices. The AI Engineer II leads assigned technical workstreams, promotes reusable engineering standards, and contributes to the continued development and adoption of AI capabilities across the organization. **ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS \& RESPONSIBILITIES:** * **AI Solution Implementation:** Design and deliver approved AI applications, implementing AI enabled tools, workflows, and agents that solve business problems. Create workflows and automations from requirements through production support including AI Governance, Internal Models, and Model Harnesses, and AI related projects from other lines of business. * **Enterprise Integration:** Build secure API and data integrations with Snowflake, business applications, and approved AI services. Partner with Data Engineering on source quality, access, and lineage. Build integrations between Snowflake, ChatGPT Enterprise, and other approved tools using A2A, ACP, MCP, ANP, APIs, and other AI protocols. * **AI Development:** Write and maintain dashboards that support data visibility, agentic workflows, document handling, data preparation, workflow routing, and operational processes. Use version control, automated testing, peer review, and change management practices. Improve documentation and reusable patterns across solutions. * **LLM Integration:** Integrate applications with approved large language models, including enterprise hosted, privately deployed, and third\-party services. Understand model capabilities, context windows, token usage, inference parameters, and limitations. * **Internal AI Models:** Support deployment and integration of internally hosted or privately managed models when required by security, privacy, performance, or business requirements. * **Testing:** Define acceptance criteria and repeatable tests for output quality, accuracy, reliability, latency, and cost. Record results and resolve defects before releases. Ensure model consistency is observable, measured, and tested. * **Agentic AI Development:** Develop AI agents capable of completing multistep tasks, retrieving information, using tools, and interacting with approved systems. Configure agent instructions, execution logic, permissions, state management, and appropriate human intervention points. * **Security \& Privacy:** Apply authentication, role based access, logging, and secure development practices. Protect customer and bank information under established policies and approved data flows. * **Operations:** Implement application monitoring, alerts, recovery procedures, and runbooks. Troubleshoot production issues and coordinate fixes with system owners and support teams. Manage high risk migrations as they arise. * **User Experience:** Develop or integrate user interfaces that allow employees to interact with AI applications. Support conversational interfaces, internal applications, and workflow based experiences using approved development platforms. * **Responsible AI Governance:** Monitor AI and Agentic AI performance**,** provide testing results, data flow documentation, and evidence for AI Working Group reviews and risk partners. Support approved monitoring controls in AI governance applications. * **Use Case Outcomes:** Partner with AI Analysts and business teams to measure quality improvements, processing time, adoption, and other agreed outcomes; improve solutions using those findings. * **Collaboration:** Work with Lending, Operations, Finance, IT, and other areas to translate needs into technical designs. Provide guidance as needed to AI colleagues. * **Other Duties:** Perform other duties as assigned. **QUALIFICATIONS:** **EDUCATION \& CERTIFICATIONS:** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS \& ABILITIES:** * 5 years of professional experience in AI engineering, software engineering, data science, data engineering, systems integration, technical process excellence/automation, or a closely related field. * Proficiency in Python and other coding language skills, with a history of improving deployment reliability and reducing manual work * Experience leading critical migrations, ensuring key system reliability and a seamless migration experience for users. * Experience with version control such as Git, CI/CD workflows, code review, documentation, and Agile or Jira based delivery. * Experience delivering production software, automated workflows, or data integrations with monitoring and support procedures. * History of cross functional collaboration between subject matter experts, project management, banking lines of business, nontechnical users. * Working knowledge of generative AI applications, including retrieval, model evaluation, and reliable handling of AI outputs. * Experience working with process excellence teams to develop automated workflows for regulated financial institutions is preferred. * Experience with Snowflake or a comparable cloud data platform preferred; familiarity with ChatGPT Enterprise or approved enterprise AI services preferred. * Understanding of application security, data access controls, and secure handling of confidential information. * Familiarity with core banking systems (Jack Henry, FIS, Fiserv, AS400/DB2 systems) preferred. * Prior experience in banking, credit unions, or financial services, with exposure to core banking platforms or shared services across multiple entities. * Familiarity with regulatory and financial reporting concepts such as Call Reports, SOX, CCPA, CECL, or related bank reporting requirements. * Ability to lead technical workstreams, coordinate priorities, and manage delivery details. * Ability to translate business requirements into technical designs, acceptance criteria, data models, and quality controls. * Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to Finance, business, and technical and non technical stakeholders. * Ability to mentor other engineers, conduct constructive code reviews, and promote reusable patterns and documentation standards. * Strong problem solving, systems thinking, and incident troubleshooting skills. * Sound judgment when working with sensitive data, third\-party services, and production systems. * Cybersecurity awareness and a commitment to responsible, controlled use of AI in banking. * Familiarity with Jira/Agile methodology for project and task management. * Relevant certifications are a plus. Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: AWS DevOps & Full Stack Technical Lead
jobs.description: **Pivot Point Solutions** ========================= Pivot Point Solutions is a California\-based technology consulting firm that specializes in delivering IT solutions and support for the construction and utility industries. We partner with organizations across the state to provide reliable technology services that improve operational efficiency, enhance project delivery, and support critical business systems. Our team understands the unique technology challenges facing construction and utility organizations, from field operations and infrastructure projects to enterprise applications and cybersecurity. By combining industry expertise with responsive service, we help clients modernize their technology environments, streamline workflows, and maintain secure, reliable IT systems that support long\-term growth. **Job Overview** ---------------- **Title:** AWS DevOps \& Full Stack Technical Lead **Sector:** Information Technology / Cloud Engineering \& Software Development **Seniority:** Expert Level **Location:** Oakland, CA **Job Type:** Remote Eligible – Only accepting current CA residents **Contract Length:** 12 months \+ **Compensation:** $65 \- $80/hr **Role Overview** ----------------- Pivot Point Solutions is seeking an experienced AWS DevOps \& Full Stack Technical Lead to oversee the architecture, development, automation, deployment and production support of enterprise cloud applications supporting customer\-facing digital services. The ideal candidate combines hands\-on software development experience with advanced AWS cloud engineering, Infrastructure as Code and DevOps capabilities. This individual will lead technical design decisions, contribute production\-quality code, establish engineering standards, mentor developers and ensure applications and infrastructure meet enterprise security, scalability, reliability and performance requirements. **Your Day\-to\-Day Activities** -------------------------------- * Lead the architecture, development, deployment and production support of enterprise applications hosted in AWS. * Design scalable, secure and highly available AWS cloud solutions supporting customer\-facing applications. * Develop full\-stack applications, backend services, REST APIs, microservices and automation solutions using Python, JavaScript/TypeScript and Node.js. * Develop reusable Terraform modules and Infrastructure as Code solutions to automate cloud infrastructure provisioning and environment management. * Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines supporting automated builds, testing, security validation, deployments and rollbacks. * Establish Git\-based development standards, including branching strategies, pull requests, code reviews and release management. * Provide hands\-on technical leadership through software development, architecture reviews, infrastructure code reviews and developer mentorship. * Develop Python and Node.js automation solutions to improve deployment efficiency, infrastructure management and operational support. * Implement AWS services supporting compute, storage, networking, APIs, serverless workloads and identity management. * Establish monitoring, logging, alerting and observability capabilities across applications and cloud infrastructure. * Lead technical incident response, root\-cause analysis, production recovery and corrective actions. * Implement cloud and application security practices, including IAM, least\-privilege access, encryption, secrets management and vulnerability remediation. * Establish engineering standards for automated testing, scalability, resiliency, security and production readiness. * Coordinate technical delivery across development, architecture, cloud engineering, cybersecurity, quality engineering and product teams. * Maintain architecture diagrams, infrastructure configurations, operational runbooks, deployment procedures and recovery plans. * Identify and implement modernization opportunities across cloud infrastructure, application frameworks and DevOps tooling. **The Job Requirements** ------------------------ * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. * 7\+ years of software development, cloud engineering, DevOps or related technology experience supporting production applications. * Hands\-on experience designing, deploying and supporting enterprise solutions within AWS cloud environments. * Hands\-on development experience with Python, JavaScript/TypeScript and Node.js, including backend services, automation or full\-stack applications. * Experience provisioning and managing cloud infrastructure using Terraform or equivalent Infrastructure as Code technologies. * Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines, automated build and deployment processes, Git\-based source control and code reviews. * Experience developing REST APIs, enterprise integrations and supporting business\-critical production systems through monitoring, troubleshooting, incident response and recovery. * Experience providing hands\-on technical leadership across application development, cloud architecture, DevOps and production support. **You'll Stand Out If You Have** -------------------------------- * Advanced experience with AWS Lambda, API Gateway, S3, CloudWatch, IAM, serverless architectures and event\-driven integrations. * Experience developing reusable Terraform modules, managing infrastructure state and integrating Infrastructure as Code with CI/CD pipelines. * Experience with Docker, AWS container services, automated testing, distributed observability and cloud security frameworks. * Experience supporting high\-volume customer\-facing digital applications with complex availability, scalability, disaster recovery and performance requirements. **About Pivot Point Solutions** ------------------------------- Pivot Point Solutions is committed to delivering technology solutions that help construction and utility organizations operate more efficiently, securely, and effectively. We work closely with our clients to provide experienced IT professionals who can support enterprise systems, modernize technology environments, and deliver reliable solutions to complex business challenges. Our team values technical expertise, collaboration, and practical problem\-solving. By connecting skilled technology professionals with meaningful projects, we help organizations strengthen their technology capabilities while providing opportunities for professionals to contribute to impactful initiatives.

jobs.title: Chief Engineer, Florida

This role is ideal for a highly respected engineering leader who combines deep technical expertise with the ability to establish standards, guide engineering teams, support key clients, and influence the long\-term growth of our geotechnical practices. **Key Responsibilities** * Serve as the firm’s ultimate technical authority for geotechnical work applied to transportation, water/wastewater, dams, pavement design, tunneling, aviation, etc. * Collaborate with the senior management team of the company. * Establish technical standards, quality procedures, and best practices across the organization. * Provide senior\-level oversight and review of complex geotechnical reports, analyses, designs, and project deliverables. * Guide project teams in resolving complex engineering challenges and technical issues. * Serve as a senior technical liaison with key clients, DOTs, and agency partners. * Provide technical leadership for major proposals, pursuits, interviews, and strategic opportunities. * Develop and mentor senior engineering staff through technical coaching and knowledge sharing. * Represent the firm at industry events, conferences, and professional to obtain additional licenses as needed). * 20\+ years of geotechnical engineering consulting experience. * Extensive background in geotechnical engineering applied to civil infrastructure, including DOT projects. * Demonstrated experience as a senior technical leader, reviewer, or engineering authority. * Strong ability to influence technical direction and develop engineering teams. * Excellent jobs.title: Cloud Engineer
jobs.description: **Location:** Louisville, KY **Job Type:** Full\-time **Schedule:** Monday\-Friday, 9:00 a.m.\-5:00 p.m. **About the Role** We are looking for a Cloud Engineer in Louisville to support the organisation's cloud platforms, maintain system reliability and assist with the development of scalable technology solutions. You will be responsible for configuring cloud resources, monitoring infrastructure performance and supporting application deployments. Working alongside software developers, IT administrators and security personnel, you will help ensure that cloud services operate efficiently, meet business requirements and follow established security standards. **What You'll Be Responsible For** * Configure, deploy and maintain cloud infrastructure across development, testing and production environments. * Manage cloud resources, including virtual machines, storage services, networking components and databases. * Support cloud platforms such as Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud. * Monitor infrastructure performance, availability and resource utilisation. * Investigate cloud\-related incidents and resolve configuration, connectivity and deployment issues. * Implement infrastructure automation using tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation or similar technologies. * Assist development teams with application hosting, deployment processes and cloud integrations. * Maintain backup configurations, recovery procedures and infrastructure documentation. * Apply security controls involving identity management, permissions, encryption and network access. * Support containerised applications using Docker and orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes. * Review cloud resource usage and identify opportunities to improve performance and manage operating costs. * Participate in infrastructure upgrades, migration activities and platform improvement projects. * Maintain monitoring tools and configure alerts to identify potential service disruptions. * Work with internal technical teams to investigate recurring infrastructure problems and implement lasting solutions. **Skills and Experience** * Three or more years of experience in cloud engineering, infrastructure administration or a related technical position. * Hands\-on experience with at least one major cloud platform, such as AWS, Azure or Google Cloud. * Understanding of cloud architecture, virtualisation, storage and networking services. * Practical knowledge of Linux and Windows Server environments. * Experience with scripting languages such as Python, Bash or PowerShell. * Familiarity with infrastructure\-as\-code tools and configuration management practices. * Understanding of CI/CD workflows and automated deployment processes. * Experience working with Docker, Kubernetes or other container technologies is beneficial. * Knowledge of cloud security, identity and access management, and data protection practices. * Ability to troubleshoot system performance, connectivity and You will need to document infrastructure changes, follow deployment procedures and ensure that technical updates are properly tested before being introduced into production environments. **Position Details** * Louisville, Kentucky * Full\-time * Monday to Friday, 9:00 a.m.\-5:00 p.m. * On\-site **How to Apply** If you have practical cloud infrastructure experience and enjoy building reliable, secure and scalable technology environments, we encourage you to apply. Please include your cloud platform experience, technical skills, relevant projects and professional certifications with your application. Pay: $130,000\.00 \- $140,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Cloud Platform Engineer – Kubernetes / EKS & DevOps
jobs.description: **About the engagement** ------------------------ You join a dedicated team delivering Advanced MSP and Cloud Center of Excellence (CCoE) services to a large enterprise customer across AWS, Azure and GCP, with AWS as the largest estate (150\+ accounts). The customer's business units run containerized workloads on EKS, and this seat is the team's primary owner of that platform. The team combines onsite CCoE architects at the customer's site, US\-remote operations engineers, and an offshore 24x7 monitoring team. You work US business hours and are the escalation point for EKS and pipeline issues raised by monitoring, the business units or the CCoE. **What you'll do** ------------------ **EKS cluster operations and lifecycle** * Operate the customer's EKS clusters day to day: node groups, add\-ons, networking (VPC CNI, CoreDNS, ingress/load balancer controllers), storage (EBS/EFS CSI) and IAM roles for service accounts. * Plan and execute Kubernetes version upgrades to keep every cluster inside AWS's supported window; manage deprecated API removals with the application teams ahead of each upgrade. * Own capacity, autoscaling (Cluster Autoscaler or Karpenter) and right\-sizing recommendations for the container platform. **Platform reliability** * Resolve P1/P2 incidents escalated by the 24x7 monitoring team; lead root\-cause analysis and corrective actions for recurring container\-platform incidents. * Define and tune EKS/container monitoring, alert thresholds and dashboards with the monitoring team. * Maintain runbooks, cluster configuration records and the EKS entries in the scope register. **CI/CD and DevOps support for application teams** * Support the application teams' pipelines (deployments, Helm charts/manifests, image builds, ECR, GitOps tooling) and troubleshoot failed deployments to the platform layer. * Set and enforce platform standards: namespaces, RBAC, resource quotas, pod security, network policies and image/registry hygiene. * Build and maintain the IaC for the clusters alongside the CCoE platform engineer — Terraform/CloudFormation, eksctl and automation of repeatable changes. **Security and change** * Remediate container\-platform vulnerability findings (nodes, images, add\-ons) within agreed windows; apply node patching and AMI refreshes on the agreed cycle. * Plan, document and execute changes through the customer's change process (ServiceNow/JSM), including work plans and post\-implementation verification. * Contribute EKS content to monthly service reports and quarterly business reviews. **Required qualifications** --------------------------- * 5\+ years in cloud infrastructure or DevOps roles, with 3\+ years operating production Kubernetes; at least 2 of those on Amazon EKS. * Hands\-on with the EKS ecosystem: managed node groups, Karpenter or Cluster Autoscaler, VPC CNI, IRSA/Pod Identity, EBS/EFS CSI, AWS Load Balancer Controller. * Has led at least two production Kubernetes version upgrades end to end, including deprecated\-API remediation with application teams. * Strong CI/CD experience with at least one of GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins or AWS CodePipeline, plus Helm and a GitOps tool (Argo CD or Flux). * Infrastructure\-as\-code in Terraform or CloudFormation; comfortable with eksctl and the AWS CLI. * Container observability: Prometheus/Grafana, CloudWatch Container Insights or Datadog; able to define SLIs and alert thresholds. * Incident and change discipline: has worked under an ITIL\-style change process and an SLA\-backed managed service or SRE function. * Linux administration and scripting (Bash, Python). * AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate or higher, or willing to obtain within 90 days. * Fluent professional English; able to write runbooks and RCA reports for a customer audience. * Authorized to work in the United States; able to pass a customer background check. **Preferred qualifications** ---------------------------- * Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) and/or AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional. * Experience at an MSP or in a multi\-tenant / multi\-account AWS organization (AWS Organizations, Control Tower, SCPs). * Service mesh (Istio, App Mesh) and secrets management (External Secrets, AWS Secrets Manager). * Container security tooling (Wiz, Trivy, Amazon Inspector, ECR scanning) and pod security standards. * Exposure to Azure (AKS) or GCP (GKE) — the engagement is multicloud. * Korean language ability is a plus but not required. * Experience supporting automotive, manufacturing or large Korean\-headquartered enterprise customers. **Working model** ----------------- * **Hours:** Engineering and change work in service hours, 08:00–18:00 Pacific, Monday–Friday. Candidates in any US time zone are welcome if they cover Pacific hours. * **On\-call:** Participates in the AWS escalation rotation for P1/P2 incidents and emergency changes outside service hours; 24x7 first response is handled by the offshore monitoring team. * **Travel:** Occasional travel to the customer's site in Southern California for planning sessions, upgrades and QBRs (estimate one trip per quarter). * **Contract\-to\-hire:** Initial engagement as a contractor with conversion to full\-time employment on performance, targeted within 6 months. * **Tooling you'll use:** AWS console/CLI, Terraform, Helm, Argo CD or Flux, ServiceNow and Jira Service Management, MegaFlow (Megazone's operations platform), Datadog/CloudWatch, Slack. ### **Why You'll Love It Here** * **Our Product is Our People:** We live by this. We invest in people who invest in themselves. Your growth is our growth. * **True Servant Leadership:** Our CTO leads with a "force multiplier" philosophy. Management is here to empower you and clear roadblocks, not to micromanage. We won't ask you to do anything we're not willing to do ourselves. * **Flat Organization, Real Impact:** Your voice and designs will directly shape our technical roadmap and our clients' success. You'll work on the latest tech to solve real problems. * **A "Learn\-from\-it" Culture:** We're moving fast and building new things. We believe mistakes are learning opportunities, not failures. We seek diverse talent who are ready to make an immediate impact. We believe that innovation thrives when teams are built with a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. If you are excited by this mission, we encourage you to apply, even if your experience doesn't perfectly match every qualification listed. **Megazone Cloud is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in E\-Verify to confirm the employment eligibility of all new hires.** Compensation Range: $100K \- $140K

jobs.title: Electrical & Electronics Engineer AI Evaluator
jobs.description: About the RoleWe are looking for experienced, hands\-on electrical and electronics engineers to help evaluate and train frontier AI models on real\-world hardware and circuit engineering work. While modern AI models can talk fluently about electronics, they still struggle to reliably execute actual engineering tasks—such as specifying a circuit, stabilizing a control loop, closing a link budget, sizing a power stage, or debugging a signal chain. In this role, you will bring the practical judgment you have built designing, simulating, bringing up, and debugging real hardware. You will design challenging, open\-ended engineering tasks drawn from your own day\-to\-day practice, run them through frontier AI models, and grade the results against a professional standard. Tasks range from compact scenarios built around a handful of files to larger, multi\-day engineering problems. In every case, the goal is the same: create a realistic problem that a competent practitioner would solve correctly, but that a frontier model currently gets wrong. This is not a traditional hardware engineering position. There is no shift work or production floor support; instead, it is a flexible, long\-form, self\-directed remote contract where clear written reasoning and physical intuition matter just as much as technical depth. **Responsibilities** * **Design Realistic Engineering Tasks:** Craft challenging circuit\- and system\-level scenarios drawn from your own expertise—complete with realistic supporting files you author yourself (schematics, simulation setups, datasheets, board files, and measurement data). * **Evaluate AI Deliverables:** Run your tasks through frontier AI models and grade their outputs (derivations, schematics, component selections, simulation setups, and design calculations) against the bar you would hold a colleague to. * **Compare \& Benchmark Models:** Evaluate side\-by\-side model responses on identical prompts and supporting files, decide which performed better, and document precisely where each fell short. * **Author Grading Rubrics:** Write detailed grading rubrics and the technical rationale behind your judgments to define what a physically sound, complete deliverable requires. * **Flag Model Failures with Evidence:** Identify and document concrete errors including unstated or incorrect assumptions, sign and unit errors, unphysical results, invalid component or topology choices, misapplied approximations, fabricated datasheet values, misread schematics/plots, and off\-brief interpretations. * **Cross\-Domain Contribution \& Peer Review:** Contribute across analog, RF/mixed\-signal, power electronics, embedded/controls, signal processing, electromagnetics, photonics, and energy systems, while reviewing and refining tasks built by fellow engineers. **Representative Task Types** * Specifying a circuit or sizing a power stage with defensible component tradeoffs. * Stabilizing a feedback control loop. * Closing an RF or optical link budget. * Debugging a noisy or failing mixed\-signal chain from measurement data. * Conducting a mixed\-signal or embedded telemetry PCB power and thermal design review. * Creating a photonic test\-circuit layout and verification setup. **Domain Qualifications** * **Hands\-On Industry Experience:** 2\+ years of industry experience in circuit or electronics engineering (5\+ years is a plus), currently or very recently performing technical design, simulation, and debug work at an individual\-contributor level. * **Specialty Depth:** Practical hardware experience in at least one core discipline: * Analog, RF, and mixed\-signal circuits * Power electronics and electric power/energy systems * Embedded systems, firmware/hardware, and controls * PCB and board\-level hardware design * Signal processing, electromagnetics, antennas, and microwaves * Electronic devices, materials, photonics, and optoelectronics * **Circuit \& System Mastery:** Strong command of circuit analysis and design tradeoffs, with the ability to defend both component\-level and system\-level engineering decisions. * **Tooling Fluency:** Hands\-on proficiency in standard industry tools—including circuit simulation (SPICE or similar), schematic capture and PCB layout tools, lab instrumentation, and MATLAB or Python for engineering analysis. * **Education:** An in\-progress or completed Bachelor’s degree or higher in electrical engineering, electronics engineering, or a closely related field is preferred, though verifiable hands\-on circuit and hardware experience outweighs formal degrees or PE licensure. **General Requirements** * **Analytical Rigor \& Communication:** Full professional or native\-level written and spoken English. You are meticulous, verify claims against underlying numbers and datasheets, and can clearly articulate *why* an engineering solution is wrong, not just *that* it is wrong. * **Autonomy:** Comfortable working independently in ambiguous, open\-ended scenarios and applying reviewer feedback without hand\-holding. * **AI \& Tech Literacy:** General user\-level familiarity with LLM tools (such as Claude or ChatGPT) to distinguish a well\-reasoned technical derivation from a plausible\-sounding hallucination (or the ability to pick these tools up quickly). Comfortable with cloud file tools (Google Workspace), browser profiles, desktop apps, and standard file handling (Excel/Google Sheets conversions, zip files). * **Weekly Availability:** Minimum of 10 hours per week with no weekly cap; **30–40\+ hours/week is prioritized** and full\-time capacity is available. **Compensation \& Terms** * **Pay Rate:** $40–$125/hr USD (with bonus rates available on select projects). * **Schedule:** Contract position, fully remote, with flexible scheduling. Multi\-day task timers allow you to spread work across your week. * **Location:** Must be based in the **United States, Canada, the UK, Australia, Ireland, or New Zealand**. * **Tools Provided:** Access to frontier models (including Claude and ChatGPT) is provided through the platform; no personal subscription is required. Pay: $40\.00 \- $125\.00 per hour Expected hours: No less than 10\.0 per week Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Commercial Aviation
jobs.description: Navi captures everything a pilot sees and hears and turns it into automated debrief intelligence, sortie\-level awareness that has never existed before. You're building the platform that makes that happen. Navi is live at the U.S. Air Force Test Pilot School, Embry\-Riddle, United Aviate, Sling Pilot Academy and Delta State University. You'll bring it to the next school, and make the one after that faster. **On site with customers 25 to 40% of the time** **About the role** ================== At a flight school, Navi is a device in every aircraft, a debrief after every lesson, and the picture the chief instructor, director of operations and safety officer run the school on. Forward deployed engineers make that work at each customer. You'll spend time at flight schools, universities and airline pathway programs: on the ramp, in dispatch and in the briefing room. Then you'll write the production code that turns what you saw into product, in the same codebase every customer runs. You'll own a set of customers end to end, from the devices in their aircraft to the instructors and staff who use what comes out. **Problems you'll own** ======================= **Bring a school online.** Install recording devices across a fleet. Connect avionics (Garmin G1000 and G3X, piston and turbine engines) and the school's scheduling and maintenance systems. Map roles and permissions to how the school actually runs: chief instructors, stage check pilots, dispatchers, maintenance and students. **Keep every flight recorded.** Devices live in hot cockpits on vibrating panels, with SD cards and cables that fail. When a student says their flight never showed up, you'll trace it from the aircraft through the ingest pipeline to storage, recover it, and fix the reason it went missing. Then you'll build the alerts and troubleshooting guides that catch the next failing device before a week of flights goes unrecorded. **Make the debrief right for their aircraft and procedures.** A turbine logs torque and percent power; a piston logs manifold pressure. One school's stabilized approach criteria aren't another's. You'll tune exceedances, SOP adherence and maneuver detection to each fleet and each operation, as configuration where you can and code where you must. **Build what leaders run the school on.** Student progress and completion forecasts, stalled students, upcoming stage checks and checkrides, aircraft hours to the next inspection, open squawks. You'll find the question a chief instructor or director of operations asks every Monday morning and make Navi answer it. **Make safety proactive.** Every exceedance, unstable approach and trend across every flight, not only the ones someone reported. You'll turn flight data and safety reports into the picture a safety officer runs their SMS on. **Know whether it worked.** Every feature ships with product analytics, so you can tell which schools and which roles use it and where people drop off. Adoption is the scoreboard. **Earn trust with student data.** Students see their own progress without comparisons to classmates, and names stay blurred on shared screens. You'll make the careful calls on how data about people is shown. **About you** ============= * 3\+ years shipping production software, in any programming language. You've owned a system in production end to end. * You debug across the whole stack: a device in an aircraft, a queue, a database, a web page. * Comfortable with flight data or other real\-world time series: sampling rates, units, gaps and bad sensors. * You can run a meeting with a chief instructor and a director of operations and come back with the right problem, not just the one they named. * You build with AI coding agents every day, and you know how to check their work: tests, measurements and a second look before anything ships. * You're comfortable owning outcomes when the roadmap isn't written yet. * Able to travel to customer sites regularly. **Nice to have** ================ * A pilot certificate, and a CFI or CFII even more * Flight school operations: Part 141 and Part 61 training, stage checks, scheduling and maintenance software * Avionics and engine data: Garmin G1000 and G3X logs, ADS\-B * Airline training and safety programs: AQP, FOQA/FDM, SMS * Devices in the field: embedded Linux, IoT fleets, cellular connectivity * Hands\-on aviation work: an A\&P certificate, a dispatcher certificate or line service **What this role is not** ========================= Not a sales engineer running demos. Not support working a ticket queue. Not a consultant handing over a report. You write production code that ships to every customer, and you're the reason it works where it lands. **Why this role matters** ========================= Most of what happens on a training flight is never reviewed. An instructor has minutes between lessons, and a chief instructor can learn that a student was struggling weeks after it started. Navi turns every flight into something a student can learn from and a school can act on. Getting it right at each school is how flight training gets safer and faster for everyone who comes after. **What you'll get** =================== * Early\-stage equity: real ownership in a category\-defining company * Flight training: earn your pilot's license and build with true domain expertise * Time on the ramp with the people who use what you build * A role that grows into leading Navi's commercial deployments as we scale **How we work** =============== * **Find a way.** We don't wait for permission or perfect information. Ideas come from anywhere regardless of title. Figure it out, ship it, iterate. * **Creativity over control.** First principles over process. We'd rather have a creative solution that's 80% right today than a perfect one next quarter. * **Update fast.** Come in with a hypothesis, throw it away when the data says otherwise. Ego has no place here. * **Intensity with focus.** We work hard because the mission demands it. Clarity on what matters is how we make that sustainable.

You'll work on the latest tech to solve real problems. * **A "Learn\-from\-it" Culture:** We're moving fast and building new things. We believe mistakes are learning opportunities, not failures. We seek diverse talent who are ready to make an immediate impact. We believe that innovation thrives when teams are built with a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. If you are excited by this mission, we encourage you to apply, even if your experience doesn't perfectly match every qualification listed. **Megazone Cloud is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in E\-Verify to confirm the employment eligibility of all new hires.** Compensation Range: $80K \- $120K

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.description: **About RunSybil** RunSybil is an AI security startup scaling offensive security services by automating hacker intuition. We're building Sybil: an AI\-powered penetration testing product that finds vulnerabilities faster than human hackers. Backed by strong investor support and early customer traction, our team is composed of experts from the likes of OpenAI, Meta, Mandiant, Palantir, Cruise, and Trail of Bits. **About the Role** We are hiring our first Head of Engineering to take a strong, senior team of about a dozen engineers and scale it to roughly 30 over the next year without losing the speed and ownership that got us here. You will report to our CTO, lead our engineering managers and our staff\-level engineers, and own how engineering at RunSybil plans, ships, hires, and grows. You will build the planning, hiring, and delivery systems a 30\-person org needs, and keep them light enough that engineers spend their time building. This is both a builder's role first and a management role second. You will stay close to the code and the architecture, make real technical calls, and earn the team's trust by shipping with them. We want someone who finds their own problems, operates without a playbook, and treats company resources like their own. **What You'll Do** * Own engineering execution across product, infrastructure, and SRE: how we plan, prioritize, and ship Sybil to customers on a predictable cadence. * Lead, coach, and grow our engineering managers and staff\+ engineers, and set a clear bar for what great looks like at each level. * Own the plan to grow engineering from about 12 to 30 people by Q4 2027: org design, headcount sequencing, and when to add new managers and teams. * Run engineering hiring end to end with our recruiting team, from defining roles and interview loops to closing senior candidates yourself. * Stand up the operating rhythm a scaling team needs: planning, technical design review, incident response, and delivery metrics, built from scratch and kept lean. * Partner with the CTO on architecture and technical strategy, and make the calls on reliability, scalability, and technical debt as customer usage grows. * Work directly with product, security research, and go\-to\-market leaders to turn customer needs and research breakthroughs into shipped features. * Get hands\-on in the early months: review code, pair on hard problems, and personally unblock the projects that matter most before you have a system in place to do it. * Build an engineering culture where people ship with urgency, raise their hand without waiting to be asked, and own outcomes end to end. **We're Looking For Someone Who Has A Mix of The Following** * 10\+ years of software engineering experience, with 4\+ years leading engineering managers or multi\-team engineering organizations. * A track record of scaling an engineering team through hypergrowth at an early\-stage company, ideally from around 10 to 30\+ engineers. * Deep technical credibility in distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and building customer\-facing products, with the ability to go deep in design reviews and code. * Experience building engineering processes from scratch and keeping them as light as the stage allows. * A strong recruiting record: you have hired senior engineers and managers, built interview loops, and closed candidates who had other options. * The builder mindset we hire for across the company: you operate without a playbook, find your own problems, move with urgency, and treat company resources like your own. * Experience shipping AI or LLM\-powered products is a plus. * Security or cybersecurity product experience, especially offensive security, is a strong plus but not required. **Location**: New York City metro area, hybrid. Candidates must be based in or open to relocation. **Benefits** * **Health coverage:** Medical (Anthem), dental, and vision (Guardian). RunSybil pays 100% of employee premiums and 79\-87% of dependent premiums, depending on plan and tier. * **Time off:** Uncapped PTO with an encouraged minimum of 20 days a year, plus 13 company holidays * **Parental leave:** 12 weeks of paid leave for all new parents, including birthing, non\-birthing, adoptive, and foster parents. * **Family building:** $10,000 lifetime reimbursement for fertility, surrogacy, and adoption\-related medical expenses. * **Financial:** 401(k) with pre\-tax and Roth options, health care and dependent care FSAs, and pre\-tax commuter benefits. * **Income protection:** Company\-paid life, AD\&D, short\-term disability, and long\-term disability insurance. * **Wellbeing:** One Medical primary care, mental health support through Spring Health and a 24/7 employee assistance program, a Wellhub fitness and wellness membership, personal health care navigation through Rightway, and more.NYC area. **Compensation:** The base salary for this full\-time position ranges from $275,000\-$325,000\. In addition to base salary, we offer meaningful equity. We want everyone here to have ownership in what we're building. Diverse teams build better products. RunSybil is committed to hiring people who bring different perspectives, lived experiences, and backgrounds to our work. We encourage candidates of all races, ethnicities, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, disability or medical conditions, ages, religions, and socioeconomic backgrounds to apply. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. If you're excited about this role but don't check every box, we still want to hear from you.

jobs.title: Inference Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: **The role** ============ As an inference infrastructure engineer, you’ll build and operate the systems that deploy Applied Compute’s models and serve production inference traffic. You’ll own model deployment, GPU capacity management, request routing, and recovery from failures, balancing reliability, latency, and serving efficiency. You’ll partner with research engineers to support new models and with inference performance engineers to bring execution improvements into production. Your work will make it possible to release models safely, securely, and serve changing workloads reliably. **What You’ll Do** * Design, build, and maintain the inference APIs developers use to interact with our models, supporting streaming responses, tool use, structured outputs, and multimodal inputs. * Build services that take model checkpoints through deployment, health checks, staged rollout, and rollback. Give engineers a dependable way to launch endpoints, inspect their behavior, and update model versions or configurations. * Develop GPU placement and autoscaling systems that account for model memory requirements, startup time, hardware availability, and changing demand. * Build routing, queueing, and admission\-control policies that balance latency, throughput, and GPU utilization while maintaining isolation between workloads and protecting the service from overload. * Make deployments resilient to failed processes, unhealthy GPUs, and unavailable hosts through failure detection, recovery, and replacement. * Establish service objectives, telemetry, and load tests that make serving behavior understandable. Investigate incidents across service code, model servers, networking, and cluster resources, and turn recurring failures into lasting fixes. * Partner with inference performance engineers to evaluate serving configurations under representative traffic and safely deploy improvements without disrupting active workloads. **What We’re Looking For** * Strong software engineering skills and experience building and maintaining backend services or distributed systems in production. * Proficiency in Go, Rust, Python, C\+\+, or a comparable language, with the ability to navigate unfamiliar code and make well\-tested changes. * Experience designing systems that coordinate work across multiple machines, including an understanding of concurrency, state management, and partial failures. * Good judgment about queueing, timeouts, retries, backpressure, and resource isolation, and how these choices affect a service under load. * Practical knowledge of Linux, containers, and cloud infrastructure. You can investigate problems that cross software and infrastructure boundaries. * Experience supporting software after release: diagnosing incidents, improving monitoring, and making changes safely while users depend on the service. * Ownership and clear technical communication: you can work through open\-ended problems, use measurements to guide decisions, explain tradeoffs, and stay accountable for the result after release. We welcome strong backend and distributed systems engineers who are moving into inference. Prior experience with model serving or GPU infrastructure is helpful, but not required. **Nice to Have** * Experience managing accelerator fleets or supporting inference workloads with changing model sizes, traffic patterns, and hardware requirements. * Familiarity with model\-serving fundamentals, including GPU memory constraints, model loading, and the different resource demands of prefill and decode. * Experience deploying or operating serving engines such as vLLM, SGLang, or TensorRT\-LLM. * Experience extending Kubernetes through controllers or building software for workload placement and capacity management. * Familiarity with GPU health diagnostics, high\-speed interconnects, or inference deployments that span multiple machines. * Experience building foundational infrastructure at an early\-stage company or contributing to open\-source systems software. The U.S. base salary range for this full\-time position is 275\-400k. Total compensation includes equity and a comprehensive benefits package. Individual compensation depends on qualifications, experience, skills, and work location. **Benefits \& Logistics** ========================= This role is based in San Francisco. We work from our office in the Mission. We offer: * Competitive compensation and equity * 100% employer\-paid health insurance coverage for you and your family * Unlimited PTO * Paid parental leave * Daily lunches and dinners * Transportation and relocation support * 5% 401(k) match We sponsor visas. While we can't guarantee success for every candidate or role, if you're the right fit, we're committed to working through the process with you. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. As set forth in Applied Compute’s Equal Employment Opportunity policy, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected group status under any applicable law.

This is a hands\-on engineering role focused on custom applications, laboratory systems, systems integration, data, workflow automation, and emerging AI capabilities. The position partners directly with laboratory, operations, and business teams to identify opportunities to eliminate manual processes, connect disconnected systems, and deliver reliable and maintainable technology solutions. The role also serves as a technical bridge between specialized laboratory and operational systems and the broader enterprise technology environment. **Applications, data and AI** * Design, build and maintain internal business applications, web tools and REST APIs from requirements through deployment. * Design and administer relational databases (SQL Manage Instance): schema, indexing, performance tuning, backup and security. * Build data pipelines and integrations between business systems, and deliver reporting from them. * Develop AI solutions on Azure, such as assistants over company documents, retrieval\-augmented generation, and agents that call internal systems. * Support existing custom applications and integrations throughout their lifecycle. * Maintain source code, version support or recover internally developed solutions. **IT infrastructure and Administration** * Serve as the escalation resource for issues involving custom applications, laboratory systems, automation, integrations, and associated databases. * Collaborate with Help Desk and infrastructure resources when issues cross application, endpoint, identity, network, or cloud boundaries. * Coordinate with software, laboratory equipment, and technology vendors on advanced technical issues. * Train users and IT personnel on internally developed applications and workflows. * Support the administration of user accounts, groups, licenses and access in Microsoft Entra ID and Microsoft 365, including onboarding, offboarding and permission changes. * Enroll, configure and maintain end\-user devices in Intune, including compliance policies, app deployment and Windows 11 upgrades. * Install, set up, and troubleshoot hardware at company sites: workstations, printers, lab peripherals, network switches and access points. * Work escalated help desk tickets to resolution, and keep runbooks, asset records, and network documentation up to date. * Prepare evaluations of software or hardware and recommend improvements or upgrades. * Assist with infrastructure lifecycle planning, hardware refreshes, migrations, and technology deployments. * Maintain accurate infrastructure documentation, diagrams, configurations, and operating procedures. * Monitor infrastructure performance, availability, capacity, and system health. **Required qualifications** * Bachelor's degree (four\-year) in engineering or computer science. * 5\+ years of combined experience in IT infrastructure and software development (years to confirm). * Hands\-on Azure a 100 or more users. * Proficiency in at least one application language (C\#/.NET or Python) and one scripting language (PowerShell) (stack to confirm). * Strong SQL skills, including database design and performance tuning. * Experience building or deploying AI solutions, such as LLM\-based applications using Azure OpenAI or similar services. * Experience with physical hardware: servers, network equipment, workstations and peripherals. * Solid grasp of networking (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, VPN, firewalls) and security practice. * Experience with Git and CI/CD pipelines. * Ability to travel as required and a valid driver's license. software (FactoryTalk View, Ignition) and industrial protocols (Ethernet/IP, OPC UA, MQTT). * Experience linking plant\-floor systems to business systems and databases. * Microsoft certifications such as AZ\-104 (Azure Administrator), AZ\-204 (Azure Developer), AI\-102 (Azure AI Engineer) or MD\-102 (Endpoint Administrator). * Experience with Power Platform, Power BI, or Microsoft Fabric. * Experience as a sole or lead IT resource in a small or mid\-sized company. **Who succeeds in this role:** * Self\-directed. You explain technical decisions to non\-technical colleagues and document your work. * Reliable when remote. You stay responsive and visible without an office around you. **Work environment and travel** * Remote position, worked from a home office with reliable high\-speed internet. * Travel to company sites for hardware installs, upgrades, project work and urgent on\-site support, sometimes at short notice. * Occasional evening or weekend work for maintenance windows and critical incidents. * On\-site work may include lifting and installing equipment and, where applicable, time on a production floor. jobs.title: Lead Machine Learning Engineer - News
jobs.description: **Job Requirements** **Disney Entertainment \& ESPN Technology** On any given day at Disney Entertainment \& ESPN Technology, we’re reimagining ways to create magical viewing experiences for the world’s most beloved stories while also transforming Disney’s media business for the future. Whether that’s evolving our streaming and digital products in new and immersive ways, powering worldwide advertising and distribution to maximize flexibility and efficiency, or delivering Disney’s unmatched entertainment and sports content, every day is a moment to make a difference to partners and to hundreds of millions of people around the world. *A few reasons why we think you’d love working for Disney Entertainment \& ESPN Technology* * **Building the future of Disney’s media business:** DE\&E Technologists are designing and building the infrastructure that will power Disney’s media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come. * **Reach \& Scale:** The products and platforms this group builds and operates delight millions of consumers every minute of every day – from Disney\+ and Hulu, to ABC News and Entertainment, to ESPN and ESPN\+, and much more. * **Innovation:** We develop and execute groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms and enhance how audiences experience sports, entertainment \& news. Product Engineering is a unified team responsible for the engineering of Disney Entertainment \& ESPN digital and streaming products and platforms. This includes product engineering, media engineering, quality assurance, engineering behind personalization, commerce, lifecycle, and identity. **Job Summary:** The News ML team is responsible for building robust data pipelines and advanced machine learning platforms that deliver personalized experiences to users across ABC News, Good Morning America, and local news stations. Our services leverage machine learning models to enable real\-time content personalization and targeted distribution across web, mobile, and connected TV platforms, ensuring that users receive the most relevant and engaging news content tailored to their interests. Our mission is to drive seamless, resilient, and low\-latency personalized content delivery at scale, while continuously advancing our ML infrastructure and recommendation algorithms. As a Lead Machine Learning Engineer, you will play a leading role in shaping the technical direction of the News ML Platform. You will drive infrastructure for scalable learning, inference, and monitoring, conduct in\-depth data exploration and analysis, and collaborate across product, data, and engineering teams to power exceptional, personalized guest experiences. Your work will directly support strategic initiatives to help shape the roadmap for algorithmic innovation while ensuring that solutions are scalable, impactful, and aligned with stakeholder needs. **Responsibilities and Duties of the Role:** * Own complex technical initiatives end\-to\-end, from technical design through production deployment and operational excellence * Design and develop infrastructure supporting the full cycle of machine learning, including data pipelines and workflow orchestration, data discovery and quality tools, and feature libraries * Drive data and ML\-driven solutions for diverse engineering use cases such as recommendation systems, object detection, autogenerated tagging solutions, RAGs * Partner with product, editorial, and engineering stakeholders to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions * Strategically prioritize initiatives and technical workstreams to deliver the highest\-impact and most time\-sensitive outcomes, while proactively identifying, communicating, and mitigating risks to ensure successful execution * Champion engineering best practices across code quality, testing, CI/CD, observability, and incident response * Mentor and coach engineers, fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement * Contribute to technical documentation and promote knowledge sharing across teams **Required Education, Experience/Skills/Training:** Minimum and Preferred. Inclusive of Licenses/Certs (include functional experience as well as behavioral attributes and/or leadership capabilities) Basic Qualifications * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Statistics, Math, or comparable field of study, and/or equivalent work experience * 7\+ years of software engineering experience * 5\+ years of hands\-on experience developing and deploying machine learning systems in production * Expertise in data science, deep learning algorithms, or statistical methods to solve real\-world engineering problems * Comfortable operating at all levels of the predictive stack, including data collection, data analysis, feature engineering, batch training and low\-latency online serving * Experience designing and developing backend microservices for large\-scale distributed systems using REST * Experience with cloud infrastructure, preferably AWS (Step Functions, Lambda, Glue, SQS, SNS, Personalize) * Familiarity with developing and deploying Spark and ML pipelines * Hands\-on experience with big data technologies such as Databricks, Kinesis, Kafka * Proven leadership, coaching, and mentoring skills, with the ability to inspire and empower a team towards achieving business goals * Experience with observability tools for metrics, logging, and monitoring such as Datadog * Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments * Excellent communication skills and a commitment to collaboration in a fast\-paced, guest\-focused environment **Disclaimer** PAY TRANSPARENCY The hiring range for this position in New York, NY is $182,400\- $244,600 and for Glendale, CA is $174,100 \- $233,500\. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long\-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. This position is with Disney Entertainment \& Sports LLC, which is part of a business we call Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product \& Technology. jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: **About Ayo** ------------- We are a venture\-backed early\-stage startup developing processors specialized for machine learning. The processor will provide orders of magnitude improvement in speed and power efficiency with a goal of unseating the GPU as the dominant computing platform for machine learning. **The Role** ------------ We're looking for a hands\-on machine learning engineer to join our founding team and get models running on our photonic processor. You'll take models from PyTorch to prototype silicon and digital twins, figure out what breaks, fix it, and feed what you learn straight back to the hardware team. This is a builder role: you'll own real problems end to end, move fast, and work shoulder to shoulder with photonics, ASIC, and FPGA engineers who are building something no one has built before. No prior hardware experience required. If you're early in your career, fresh out of a PhD, and itching to work on something genuinely new, we want to hear from you. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Partner with our engineering teams to train models that run successfully on Ayo chips * Deploy and run trained models on our prototype hardware and digital twins, and turn them into working demonstrations on our chips * Build and adapt training and inference pipelines for a compute environment that doesn't behave like a GPU * Work directly with hardware engineers to test ideas, find bottlenecks, and shape the processor architecture with what you learn * Build the tooling, benchmarks, and software infrastructure our machine learning work runs on * Help show the world what Ayo's processor can do by supporting demos and go\-to\-market work **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * PhD or MS in machine learning, computer science, physics, electrical engineering, or a related field (recent grads welcome), or equivalent hands\-on experience * Has built and trained neural networks from scratch, and understands how they work under the hood * Full\-stack ML engineering skills: data pipelines, training, evaluation, and deployment * Fluent in Python and PyTorch (TensorFlow or JAX also welcome) * A bias toward action: you'd rather ship a working prototype than perfect a plan * Excitement about novel hardware. You don't need photonics or silicon experience, just curiosity and the drive to learn fast **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience with distributed training or large\-scale compute * Model optimization experience such as quantization, pruning, compilers, or custom kernels (CUDA, Triton) * Interpretability or explainability work * Any exposure to hardware, FPGAs, or analog or in\-memory compute **Why Ayo** ----------- * You'll be a founding machine learning team member, shaping how we deploy machine learning on an entirely new kind of processor. * We are working on a genuinely hard and interesting problem: unseating the GPU as the dominant machine learning compute platform. * Early\-stage means real ownership, real impact, and meaningful equity. * Competitive salary. Equity commensurate with stage and seniority. Benefits package including health, dental, and vision. * Fully onsite in Boston \- we are a collaborative, in\-person team.

jobs.title: Microsoft 365 Administrator & Adoption Specialist (SRPS SOFTWARE ENGINEER II)
jobs.description: **Introduction** ---------------- The Maryland State Retirement Agency is the administrator of the Maryland State Retirement and Pension System (“System”). The System is a defined benefit retirement system covering State and local government employees of Maryland. It’s composed of twelve (12\) separate retirement and pension systems with over 50 different rule sets. The System has over 433,000 participants (customers), including 210,000 members who are actively employed and participating in the System, 179,000 payees who receive a monthly payment from the System, and 44,000 vested members who are no longer actively employed but have earned a benefit that will become payable at a future date. Located in Baltimore’s Central Business District, SRPS offers a purpose\-driven workplace with modern amenities, including panoramic city and harbor views, renovated common areas, upgraded elevators, and an on\-site café. Employees enjoy comprehensive state benefits including medical, dental, prescription coverage, generous paid leave, participation in the state pension system, and supplemental retirement savings options (401(k), 457(b), and more). Additional perks include an on\-site fitness center with showers and lockers, 24/7 building security, and easy access to restaurants, shops, public transit, and major highways. If you're seeking a career with impact, stability, and a supportive environment, explore opportunities with MSRPS. This position is eligible for a hybrid telework schedule after successfully completing the defined required training period. **GRADE** --------- STD0019 **LOCATION OF POSITION** ------------------------ 120 East Baltimore Street Baltimore, Maryland 21202 **Main Purpose of Job** ----------------------- The Microsoft 365 Administrator \& Adoption Specialist keeps the agency’s SharePoint, Teams, and OneDrive environment well organized and secure, and helps employees use these tools effectively to share files and collaborate. Reporting to the Director of Digital Workplace Innovation, this role administers sites, permissions, and sharing, supports department site owners, designs and delivers training, prepares departments for the move to SharePoint, and maintains the agency’s dataset and software asset inventories. **POSITION DUTIES** ------------------- Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: * Administer SharePoint Online, Teams, and OneDrive, including sites, permissions, sharing, and guest access • Develop and deliver training programs, guides, videos, and quick\-reference materials • Prepare departments for the move to SharePoint and lead adoption through coaching and a champions network • Support department site owners and apply governance standards such as naming, metadata, and retention • Serve as the go\-to resource for how\-to and escalated questions, complementing the help desk • Help select and implement a software inventory system, and maintain the software and dataset inventories • Meet with departments to document needs and recommend modern tools, test new solutions, and report adoption results **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS** -------------------------- Education: Graduation from an accredited high school or possession of a high school equivalency certificate. Experience: Three years of experience designing, developing, testing, implementing and maintaining applications systems and programs using generally accepted computer programming languages or other developmental tools. Notes: 1\. Candidates may substitute a Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in Information Technology, Computer Science, Management Information Systems, or other information technology related field for up to two years of the required experience. 2\. Candidates may substitute an Associate's degree from an accredited college or university in Information Technology, Computer Science, Management Information Systems, or other information technology related field for up to one year of the required experience. 3\. Candidates may substitute six credit hours of coursework in application analysis and programming using generally accepted computer programming languages or other developmental tools for six months of the required experience. 4\. Candidates may substitute experience in one of the following areas: operating computers, scheduling, controlling input and output or maintaining backups or data storage, processing data on computers, evaluating, implementing and maintaining hardware and software, on a year\-for\-year basis for the required education. 5\. Candidates may substitute U.S. Armed Forces military service experience in Computer Systems Programming classifications or Computer Systems Programming specialty codes in the Information Technology field of work on a year\-for\-year basis for the required experience and education. **SELECTIVE QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- **Candidates must** **possess** **the following qualification to be considered:** One year of experien  guides, videos, and quick\-reference materials * Experience maintaining data, application, or software asset inventories, or implementing an inventory or asset management tool * Experience teaching Microsoft Copilot or other AI\-enabled productivity tools * Microsoft certification such as Microsoft 365 Administrator (MS\-102\) or Teams Administrator (MS\-700\) **SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS** ------------------------ Employees in this classification may be subject to call\-in 24 hours a day and, therefore, may be required to provide the employing agency with a telephone number where the employee can be reached. Employees may be furnished with an Agency\-issued cell phone. Applicants for this classification handle sensitive data. This will require a full scope background investigation prior to appointment. A criminal conviction may be grounds for rejection of the applicant. Employees may occasionally be required to travel to field locations (i.e., disaster recovery site) and must have access to an automobile in the event a state vehicle cannot be provided. Standard mileage allowance will be paid for use of a privately owned vehicle. **SELECTION PROCESS** --------------------- Please make sure that you provide sufficient information on your application to show that you meet the minimum for this recruitment. All information concerning your qualifications must be submitted by the closing date. We will not consider information submitted after this date. Successful candidates will be ranked as Best Qualified, Better Qualified, or Qualified and placed on the employment (eligible) list for at least one year. This list will be used by the hiring agency to select employees. For education obtained outside the U.S., a copy of the equivalent American education as determined by a foreign credential evaluation service must be provided prior to hire. Due to the confidential nature of the work, selected candidates must undergo and pass a background check. **EXAMINATION PROCESS** ----------------------- The examination will consist of a rating of your education, training, and experience as presented on your application and as they relate to the requirements of the position. You may be asked to complete a supplemental questionnaire. The supplemental questionnaire may be used as part of the rating process. Therefore, it is important that you provide complete and accurate information on your application. **BENEFITS** ------------ **STATE OF MARYLAND BENEFITS** As an employee of the State of Maryland, you will have access to outstanding benefits, including health insurance, dental, and vision plans offered at a low cost. * Personal Leave \- new State employees are awarded six (6\) personnel days annually (prorated based on start date). * Annual Leave \- ten (10\) days of accumulated annual leave per year. * Sick Leave \- fifteen (15\) days of accumulated sick leave per year. * Holidays \- State employees also celebrate at least thirteen (13\) holidays per year. * Pension \- State employees earn credit towards a retirement pension. * Positions may be eligible for telework. **FURTHER INSTRUCTIONS** ------------------------ The online application process is STRONGLY preferred. If you are unable to apply online, you may mail a paper application and supplemental questionnaire to: Maryland State Retirement and Pension Systems Human Resources Section 120 E. Baltimore Street Baltimore, MD 21202 ATTN: Ashley Lohr Must be postmarked by the closing date. Email: alohr@sra.state.md.us **PLEASE DO NOT SUBMIT UNSOLICITED DOCUMENTATION** The resulting certified eligible list for this recruitment may be used for similar positions in this or other State agencies. As an equal opportunity employer, Maryland is committed to recruiting, retaining and promoting employees who are reflective of the State’s diversity. People with disabilities and bilingual candidates are encouraged to apply. We thank our Veterans for their service to our country. TTY Users: call via Maryland Relay

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description: **About Plotsy** Plotsy (plotsy.tv) is a streaming service where books come to life, exactly as written. We work with authors to adapt their novels into vBooks: limited series that follow the original book episode by episode and scene by scene, keeping the author's story, characters, and dialogue intact. We are building our library now, starting with science fiction and fantasy, and the Plotsy app is available on iPhone, iPad, Apple TV, Android, and Roku. Behind the service is our own AI\-powered production studio. It lets a small creative team produce a full series, with people reviewing and approving every creative step. **About the Role** We are hiring our first Product Manager to own the production platform our creative team and production partners use to make every series. Your users are professionals \- showrunners, producers, editors, and partner studios \- not viewers. You will shape and prioritize what gets built, work side by side with engineers as it is built, and make sure the people who use it get the most out of it. You will report directly to the CTO and work closely with our engineering and AI research teams. **What You'll Do** * Own the product backlog: gather feature requests and bugs from the production team and partners, and rank them by impact. * Turn requests into clear specs with user stories and acceptance criteria that engineers can build from. * Work day\-to\-day with engineers as features are built, making scope decisions and trade\-offs quickly. * Champion the platform internally: demo new releases, write release notes, keep user guides current, and train creative staff on new releases. * Measure what matters \- time saved per finished hour of content, adoption, quality, and check that each release delivered what it promised. **What We're Looking For** * 5\+ years in product management, ideally for internal tools, workflow software, or a platform used by professionals. * Experience owning a backlog with an engineering team: writing specs, prioritizing, and shipping. * Strong technical literacy, without needing to write production code. * Daily, hands\-on use of AI tools for research, specs, analysis, and prototyping. **Nice to Have** * Product experience with generative AI or machine\-learning features. * Background in film, TV, animation, VFX, or post\-production. * Experience with Linear, Figma, and basic SQL. Pay: $105,000\.00 \- $115,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Paid time off Work Location: Remote
