jobs.title: Research Technician - Building Energy Sciences
jobs.description: **Posting Title** ================= Research Technician \- Building Energy Sciences . **Location** ============ CO \- Golden . **Position Type** ================= Regular . **Hours Per Week** ================== 40 . **Working at NLR** ================== NLR is located at the foothills of the Rocky Mountains in Golden, Colorado is the nation's primary laboratory for energy systems research and development. Join the National Laboratory of the Rockies (NLR), where world\-class scientists, engineers, and experts are accelerating energy innovation through breakthrough research and systems integration. From our mission to our collaborative culture, NLR stands out in the research community for its commitment to an affordable and secure energy future. Spanning foundational science to applied systems engineering and analysis, we focus on solving complex challenges to deliver advanced, secure, reliable, and cost\-effective energy solutions. Our work helps strengthen U.S. industries, support job creation, and promote national economic growth. At NLR, you'll find a mission\-driven environment supported by state\-of\-the\-art facilities, multidisciplinary research teams, and strong collaborations with industry, academia, and other national laboratories. We offer robust professional development opportunities, and a competitive benefits package designed to support your career and well\-being. **Job Description** =================== NLR's Building and Industrial Equipment Research group has an opening for a research technician. This position will support hands\-on research and development of building components and systems with a focus on new efficient and affordable technologies. The technologies of interest include a full range of HVAC systems, water heaters, refrigeration, major appliances, lighting, and energy management systems. The successful candidate will assist in development, preparation and operation of R\&D experiments under supervision of engineering staff. This includes working with engineers and scientists to design, fabricate and conduct experiments, to set up computers and controls, and to monitor equipment. The key duties of this position include: * Leads and is responsible for maintenance of experiments, sensors and laboratory facilities. Job requires ability to troubleshoot and maintain complex mechanical and electrical equipment and intricate experiments. * Special attention to all aspects of safety is a priority; Technician must maintain a safe operating environment in accordance with NLR’s policies and procedures. * Work responsibilities may include supporting field test work including limited travel. . **Basic Qualifications** ======================== High School Diploma or equivalent and 7 or more years of experience or equivalent relevant education/experience. Or, relevant Associate's Degree or certification program of comparable scope and 5 or more years of experience or equivalent relevant education/experience. Extensive knowledge in specialized focused support functions. A comprehensive acquaintance with and understanding of both general and detailed aspects of technical support activities, and their practical application to a wide variety of problems and situations specific to the discipline or field supported. Strong research techniques and practices. Strong communication, interpersonal, project management and customer relations skills. **\* Must meet educational requirements prior to employment start date.** **Additional Required Qualifications** ====================================== * High School Diploma or equivalent and 7 or more years of experience or equivalent relevant education/experience. Or, relevant Associate's Degree or certification program of comparable scope and 5 or more years of experience or equivalent relevant education/experience. * The successful candidate will be able to sit for long periods of time, safely lift loads up to 50 lbs, and work safely from a ladder for extended periods. * Ability to interpret schematics and construct apparatuses to match; to generate schematics and drawings representing an as\-built system; and to clearly explain the function of components and the system design decisions. · Prior experience in machining, welding, electronics, and fabrication · Prior experience in residential/commercial HVAC systems and controls * The successful candidate will be computer literate including full fluency in Microsoft Office. * Familiarity with and commitment to security, health, and safety. Demonstrated ability to work independently. **Preferred Qualifications** ============================ · 7 plus years of experience in relevant technical field · Universal EPA certification for handling refrigerants · Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline · Previous experience with data acquisition set\-up and use, including signal wiring, circuits and sensors · Proficiency in electrical power wiring . **Job Application Submission Window** ===================================== The anticipated closing window for application submission is up to 30 days and may be extended as needed. **Annual Salary Range (based on full\-time 40 hours per week)** =============================================================== Job Profile: Research Technician IV / Annual Salary Range: $66,400 \- $109,600 Job Profile: Research Technician III / Annual Salary Range: $57,900 \- $95,500 Job Profile: Research Technician V / Annual Salary Range: $76,600 \- $126,400 NLR takes into consideration a candidate’s education, training, and experience, expected quality and quantity of work, required travel (if any), external market and internal value, including seniority and merit systems, and internal pay alignment when determining the salary level for potential new employees. In compliance with the Colorado Equal Pay for Equal Work Act, a potential new employee’s salary history will not be used in compensation decisions. **Benefits Summary** ==================== Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance; short\*\- and long\-term disability insurance; pension benefits\*; 403(b) Employee Savings Plan with employer match\*; life and accidental death and dismemberment (AD\&D) insurance; personal time off (PTO) and sick leave; paid holidays; and tuition reimbursement\*. NLR employees may be eligible for, but are not guaranteed, performance\-, merit\-, and achievement\- based awards that include a monetary component. Some positions may be eligible for relocation expense reimbursement. Limited\-term positions are not eligible for long\-term disability or tuition reimbursement. **\*** Based on eligibility rules **Badging Requirement** ======================= NLR is subject to Department of Energy (DOE) access restrictions. All employees must also be able to obtain and maintain a federal Personal Identity Verification (PIV) card as required by Homeland Security Presidential Directive 12 (HSPD\-12\), which includes a favorable background investigation. **Drug Free Workplace** ======================= NLR is committed to maintaining a drug\-free workplace in accordance with the federal Drug\-Free Workplace Act and complies with federal laws prohibiting the possession and use of illegal drugs. Under federal law, marijuana remains an illegal drug. If you are offered employment at NLR, you must pass a pre\-employment drug test prior to commencing employment. Unless prohibited by state or local law, the pre\-employment drug test will include marijuana. If you test positive on the pre\-employment drug test, your offer of employment may be withdrawn. **Submission Guidelines** ========================= Please note that in order to be considered an applicant for any position at NLR you must submit an application form for each position for which you believe you are qualified. Applications are not kept on file for future positions. Please include a cover letter and resume with each position application. . **Equal Opportunity Employer** ============================== All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard basis of age (40 and over), color, disability, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, domestic partner status, military or veteran status, national origin/ancestry, race, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding), sexual orientation, and any other applicable status protected by federal, state, or local laws. **Reasonable Accommodations** **E** **\-Verify** **www.dhs.gov/E\-Verify** For information about right to work E\-Verify is a registered trademark of the U.S. Department of Homeland Security. This business uses E\-Verify in its hiring practices to achieve a lawful workforce.

jobs.title: Robotics Software Engineer - Core/System
jobs.description: **Robotics Software Engineer \- Core/System** --------------------------------------------- Location: San Francisco, CA (full time, in\-person) **Company Overview** Our mission is to accelerate the construction of critical infrastructure on Earth while pioneering technologies to enable humanity to build beyond Earth. Starting with the Cosmic\-1a system that installs solar panels 10x faster than today’s methods, our goal is to help transition the world to a clean energy future and laying the groundwork for the future of autonomous construction. **The Role** As a core/system engineer you will contribute to the foundational software that makes performant robotics possible at Cosmic. You will be expected to contribute to code responsible for supporting everything in the stack from low\-level health monitoring, middleware and logging of sensor data, efficient online inference of ML networks for perception, all the way back down to real\-time controllers planning and commanding robot motion. This work will involve collaborating with different owners across software, as well as electrical and hardware engineering to implement and improve features. This is a rare opportunity to: * Work on hard, meaningful problems that impact the future of infrastructure and energy. * Collaborate with a world\-class team from NASA, SpaceX, Google, Amazon, Zoox, Tesla, Nuro, Built Robotics, and others. * Rapidly grow, learn, and lead within a quickly scaling company. **Responsibilities** * Design, write, profile, debug, optimize, and harden on\-bot software * Contribute to disciplined code review, and enforce best practices in software test design * Rapidly prototype code to prove out new features and hardware capabilities * Understand that while development is the primary responsibility, many problems require electrical or hardware solutions, and being willing to dive into these as well * Occasionally travel to the field to test, validate, and train operators on features developed **Requirements** * At least 3\-4 years of professional software engineering experience, preferably in robotics * Strong proficiency in modern C\+\+ and comfortable with Python * Prior work developing software for concurrent/multithreaded latency\-critical applications on resource\-constrained (embedded) Linux environments * Strong understanding of computer architecture fundamentals, and how it should inform software design on heterogeneous/NUMA systems * Excellent written and verbal communication skills * Thrives in ambiguity and incomplete information **Bonus** * Experience developing software according to ISO 26262 or other similar functional safety standards * Proven track record building systems involving coordination across multiple compute units, and a strong grasp of networking fundamentals * Skill and desire to optimize existing codepaths using CUDA/other GPGPU paradigms * Familiarity with QNX, SafeRTOS environments

jobs.title: Salesforce Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Summary** NewEdge Capital Group is seeking a Salesforce Forward Deployed Engineer who sits at the intersection of Salesforce expertise and AI. This is not a traditional developer role. An FDE works directly with the business, shapes solutions, owns outcomes, and builds. You will design and deliver intelligent Salesforce solutions that combine deep platform knowledge with AI capabilities, including integrating Claude and other AI tools into Salesforce workflows to automate operations, surface insights, and fundamentally change how advisors and operations teams work. You will be embedded with business stakeholders across client services, wealth management, and operations, translating real problems into working solutions that ship fast and compound over time. *What makes this role different:* You are not writing code behind a ticket queue. You are in the room with the business, identifying where AI and Salesforce together can change how work gets done, and then you build it. You ship fast, measure what works, and iterate. If you've been waiting for a role where you can combine deep Salesforce skills with real AI engineering and see it make an impact every week, this is it. **Key Responsibilities** * **AI\-Powered Salesforce Solutions:** Build intelligent features that connect Claude and other AI tools directly into Salesforce workflows. Design solutions where AI reads from Salesforce data (accounts, cases, client records) and takes action: automating case triage, generating client communications, surfacing cross\-sell opportunities, preparing meeting briefs, and streamlining advisor workflows. Think beyond automation. Build solutions that make the platform smarter over time. * **Forward Deployed Engagement**: Sit with the business, not behind a ticket queue. Understand advisor and operations workflows firsthand. Identify high\-impact problems and build solutions without waiting for a formal project to be scoped. Own the outcome from discovery through deployment, not just the code. * **Salesforce Architecture and Development**: Design and build Lightning Web Components (LWC), custom workflows, flows, validation rules, and triggers. Create user\-friendly interfaces using Lightning, JavaScript, and CSS. Architect solutions that are scalable, maintainable, and built to last. * **Financial Services Cloud (FSC):** Leverage Salesforce FSC to optimize workflows for financial operations. Design solutions tailored to wealth management, advisory services, and client onboarding use cases across multiple business units. * **Integration and Data Connectivity**: Develop and manage integrations with third\-party systems including Orion, Addepar, SofTek, and other financial platforms using REST APIs. Build the connectors that feed AI with the data it needs to be useful. Ensure seamless data flow and synchronization between Salesforce and the firm's broader data ecosystem. * **Prompt Engineering and AI Design**: Design effective prompts, context windows, and AI interaction patterns within Salesforce. Understand how to structure data so AI tools can reason over it effectively. Build evaluation frameworks to measure whether AI\-powered features are actually improving outcomes. * **CI/CD and Deployment**: Lead Salesforce deployments adhering to CI/CD best practices. Manage version control, automated testing, and smooth deployments across environments. Experience with tools like Copado, Azure DevOps, or GitHub Actions for Salesforce release management. * **Security and Governance**: Implement and manage OAuth, SSO, and API security for both Salesforce and AI integrations. Ensure AI features comply with data governance policies, including what data AI can access, what it can generate, and how outputs are reviewed. **Required Skills and Qualifications:** *Required:* * 5 years of Salesforce development experience with strong proficiency in LWC, Apex, JavaScript, and CSS. * Hands\-on experience integrating AI tools (Claude, GPT, or similar) into business applications, not just personal use but production\-grade, user\-facing solutions. * Experience with REST APIs for integrations across multiple systems. * Strong understanding of CI/CD processes and deployment best practices. * Hands\-on experience with OAuth, SSO, and Salesforce security protocols. * Familiarity with Salesforce Financial Services Cloud and financial industry platforms like Orion or Addepar. * Proven ability to work directly with business stakeholders, not just technical teams. * Comfort operating with ambiguity, moving fast, and owning outcomes end to end. *Preferred*: * Experience building MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations or AI agent workflows. * Familiarity with knowledge retrieval patterns (RAG, embeddings, vector search) as they apply to CRM data. * Experience in wealth management, financial advisory, or RIA operations. * Track record of shipping AI\-powered features that users actually adopt and rely on. *Salary Range:* $140,000 \- $160,000 annually, based on experience, plus eligibility to participate in the company's bonus program

jobs.title: Senior Agentic AI/LLM Engineer, Coverage Intelligence
jobs.description: **YOUR ROLE** As a Senior Agentic AI / LLM Engineer on the Coverage Intelligence team, you design and build the AI systems that turn complex insurance documents into reliable, explainable coverage intelligence inside the Digital Exchange, powered by DeX ai. You own problems end to end, from understanding unstructured documents to building agents that reason about coverage, and you hold that work to a measurable standard of accuracy. team builds with AI as the technology evolves. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** * Design, build and own production AI systems for document understanding and coverage analysis. * Build agentic workflows that combine models, tools and human review, and recognize when a decision needs an expert. * Ground outputs in source documents and domain knowledge so every result is traceable and explainable. * Drive accuracy through evaluation, experimentation and error analysis against expert\-labeled data. * Make sound trade\-offs across models and providers on accuracy, cost and latency. * Partner with domain experts and engineers to turn expert judgment into durable system behavior. * Set and drive the team’s technical direction for AI and agent architecture as LLM capabilities evolve. * Lead design reviews and establish engineering and evaluation standards for production LLM systems. * Mentor engineers and raise the team’s AI engineering capability. * Shape the Coverage Intelligence roadmap with Product, translating business goals into technical strategy. * Other duties and responsibilities as assigned. **YOUR LOCATION** This is a fully remote role, with the exception of onboarding and optional in\-office events. **SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS** * 7\+ years’ experience in software engineering or applied machine learning, including 3\+ years building LLM applications in production. * Strong Python skills, including typed schemas for structured output (e.g., Pydantic). * Hands\-on experience extracting structured data from complex documents using PDF parsing, OCR and vision\-language models. * Experience with agentic patterns such as tool use, multi\-step workflows, self\-verification and human\-in\-the\-loop review. * Experience with retrieval\-augmented generation, embeddings and source\-grounded output. * A rigorous approach to evaluation: defining metrics, building test sets and doing systematic error analysis. * Track record of leading the architecture of production AI systems end to end. * Experience mentoring engineers and influencing technical decisions across teams. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including working directly with domain jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Architect · Builder · Owner of the data foundation** Credit unions trust us with the data behind every teller transaction, member relationship, and lending decision. We run that data at scale on a foundation that is proven in production, and we are not content to stand still. We are pushing into a multi\-tenant, AI\-native data platform where analysts, products, and AI agents can all explore data with confidence, and we are doing it faster than the industry expects. We want the person who helps us set the pace. **The mission** Own the next generation of our data platform. You will architect how data moves out of the operational systems of record, where it lands (Snowflake, Postgres, and whatever proves better), and how it is modeled, secured, and served to applications and AI. You will make the hard calls and build alongside a team that ships. The industry has not settled how this is done. We intend to show them. **What you’ll do** * Set the architecture. Decide how operational, analytical, and AI workloads fit together, and defend the trade\-offs in plain language. * Build, don’t just draw. Ship pipelines, models, and platform pieces that run in production for real institutions where accuracy is not optional. * Bridge old and new. Learn how the legacy systems feeding our core actually behave, then design the path to modern paradigms without breaking what tellers and members rely on. * Own reporting end to end. Create, manage, and continuously improve the reports credit unions run their business on, from operational and regulatory staples to self\-service and AI\-assisted analysis. Accurate, fast, versioned, and trusted. * Make data AI\-ready. Build the semantic layer, quality, lineage, and tenant\-safe access patterns that let people and agents explore data with confidence. * Use AI as leverage. Work the way the best engineers now do: pairing with coding agents, automating toil, and raising the bar on speed and quality. * Raise the room. Set standards, mentor, and help shape the rest of the data team. **You might be our person if** * You have shipped data platforms end to end and can point to what you owned, not just what you attended. * You are deeply fluent in SQL and data modeling, and equally comfortable in a general\-purpose language. * You have real depth in a modern cloud warehouse and a relational database, and strong opinions about when to use which. * You are curious enough to learn a legacy system’s quirks and honest enough to say what you don’t know yet. * You see a vague, messy problem and start. You scope, prototype, learn, and adjust without waiting for permission. * You think in systems, but your designs survive contact with production. * You treat security, privacy, and correctness as part of the design, because this is financial data. * You have something to prove, and we want to give you the room to prove it. **Nice to have** Experience in financial services, core banking, or other regulated environments · SQL Server and legacy\-to\-cloud migrations · change data capture and streaming · orchestration and transformation tooling · building data products for LLM and agent use cases. Résumés matter less than evidence of what you have built; if you have an unconventional path, tell us the story. **Why this role** **• Real ownership.** A strong foundation, a clear ambition, and the architectural say over where it goes next. **• Real stakes.** Your work reaches credit union staff and members, and the communities behind them. **• Real access.** Direct line to leadership, a clear mandate, and the autonomy to match. **Interested?** Tell us about something you have built that you are proud of: a system you tamed, a design you stood behind, a problem nobody else wanted. We care about the story and the evidence far more than the formatting. Pay: $100,000\.00 \- $160,000\.00 per year Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Software Engineer AI Evaluator
jobs.description: We are looking for experienced, hands\-on software engineers to help train and evaluate the next generation of AI coding agents. While modern AI coding agents are capable in many areas, they frequently miss edge cases, introduce brittle changes, write tests that pass for the wrong reasons, and require close supervision from an experienced engineer. In this role, you will bring the engineering judgment you have built shipping production systems to evaluate how AI coding agents handle real\-world software engineering work inside realistic codebases. You will design challenging, realistic tasks drawn from your own day\-to\-day experience—ranging from compact bug fixes to multi\-day engineering scenarios—run them through frontier AI models, and grade the results against a professional standard. This is not a traditional software engineering position. There is no production on\-call or rigid shift work; instead, it is a flexible, self\-directed, fully remote contract where clear written reasoning matters just as much as technical depth. **Responsibilities** * **Design Realistic Engineering Tasks:** Create challenging scenarios drawn from your own practice—including specs phrased as you would brief a trusted teammate, alongside repositories, tests, logs, API contracts, and design notes that you construct or adapt yourself. * **Evaluate AI Coding Agents:** Run your tasks through frontier AI models and grade their deliverables (diffs, tests, designs, and pull request reviews) against the bar you would hold a teammate to. * **Compare \& Benchmark Outputs:** Evaluate side\-by\-side agent outputs on identical specs and codebases, determine which performed better, and document where each fell short. * **Define Success Criteria:** Author unit/regression tests and detailed grading rubrics specifying required behaviors, edge cases, and codebase conventions, explaining in writing why a submission passes or fails each criterion. * **Flag Model Failures with Evidence:** Identify and document concrete issues such as brittle changes, missed edge cases, false\-positive tests, trace thrashing, fabricated/ignored files, and off\-spec interpretations. * **Peer Review \& Collaboration:** Contribute across your primary tech stack (and adjacent ones) while reviewing and refining tasks built by fellow engineers. **Representative Task Types** * Implementing a new feature to spec, complete with comprehensive tests. * Fixing a complex bug accompanied by a regression test that proves the fix. * Refactoring existing code while strictly preserving behavior. * Conducting a thorough pull request review. * Writing a root\-cause debugging analysis from system logs and traces. * Designing an API contract with concrete examples. **Qualifications** * **Hands\-On Practitioner:** You currently write and ship production code—or have done so very recently—at an individual\-contributor level (engineers who only manage, architect, or review without coding day\-to\-day will not be a fit). * **Experience:** 2\+ years of professional software engineering experience shipping and maintaining production code as part of a team (strong mid\-level to senior individual contributors are ideal). * **Technical Stack:** Deep expertise in at least one common language/stack (e.g., TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, Java, Go, Rust, C\+\+, C\#, Ruby, PHP, Swift, or Kotlin). Frontend, backend, full\-stack, mobile, infrastructure, and systems specialists are all welcome. * **Tooling Fluency:** Comfortable working in a terminal with git, test runners, and debuggers, with the ability to orient yourself quickly in an unfamiliar codebase (Docker and CI experience is a plus). * **Communication \& Judgment:** Full professional or native\-level written and spoken English, with the ability to clearly articulate *why* a technical solution is flawed, not just *that* it is wrong. * **AI Familiarity:** General user\-level familiarity with LLM tools (such as Claude or ChatGPT) to distinguish a well\-reasoned technical answer from a plausible\-sounding hallucination. No prior AI/ML engineering experience is required. * **Education \& Tech Literacy:** An in\-progress Bachelor’s degree or higher (a CS degree is a plus, though verifiable shipped production work outweighs credentials). Comfortable with standard cloud tools (Google Workspace), file handling, and desktop applications. **Compensation \& Terms** * **Pay Rate:** $40–$125/hr USD. * **Schedule:** Minimum commitment of 10 hours per week with no weekly cap; full\-time hours (40\+ hrs/week) are available. Multi\-day task timers allow you to spread work flexibly across your week. * **Location:** Must be based in the **United States, Canada, or the UK**. * **Tools Provided:** Access to frontier models (including Claude and ChatGPT) is provided through the platform; no personal subscriptions are required. Pay: $40\.00 \- $125\.00 per hour Expected hours: No less than 10\.0 per week Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Staff Software Developer
jobs.description: **About the Role** We’re looking for a pragmatic, detail\-oriented staff\-level developer to support, modernize, and extend the core banking platform used by our credit union clients. You’ll work across a mature .NET application with significant business logic in SQL Server stored procedures, and across the newer Python and Azure services we’re building alongside it. AI is part of how we work every day. Our developers use AI coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex to investigate production issues, trace code across repositories, write and review changes, and produce documentation. We want someone who already works this way, or is eager to, and who understands that AI output is a starting point to verify, not an answer to trust. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys detective work, can trace issues across application and database layers, and takes pride in keeping complex systems running smoothly for real users. **What You’ll Actually Be Doing** •**Investigating and resolving production issues** \- tracing problems from user\-reported symptoms through VB.NET and ASP.NET code into SQL Server stored procedures and back, often with an AI agent doing the first pass and you confirming every finding against the source code and live data •**Enhancing existing functionality** \- adding features to a 15\+ year codebase while respecting existing patterns and avoiding regressions •**Writing and modifying stored procedures** \- much of the business logic lives in T\-SQL and is deployed to every credit union we support; you’ll spend significant time here, including checking for client\-specific differences before a change goes out •**Directing AI coding agents** \- writing clear specs, breaking work into tasks an agent can build, and reviewing AI\-generated changes with the same rigor as any other pull request •**Building AI\-assisted tools and services** \- extending our internal AI investigation platform (Python, Azure Functions, Azure AI Foundry), including the agent workflows, prompts, and guardrails that keep its answers accurate •**Building on Azure** \- Function Apps, App Service, Key Vault, Cosmos DB, and Blob Storage, with managed identities and least\-privilege access designed in from the start •**Reviewing code and releases** \- reviewing pull requests and deployment plans from the team and contractors, and catching risky changes before they reach production •**Technical leadership** \- making architecture decisions, writing technical handoffs for contractors, mentoring other developers, and helping set the team’s standards for using AI safely •**Supporting Crystal Reports** \- modifying report logic, troubleshooting data discrepancies, and occasionally building new reports •**Working directly with support staff** \- translating technical findings into plain English and providing guidance on client\-facing issues •**Maintaining integrations** \- ACH processing, card networks, GL interfaces, IRS information returns, and various third\-party vendor connections **Required Skills Must Have:** •**VB.NET or C\#** \- 5\+ years working in .NET Framework (not just .NET Core) •**SQL Server \& T\-SQL** \- Strong experience writing and debugging complex stored procedures, views, and functions. You should be comfortable with: – Multi\-table JOINs and subqueries –Transaction handling and error management in T\-SQL – Query performance analysis and optimization, including locking behavior on busy production tables –Reading and understanding someone else’s 500\-line stored procedure •**AI\-assisted development** \- Daily, hands\-on use of AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, or similar) for real production work, not just autocomplete. You should be able to show us how you check AI output before you rely on it. •**Python** \- Experience building services, scripts, or internal tools •**Debugging skills** \- Ability to trace issues across application and database layers •**Windows Forms or WPF** \- Experience with desktop application development **Strongly Preferred:** •**Microsoft Azure** \- Functions, App Service, Key Vault, Cosmos DB, Storage, and Entra ID / managed identities * **Building with LLMs** \- Prompt design, tool calling, MCP servers, retrieval (RAG), and measuring whether model output is actually correct •**Security and compliance awareness** \- SOC 2 controls, least\-privilege database access, secrets management, and protecting member data •**Crystal Reports** \- Experience modifying existing reports and understanding how they consume stored procedure data •**Financial/banking domain** \- Understanding of accounts, transactions, GL concepts, or similar •**Legacy system experience** \- You’ve worked on systems that evolved over many years and understand the value of incremental improvement over rewrites **Nice to Have:** •Credit union or community bank experience •ACH/NACHA file processing •Card processing integrations (ISO 8583\) •**Future\-state platform work** \- TypeScript, Node.js, Fastify, and React for the next\-generation services we’re building •GitHub Actions and CI/CD pipelines •Leading contractors or mentoring developers **What We’re NOT Looking For** •Someone who wants to rewrite everything in the latest framework •A developer who only wants to work on greenfield projects •Someone uncomfortable with stored procedures containing business logic (this is the architecture \- we need someone who can thrive in it) •Someone who pastes AI output into production without reading it and checking it against the real system •Someone unwilling to use AI tools \- this is how our team works, and we expect you to keep getting better with them **The Right Mindset** **The ideal candidate:** •**Reads before writing** \- Understands existing code before making changes •**Asks “why is it this way?”** \- Before assuming something is wrong •**Trusts, but verifies** \- Treats AI findings as leads, then confirms them against the source code and live data •**Communicates clearly** \- Can explain technical issues to non\-technical staff •**Values stability** \- Understands that “working” beats “elegant” in production financial systems •**Has patience** \- Some investigations take time; you’re okay with that •**Keeps learning** \- AI tools change every few months; you enjoy trying new ones and sharing what works with the team **Technical Environment** •**Languages:** VB.NET, T\-SQL, C\#, Python, some TypeScript •**Database:** SQL Server 2019\+, Azure Cosmos DB, Postgres •**Cloud:** Microsoft Azure (Functions, App Service, Key Vault, Storage, AI Foundry) •**AI Tools:** Claude Code, Codex, Azure\-hosted models, MCP servers •**Reporting:** Crystal Reports •**Source Control:** Git/GitHub, with required pull request review •**IDE:** Visual Studio, VS Code Pay: $100,000\.00 \- $160,000\.00 per year Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Rapid Development
jobs.description: **About Quindar** ----------------- Quindar builds modern, cloud\-native satellite mission operations software with a simple mission: to operate satellites like servers. Our platform replaces fragmented, legacy ground systems with an integrated, automation\-driven approach that brings modern software velocity to space operations. We’re a small, fast\-moving team with deep aerospace and software roots, energized by big challenges and motivated by the impact we have on real missions in this next chapter of the Space Age. If you want to work with sharp, ambitious people who push boundaries, move quickly, and are excited to take space operations to the next level, Quindar is the place to do it. **What You’ll Be Doing** ------------------------ As a Staff Software Engineer on Quindar’s new Special Projects team, you’ll work at the intersection of research, rapid prototyping, and production software engineering. You’ll help turn experimental ideas and emerging capabilities into reliable, scalable features that integrate seamlessly into Quindar’s satellite operations platform. This is a highly autonomous, hands\-on engineering role focused on moving quickly without sacrificing quality. You’ll collaborate with engineers and researchers developing early\-stage prototypes, evaluate technical approaches, and take promising concepts through implementation, integration, and production deployment. Some projects will evolve into core platform capabilities; others will be exploratory efforts that help shape Quindar’s technical direction. You’ll work primarily in Python, building backend services, APIs, and integrations across our existing architecture. You’ll also contribute to frontend development when needed, using modern AI\-assisted development tools to work effectively across the stack. Success in this role requires strong engineering judgment. You’ll move rapidly through technical challenges while ensuring that new capabilities follow established architectural patterns, integrate cleanly with existing systems, and meet the standards of production software. You’ll work closely with other engineering teams to ensure that Special Projects development contributes positively to evolving systems. You’ll own your work beyond initial delivery, including testing, deployment, observability, troubleshooting, and resolving production issues. We’re looking for an exceptional engineer who enjoys building new things, thrives in an experimental environment, and takes pride in delivering software that’s both innovative and built to last. ### **In this role, you will:** * Own the development and production integration of experimental capabilities, prototypes, and new product features * Contribute across the full stack, from frontend and backend software to Kubernetes platform configuration * Collaborate with product, architecture, and engineering teams to evaluate technical approaches and turn promising ideas into production\-ready solutions * Take end\-to\-end ownership of projects, including implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and production support * Leverage AI coding agents, automation, and modern development tools to accelerate delivery while maintaining rigorous standards for correctness and maintainability * Make pragmatic architectural decisions that balance rapid experimentation, technical quality, and long\-term sustainability **Required Technical Skills** ----------------------------- * Expert proficiency in Python, with extensive experience designing, building, and operating production backend systems * Strong understanding of software architecture, distributed systems, API design, and integration patterns * Experience building and maintaining cloud applications using AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, and related technologies * Experience with relational databases, GraphQL and/or REST APIs, and asynchronous or event\-driven architectures * Strong software engineering fundamentals, including automated testing, CI/CD, observability, security, and performance * Ability to work effectively across the stack with direct ownership of platform configuration and contributions to frontend applications using React and TypeScript * Fluency in collaborative development using Git, code reviews, and established engineering workflows **What Makes You Stand Out** ---------------------------- * You have experience taking research prototypes, proofs of concept, or experimental software into production * You combine rapid execution with strong architectural judgment and a commitment to clean, maintainable code * You’re comfortable working across unfamiliar technologies and can quickly become productive in new parts of a software stack * You use AI coding agents extensively and effectively, while maintaining a deep understanding of the code they produce * You take full ownership of your work, including operational reliability, troubleshooting, and resolving issues after deployment **Background Qualifications** ----------------------------- * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field—or equivalent practical experience * 8\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with substantial experience developing production backend systems * Demonstrated experience independently leading complex technical projects from initial design through production deployment and operation * Proven ability to make sound architectural decisions, influence engineering practices, and collaborate effectively across multiple engineering teams **Why You’ll Love Working at Quindar** -------------------------------------- * Work on cutting\-edge technology and see your contributions directly support the success of real\-world space missions! * Make a meaningful impact as part of a small, collaborative team where your ideas, expertise, and leadership truly matter. * Enjoy unlimited PTO, a minimum of 15 days off each year, and most U.S. federal holidays—we take work\-life balance seriously! * Take care of yourself and your family with quarterly health and wellness benefits, comprehensive health insurance, and 100% employee coverage. * Invest in your future with a 4% 401(k) match, and connect with the team at our annual four\-day company offsite in destinations across the country! * Help shape what comes next at Quindar as our technology, culture, and company continue to evolve!

jobs.description: Dayton, Ohio Job Type: Full\-time, Permanent Working Pattern: Hybrid Working Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM NorthTrail IT Services provides managed technology solutions, IT infrastructure support and cybersecurity services to businesses across a range of industries. We are looking for someone who takes ownership of technical responsibilities, approaches problems methodically and understands the importance of delivering dependable IT services. Please submit your resume outlining your relevant experience, technical capabilities and professional certifications. jobs.title: DevOps / Automation Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Summary:** The DevOps / Automation Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, implementing, and continuously improving enterprise automation, orchestration, Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC), and CI/CD capabilities across the organization. This role accelerates technology delivery and enhances operational efficiency by standardizing multi\-cloud infrastructure deployments across Microsoft Azure, AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), alongside cloud data platforms such as Databricks. Working collaboratively across Cloud Infrastructure, Application Development, Data Engineering, Cybersecurity, and Service Operations teams, the Engineer implements scalable delivery standards aligned with enterprise architecture, security governance, cost optimization, and change management requirements. A typical day involves writing reusable IaC modules, optimizing deployment pipelines, integrating ITSM observability tools, and troubleshooting automation workflows to ensure secure, resilient technology operations. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities:** * Designs, develops, and maintains Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC) solutions and reusable Terraform modules to standardize provisioning across multi\-cloud environments (Azure, AWS, GCP, OCI) and cloud data platforms such as Databricks. * Automates cloud infrastructure configurations, identity and access controls, policy enforcement, resource tagging, and operational readiness in compliance with architecture, security, and cost\-optimization standards. * Engineers and maintains automated CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or equivalent platforms to streamline application, infrastructure, and data workflow deployments across development, test, staging, and production environments. * Establishes repeatable, secure release management processes with automated testing, approval gates, configuration management, deployment validation, and rollback capabilities. * Administers enterprise orchestration platforms to automate application workloads, data pipelines, scheduled processes, and system integrations with automated error handling and failure recovery. * Builds automated integrations with ServiceNow and enterprise APIs, web services, event systems, and monitoring tools to automate incident handling, service requests, and operational remediation. * Implements telemetry, logging, alerting, and dashboards integrated with Grafana and ServiceNow to monitor the health, performance, and execution of automation workflows and pipelines. * Troubleshoots automation failures, performs root\-cause analysis, implements lasting corrective actions, and executes approved infrastructure and platform changes through established change\-management processes. * Maintains comprehensive architecture diagrams, implementation guides, runbooks, troubleshooting procedures, and knowledge base articles to support consistent operations and recovery. * Identifies continuous improvement opportunities for automation, orchestration, and self\-service to reduce technical debt and measure results in deployment speed, failure reduction, and operational capacity. **Position Requirements (Work Experience, Skills, Licenses, etc.):** * * Strong proficiency with Terraform or comparable Infrastructure\-as\-Code technologies and scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, or Bash. * Hands\-on experience with Git\-based source control, CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, and multi\-cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP, OCI). * Working knowledge of enterprise workload orchestration, REST APIs, ServiceNow or comparable ITSM platforms, and observability tools such as Grafana. * Solid understanding of cloud architecture, networking fundamentals, identity and access management (IAM), infrastructure security, and operational change management. * Strong organizational, analytical, and troubleshooting skills with the ability to manage complex deployment pipelines under tight deadlines. * Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the proven ability to build alignment across cross\-functional engineering, development, and cybersecurity teams. **Education and Experience:** * **Required**: Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related technical field (or equivalent combination of education and practical experience with Databricks, Unity Catalog, Databricks Declarative Automation Bundles, or advanced data platform governance tools. * **Desired**: Relevant professional certifications in cloud platforms, DevOps, or automation (e.g., Azure Administrator, AWS Solutions Architect, HashiCorp Certified Terraform Associate, Databricks, or ITIL Foundation). **ACCO Competencies:** * **Proactivity/Initiative**: Recognizes what needs to be done a s. Demonstrates appropriate compromise, effective time management, prioritization practices and holds team members (including themselves) accountable for their performance/conduct. * **Professionalism**: Respectfully observes and challenges the status quo with intent for improvement. Can take direction, accept feedback, and take full responsibility for their actions. Lead by example through positive influence and ethical leadership with consideration of the entire organization. **Job Responsibility Level:** No direct reports **Travel Requirements:** Travel required 0\-10% of the time to other office locations. **Hours:** This is an exempt position. Workdays are scheduled from Monday through Friday. Typically, work hours begin and end between 7:00 am and 5:00 pm as scheduled with the position's supervisor. Work outside of regular hours may occasionally be necessary to meet business needs. **Physical Demands:** (The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.) * Must frequently lift and/or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 40 pounds. * Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and ability to adjust focus. * Prolonged sitting. * Frequently required to reach with hands and arms. * Occasionally required to stand; walk and stoop, kneel, crouch. **Competitive Wages:** $106,000 to $143,000 Annual Salary. jobs.title: Founding Lead AI for Engineering US
jobs.description: **Company Description** **Work with Us. Change the World.** At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations. There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world. We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us. **Job Description** **AI for Engineering** We are looking for an exceptional, entrepreneurial leader to establish and lead our new AI for Engineering office in Dallas–Fort Worth. This is not a traditional management role. We need someone who can build something from the ground up, move exceptionally fast, attract outstanding talent, and help shape the future of engineering through AI. The ideal candidate combines deep technical understanding of AI with strong engineering intuition, strategic thinking, creativity, and a relentless drive to execute. We are particularly interested in individuals who have founded or scaled technology companies, built high\-performing technical teams, or led ambitious AI\-driven product development. This person will be instrumental in connecting the worlds of engineering and AI, identifying opportunities, developing new product directions, and turning ambitious ideas into working AI agents. **What You’ll Do** **Establish and lead the Dallas–Fort Worth office** * Build our new AI for Engineering office from the ground up. * Establish a high\-performance, entrepreneurial culture focused on speed, ownership, ambition, and delivery. * Recruit, develop, and motivate exceptional talent, including product managers, AI engineers, and technical specialists. * Build a small, exceptionally capable team with a strong bias towards action. **Drive AI product development and innovation** * Lead the development and expansion of AI for Engineering capabilities. * Bridge traditional engineering disciplines and cutting\-edge AI technology. * Identify new opportunities where AI agents can fundamentally transform engineering workflows and deliver client value. * Challenge conventional approaches and develop creative, ambitious product concepts. * Work closely with our global AI for Engineering leadership, product, and engineering teams to translate strategy into execution. **Provide strategic and technical leadership** * Help shape the direction of AI for Engineering, identifying emerging technologies, opportunities, and new areas of development. * Stay at the forefront of AI developments and understand how rapidly evolving technology can be applied to real\-world engineering challenges. * Turn complex technical opportunities into clear priorities, product roadmaps, and tangible outcomes. * Balance long\-term strategic vision with exceptional execution speed. * Actively contribute to technical discussions, product decisions, and problem\-solving rather than managing from a distance. **Qualifications** **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor's Degree plus extensive years of software engineering, data science, or AI/ML experience, including 6 years of leadership experience, or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education. * Proven experience building technical teams, products, or new business units from scratch. * Strong understanding of modern AI technologies, including LLMs, AI agents, and emerging AI architectures. **Preferred Qualifications** We are open to unconventional profiles and will prioritize exceptional talent, ambition, technical capability, and entrepreneurial attitude over traditional credentials. Experience that would be particularly attractive includes: * Founder, co\-founder, or early executive at one or more AI or technology startups. * Leadership in AI product development, applied AI, or advanced engineering technology. * Experience translating complex technical challenges into scalable products. * Exposure to engineering, infrastructure, construction, industrial technology, or related technical industries. **What Success Looks Like** Within the first 12 months, this person will have: * Established a functioning, high\-performing AI for Engineering office in Dallas–Fort Worth. * Recruited an exceptional initial team, including strong product management leadership. * Created a culture of speed, creativity, technical excellence, and ownership. * Identified and advanced high\-impact AI product opportunities. * Delivered tangibl for Engineering globally. * Real\-world impact: AI that changes how transportation infrastructure is designed and delivered, backed by AECOM's projects, data, and clients. * Ownership of hiring, culture, and product direction. **The Person We Are Looking For** * Entrepreneurial by nature: Someone who thinks and acts like a founder. Ideally, they have started one or more companies, built products from scratch, or helped scale ambitious technology businesses. They are comfortable with ambiguity, take ownership, and create momentum without waiting for instructions. * AI and technology to the core: Deeply passionate about AI and technology, with a strong technical foundation. They actively experiment with emerging AI capabilities and understand what is possible today, not just what was possible six months ago. * A bridge between engineering and AI: Able to connect real engineering challenges with cutting\-edge AI capabilities. A background in engineering, engineering technology, or AI applied to complex technical industries would be highly valuable. * Exceptionally driven and fast\-moving: Highly ambitious, hardworking, and energized by challenging goals. Someone who moves quickly, makes decisions, removes obstacles, and consistently delivers results. * Creative and strategically minded: Not simply someone who executes an existing roadmap, but someone who constantly generates new ideas, challenges assumptions, identifies opportunities, and helps define where we should go next. * An inspiring, hands\-on leader: Someone who attracts exceptional people, builds strong teams, and motivates others through ambition, energy, technical credibility, and personal example. A leader who is also a doer. At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in\-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.*** **About AECOM** AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD\&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well\-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan. AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public\- and private\-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16\.1 billion in fiscal year 2025\. Learn more at aecom.com. **What makes AECOM a great place to work** You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects \- both in your local community and on a global scale \- that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting\-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award\-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, AI
jobs.description: Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. This individual will serve as a senior technical authority for AI\-enabled solutions spanning laboratory pre\-analytics, analytics, post\-analytics, workflow optimization, and clinical decision support. The Principal AI Solutions Architect will establish the reference architectures, data strategies, engineering standards, and implementation approaches needed to deliver safe, reliable, scalable, and differentiated AI capabilities. This is a senior individual\-contributor role for a leader who can connect emerging AI capabilities with real laboratory and healthcare needs. The successful candidate will combine deep technical expertise with product judgment, architecture leadership, and hands\-on engineering. This individual will work across product management, systems engineering, software engineering, data engineering, clinical and medical affairs, cybersecurity, regulatory, quality, and other functions to translate complex opportunities into production\-ready solutions. The role requires more than evaluating AI technologies or developing proofs of concept. It requires ownership of the technical direction and critical decisions needed to move AI\-enabled capabilities from concept through architecture, implementation, evaluation, product integration, deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management. **What You’ll Work On** **AI Technical Strategy and Architecture** * Define and drive the long\-term AI technical strategy, target architecture, and technology roadmap for Abbott's digital laboratory products. * Establish reference architectures, technical standards, reusable patterns, and shared platform capabilities for AI\-enabled products. * Translate product, laboratory, clinical, scientific, and operational needs into scalable AI architectures and executable implementation strategies. * Provide technical direction for AI capabilities across laboratory pre\-analytics, analytics, post\-analytics, workflow optimization, clinical decision support, and related digital\-health applications. * Define architectural approaches spanning applications, data, models, integration, cloud and edge infrastructure, cybersecurity, privacy, observability, and governance. * Lead architectural decisions involving predictive machine learning, natural\-language processing, generative AI, large language models, retrieval\-augmented generation, conversational AI, agent\-based workflows, knowledge\-based systems, and optimization methods. * Determine when AI, deterministic software, rules\-based logic, statistical methods, or combined approaches are most appropriate for a product use case. * Serve as a senior technical escalation point for complex, ambiguous, cross\-product AI architecture and implementation challenges. **Data and Model Strategy** * Define data strategies that support the development, validation, deployment, and continuous monitoring of AI\-enabled product capabilities. * Establish architectural patterns for data acquisition, preparation, quality, lineage, labeling, access, privacy, retention, and fitness for intended use. * Guide decisions concerning enterprise and product data platforms, Lakehouse architectures, feature management, streaming data, vector and graph\-based retrieval, and structured and unstructured data. * Define approaches for model selection, build\-versus\-buy analysis, foundation\-model selection, model hosting, feature engineering and analysis, algorithm and model selection, training, validation, hyperparameter optimization, performance characterization, and model interpretability * Experience defining technical strategies and translating complex product, business, clinical, scientific, or operational needs into scalable architectures and implementation roadmaps * Experience leading architecture decisions across application, data, integration, security, infrastructure, cloud, platform, and governance domains * Experience operationalizing AI and ML solutions through MLOps or LLMOps practices, including automated testing, versioning, CI/CD, deployment, monitoring, observability, rollback, and lifecycle management * Experience with one or more of the following: predictive machine learning, natural\-language processing, generative AI, large language models, conversational AI, retrieval\-augmented generation, knowledge\-based systems, or agent\-based workflows * Experience defining data strategies and designing data architectures and pipelines for AI development, validation, deployment, and monitoring * Demonstrated experience evaluating and selecting models, technical architectures, cloud services, frameworks, platforms, and third\-party technologies * Strong understanding of modern software\-development lifecycle practices and experience delivering solutions from concept and prototyping through production deployment and sustaining support * Demonstrated ability to engage and influence senior technical, product, business, and executive leaders * Demonstrated ability to lead through technical influence, resolve ambiguous engineering problems, mentor senior engineers, and establish practices adopted by multiple teams * Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and technical\-documentation skills **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience developing AI\-enabled products within healthcare, diagnostics, medical devices, life sciences, or another regulated and safety\-critical environment * Experience with laboratory medicine, clinical workflows, laboratory informatics, diagnostic systems, clinical decision support, or healthcare data * Experience with Microsoft Azure AI services, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, Azure Databricks, cloud\-native data services, and associated security and monitoring capabilities * Experience with cloud, on\-premises, hybrid, edge, or instrument\-connected product architecture * Experience with laboratory or healthcare interoperability standards and integration patterns, such as HL7, FHIR, ASTM, APIs, event\-driven interfaces, or related technologies * Experience designing or governing generative AI and agent\-based systems, including retrieval, grounding, tool use, memory, orchestration, safeguards, evaluation, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls * Experience working within design controls, quality systems, risk\-management processes, or regulated software\-development environments * Familiarity with medical\-device software lifecycle practices and standards, including applicable aspects of IEC 62304, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, cybersecurity, privacy, and AI governance * Experience evaluating external model providers, AI platforms, data technologies, and development partners * Relevant certifications or specialized training in AI, machine learning, generative AI, software or data architecture, or cloud platforms **Apply Now** **Learn more about our health and wellness benefits, which provide the security to help you and your family live full lives:** www.abbottbenefits.com Follow your career aspirations to Abbott for diverse opportunities with a company that can help you build your future and live your best life. Abbott is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to employee diversity. Connect with us at www.abbott.com, on Facebook at www.facebook.com/Abbott and on Twitter @AbbottNews. The base pay for this position is $113,300\.00 – $226,700\.00\. In specific locations, the pay range may vary from the range posted.

jobs.title: Senior Deployment and Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: We are looking for a **Senior Deployment and Site Reliability Engineer** to deploy, commission, and support our software in some of the most demanding customer environments, including cloud, on\-premises, hybrid, and air\-gapped installations. You will be the bridge between our product teams and our customers: ensuring installations go smoothly, upgrades are predictable, and issues are resolved quickly and permanently. This role suits an engineer who is equally comfortable working hands\-on at a customer site during a tight maintenance window and designing the monitoring, automation, and documentation that make those deployments repeatable and reliable. This is a **field\-facing SRE / deployment** role. **Location:** Salt Lake City (Utah) or Houston (Texas) \- US **Work Mode:** Hybrid **Travel:** Approximately 30% to customer sites **Level:** Senior ### **Key Responsibilities** **Deployment and Commissioning** * Deploy, commission, and upgrade software at customer sites and remotely across cloud, on\-premises, hybrid, and air\-gapped environments, often within a fixed maintenance window. * Develop and maintain deployment automation, verification, and diagnostic tooling. **Incident Management and Escalation** * Serve as the technical escalation point for critical production issues: restore service first, then perform root cause analysis. * Drive permanent fixes in partnership with product and engineering teams. **Environment Ownership** * Own staging and pre\-production environments that mirror real customer installations. * Validate releases and upgrade paths before they reach customers. **Monitoring and Reliability** * Design and implement monitoring and alerting so issues are detected before customers report them. * Continuously improve observability, resilience, and operational readiness. **Documentation and Enablement** * Write installation guides, runbooks, and troubleshooting guides. * Train Regional Operations teams and customer staff. ### **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field. * 5–8\+ years of experience deploying, commissioning, and supporting complex software solutions in production and customer environments. * Proven experience managing critical production incidents under time pressure, including troubleshooting, service restoration, root cause analysis, and corrective actions. * Strong hands\-on experience with Kubernetes operations, including Helm, RBAC, storage, networking, and production troubleshooting. * Experience with Docker and container management, including image building, inspection, and runtime troubleshooting. * Strong Linux administration skills (Debian, Ubuntu, or Red Hat), including networking, storage, log analysis, and command\-line troubleshooting. * Experience with both on\-premises and cloud deployments (Azure or AWS). * Production experience with PostgreSQL or similar relational databases, including backup, recovery, migrations, and basic performance troubleshooting. * Strong understanding of networking and security concepts, including TLS/certificates, firewalls, proxies, DNS, routing, load balancing, and VPN/remote access. * Experience using Prometheus and Grafana for production monitoring and incident troubleshooting. * Scripting skills in Python and/or Bash for deployment automation, verification, and diagnostics. * Experience with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps) and artifact repositories such as Artifactory. * Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and distributed development teams. * Strong customer\-facing communication skills, particularly when handling technical incidents under pressure. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience deploying and supporting software in substation, utility, industrial, or other Operational Technology (OT) environments. * Knowledge of IT/OT integration, including network segmentation, restricted remote access, hardened infrastructure, and air\-gapped environments. * Familiarity with industrial cybersecurity standards, particularly IEC 62443, as well as security patching and vulnerability remediation. * Experience with High Availability (HA) and Disaster Recovery (DR), including database clustering and connection pooling (e.g., pgpool). * Familiarity with GitOps tools such as Argo CD or Flux, and service mesh technologies such as Istio. * Experience with structured incident and problem management processes (ITIL), using tools such as Jira or ServiceNow. * Familiarity with test automation and management tools such as Cypress, Playwright, and Jira/Xray. * Additional language skills relevant to the regions supported. ### **Why choose us** * An international community bringing together more than 110 different nationalities * An environment where trust is central: 70% of our leaders started their careers at the entry level * A strong training system with our internal Academy and more than 250 modules available * A dynamic work environment that frequently comes together for internal events (afterworks, team buildings, etc.) *Amaris Consulting promotes equal opportunities. We are committed to bringing together people from diverse backgrounds and creating an inclusive work environment. In this regard, we welcome applications from all qu**alified individuals, regardless of sex, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, beliefs, age, marital status, disability, or other characteristics.* *\#LI\-AS2* **Who are we?** --------------- **Amaris Consulting** is an independent technology consulting firm providing guidance and solutions to businesses. With more than 1000 clients across the globe, we have been rolling out solutions in major projects for over a decade – this is made possible by an international team of 7,600 people spread across 5 continents and more than 60 countries. Our solutions focus on four different Business Lines: Information System \& Digital, Telecom, Life Sciences and Engineering. We’re focused on building and nurturing a top talent community where all our team members can achieve their full potential. Amaris is your steppingstone to cross rivers of change, meet challenges and achieve all your projects with success. At Amaris, we strive to provide our candidates with the best possible recruitment experience. We like to get to know our candidates, challenge them, and be able to give them proper feedback as quickly as possible. Here's what our recruitment process looks like: **Brief Call**: Our process typically begins with a brief virtual/phone conversation to get to know you! The objective? Learn about you, understand your motivations, and make sure we have the right job for you! **Interviews** (the average number of interviews is 3 \- the number may vary depending on the level of seniority required for the position). During the interviews, you will meet people from our team: your line manager of course, but also other people related to your future role. We will talk in depth about you, your experience, and skills, but also about the position and what will be expected of you. Of course, you will also get to know Amaris: our culture, our roots, our teams, and your career opportunities! **Case study**: Depending on the position, we may ask you to take a test. This could be a role play, a technical assessment, a problem\-solving scenario, etc. As you know, every person is different and so is every role in a company. That is why we have to adapt accordingly, and the process may differ slightly at times. However, please know that we always put ourselves in the candidate's shoes to ensure they have the best possible experience. We look forward to meeting you!

jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon's unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day\-to\-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers' businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon's real\-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no\-brainers to buy and easy to use. On the Experimentation Service, our vision is that every product decision in AWS should be backed by evidence. We're building an A/B testing service that brings Weblab's statistical rigor to AWS. We're integrating with existing AWS products so teams can reuse the feature\-flag configurations and data they already have. The challenge is building a single analysis layer that works for everyone while keeping onboarding simple enough that experimentation becomes the default. We're also working to shape how teams evaluate agentic workloads — agents improve faster when teams can measure what actually works in production rather than relying on intuition and benchmarks alone. We have live customers today, we're onboarding new teams this quarter, and we're working toward becoming the experimentation service for AWS. We are seeking an SDE II to help build and scale this service. The technical problems are real, and the work demands judgment along with strong execution. Our product only works if teams can adopt it without overhauling how they build — which means we're constantly reducing onboarding friction while resisting the pull to build a custom integration for every customer. There is no long backlog here. Customers are in the room with us giving feedback in real time and expecting to see improvements next week. You'll be in those conversations, hearing what customers actually need firsthand. You'll help weigh what to solve generically versus what to solve scrappily right now, and then build the thing. You'll work closely with partner teams on the integrations you own, and own your components end to end. This is a high\-ownership role on a small team building something that doesn't exist yet at AWS. If you do your best work in ambiguity and want to help shape how AWS builds and validates products, this is the role. Around 11 you'll have standup, then grab lunch with the team (if you like) before the afternoon opens up for design reviews, CR feedback, or unblocking an engineer. Some days you're deep in code; others you're on a call with a customer team working through how their system integrates with yours. You're the person who knows the system most deeply \- and you work to ensure you're never the bottleneck. The problems are hard and the stakes are high \- but we believe we can move fast, do exceptional work, and have a full life outside of it. We're a small team building two greenfield projects within Agentic WorkSpaces. We're moving fast enough that our team name is still taking shape — but our engineering culture is well established. jobs.title: Applied Scientist II, Brand Optimization
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Amazon Advertising is one of Amazon's fastest growing businesses, responsible for defining and delivering a collection of advertising products that drive discovery and sales. Brand advertising is at the center of that growth, and brand marketers are pushing the industry toward a fundamental shift: they no longer want to optimize toward proxy metrics like reach and frequency alone. They want their investment across Streaming TV, online video, and display to drive measurable business outcomes, from consideration through to purchase and long\-term loyalty. The core scientific challenge is connecting a brand ad exposure today to an outcome that may happen days or weeks later, and then optimizing for it in real time. The Brand Outcomes Optimization team exists to solve that challenge. We build machine\-learned models that predict how likely a customer is to move along the full funnel, from awareness through conversion, and we integrate those predictions into real\-time bidding so that every brand bid is placed on the opportunity most likely to produce the outcome the advertiser cares about. These systems operate at large scale, and even small improvements to how we predict and optimize for outcomes have meaningful and immediate impact on advertiser results. As an Applied Scientist II, you will help drive this outcome\-optimization. You will take on increasingly ambiguous problems, from predicting what a brand outcome will be, to building the bidding and control algorithms that optimize for it, to proving the lift through experimentation. You will work alongside senior scientists and engineers, applying advances in machine learning, online optimization, optimal control, forecasting, and causal inference. You will also join the Amazon science community, with opportunities to publish papers, attend workshops and conferences, and gain early access to Amazon ML technologies. Key job responsibilities In this role, you will work with a highly motivated team of ML scientists and engineers focused on making brand advertising measurable and optimizable against real outcomes. jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- If you are interested in this position, please apply on Twitch's Career site https://www.twitch.tv/jobs/en/If you are interested in this position, please apply on Twitch's Career site https://www.twitch.tv/jobs/en/ About Us Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day. We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. You will work with product managers, ML engineers and applied scientists to help build what our recommendation systems should optimize for. It also means weighing short\-form clips against long\-form live content, and each surface against the others.
