Reporting to the Director of Data Science, you will work from our San Francisco, CA office. You Will * Help define the objective functions and success metrics for ranking and recommendations across feeds, search and notifications. Make the trade\-offs explicit between short\-term engagement (clicks, plays, watch time) and long\-term outcomes (return visits, retention, new creator connections), including how short\-form clips and live content add to or take away from each other. * Evaluate ranking, recommendation and feed changes with ML engineers and applied scientists. This covers A/B tests and long\-running holdouts, offline metrics that predict online results, and the cost and value of exploration and cold start. Handle the hard cases: novelty effects, interference between experiments, two\-sided marketplace effects involving creators and viewers, and feedback loops in recommendation data. * Build statistical and ML models that explain viewer behavior and size opportunities, such as propensity, uplift, survival and retention models. Include proxy metrics that predict long\-term retention, so teams can decide in days rather than months. * Turn ambiguous product questions into clear analyses. Quantify the uncertainty, and make recommendations that inform the machine learning and discovery roadmap. * Define the logging and data needed to measure discovery surfaces, and check its quality. * Contribute to the team's standards for experimentation, causal inference and model evaluation, and share what you learn with other data scientists. jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- AWS operates the world's largest fleet of GPU\-accelerated servers for AI/ML training and inference at cloud scale. Our team owns the embedded software that brings these servers up, keeps them healthy, and tells us why they fail. If you want to lead the engineers who write the firmware and diagnostic software underneath frontier model training, this is the role. We are seeking a Software Development Manager to lead a team of software and systems development engineers working on embedded systems for UltraServer platforms: platform firmware, and other server management software, fleet failure root\-causing across hardware, firmware and embedded software failures, and manufacturing test automation. You will set technical direction for your team, deliver embedded software across NPI phases, and own the software side of fleet reliability. The role needs embedded systems depth to guide technical decisions and people leadership to hire, develop and retain a strong engineering team. What You Will Do You will lead engineers who own the software layer closest to the hardware. You will set your team's technical strategy for accelerator server platforms with hardware, product and leadership partners, and make trade\-offs between schedule, reliability, security and performance. Your team will take the hardest annualized failure rate issues, where the cause could be in silicon, firmware, the kernel or the hypervisor, find the root cause, and turn each finding into diagnostic software that catches the next one automatically. You will also scale manufacturing automation so new platforms ramp with high first\-pass yield. You will be accountable for the software contribution to fleet quality. Why You Will Love It The world's most advanced frontier models train on servers your team's firmware brings up and keeps healthy. Your diagnostics run across a large fleet of servers, and you can see their effect on failure rates within weeks. The team is technical and high\-trust, works closely with hardware and silicon partners, and has direct access to senior leadership. The Ideal Candidate You combine embedded systems depth with people leadership. You have led teams that shipped firmware or platform software on server\-class hardware, and you can still review a system design, read a kernel log or work through a PCIe link training failure with your engineers. You set a high bar for software quality and security, make decisions with data, and communicate clearly to engineers and executives. You build teams that are stronger because of your presence but don't depend on it. Key job responsibilities Technical Leadership \& Strategy 1\. Set technical direction for software and hardware validation across GPU\-accelerated server platforms, including CPU, GPU and NIC interconnects, BMC, BIOS/UEFI integration, CPLD/FPGA interfaces, and power and thermal management firmware 2\. Drive architecture and design reviews for platform management software, covering reliability, security, telemetry, and availability. 3\. Define software standards for firmware update, recovery and validation that hold across platform generations 4\. Reduce duplication so the organization maintains one set of platform software across product lines Issue Root Cause \& Fleet Diagnostics 1\. Own a team that root\-causes complex fleet failures across hardware, firmware and software layers, including memory errors across CPU and GPU, PCIe link failures and networking interface card failures. 2\. Turn root cause findings into durable diagnostic and remediation software that detects recurring failure modes automatically across the fleet. 3\. Partner with hardware engineering, silicon vendors and datacenter operations to drive corrective actions into design, firmware and qualification criteria 4\. Track annualized failure rate and remediation metrics for software\-attributable failures and report trends to leadership Manufacturing \& Test Automation 1\. Build and scale manufacturing test and vetting automation with ODM partners to raise first\-pass yield and cut test dwell time without losing coverage 2\. Deliver firmware flashing, provisioning and configuration workflows used on manufacturing lines and in datacenter bring\-up 3\. Close the loop between manufacturing escapes, fleet failures and test coverage gaps People Leadership \& Development 1\. Hire, develop and retain software and systems development engineers; build a team culture around engineering excellence and customer obsession 2\. Set clear goals, give regular feedback, and coach engineers on career growth through 1:1s 3\. Run calibrations and promotion assessments and keep the team's technical bar high 4\. Build an inclusive environment where engineers can do their best work Delivery \& Cross\-Functional Alignment 1\. jobs.title: Sr. Software Development Engineer, Resilience Infrastruction and Solutions: Incident Mitigation
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion At AWS, resilience is a promise to our customers: that their workloads keep running even when part of the cloud doesn't. The Resilience Infrastructure and Solutions (RIS) organization makes good on that promise, driving higher availability for AWS customers through fewer and shorter operational events. We build the services and programs that detect, mitigate, and recover from failures, from a single impaired Availability Zone to a full Region. When something goes wrong at cloud scale, our systems are what move customer traffic out of harm's way, often in under a minute, before most people notice anything happened. You'll join a team of software engineers, product and program managers, and resilience specialists who work across AWS to raise the bar on availability. You'll partner with foundational services that depend on us as their default mitigation path, and you'll help customers protect workloads they can't afford to have go down. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. The Incident Mitigation team is looking for an experienced software engineer excited about building large\-scale distributed systems that protect hundreds of thousands of customer resources across every AWS Region. You'll own the design and development of significant components of our mission\-critical control and data planes, where correctness, speed, and scale are non\-negotiable, since the moment they're needed most is during an active event. The work spans cross\-service integrations with Route53, ELB, S3, EKS, DynamoDB, EC2, and other foundational services, and demands strong judgment in fault\-tolerant and distributed systems design. In this hands\-on role you'll do everything from building rock\-solid components to anticipating failure modes in design reviews to mentoring other engineers. You need to be not only a strong software developer with a track record of delivering, but someone who excels in communication, technical leadership, and customer focus. You'll help shape the technology and the direction of a growing, high\-impact space inside AWS, writing high\-quality code that measurably improves availability for every AWS customer. Key job responsibilities * Lead the end\-to\-end design, implementation, and delivery of software systems spanning multiple features across the full development lifecycle, ensuring solutions are well\-architected, extensible, and maintainable. * Own your team's architectural direction by evaluating trade\-offs across scalability, performance, security, and maintainability, and guide future technology choices that align with business goals. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including product managers, technical program managers, and partner engineering teams to define requirements, align on system design, and deliver integrated solutions. * Coach and mentor engineers on your team and across related teams, driving adoption of engineering best practices and raising the quality bar for code organization, clarity, and documentation. * Identify opportunities to simplify existing systems and reduce technical debt, leveraging generative AI tools and industry innovations where appropriate to improve team productivity and solution quality. A day in the life You will start your day reviewing design documents and code reviews, providing guidance that helps your teammates ship high\-quality software. You might then dive into a complex system design challenge, weighing trade\-offs with partner teams before writing code for a critical component. Afternoons could include mentoring a fellow engineer, prototyping a new approach using generative AI tools, or leading a discussion on operational improvements. Your work will balance hands\-on coding with architectural leadership, giving you the chance to shape both the technical direction and the culture of your team. About the team Our team is focused on building software that customers rely on every day. We value collaboration, pragmatism, and a commitment to quality that shows up in everything we build. You will work alongside talented engineers who are eager to learn from each other and solve meaningful problems together. We are investing in new capabilities and looking for someone who will help define our technical roadmap for the years ahead. If you are excited about working in an inclusive environment where your ideas shape the future of our products, we would love to hear from you.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 5\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience * 5\+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience * 5\+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience * Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * 5\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience * Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. jobs.title: Safeguards Enforcement Analyst, Targeting, Tracking & Surveillance
jobs.description: **About Anthropic** ------------------- Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. **About the role** ------------------ As a Safeguards Analyst focusing on Targeting, Tracking \& Surveillance, you will be responsible for building and executing enforcement workflows for our products and services, with a focus on detecting and mitigating attempts to misuse Anthropic's AI systems to track, target, or surveil individuals and groups covertly, without their informed consent, or with malicious intent. Your work will span an interconnected set of harm areas: the use of AI systems to facilitate stalking, the covert monitoring of people's locations, devices, and online activity, the profiling and identification of individuals or groups, and surveillance at scale. Important context for this role: In this position you may be exposed to and engage with explicit content spanning a range of topics, including those of a sexual, violent, or psychologically disturbing nature. This role may require responding to escalations during weekends and holidays. **Key responsibilities** ------------------------ * Design and architect automated enforcement systems and review workflows that scale effectively while maintaining high accuracy * Partner with Engineering and Data Science teams to optimize detection models for policy violations and automated enforcement systems * Review flagged content to drive enforcement and policy improvements * Enforce usage policies with a focus on detecting and mitigating AI\-enabled targeting, tracking, and surveillance of individuals and groups, and on distinguishing that activity from legitimate research and journalism * Support the Safeguards policy design team by providing detailed feedback on policy gaps based on real enforcement scenarios * Collaborate with Policy Managers and Threat Intelligence Investigators to identify emerging trends and flag content for classifier refinement * Keep up to date with emerging AI policy enforcement best practices, evolving threat actor tactics, and the regulatory landscape around privacy and surveillance, using these to inform our decision\-making and workflows **Minimum qualifications** -------------------------- * Experience in trust \& safety, policy enforcement, threat intelligence, or a closely related field with a focus on privacy and surveillance harms, such as targeting, tracking, stalking, or profiling * Experience standing up and scaling policy enforcement or content review workflows * Proficiency in SQL and/or other data analysis tools to draw insights from large datasets * Experience identifying emerging risks and threat actors, and communicating findings to a diverse set of stakeholders, such as Product, Policy, Engineering, and Legal teams * Experience working with generative AI products, including writing effective prompts for content review and enforcement * Understanding of the challenges involved in implementing product policies at scale, including in the content moderation space **Preferred qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience conducting cross\-platform investigations into targeting, tracking, or surveillance activity and the threat actors behind it * Familiarity with open\-source intelligence (OSINT) techniques and tools used for threat actor tracking and network analysis * Working knowledge of privacy law, surveillance technology, or data broker ecosystems as they relate to targeting and tracking harms * Experience with large language models and an understanding of how AI technology could be misused to locate, identify, profile, or monitor people at scale * Experience navigating evolving regulatory landscapes relevant to this space (e.g., DSA, EU AI Act, GDPR) * Experience working with civil society organizations or government agencies on privacy or surveillance\-related issues * Proficiency in Python for data analysis and automation * Experience with dark web monitoring or tracking threat actors across surface, deep, and dark web environments The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $245,000 \- $285,000 USD **Logistics** ------------- **Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience **Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience **Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position **Location\-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. **Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. **For roles performing work in California:** We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. **We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. **Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. **How we're different** ----------------------- We believe that the highest\-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large\-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long\-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest\-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT\-3, Circuit\-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI \& Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. **Come work with us!** ---------------------- Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Appointee – Advanced Nanocomposite Materials for Energy Applications
jobs.description: Argonne National Laboratory in the Nanocomposite Materials and Membrane Manufacturing Group within the Applied Materials Division (AMD) seeks a highly motivated Postdoctoral Appointee to conduct research on advanced materials, processing, and manufacturing approaches for next\-generation solid\-state battery technologies. The successful candidate will contribute to the development of high\-performance solid\-state battery materials and components, with an emphasis on solid electrolytes, electrode materials, electrode–electrolyte interfaces, and scalable manufacturing processes. The position combines fundamental materials synthesis, advanced characterization, electrochemical evaluation, and manufacturing science to establish processing–structure–property relationships that enable high\-performance solid\-state battery technologies. Research will focus on improving ionic conductivity, interfacial compatibility, mechanical integrity, electrochemical stability, and manufacturing scalability of solid\-state battery components. The candidate will work closely with scientists and engineers across Argonne National Laboratory while collaborating with academic and industrial partners. The successful candidate will investigate materials synthesis, processing, and manufacturing strategies for advanced solid\-state battery components, including ceramic, polymer, and composite solid electrolytes and electrode materials. Research activities will include developing scalable solution\-based processing methods, optimizing powder processing and slurry formulations, fabricating solid electrolyte membranes and composite electrodes, and investigating electrode–electrolyte interfaces. The researcher will explore advanced fabrication approaches, including powder processing, tape casting, slurry\-based processing, thermal treatment, sintering, hot pressing, and other relevant manufacturing techniques. Particular emphasis will be placed on developing processing strategies that improve electrolyte density, microstructural uniformity, ionic transport, mechanical properties, and interfacial contact between solid electrolytes and battery electrodes. The researcher is expected to design and execute independent research while contributing to multidisciplinary team projects. Responsibilities include planning experiments, analyzing complex datasets, developing mechanistic understanding of materials behavior and electrochemical performance, publishing research findings in high\-impact journals, presenting results at scientific conferences, and contributing to proposal development for future research initiatives. Major Duties / Responsibilities: * Synthesize and characterize advanced solid electrolyte materials, including ceramic, polymer, and composite electrolyte systems for next\-generation solid\-state batteries. * Develop scalable materials processing approaches for fabricating solid electrolyte membranes, composite electrodes, and other solid\-state battery components. * Design and optimize powder processing, solution\-based processing, slurry formulation, tape casting, and other advanced manufacturing techniques for solid\-state battery materials. * Investigate electrode–electrolyte interfacial properties and develop strategies to minimize interfacial resistance, improve contact quality, and enhance electrochemical performance. * Establish processing–structure–property relationships governing ionic conductivity, electrochemical stability, mechanical integrity, thermal stability, and interfacial compatibility. * Fabricate and evaluate solid\-state battery components and cells using appropriate materials processing, cell assembly, and electrochemical testing protocols. * Characterize materials and interfaces using advanced analytical techniques, including X\-ray diffraction (XRD), scanning electron microscopy (SEM), transmission electron microscopy (TEM), energy\-dispersive X\-ray spectroscopy (EDS), Raman spectroscopy, Fourier\-transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR), and other relevant techniques. * Perform electrochemical characterization, including electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS), galvanostatic cycling, cyclic voltammetry (CV), rate capability testing, and long\-term cycling stability measurements. * Investigate mechanical and thermal properties of solid electrolytes and composite battery components to understand their behavior under practical operating conditions. * Analyze experimental data, develop mechanistic insights, and communicate scientific findings through technical reports, peer\-reviewed publications, and conference presentations. * Collaborate with multidisciplinary research teams across Argonne National Laboratory, universities, and industrial partners. * Assist in the preparation of research proposals, project reports, intellectual property disclosures, and patent applications. * Maintain a safe laboratory environment while following Argonne safety policies and best laboratory practices. **Position Requirem (CV), and galvanostatic charge–discharge testing. * Understanding of electrode–electrolyte interfaces, interfacial resistance, and electrochemical stability. * Strong publication record demonstrating scientific productivity. * Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills. * Ability to conduct both independent and collaborative research in a multidisciplinary environment. * Ability to contribute to proposal development, technical reporting, publications, and intellectual property generation. * A successful candidate must model Argonne’s Core Values: Impact, Safety, Respect, Integrity, and Teamwork. * This position requires onsite presence at Argonne National Laboratory in Lemont, Illinois. Preferred Qualifications: * Experience synthesizing and processing solid electrolyte materials, including oxide, sulfide, polymer, or composite electrolyte systems. * Experience developing ceramic, polymer, or composite solid electrolytes with improved ionic conductivity and mechanical properties. * Experience fabricating solid\-state battery cells and evaluating their electrochemical performance. * Experience with electrode–electrolyte interface engineering and interfacial characterization. * Experience with advanced manufacturing techniques, including tape casting, slurry processing, powder consolidation, hot pressing, spark plasma sintering (SPS), or other thermal processing methods. * Experience with powder processing, colloidal chemistry, and scalable manufacturing techniques. * Familiarity with advanced electrochemical characterization techniques and analysis of ionic transport mechanisms * Experience with lithium\-metal or other advanced electrode materials and their integration with solid electrolytes. * Demonstrated ability to develop innovative research directions as evidenced by high\-quality publications, presentations, patents, or research awards. **Job Family** Postdoctoral**Job Profile** Postdoctoral Appointee**Worker Type** Long\-Term (Fixed Term)**Time Type** Full time The expected hiring range for this position is $72,879\.00\-$121,465\.00\. jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer
jobs.description: Burro is the leading robotics company in the world by number of robots working outdoors in the field with real customers. Our mission is to free people from tedious work and solve the critical labor shortages faced by farmers and others that work outdoors. To accomplish our mission, we need a world\-class, diverse team where everyone feels comfortable sharing their ideas. With this in mind, we strive to create a work environment where every employee can be themselves and express their perspective, which enables us to deliver the most creative and innovative solutions to problems our customers face. Headquartered in Philadelphia with an office in central California, and backed by top Agtech and autonomy investors, including S2G, Catalyst, Translink, Cibus, FPrime, Toyota Ventures, FFVC, Xplorer, and Radicle, Burro was created to solve the labor shortages facing farmers using robotics. Burros can be described as Disney's Wall\-E for agriculture and work outdoors, in a 1\.0 format. They function, today, as computer vision based autonomous ground vehicles for carrying, towing, and scouting, and are designed to lay the base for the fully autonomous future of work outdoors. We have 800\+ robots in our growing fleet deployed in paid commercial use within vineyards, nurseries, berries, and beyond, and demand for our product is accelerating, so we are growing our team. We are hiring a **Sr. Electrical Engineer** in our Philadelphia office to own power, distribution, and protection electronics across current and future Burro products. You'll design PCBAs, develop firmware, and troubleshoot hardware issues on deployed units, taking designs from concept through prototyping, validation and production. ### **Responsibilities:** * Designing and revising electrical and embedded subsystems in the current and next generation Burro robots * Working with an interdisciplinary team to execute product designs from concept to production including design, prototyping, validation and testing * Managing product development timeline * Producing PCBAs, wiring diagrams, and cable and harness drawings suitable for manufacturing * Designing power distribution and protection electronics for our 48V robots * Designing safety\-related circuits using safety\-rated components in accordance with ISO 13849\-1 * Developing microcontroller firmware, and configuring and updating firmware on purchased power and charging equipment (chargers, battery monitors, motor controllers) * Writing clear failure analyses, root cause and corrective action reports, and test reports * Planning and running thermal qualification tests with margin above maximum operating temperature * Working directly with suppliers and contract manufacturers on technical requirements, DFM, and failure analysis * Reviewing other engineers' schematic and PCB designs and mentoring less experienced engineers * Producing review\-ready design packages (schematic PDFs, design documents) and releasing parts and drawings in our PLM system * Spotting field failure trends before they are assigned to you, driving the fix, and closing the loop in writing * Raising schedule risk early, with options, before a date slips * Keeping your own deliverables, schedule, and documents current without being asked * Building prototypes, debugging and repairing test systems, and supporting products in field ### **Requirements:** * BS/MS in electrical engineering, computer engineering or computer science * 8\+ years of experience in electrical and embedded systems development, with a proven track record of delivering successful products that make customers happy * Familiarity with design practices that support scalability, such as modular firmware architecture, reusable hardware components, and robust testing frameworks * In\-depth knowledge of embedded system architecture * Experience with schematic and PCB design tools such as Altium Designer * Ability to analyze a PCBA design, including determining margins for parts overstress * Good programming skills in C * Working knowledge of standard communication buses and protocols (e.g. UART, USB, I2C, SPI, CAN, etc.) * Solid embedded hardware and software debugging skills. Familiar with test/debug tools such as JTAG, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers and signal generators * Proficient in SMD soldering * Power electronics experience in 48V battery\-powered systems, including hot\-swap and inrush, overvoltage and overcurrent protection, and high\-current DC distribution (fuses and fuse derating, contactors, busbars, cable sizing) * Track record of taking initiative to find and fix problems no one asked you to own ### **Nice\-To\-Haves** * Previous start\-up experience, especially in mobile robot, electrical vehicle, or automotive industry * Experience in motor control and robotic actuators * Scripting experience with Python ### **Perks** * Competitive salary and benefits package (medical/dental/vision) * Early\-Stage Equity * 401K Plan with up to a 4% match * Unlimited PTO * Paid parental leave $110,500 \- $130,500 a year **RECRUITERS**: We are **not** accepting agency resumes for this position. Please do not forward or submit resumes through our website or to any of our employees directly. Burro is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. jobs.description: **Company Description** Avery Dennison Corporation (NYSE: AVY) is a global materials science and digital identification solutions company. We are Making Possible™ products and solutions that help advance the industries we serve, providing branding and information solutions that optimize labor and supply chain efficiency, reduce waste and mitigate loss, advance sustainability, circularity and transparency and better connect brands and consumers. We design and develop labeling and functional materials, radio\-frequency identification (RFID) inlays and tags, software applications that connect the physical and digital and offerings that enhance branded packaging and carry or display information that improves the customer experience. Serving industries worldwide — including home and personal care, apparel, general retail, e\-commerce, logistics, food and grocery, pharmaceuticals and automotive — we employ approximately 35,000 employees in more than 50 countries. Our reported sales in 2025 were $8\.9 billion. Learn more at www.averydennison.com. At Avery Dennison, some of the great benefits we provide are: * Health \& Wellness benefits starting on day 1 of employment * Paid parental leave * 401K eligibility * Tuition reimbursement * Employee Assistance Program eligibility / Health Advocate * Paid vacation and Paid holidays **Job Description** We are seeking an exceptionally talented and entrepreneurial AI engineer to build next\-generation Artificial Intelligence capabilities that transform how scientific knowledge is accessed, interpreted, synthesized, and applied across global R\&D. This is a fast\-moving, highly exploratory role within the Materials Science \& Characterization (MSC) organization, operating as an AI skunk works focused on developing custom AI systems and intelligent applications for scientific and engineering challenges. The successful candidate will work at the intersection of advanced AI architectures, large language models (LLMs), information retrieval, knowledge engineering, and scientific computing. A central part of the mission will be to develop sophisticated Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures that connect LLMs to proprietary scientific databases, experimental datasets, technical literature, patents, and internal knowledge repositories. Beyond conventional LLM applications, the candidate will explore and build custom solutions using LLMs, multimodal language models, and small language models (SLMs), along with agentic architectures capable of reasoning, retrieving information, orchestrating computational tools, and executing complex scientific workflows. We are looking for someone who thrives on experimentation, moves rapidly from concepts to working prototypes, and has the technical depth to build custom AI solutions rather than simply assemble existing tools. The opportunity is to establish entirely new ways of leveraging scientific knowledge and computational intelligence to accelerate innovation. Key Responsibilities Advanced LLM and RAG Architectures * Design, develop, and implement advanced RAG architectures connecting LLMs to complex scientific and engineering databases. * Explore and develop hybrid, graph\-based, hierarchical, multimodal, and agentic RAG approaches. * Build sophisticated retrieval, reranking, embedding, and context\-engineering pipelines to improve accuracy, relevance, and scientific grounding. * Develop mechanisms for source attribution, traceability, provenance, and reliable retrieval of scientific information. * Integrate structured and unstructured data sources, including scientific databases, technical reports, patents, publications, experimental datasets, and engineering documentation. Custom AI Models and Intelligent Agents * Develop, fine\-tune, adapt, and deploy custom LLMs, multimodal models, and SLMs for specialized scientific and engineering applications. * Build agentic AI systems capable of multi\-step reasoning, information retrieval, data analysis, and computational task execution. * Develop multi\-agent architectures that coordinate specialized tools, models, and scientific workflows. * Explore emerging model architectures, orchestration frameworks, and AI development paradigms to identify opportunities for competitive differentiation. * Evaluate open\-source and commercial foundation models and determine optimal architectures for specific scientific applications. Scientific Knowledge Engineering * Develop intelligent interfaces and knowledge systems that make complex scientific databases accessible through natural language and semantic search. * Build knowledge graphs, scientific ontologies, and semantic representations connecting materials, formulations, processes, structures, properties, and performance. * Develop pipelines for extracting and structuring scientific information from heterogeneous sources, including complex documents, tables, figures, and experimental records. * Establish robust approaches for data preparation,  odern software engineering, model orchestration, and deployment frameworks. * Integrate LLMs with scientific databases, Python\-based computational tools, simulation platforms, and analytical workflows. * Explore emerging technologies and translate promising concepts into practical, working applications. * Establish evaluation frameworks to assess model accuracy, retrieval quality, hallucination rates, reliability, security, and practical utility. Collaboration and Innovation Across R\&D * Work closely with materials scientists, computational scientists, experimentalists, and engineers to identify opportunities for AI\-enabled scientific discovery. * Translate complex scientific problems into computational architectures and working AI solutions. * Help establish new capabilities and technical standards for the responsible deployment of AI across R\&D. * Stay at the forefront of developments in LLMs, agentic AI, multimodal systems, and scientific AI. **Qualifications*** BS or MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related technical discipline. * Candidates from engineering disciplines will also be considered with exceptional computer science foundations and demonstrated AI engineering expertise. * Strong programming and software development skills, particularly in Python. * Demonstrated experience developing and implementing LLM\-based applications, including RAG architectures. * Strong understanding of modern machine learning, deep learning, transformer architectures, embeddings, vector databases, and information retrieval. * Experience with modern AI development frameworks and tools, such as PyTorch, Hugging Face, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent technologies. * Experience working with APIs, databases, data pipelines, and software integration. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities, with the ability to translate ambiguous problems into practical computational solutions. * Ability to work independently as well as in a diverse cross\-functional team, experiment rapidly, and develop working prototypes with minimal supervision. * Experience in one or more of the following areas is highly desirable: + Advanced RAG architectures, including Graph RAG, Agentic RAG, and multimodal RAG. + Fine\-tuning and customization of open\-source LLMs and SLMs. + Multi\-agent systems and intelligent AI orchestration. + Knowledge graphs, ontologies, semantic search, and scientific knowledge representation. + Vector databases and hybrid retrieval architectures. + Model evaluation, benchmarking, and optimization. + Multimodal AI involving technical documents, scientific images, tables, and structured/unstructured data. + AI application development, deployment, and scalable software architectures. + Integration of AI systems with scientific computing, simulation, and engineering tools. Experience in scientific, engineering, or industrial applications is particularly valuable. * Less than 10% travel expected. **Additional Information** All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or other protected status. jobs.title: Staff Engineer, Fullstack and Applied AI
jobs.description: Awayday is looking for a Staff Engineer, Fullstack and Applied AI to join our IT Team! The Staff Engineer, Fullstack and Applied AI is the senior technical individual contributor in Awayday’s AI and application engineering function. The role owns the hardest technical problems across the custom application estate and the agentic capabilities built on the governed data platform: the designs others build against, the systems that must not fail, and the standards that keep a blended team of full\-time and contracted engineers producing consistent work. This is a build role with leverage. You will spend most of your time designing and writing production code across the stack, and the remainder raising the capability of everyone around you through design review, code review, and mentoring. You carry no direct reports and no budget; influence comes from the quality of your designs and the technical judgment others defer to. The ideal candidate is a full\-stack engineer with genuine production depth in applied AI: someone who can take an ambiguous business problem, decide whether it calls for an agent, a model call, or conventional software, build it, and prove that it works before it reaches a user. The role calls for an engineer who sets the technical standard by example and raises others rather than absorbing their work, who takes ownership of outcomes across the whole system rather than only the component assigned, who is pragmatic about where sophistication is warranted and skeptical of unproven AI capability, and who stays calm under pressure and communicates tradeoffs so any audience can act on them. **Key Responsibilities:** **Technical Design and Hands\-On Delivery** * Own the design of significant systems end to end: application services and APIs, integration with systems of record, data access patterns, and the user\-facing layer. * Translate ambiguous business problems into technical designs, including the judgment of when an agentic or model\-based approach is warranted and when conventional software is the better answer. * Write and maintain the design documents, interface contracts, and reference implementations other engineers build against. * Build and ship production software across the full stack, taking the most complex and highest\-risk components personally, including work that crosses pod and system boundaries where no single team has the full picture. * Build and maintain the shared libraries, services, and internal tooling that remove repeated effort across the team, and operate what you build: instrumentation, alerting, performance and cost tuning, and incident response. * Identify and retire architectural risk and technical debt before it constrains the roadmap, and make the case for the investment required. **Applied AI Engineering** * Design and build agentic capabilities in production: orchestration, tool and function design, retrieval, context and memory management, and the integration layer between models and systems of record. * Build the evaluation harness that proves a capability works: test sets, regression evaluation, grounding and accuracy measurement, and the thresholds a capability meets before release. * Implement guardrails, human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints, and failure handling so that model behavior stays within defined bounds. * Engineer the security controls specific to agentic systems: scoped and least\-privilege tool permissions, prompt\-injection and data\-exfiltration defenses, input and output filtering, rate and cost limits, and complete logging and tracing of model and agent activity for audit. * Partner with Data Services on the governed metrics, semantic definitions, and retrieval foundations the agentic assistant depends on, and surface gaps early. * Track the model and tooling landscape, run focused proofs of concept, and give the Director a clear recommendation with evidence. * Lead the technical side of build\-versus\-buy evaluations: define the evaluation criteria and test sets, benchmark candidate models, platforms and vendor products against them, estimate engineering effort and inference and platform cost, and document the recommendation with evidence. **Quality, Standards, and Delivery** * Set and enforce the engineering standard through design and code review across the work of full\-time and contracted engineers, including the testing, documentation, and observability expected of every change. * Strengthen the development pipeline: CI/CD, environment management, infrastructure as code, automated testing, and release practice. * Build security and privacy into designs from the start, in partnership with IT Security, including the handling of employee, guest, and owner data. * Meet the AI governance requirements set by the Director: evaluation records and release evidence for each capability, documented risk tier and approval, model and prompt version control with change history, and participation in security reviews and threat modeling before release pability of the engineers around you through mentoring, pairing, and substantive code review with full\-time and contracted peers, and serve as technical escalation when they are blocked. * Support hiring as a technical interviewer, and contribute to leveling and interview standards for engineering roles. * Lead by demonstration on AI\-assisted development practice, including how such output is reviewed before it is merged. **Qualifications:** * 8\+ years building and operating production software, with a track record of owning systems of significant scope end to end. * Demonstrated full\-stack depth: services and APIs, data access and persistence, and modern front\-end development, with the judgment to work credibly at every layer. * Production experience delivering LLM\-based capability, including retrieval\-augmented generation, tool and function calling, agent orchestration, context and memory design, and prompt engineering grounded on trusted data. * Demonstrated ownership of evaluation for AI systems: test sets, regression evaluation, accuracy and grounding measurement, and the discipline to hold a release until the evidence supports it. * Deep experience with a major cloud platform in production, AWS strongly preferred, including CI/CD, infrastructure as code, observability, and cost and performance tuning. * Demonstrated technical leadership without formal authority: design and code review across a team, mentoring, and standards adopted because they were persuasive, including with contracted engineers. * Hands\-on participation in an agile practice: elaboration into stories with acceptance criteria, estimation, sprint planning, review, and retrospectives. * Strong oral and written communication, including the ability to document a design clearly and explain technical tradeoffs to a business audience. * Sound security and privacy judgment in system design, and openness to an evolving model, agent, and application stack. * Experience implementing guardrails and security controls for AI systems in production, including tool permission scoping, prompt\-injection defenses, audit logging, and human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience with AI, Agent frameworks, Model Context Protocol (MCP) or comparable tool\-integration standards, and vector or hybrid retrieval. * Experience running model observability in production, including logging, tracing, drift detection, and inference cost management. * Hospitality, vacation\-rental, or property\-management domain experience, including integration with those operational platforms and technical onboarding of acquired systems. * Experience with Terraform, AWS application and AI services, and cloud identity and RBAC design. * Prior staff, principal, or technical lead designation at a comparable organization. **Why Join Awayday?** * Be part of a **fast\-growing** company with opportunities for advancement. * Full\-time employees receive **PTO, 401K participation, health insurance, and life insurance**. * Work in a **dynamic, team\-oriented environment** where your contributions make a direct impact. * A collaborative, energized team that’s passionate about hospitality and performance marketing. Ready to make an impact? Apply today and help us shape the future of vacation rentals! Awayday, LLC, is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship. Awayday, LLC makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.

jobs.title: Sr. AI Engineer, Enterprise Data Analytics, Remote Eligible, Baptist Health
jobs.description: About Baptist Health Recognized as a top place to work in health care, Baptist Health cares for more patients in Northeast Florida than any other provider, ranking as “most preferred” for more than 30 years. We’re Jacksonville's only locally governed, faith\-based, not\-for\-profit health system and provide a full spectrum of preventive and specialty care through 200\+ locations and six hospitals. Our centers of excellence include Baptist MD Anderson Cancer Center, Baptist Heart Hospital, Baptist Neurological Institute and Wolfson Children's Hospital. **Sr. AI Engineer, Enterprise Data Analytics, Remote Eligible, Baptist Health** This role is a software engineer who designs, builds, and operates production AI agents: software that reasons with an LLM, plans, calls tools and enterprise systems, and takes action to do real clinical and operational work. You take a use case the AI Analysts have framed and turn it into a governed, evaluated agent that retrieves the right Baptist data, calls tools and systems including Epic, acts in the workflow, and proves itself safe and accurate through evals. You own each agent end to end in .NET, version\-controlled in GitHub, containerized with Docker, tested, and shipped through CI/CD, observable and governed. The bar is a working agent in production, not a demo. The role is the most senior builder on the team. Reporting to the Senior Director of AI, the Senior knows and owns all of the agentic domains below, sets the patterns the build team follows, and mentors the developers below them. We are looking for someone with this skill set to help us build the agentic platforms the rest of Baptist Health builds on. The Senior works inside the standards set by the Principal AI Architect and with the Platform Architects, SRE, and AI Analysts to land safe, observable agents in production. Every agent the Senior ships is registered in the enterprise agent registry and meets enterprise governance and security controls. The AI Engineer works with AI Analysts and clinical and business stakeholders to translate workflow needs into application requirements. They partner with Senior AI Engineers, MLOps Engineers, Platform Architects, and Site Reliability Engineers to deploy and maintain applications. They also guide Associate AI Engineers through design decisions, code reviews, testing, and troubleshooting. **Sr. AI Analyst Responsibilities:** * Own the design, implementation, testing, release, and support of assigned AI applications and agents. * Work with AI Analysts to turn validated business needs into feasible designs and measurable acceptance criteria. * Build Python or C\#/.NET services, model integrations, retrieval, and orchestration components. * Design and build secure integrations with Epic and other enterprise systems. * Enforce authorization, approval, execution, and recovery controls on agent actions. * Own testing and evaluation for assigned solutions, including automated software tests, AI evaluations, and regression suites. * Document design decisions and operations; instrument systems, diagnose incidents, and fix production defects. * Review designs and code, contribute reusable components, and mentor Associate AI Engineers. Work with Senior AI Engineers on decisions that affect shared patterns. * Meet AI registration, security, privacy, and governance requirements; tune performance, latency, and cost against measured outcomes. **Sr. AI Analyst Experience** * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated technical capability. * Strong proficiency in Python or C\#/.NET, with experience designing, deploying, and maintaining production applications. * Practical experience integrating large language models into software; working knowledge of agent orchestration, tool calling, retrieval\-augmented generation, and AI evaluation. * Experience building REST APIs and integrating enterprise systems; understanding of asynchronous processing, distributed applications, messaging, and failure recovery. * Proficiency with GitHub, automated tests, Docker, and CI/CD; experience developing or deploying on Microsoft Azure or a comparable cloud. * Experience with application security, authentication, and authorization, and diagnosing production issues through logs, metrics, and traces. * Ability to turn requirements into maintainable solutions independently, document technical work clearly, and collaborate across engineering, architecture, operations, and business teams. **Education Note:** * BA/BS required * Degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience *preferred* **Certification Note:** ***(required)*** * Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Apps and Agents Developer Associate (AI\-103\), or a similar current Microsoft AI associate credential, within 6 months of hire, held active throughout tenure. Primary Location: Remote \- Florida 123 Remote St Tallahassee, FL 32301 United States of America

applications, services, or developer tools, with strong proficiency in TypeScript, JavaScript, and React. * Demonstrated hands\-on experience building at least one substantive AI\-enabled application, CI/CD practices. * Ability to move independently from an idea to a working prototype, then collaborate with others to integrate and productionize it in an existing codebase. * Practical understanding of unreliable model output, context constraints, privacy and data security, evaluation, and the need for human oversight. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical findings, limitations, and trade\-offs clearly. **What Will Make You Stand Out** * A portfolio, GitHub repository, technical demonstration, or professional project showing a substantive AI tool or workflow you have personally built. * Experience evaluating and integrating one or more agent frameworks or AI development platforms, with clear reasoning for the implementation choices. * Experience with tool calling, retrieval\-augmented generation, structured outputs, memory, orchestration, or multi\-agent collaboration. * Experience connecting AI\-enabled workflows to GitHub, GitHub Copilot, Azure DevOps, Model Context Protocol servers, internal tools, or other data sources. * Experience creating AI\-enabled workflows for coding, testing, debugging, code review, documentation, or engineering knowledge discovery. * Experience defining evaluation methods, regression tests, and success measures for quality, reliability, latency, cost, and user impact. * Experience adding privacy, authorization, prompt\-injection, rate\-limit, fallback, or observability controls to AI\-enabled systems. * Evidence of ongoing experimentation through personal or open\-source projects, technical demonstrations, technical writing, or hackathon work. * Experience with a TypeScript/React monorepo and tools such as pnpm, Vitest or Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright, or Module Federation. * Experience with iTwin.js, CesiumJS, WebGL, digital twins, BIM, CAD, geospatial, or infrastructure software. \#LI\-RB1 \#LI\-Hybrid This is a Hybrid role. **What We jobs.title: Senior Engineer - Machine Learning
jobs.description: **Be Part of the Next. Be Berkadia.** ===================================== Berkadia is built on deep expertise, strong relationships, and a commitment to excellence across the commercial real estate industry. What sets us apart is our people. As a values\-driven organization, we foster a culture where collaboration thrives, growth is encouraged, and employees are empowered to make an impact. Together, our people strengthen our business and help shape the future of Berkadia. Are you ready to be part of the next? Discover your next opportunity at Berkadia and apply today. As a Senior Engineer, Machine Learning at Berkadia, you’ll be at the forefront of applying cutting\-edge machine learning and generative AI to redefine how the commercial real estate industry operates. Berkadia now has a dedicated machine learning team and an established generative AI system — Berkie — which is transforming the way Berkadians work. In this role, you will contribute directly to expanding and improving Berkie, building on top of proprietary company data to create intelligent systems that drive operational efficiency, enhance workflows, and generate revenue. You will work closely with product, engineering, architecture, and data teams to design, implement, and scale AI systems \- ranging from predictive modeling and traditional machine learning pipelines to agentic systems, intelligent document processing, and generative AI applications. This is a high\-impact position for someone passionate about applying AI to real\-world problems, who thrives in a collaborative environment and stays ahead in a fast\-moving field. **Responsibilities** * Design, implement, and maintain production\-ready machine learning systems using both generative and traditional techniques. * Architect end\-to\-end AI solutions for use cases such as intelligent document processing, agentic systems, and information retrieval. * Drive the continued development of *Berkie*, Berkadia’s generative AI platform, ensuring it delivers meaningful access to proprietary data and supports efficiency and growth across the business. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams — including product, engineering, and data — to identify impactful problems and translate them into scalable AI solutions. * Write maintainable, high\-quality code using Python and modern cloud infrastructure; use notebooks as needed for experimentation and rapid iteration. * Establish and contribute to best practices in MLOps, including model deployment, monitoring, observability, and continuous improvement. * Participate in peer reviews, design discussions, and team learning sessions to foster transparency and knowledge\-sharing. * Document system designs, decisions, and outcomes to improve clarity and reproducibility across the team. * Stay up\-to\-date with the rapidly evolving ML and GenAI landscape; self\-learning and curiosity are essential to success in this role. * Take initiative, share wins, and work with purpose — we value engineers who care deeply about their craft and their impact on others. **Qualifications** Qualifications to perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the experience required. * 6\+ years of professional software development experience, with a focus on Python. * Experience building both traditional machine learning models (e.g., regression, classification, clustering) and generative AI systems (e.g., LLMs, retrieval\-augmented generation, prompt engineering). * Familiarity with cloud infrastructure and MLOps practices (deployment, monitoring, observability). * Experience working with unstructured and semi\-structured data, including transforming it into structured formats via machine learning. * JavaScript experience is a plus. * Experience with Agile methodologies and CI/CD practices. Knowledge/Skills/Abilities: * Deep curiosity and a strong drive for self\-learning; ability to stay current with rapid developments in ML and generative AI. * Clear communicator with excellent written, visual, and verbal skills. * Strong problem\-solving and analytical thinking. * Collaborative and open to sharing knowledge, giving and receiving feedback, and celebrating team progress. * Motivated by impact and a sense of purpose in your work. The provided base salary information for this position is part of an overall national range. The actual salary within our range for this position will be determined by several factors, including but not limited to the scope, complexity and location of the role, the skills, education, training, credentials, and experience of the candidate. The total compensation package for this role may also include additional incentive opportunities. **Compensation**: $200,000\- $225,000 USD **We believe People Matter, so we offer benefits that go beyond:** ================================================================== * Monthly paid volunteer hours and donation matching to benefit our communities * Employee Resource Groups that help you grow with us * Fertility and family planning services * Up to 12\-weeks of fully paid parental leave * Mental health care, including free counseling sessions: * We'll help you fund your learning journey with generous tuition reimbursement * Pet insurance discounts * And more! **Be Your Best Self. Be Berkadia.** =================================== Berkadia, as an equal opportunity employer, celebrates our employees’ unique differences, which we believe drives personal and company\-wide innovation and creates a people\-first culture where your career can take the long view. To achieve these goals, we are committed to the inclusion of all qualified individuals, without regard to race, religion, age, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, domestic partner status, military and veteran status, disability, pregnancy, parental status, genetic information, political affiliation, or any other status protected by federal, state and local laws. In keeping with our commitment, Berkadia takes the necessary steps to provide a workplace free from harassment, discrimination, and unlawful retaliation, as well as access and reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities and sincerely held religious beliefs. If you require a reasonable accommodation to take part in the interview process, please contact talentacquisition@berkadia.com. You have rights under federal, state and local employment laws. No question in this Application is intended to elicit information in violation of any such law, nor will any information obtained in response to any question be used in violation of any such law. If you apply for this role, you are acknowledging Berkadia's Application Policy and Berkadia's Privacy Policy. Please click the following links for more information about: EEOC, Employee Rights under the FMLA, EPPA.

jobs.title: Java Backend Engineer, VP - Aladdin Trader
jobs.description: Locations: **New York, New York** **Job description** ------------------- **About this role** You will be part of the Trading Engineering team supporting Aladdin, BlackRock’s investment operating system used internally and by financial institutions globally. The team operates at the intersection of finance and technology, building robust solutions that support investment and trading workflows with a focus on reliability, speed, scalability, and technical excellence. The team brings together engineers, traders, product managers, and other partners to solve complex problems and deliver technology that drives meaningful business outcomes. The environment emphasizes collaboration, continuous learning, open dialogue, and high\-quality engineering. **Your role and impact** ------------------------ You will be at the heart of Aladdin, building the technology that supports BlackRock’s and our clients’ investment and trading operations. You will design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications and high\-performance Application Programming Interfaces (APIs), working closely with traders, product managers, and engineers to translate requirements into impactful solutions. You will troubleshoot technical challenges, optimize microservices and data\-processing pipelines, and explore new technologies that improve system performance. Through hands\-on engineering, mentorship, and collaboration, you will help strengthen the reliability, security, and efficiency of mission\-critical trading systems. This role provides the opportunity to make an impact in a global trading environment while working on complex technical problems and supporting the continued development of engineering talent. **Your responsibilities** ------------------------- In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities: * Design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications and backend services to support trading operations. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including traders, product managers, and other engineers to define requirements and deliver solutions. * Implement and optimize high\-performance APIs, microservices, and data processing pipelines. * Ensure best practices in code quality, testing, deployment, and security. * Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues across the system with a focus on reliability and efficiency. * Continuously research and adopt new technologies to improve team productivity and system performance. * Mentor junior engineers and contribute to a positive, innovative team culture. **Your experience** ------------------- ### **Minimum qualifications** * Bachelor of Science or Master of Science degree in Computer Science or related technical field. * Minimum 7 years’ proven experience as a Software Engineer, preferably in trading, finance, or similarly complex environments. * Proven experience with object\-oriented programming languages such as Java 17\. * Expertise in jobs.description: About Blackhawk Network: Today, through BHN’s single global platform, businesses of all kinds can tap into the world’s largest network of branded payment solutions. BHN helps businesses grow revenue, increase loyalty, motivate and reward their teams, disburse funds and engage consumers. Branded payment solutions include the issuance and distribution of gift cards, egifts, corporate payouts and rewards, along with the technology to deliver these products in seamless, integrated ways. BHN’s network spans the globe with more than 400,000 consumer touchpoints. Learn more at BHN.com. **Hybrid flexibility:** At Blackhawk Network, you’ll enjoy the best of both worlds—focused remote work plus in\-person collaboration at our Coppell, TX office. This rhythm gives you the tools, connection, and autonomy you need to make a real impact. Overview: The Operations Command Centre (OCC) is looking for a Platform Engineer II who combines strong engineering judgement with confident ownership of production services. This is not a traditional Platform Engineering or NOC role: you will improve the systems you operate, using automation, observability and sound operational practice to prevent incidents, shorten diagnosis and restore service safely. You will work across BHN’s production platforms and partner closely with application, infrastructure and business teams. At this level, you are expected to independently investigate complex issues, take a leading role in major incidents, and keep technical and non\-technical stakeholders aligned through clear, timely communication. assess evidence, risks and options; escalate promptly when impact or uncertainty warrants it; and avoid unvalidated or unsafe changes. * Provide concise, regular updates tailored to the audience—covering customer or business impact, current status, actions underway, risks, decisions needed and the next update time. * Maintain a clear incident timeline and ensure actions, owners and decisions are captured for effective handover and later review. * Contribute to blameless post\-incident reviews; document operational dependencies and failure modes. **Observability \& reliability engineering** * Improve service visibility through meaningful metrics, logs, traces, dashboards and actionable alerts. * Tune alerting to identify customer\-impacting conditions early while reducing noise and alert fatigue. * Use production and incident data to identify reliability risks, capacity concerns, performance trends and improvement opportunities. * Define, measure and use Service Level Indicators (SLIs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and operational health measures with service teams. * Share findings and recommendations clearly, using evidence to help teams prioritise reliability work. **Intelligent operations \& continuous improvement** * Use AI\-assisted engineering tools where appropriate to improve delivery, investigation and documentation; validate outputs and follow security, privacy and engineering controls. * Identify practical opportunities for incident summarisation, contextual diagnostics, knowledge retrieval and workflow automation. * Help evaluate and operationalise intelligent tooling with appropriate human oversight, testing, auditability and failure handling. * Contribute to runbooks, knowledge systems and operational learning that make troubleshooting faster and more consistent. experience leading or coordinating high\-severity incidents is essential. * Strong written and verbal communication: able to explain technical issues in plain language, write concise status updates and handovers, facilitate discussions, and communicate calmly and confidently under pressure. * Strong Linux fundamentals and practical experience with AWS or another major cloud platform. * Working knowledge of Git and modern software\-development practices, plus practical scripting or automation experience in Python, Bash or a similar language. * Sound judgement, clear ownership and a collaborative approach: able to coordinate across teams, make progress amid ambiguity, and escalate with the right context. * A continuous\-improvement mindset, including the ability to turn incidents and operational data into prioritised, measurable engineering changes. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. **Helpful experience** * Kubernetes, Docker or other container platforms; jobs.description: It all started with an idea at Block in 2013\. Initially built to take the pain out of peer\-to\-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay/Clearpay, to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 50\+ million monthly active customers. We want to redefine the world’s relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible. Today, Cash App has thousands of employees working globally across office and remote locations, with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration and impact. We’ve been a distributed team since day one, and many of our roles can be done remotely from the countries where Cash App operates. No matter the location, we tailor our experience to ensure our employees are creative, productive, and happy. #### **The Team** Apollo leads Block's work on the **Customer World Model**: a continuously evolving representation of each customer's goals, context, history, constraints, and likely future needs. The Customer World Model powers **Proactive Intelligence** across Block's ecosystem, including Square, Cash App, and Afterpay. Instead of customers searching through products for the feature they need, the system understands what matters to them, anticipates what comes next, and takes timely action that improves their outcomes. Both are top priorities for Block. #### **The Role** We're hiring exceptional AI Researchers to take Customer World Model and Proactive Intelligence from promising research to reliable production systems. You'll set the technical direction, solve the hardest research and engineering problems, and own delivery all the way through production integration. The scope covers customer representations, forecasts, decision models, evaluation, real\-time serving, and integration into the products customers use every day. You'll shape problems that span several teams, connect applied research with engineering and product, and raise the effectiveness of everyone around you through shared infrastructure, clear technical standards, and mentorship. Our team already builds heavily with agentic development tools. As throughput grows, the judgment to frame the right problem, validate the result, and get it through the last mile matters more than ever. That judgment is what this role brings. #### **You Will** * Translate product needs into research and engineering plans with clear, measurable success criteria. * Develop customer representations, forecasts, and decision models from large\-scale event, transaction, and behavioral data. * Evaluate models rigorously for accuracy, uncertainty, and real customer impact, and build the evaluation frameworks that predict how they'll perform in production. * Own the path from prototype to production, including data dependencies, real\-time serving, monitoring, and integration with product teams. * Lead cross\-team technical decisions, act as a tie\-breaker on hard tradeoffs, and build shared capabilities that reduce duplicated work across Block's businesses. * Expand automation across development, experimentation, evaluation, and operations so the whole team moves faster. * Mentor researchers and engineers, set technical standards, and help grow the team's research and engineering practice. #### **You Have** * A track record of technical leadership at a Principal or equivalent level, setting direction for work that spans multiple teams. * \[10\+] years of experience in machine learning research or engineering, \[or a PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Operations Research, or a related field with 7\+ years of industry experience]. * Deep expertise in modern machine learning, including representation learning, sequence or foundation models, and forecasting or decision\-making under uncertainty. * Experience taking models from research to production at scale, and owning them through serving, monitoring, and iteration. * Strong judgment in evaluation: offline and online metrics, calibration and uncertainty, experimentation, and measuring real customer impact. * Fluency in Python and a modern ML framework such as PyTorch or JAX, and the ability to write production\-quality code. * Clear communication and the ability to align research, engineering, and product partners on ambiguous problems. #### **Preferred** * Experience building foundation models or embeddings over transaction, event\-sequence, or behavioral data. * Experience with reinforcement learning, causal inference, counterfactual evaluation, or next\-best\-action systems. * Experience building real\-time ML systems that power customer\-facing products. * Experience in financial technology, payments, or another regulated domain. * Hands\-on experience using agentic development tools to speed up research and engineering. * A record of research excellence through publications, open\-source contributions, or equivalent work. #### **Success in Your First Year** * You've set the technical direction for a core part of the Customer World Model or Proactive Intelligence, with success criteria the team and product partners agree on. * At least one capability you led is in production, monitored, and measurably improving a customer experience. * You've built a shared evaluation or infrastructure capability that other teams use instead of building their own. * The team ships faster and with higher confidence because of the standards, automation, and mentorship you brought. Contact us here with hiring practice or data usage questions. *Every benefit we offer is designed with one goal: empowering you to do the best work of your career while building the life you want.
