jobs.title: Associate GTM Engineer, AI
jobs.description: Go\-to\-market is being rebuilt around AI, and the teams that get it right will pair smart systems with people who know where judgment, taste and follow\-through still matter. We're hiring someone who wants to be that person, and who wants to help build the systems too. Blue Orange Digital is an AI consulting and implementation firm. We build data and AI systems for private equity firms and the upper mid\-market companies they own, which means our buyers are skeptical, busy, and very good at spotting noise. We've been at this long enough to earn their trust. We still run like a startup: a small team, a short distance between an idea and a shipped thing, and nowhere for good work to hide. You'll work directly with our founder and CEO, a technical founder, and alongside our sales and go\-to\-market leads. Together we're figuring out what go\-to\-market looks like when AI handles most of the production. Then we're building it, and you'll be one of the people running it. ###### **What You'll Work On** This is a broad role on purpose. You'll own or co\-own programs across marketing and the sell side, each one built heavily with AI: * Newsletter. Grow and run a newsletter that PE operators actually open, with AI doing the heavy lifting on research and drafting. * Media. Help stand up our media operation, including video, which we're just starting to lean into. * Account\-based marketing. Targeted programs aimed at specific PE firms and portfolio companies, so the right people discover us before they need us. * GEO and AEO. Make sure Blue Orange shows up when a buyer asks ChatGPT, Claude or Perplexity who to call about AI. * Content. Articles, posts, case studies and point\-of\-view pieces that sound like a firm with opinions. * Sales enablement. Decks, messaging, offers and video for the sales team, plus the AI skills and infrastructure that let us produce them in hours instead of weeks. Across all of it, you'll own the numbers. We already have strong analytics, and this role lives in them: setting up tests, reading what's working, and telling us where our time and energy should go next. We want taste and data working together. Good instincts get something shipped, the data tells us whether people engaged, and engagement is the goal in every one of these channels. AI makes it easier than ever to pull every channel into one consistent view of go\-to\-market. We need someone watching that view every day and acting on it. Some of these are running. Some are half built. A few are ideas on a whiteboard. You'll do the implementation, and you'll also be in the room when we decide what to build next. Bring ideas. We'd rather test five and keep one than debate one for a month. We care about shipping. A rough version in front of a real audience this week beats a polished plan for next quarter. ###### **How You'll Work** You'll work with the tools most marketing teams haven't touched yet: agent orchestration, workflow automation, Claude Code, custom skills, and whatever ships next month that's better. You'll learn how the technical side works by building on it next to people who build this for clients every day. You'll start behind the keyboard. As you learn our sales process, how we qualify deals, and how the data and AI market fits together, you'll move into client\-facing work. We'll train you for that. Nobody gets thrown in front of a PE partner on day ten. ###### **Who Does Well Here** The people who thrive at Blue Orange can't leave a system alone. When they see a tool, they want to know how it works, and they don't really believe they understand something until they've built it end to end. They act before they're told to. They finish things, then check the numbers to see whether it worked. They'd rather own a messy problem than polish someone else's slide. If you've ever stayed up rebuilding a workflow because the first version annoyed you, or wired three AI tools together just to see if it would work, we want to hear from you. ###### **What You Need** * Roughly 1 to 3 years of experience in marketing, growth, go\-to\-market, sales ops, consulting or a startup, or clear evidence you've built real things on your own * Heavy daily use of AI tools, with opinions. You should be able to tell us where models from Anthropic, OpenAI and Google each win, and why you think so * Comfort with technology and a real appetite to learn the technical side. You don't need to be an engineer * Clear writing. Most of this job ends up as words someone else reads * Based in New York City and in our Midtown office 2 to 3 days a week * Rigor with analytics and testing. You set up experiments, read results honestly, and change course when the data says so ###### **Nice to Have** * You've used Claude Code, even if you're not technical * You've run a CMS such as WordPress, Webflow or Sanity, especially if you've driven it with AI * Some video production or editing experience * Exposure to private equity, B2B services, or data and AI ###### **Where This Goes** This role has a lot of room above it. Once you've built domain knowledge in data and AI, paths open into client work, sales, and owning a go\-to\-market function outright. The people who build the playbook tend to end up running it. ###### **Compensation** * Base salary: $90,000 to $105,000 * On\-target earnings: $125,000 to $140,000 Variable pay is paid quarterly. About 60% is tied to sales\-accepted pipeline from any channel you run, and about 40% is tied to program goals you set with the founder each quarter. The split exists because some of the most valuable work here, like the newsletter and GEO, builds over time and doesn't show up as a lead this month. Pipeline pays on the upside. ###### **How to Apply** Send us something you built with AI: a workflow, an agent, a newsletter, a strange experiment that half worked. Tell us in a few sentences what it does and what you'd change about it. That tells us more than your resume does, though we'd like that too. Background checks may be required for certain positions/projects. Blue Orange Digital is an equal\-opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: At Bluesight, our mission is to create groundbreaking solutions that increase efficiency, safety and visibility for health systems, hospital pharmacy, and pharmaceutical manufacturers. The pipelines you build will carry data from hospital systems, third\-party sources, and our own applications into products that pharmacy directors and compliance teams use every day. they can be better * Write and refine queries to explore, validate, and explain the data you work with * Understand the data contracts and commitments we make with other teams * Implement data quality checks and monitoring, and learn to tell useful alerts from a noisy ones * Debug pipeline and data issues, and explain afterward what went wrong and why * Document what you build, both for fellow data engineers on your team, and for the teams supporting customers * Take part in discussions about data modeling, quality, and governance, where good questions count as a contribution * Exercise care in handling PHI and PII, guided by our engineering principles and the policies set by DevOps and Security * Grow toward owning a data domain, and toward being the person teammates come to about it ### **Required Qualifications \& Skills** * A bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience in a quantitative or data\-intensive field * Working skills in SQL\-style or distributed (MapReduce, Spark, etc) querying, comfortable with different data types, joins and aggregations * Programming experience * Familiarity with version control and automated testing * Understanding of ETL concepts and how data moves and transforms between systems * Knowledge of, or curiosity about, tradeoffs in data modeling, storage, and other aspects of data engineering * Clear communication about work, including flagging problems and blockers early, asking well\-formed questions about problems, and willingness to help build knowledge from the answers * Comfort taking on unfamiliar problems, knowing your team is available for help * Comfort giving and receiving feedback in code reviews to help the whole team improve over time * Attention to detail, especially regarding correctness in data ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience building robust data pipelines * Experience with pipeline orchestration and monitoring * Experience in a cloud environment or other environment with "infrastructure as code" * Experience handling regulated or sensitive data * Knowledge of or interest in healthcare data (e.g. EHR, FHIR, automated dispensing systems, purchasing reports) The standard base pay range for this role is $110,000 \- $130,000 when annualized. In addition to a base salary, this position is also eligible for an amazing benefits package. The actual amount of salary offered will vary depending on the position level, experience, performance, and location. This position is fully remote and open to applicants in the continental United States. We truly believe that where you work and what you do matters. jobs.title: Analytics Engineer
jobs.description: Brain Corp is a San Diego, California, USA\-based AI company creating transformative core technology for the robotics industry. Our purpose is to create autonomous technology that helps the real world work better. Brain's robotic and AI solutions help retailers ensure that the right product is on the right shelf at the right price, in a clean environment. Through the BrainOS® Robotics Platform, which powers the largest global fleet of the Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs) in operation in commercial public spaces, Brain Corp delivers insightful and efficient automated solutions in both commercial floor cleaning and inventory management, empowering organizations and their employees to achieve more. Brain Corp currently powers more than 50,000 AMRs, representing the largest fleet of its kind in the world. Brain Corp is funded by the SoftBank Vision Fund, Clearbridge, and Qualcomm Ventures. Named a top workplace by the San Diego Union Tribune and USA today in 2025, we make life\-changing impacts through innovation, helping workers globally unlock their abilities in orchestration with intelligent machines. ### **Position Summary:** As a member of the Operational Data \& Analytics team, the Analytics Engineer builds and runs the data products that Brain Corp's operations, customers and leadership rely on: trusted metrics, production data pipelines and the applications that put them in front of people. Operational data drives customer commitments, company goals and audit evidence, and this work is in a scalable, production\-grade data platform. This role builds and owns that platform's data products, writing production code with tests, reviews and monitoring rather than one\-off reports. The role works cross\-functionally with Operations, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, Manufacturing and Compliance. ### **Essential Job Functions:** * Design, build and maintain the operational metrics, dashboards and data applications used by business units, customers and leadership, owning each from requirements through release and support. * Build reliable, cost\-aware transformations and data products on top of Data Engineering's managed sources, and partner with Data Engineering when a durable source is needed. * Ship and operate data products with CI/CD, automated testing and monitoring, following the company's platform and security standards. * Define metrics once in version\-controlled code, keep every number traceable to its source, and add tests, freshness checks and alerts that catch problems before users do. * Turn open business questions into clear analyses, and turn recurring questions into lasting self\-serve views. * Take operational problems from problem statements to controlled improvement: define the metric and baseline, support the fix, and put monitoring and alerts in place so the gain holds. * Build alerting on operational data and produce reliable evidence for customer commitments and audit controls. * Build and maintain AI\-assisted data tools on approved models, with evaluation and guardrails. * Communicate findings and trade\-offs clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences, including executives and customers. ### **Education and/or Work Experience Requirements:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Statistics or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 3\-5 years in analytics engineering, engineering or a similar role, shipping production code that others relied on. * Advanced SQL on a cloud data warehouse (BigQuery preferred), including performance and cost tuning. * Strong Python for data pipelines and services. * Software engineering practices: version control, code review, automated testing and CI/CD. * Experience with a major cloud platform; Google Cloud preferred. * Data modeling and metric definition across messy, multi\-source data. * Sound judgment on data quality: validates before publishing and says when the data cannot answer the question. * Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non\-technical audiences. ### **Required Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, and Other Characteristics That Make a Difference:** * Data transformation and orchestration tools. * Infrastructure as code and containerized services (Docker, Cloud Run). * Business intelligence tools (Grafana, Looker, Power BI) or front\-end skills for building data applications. * IoT, robotics or other device telemetry data. * CRM or field\-service data (Salesforce Service Cloud or similar). * Building with large language models: prompting, tool use and evaluation. * Supporting SOC 1 / SOC 2 or similar audit controls. * Experience with collaborative \& project management tools. Essential functions may require maintaining the physical condition necessary for sitting, walking or standing for periods of time; operating a computer and keyboard; use of hands to finger and grasp; talk and hear at normal room levels; visual acuity to determine the accuracy, neatness, and thoroughness of the work assigned or to make general observations of facilities or structures; push or pull up to 20 pounds. ### **Work Environment:** The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Employees are exposed to the typical office environment with computers, printers and telephones. ### **Salary Range:** The anticipated salary range for candidates who will work in San Diego, California is $127,500 to $135,000\. jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer
jobs.description: Burro is the leading robotics company in the world by number of robots working outdoors in the field with real customers. Our mission is to free people from tedious work and solve the critical labor shortages faced by farmers and others that work outdoors. To accomplish our mission, we need a world\-class, diverse team where everyone feels comfortable sharing their ideas. With this in mind, we strive to create a work environment where every employee can be themselves and express their perspective, which enables us to deliver the most creative and innovative solutions to problems our customers face. Headquartered in Philadelphia with an office in central California, and backed by top Agtech and autonomy investors, including S2G, Catalyst, Translink, Cibus, FPrime, Toyota Ventures, FFVC, Xplorer, and Radicle, Burro was created to solve the labor shortages facing farmers using robotics. Burros can be described as Disney's Wall\-E for agriculture and work outdoors, in a 1\.0 format. They function, today, as computer vision based autonomous ground vehicles for carrying, towing, and scouting, and are designed to lay the base for the fully autonomous future of work outdoors. We have 800\+ robots in our growing fleet deployed in paid commercial use within vineyards, nurseries, berries, and beyond, and demand for our product is accelerating, so we are growing our team. We are hiring a **Sr. Electrical Engineer** in our Philadelphia office to own power, distribution, and protection electronics across current and future Burro products. You'll design PCBAs, develop firmware, and troubleshoot hardware issues on deployed units, taking designs from concept through prototyping, validation and production. ### **Responsibilities:** * Designing and revising electrical and embedded subsystems in the current and next generation Burro robots * Working with an interdisciplinary team to execute product designs from concept to production including design, prototyping, validation and testing * Managing product development timeline * Producing PCBAs, wiring diagrams, and cable and harness drawings suitable for manufacturing * Designing power distribution and protection electronics for our 48V robots * Designing safety\-related circuits using safety\-rated components in accordance with ISO 13849\-1 * Developing microcontroller firmware, and configuring and updating firmware on purchased power and charging equipment (chargers, battery monitors, motor controllers) * Writing clear failure analyses, root cause and corrective action reports, and test reports * Planning and running thermal qualification tests with margin above maximum operating temperature * Working directly with suppliers and contract manufacturers on technical requirements, DFM, and failure analysis * Reviewing other engineers' schematic and PCB designs and mentoring less experienced engineers * Producing review\-ready design packages (schematic PDFs, design documents) and releasing parts and drawings in our PLM system * Spotting field failure trends before they are assigned to you, driving the fix, and closing the loop in writing * Raising schedule risk early, with options, before a date slips * Keeping your own deliverables, schedule, and documents current without being asked * Building prototypes, debugging and repairing test systems, and supporting products in field ### **Requirements:** * BS/MS in electrical engineering, computer engineering or computer science * 8\+ years of experience in electrical and embedded systems development, with a proven track record of delivering successful products that make customers happy * Familiarity with design practices that support scalability, such as modular firmware architecture, reusable hardware components, and robust testing frameworks * In\-depth knowledge of embedded system architecture * Experience with schematic and PCB design tools such as Altium Designer * Ability to analyze a PCBA design, including determining margins for parts overstress * Good programming skills in C * Working knowledge of standard communication buses and protocols (e.g. UART, USB, I2C, SPI, CAN, etc.) * Solid embedded hardware and software debugging skills. Familiar with test/debug tools such as JTAG, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers and signal generators * Proficient in SMD soldering * Power electronics experience in 48V battery\-powered systems, including hot\-swap and inrush, overvoltage and overcurrent protection, and high\-current DC distribution (fuses and fuse derating, contactors, busbars, cable sizing) * Track record of taking initiative to find and fix problems no one asked you to own ### **Nice\-To\-Haves** * Previous start\-up experience, especially in mobile robot, electrical vehicle, or automotive industry * Experience in motor control and robotic actuators * Scripting experience with Python ### **Perks** * Competitive salary and benefits package (medical/dental/vision) * Early\-Stage Equity * 401K Plan with up to a 4% match * Unlimited PTO * Paid parental leave **RECRUITERS**: We are **not** accepting agency resumes for this position. Please do not forward or submit resumes through our website or to any of our employees directly. Burro is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Reporting to the FDE Lead and partnering with the Forward Deployed Strategist, the role turns complex customer problems into working production capabilities and accountable for technical solution quality, engineering execution, production readiness, and the technical measures within the engagement scorecard This role combines software engineering, solution architecture, technical consulting, and rapid problem\-solving across CDW's AI Services Framework (AI Blueprint, AI Enable, AI Implement, AI Manage, and AI Secure). The Forward Deployed Engineer operates inside the customer's environment, writes production\-grade code, connects systems and data, builds AI agents, MCP servers, and workflows on frontier AI platforms such as Anthropic and OpenAI, provides technical direction to global delivery resources who flex onto pod\-defined builds, and hands solutions off cleanly to Global Managed Services. Between customer milestones, the role contributes field\-proven patterns to the Lighthouse Pod and CDW's portfolio IP. What you will do Customer\-Embedded Engineering and Pod Delivery * Embed with named customer accounts, as part of a dedicated enterprise pod or a shared pod serving 3–5 mid\-market customers, and partner with the FDE Lead and Forward Deployed Strategist to understand business processes, technical environments, constraints, and desired outcomes. * Translate ambiguous customer needs into technical requirements, solution designs, prototypes, and production implementations. * Own technical delivery from discovery through build, deployment, validation, and handoff to Global Managed Services to reduce handoffs and context loss. * Communicate technical options, tradeoffs, risks, and progress clearly to customer and internal stakeholders. AI Solution Design and Production Delivery * Design, build, test, and deploy production\-grade enterprise AI applications, agents, sub\-agents, skills, MCP servers, workflows, integrations, APIs, and data pipelines in the customer's environment. * Develop production\-quality software using modern engineering practices and cloud\-native architectures. * Implement patterns such as retrieval\-augmented generation, tool use, agent orchestration, evaluation, observability, and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows where appropriate. * Integrate AI capabilities with customer systems, data sources, security controls, and operational processes. * Troubleshoot complex technical issues and optimize solutions for reliability, performance, security, maintainability, and cost. Technical Leadership and Collaboration * Collaborate with the FDE Lead, Forward Deployed Strategist, Lighthouse Pod, Field CTO, architects, security, data, cloud, and other CDW practices (for example, the AWS practice) where delivery overlaps. * Evaluate emerging AI technologies and rapidly develop technical points of view through hands\-on experimentation. * Share knowledge with engineering and delivery communities and support the adoption of validated tools and patterns. * Balance rapid iteration with enterprise\-grade engineering discipline. As a Founding Engineer, you will own a core product or engineering domain end to end, work directly with customers, and help shape technical and product decisions. ### **What You'll Do** * Own a domain from architecture through daily production releases. * Join customer calls, synthesize feedback, and make product decisions independently. * Build and optimize multimodal agents, including low\-latency voice experiences and persistent conversations across channels. * Set quality practices for non\-deterministic systems, including evaluations, prompt versioning, guardrails, and drift detection. * Build across React and Next.js frontends, Node.js backends, and Python services. ### **What We're Looking For** * Three to eight years of full\-stack engineering experience, with a record of shipping and scaling products in fast\-paced environments. * Production proficiency with TypeScript, Node.js, React, and Next.js, plus experience building Python services. * Hands\-on experience building production systems with LLM APIs or agent SDKs. * Depth in at least one area: production voice or SMS agents, long\-running agent state and memory, agent evaluations and guardrails, or B2B2C and marketplace architecture. * Ability to own product decisions, conduct customer discovery, and deliver independently in an early\-stage environment. * Experience with low\-latency systems and production AI or agentic systems. Voice pipelines, evaluation tooling, and infrastructure tools such as Redis or BullMQ are useful. * Strong computer science fundamentals or demonstrated founder experience and product traction. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary: $180,000 to $250,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is not available. ### **Location** On\-site five days per week in New York, New York. Compensation Range: $180K \- $250K

jobs.title: Founding Engineer, AI Agents
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Join the founding engineering team building an AI agent framework for farm operations. You will design and ship systems that help agents handle real business decisions, with direct feedback from the teams using them. ### **What You'll Do** * Design and own the agent framework, including roles, tools, permissions, approvals, and runtime orchestration for long\-running tasks. * Build memory and context systems that give agents relevant farm\-specific knowledge, including operational knowledge that may not be documented. * Develop code automation that supports repeatable work and escalates unexpected situations to human oversight. * Create evaluations and safety measures to build trust and track agent performance over time. * Build tools on top of the data layer and integrate machine learning insights into the framework. * Work with farm teams to observe real\-world usage and improve the product based on feedback. ### **What We're Looking For** * Two to four years of engineering experience shipping production LLM agents or agentic workflows that people rely on. * Experience building agents with tool use, context and memory design, orchestration, and evaluation. * Strong Python skills and familiarity with PostgreSQL, asynchronous systems, and workflow engines. * Experience writing evaluations, investigating real\-world user needs, and independently performing system design and critically reviewing AI\-generated code. * Knowledge of memory, retrieval, and context management, including when work should be handed to a person or handled with conventional code. * Experience with durable workflow engines such as Temporal, agent observability and tracing, or security topics such as prompt injection and permissions is a plus. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary is $170,000 to $200,000 annually, plus 1% equity with four\-year vesting and a one\-year cliff. Benefits include healthcare, AI coding tools and model access, and work hardware. Visa sponsorship is not available; candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship. ### **Location** On\-site in San Francisco, five days a week, with about one week of travel per quarter to farms in Washington, Oregon, and California. Compensation Range: $170K \- $200K

jobs.title: Founding Engineer, AI Platform
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Build and improve AI talent agents for a recruiting technology platform that connects engineers with growing startups. As a founding engineer on a small team, you will own agent quality and reliability, from evaluation systems to production infrastructure. ### **What You'll Do** * Build simulation harnesses that run agents against production code, schemas, and background jobs in local environments. * Create scenario evaluations and assertions that turn production failures into regression tests. * Compare prompt variants and agent runtimes on shared scenarios, measuring cost, cache hits, and latency. * Own agent observability, including traces, prompt versioning, rollouts, and service monitoring. * Develop platform infrastructure using TypeScript services, cloud deployments, background jobs, and PostgreSQL. * Speak with candidates and hiring teams to help shape agent capabilities. ### **What We're Looking For** * At least 2 years of production software experience, including on\-call or ownership of production issues. * Experience building or operating LLM evaluation or simulation harnesses with scenarios, assertions, and regression tests based on production failures. * Experience shipping LLM features to real users. * Strong TypeScript and Node.js skills; Python experience is a plus. * Experience with PostgreSQL, queues, background jobs, CI/CD, and cloud deployments, including GCP Cloud Run or a similar platform. * Experience with observability tools such as Langfuse or Datadog, prompt versioning, and rollout practices. * Agent runtime, load testing, or LLM latency and cost optimization experience is helpful, as is early\-stage startup experience. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary: $130,000 to $170,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is available, including OPT sponsorship for qualified candidates. ### **Location** On\-site in San Francisco, California. Compensation Range: $130K \- $170K

jobs.title: Founding Engineer, Data
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Own the data infrastructure for an AI\-powered operating system serving farms. You will build the connectors and data models that bring information from disconnected farm systems into a unified platform, helping the team deliver reliable insights and agents. ### **What You'll Do** * Build a connector framework that makes integrating additional customers and systems fast and repeatable. * Develop a reliable process for AI agents to draft production\-ready connectors from vendor documentation. * Create ways to access data without APIs, including a collector that runs on farm servers. * Design and maintain a canonical farm data model, including AI\-proposed mappings for human review. * Own data quality and evaluation tools to detect when integrations or pipelines break. * Build tools for agents to query data and prepare machine learning training sets. * Investigate farm operations and occasionally connect systems on\-site. ### **What We're Looking For** * Two to four years of engineering experience building and operating production pipelines or integrations with messy data sources. * Strong Python and SQL skills, with experience using PostgreSQL, a data warehouse such as BigQuery, and dbt. * Experience designing schemas that other people and systems rely on, and resolving production issues directly. * Daily experience building with AI, with a practical understanding of its limitations. * Experience with data quality and evaluation frameworks, and an interest in real\-world operating problems. * Experience with Airbyte, Fivetran, document extraction, or OCR is helpful. * Background working with ERP, IoT, agriculture, logistics, or food supply chain data is helpful. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary is $170,000 to $200,000 annually, plus 1% equity vesting over four years with a one\-year cliff. Healthcare and work\-related hardware are provided. Visa sponsorship is not available; candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship. ### **Location** On\-site in San Francisco, five days a week, with about one week of travel per quarter to farms in Washington, Oregon, and California. Compensation Range: $170K \- $200K

jobs.title: Founding Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** As the first machine learning engineer on a founding team at an agricultural technology company, you will build the models and data foundation that help growers make informed operational decisions. You will bring fragmented farm data together and evaluate models against real\-world outcomes. ### **What You'll Do** * Audit and integrate historical data from farm systems, identifying available signals and data gaps. * Build forecasting, performance analysis, and operational efficiency tools for growers. * Develop rigorous backtesting and evaluation frameworks to assess model accuracy before deployment. * Create privacy\-first, anonymized datasets that enable farms to benefit from shared insights. * Partner with an agent engineer to deliver actionable insights through the product. ### **What We're Looking For** * Two to four years of engineering experience, including shipping production ML models that inform real decisions. * Strong Python and SQL skills, with fluency in pandas or polars, scikit\-learn, gradient boosting, and forecasting libraries. * Experience with tabular or time\-series data, data pipelines, and tools that explain model behavior. * Careful model evaluation skills, including understanding data leakage, backtesting, and production readiness. * Ability to explain model outputs and uncertainty to non\-technical stakeholders and investigate users' operational problems. * Daily experience building with AI and interest in combining LLMs and agents with classical ML. * Experience in agriculture, weather, supply chain, or other physical\-world forecasting is helpful, as is experience with privacy\-preserving data approaches. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary is $170,000 to $200,000 annually, plus 1% equity with four\-year vesting and a one\-year cliff. Healthcare benefits are provided. Visa sponsorship is not available; candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. ### **Location** On\-site in San Francisco, five days a week. Travel to farms in Washington, Oregon, and California is expected for about one week per quarter. Compensation Range: $170K \- $200K

jobs.title: Founding Product Engineer

jobs.title: Founding Product Engineer

jobs.title: Research Engineer, AI Evals
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** Join a consumer technology research team evaluating how AI models behave alongside real people. You will design and ship practical benchmarks that measure real\-world model behavior, helping distinguish meaningful results from evaluations that can be gamed. ### **What You'll Do** * Develop and publish benchmarks regularly, taking each from an initial idea through its results. * Design studies with clear tasks, no\-AI baselines, participant consent, and measurable real\-world actions. * Build evaluation harnesses that isolate model performance from prompt wording, and run leading models through them. * Create grading systems using ground truth, verifiers, and rubrics. * Document methods and write up findings for publication. ### **What We're Looking For** * 0 to 3 years of research or engineering experience, with an early PhD or research\-minded undergraduate background. * Experience building and shipping an evaluation, benchmark, or human study end to end. * Strong Python skills and experience using model APIs at scale. * Understanding of model cards, how evaluations can be gamed, and how to design technically serious tests. * Experience designing studies and building grading systems with ground truth, verifiers, and rubrics. * Relevant background may include human\-subject research in psychology, HCI, or social science; research on persuasion, sycophancy, or deception; speech or audio; or a published paper or open benchmark. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Salary range: $180,000 to $350,000 annually, plus equity. Visa sponsorship is available. ### **Location** On\-site in Palo Alto, California. Compensation Range: $180K \- $350K

jobs.title: US Founding Engineer

jobs.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer, Automation
jobs.description: Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster. We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy\-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI. We're looking for problem\-solving, opportunity\-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services. If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high\-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe. **About the Role:** Crusoe is seeking a Senior Staff Software Engineer on our Architecture team to help shape how our infrastructure monitors, configures, and heals itself without human intervention. You will partner with the Physical Network Automation team to design the automation frameworks, self\-healing workflows, and observability platforms that allow our global fleet to scale sublinearly with headcount. This is a senior technical leadership role at the intersection of Architecture, Software Engineering, and Infrastructure Reliability. You will work side by side with the Physical Network Automation team, combining Architecture's design perspective with their operational and implementation expertise, to turn intent\-based designs into production automation. You will also represent Architecture in cross\-functional planning with Deployment, Operations, and Site Reliability. You're not writing scripts to replace manual tasks. You're helping design the control plane model that makes our infrastructure intelligent. **What You'll Be Working On:** * **Co\-Develop the Automation Architecture:** Partner with the Physical Network Automation team to shape the technical roadmap and reference architecture for Crusoe's automation stack, from source of truth and configuration generation through day\-2 operations, telemetry, and closed\-loop remediation. * **Shape the Source of Truth:** Work with automation and operations teams on the data model that drives configuration, validation, and operational state, and help establish how systems integrate with it. * **Design Intent\-Based Systems Together:** Collaborate on declarative, model\-driven configuration pipelines that treat infrastructure as code and make configuration drift impossible, contributing architectural direction while the automation team brings implementation and operational insight. * **Contribute to Model\-Driven Standards:** Help define the approach to API\-driven, schema\-defined telemetry collection, configuration management, and state validation across heterogeneous hardware and vendors. * **Design Self\-Healing Workflows:** Work jointly on the architecture for event\-driven, auto\-remediation systems that detect faults, correlate telemetry, and resolve known failure modes without human escalation. * **Shape the Observability Strategy:** Partner on the technical direction for telemetry, metrics, alerting, and dashboarding, including streaming pipelines and the data models behind them. * **Advocate for Automation\-First Design:** Work with network architects and automation engineers so that designs are deployable, validatable, and operable programmatically at scale from day one. * **Collaborate and Multiply:** Participate in design reviews, architecture reviews, and technical discussions that raise the engineering bar across both teams, learning from the automation team as much as guiding them. **What You'll Bring to the Team:** * **12\+ years of engineering experience** with a demonstrated focus on production software engineering, platform architecture, and infrastructure as code in hyperscale or internet\-scale environments. * **Demonstrated Technical Leadership:** Proven track record of helping define architectures for automation platforms that a broader engineering organization builds on, and of influencing and aligning teams you don't directly manage. * **Strong Software Engineering Foundation:** Fluency in Python or Go, with a clear understanding of what makes systems testable, CI/CD\-integrated, and production\-ready. You can review and contribute to implementation, and prototype when needed. * **Model\-Driven Automation Fluency:** Deep experience with declarative, schema\-defined configuration and telemetry, and a clear view of why model\-driven automation is the only path to hyperscale. * **Source of Truth Design:** Experience designing or contributing to an infrastructure source of truth, including the data model, integrations, and the pipelines that consume it. * **Event\-Driven and Self\-Healing Systems:** Experience architecting or building auto\-remediation and closed\-loop automation that detects, correlates, and resolves faults without human intervention. * **Observability Expertise:** Hands\-on experience designing streaming telemetry and observability platforms at fleet scale. * **Hyperscale Operational Context:** Comfort designing for 10K\+ devices and multi\-region fleets, where the blast radius of a bug is measured in racks, not individual machines. * **Cross\-Team Partnership:** Ability to build trust and shared direction with automation engineers, architects, and operations teams, and to keep designs and implementations aligned without relying on formal authority. * **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience in hyperscale or internet\-scale environments. **Benefits:** * Competitive compensation and equity packages * Restricted Stock Units * Paid time off, paid holidays \& leave of absence programs * Comprehensive health, dental \& vision insurance * Employer contributions to HSA account * Paid parental leave * Paid life insurance, short\-term and long\-term disability * Professional development \& tuition reimbursement * Mental health \& wellness support * Commuter benefits (parking \& transit) * Cell phone stipend * 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary * Volunteer time off * Global travel insurance \& emergency assistance * Daily meals allowance * Additional perks \& programs specific to location **Compensation Range** Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $250,000 \-$300,000 \+ Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster. We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. We're solving that — with an energy\-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI. In this role, you’ll go beyond solving today’s problems to help build the architecture that runs the AI infrastructure of tomorrow. You’ll help drive adoption of modern networking paradigms like intent\-based networking, declarative configuration management, and network source of truth, improving how Crusoe designs, provisions, and operates its network at scale. **What You'll Be Working On:** * **Data Center Architecture:** Design and implement network architecture for Crusoe’s AI data centers, including spine\-leaf fabrics, out\-of\-band management, RDMA (RoCEv2/InfiniBand), and inter\-campus WAN connectivity. * **Intent\-Based Networking:** Help build IBN frameworks that translate operational goals into validated, auto\-generated device configurations. * **Declarative Networking and GitOps:** Implement infrastructure\-as\-code practices, GitOps\-driven network provisioning, and continuous validation pipelines for network state. * **Network Source of Truth:** Contribute to Crusoe’s SoT strategy, helping maintain authoritative data models (IPAM, DCIM, CMDB) and ensuring devices, links, and policies remain version\-controlled and consistent. * **Automation Workflows:** Build day\-0/1/2 automation using tools like Ansible, Nornir, or Terraform, driven by the network source of truth. * **Observability and standards and reference architectures, participate in architecture reviews, author design documents, and present proposals to engineering leadership. * **Team Mentorship:** Mentor mid\-level and document tradeoffs and recommendations. **Connect Data, Systems \& Organizational Knowledge** * + Build and maintain solutions on the organization’s cloud data platform (currently Microsoft Fabric), including warehouse and Lakehouse components, data pipelines, medallion data flows, identity\-resolution routines, and secure integrations with enterprise systems and APIs. + Implement governed ingestion of approved organizational documents using metadata, document\-processing, and search services while preserving source, version, effective\-date, ownership, and access\-control information. + Develop context\-registry data and metadata that link documents to programs, measures, versions, and effective dates so analytics and AI use the applicable organizational context. + Support certified semantic models and implement approved glossary terms, measures, descriptions, synonyms, lineage, stewardship metadata, sensitivity labels, data\-quality controls, and data loss prevention requirements established through the organization’s data governance program and tools. + Build hybrid, vector, and semantic retrieval capabilities with security trimming, de\-identified or minimum\-necessary AI\-facing data, and row\-level security that provide the governed retrieval foundation for RAG applications and other AI solutions. **Deliver Trusted \& Responsible Solutions** * + Configure answer provenance so AI outputs identify the measures, data sources, and cited document passages, versions, and dates used to generate each response. + Create and maintain an evaluation gold set of validated questions and use repeatable correctness and groundedness testing after material changes to data, definitions, indexes, models, or prompts. + Implement human\-review controls and reviewer routing for low\-confidence or flagged outputs; ensure AI\-generated content does not become an approved definition, finding, or program decision without appropriate review. + Apply version control, deployment pipelines, automated testing, monitoring, logging, error handling, and audit records so solutions are reliable, supportable, and traceable. **Support Adoption, Learning \& Continuous Improvement** * + Create technical documentation, architecture diagrams, data flows, support procedures, configuration records, and end\-user guidance; provide demonstrations and hands\-on support for responsible adoption. + Use preview and emerging capabilities in bounded pilots, maintain production sys Python and SQL * Experience designing and consuming REST APIs and working with structured and unstructured data * Experience with cloud data platforms, data pipelines, dimensional and/or medallion architectures, data quality, and identity resolution * Experience with generative AI and retrieval patterns, including embeddings, hybrid or vector search, RAG, agents, evaluation, citations or provenance, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls * Working knowledge of Power BI semantic models and data\-governance practices such as business glossaries, stewardship metadata, lineage, sensitivity labeling, DLP, access controls, row\-level security, and minimum\-necessary data * Experience with Git\-based version control, deployment pipelines, automated testing, monitoring, logging, documentation, and change management * Demonstrated ability to turn unclear organizational needs into practical, secure, maintainable solutions, access emerging capabilities, and explain technical tradeoffs to non\-technical stakeholders * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and cross\-functional collaboration skills Strongly Preferred: * Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Fabric (including Warehouse, Lakehouse, and Data Factory) or comparable cloud data platforms * Experience with Microsoft Azure AI services (including Azure AI Search, Azure AI Document Intelligence, Microsoft Foundry, and Fabric data agents) or comparable AI services * Experience in nonprofit, human services, education, healthcare, or another mission\-driven environment **Here's the Good Stuff...** * **Full\-time position with a starting salary of $100,000**. jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI analytics platform (Chord)
jobs.description: **About Chord** Most AI analytics breaks the moment it meets a real business. Fetching the numbers is the easy part. The hard part is knowing which definition of revenue the finance team trusts, and why last quarter’s spike shouldn’t count. Chord gives AI that context, so teams can ask questions in plain language and get answers they can act on. Chord recently acquired Zenlytic, combining Chord’s data foundation (from collection through modeling) with Zenlytic’s analytics agent. We started in commerce and now work with enterprise teams well beyond it. Our next big bet is context that improves itself: a system that learns from every correction and decision, so the agent gets more accurate the more a company uses it. We’re a small engineering team that puts AI at the center of how we build, and every engineer owns meaningful parts of the product end to end. Chord is backed by top investors and led by experienced operators. Our company is proudly remote\-first, distributed across North America. For this role, we prefer candidates based in New York City, and we’ll also consider candidates in Montreal, Canada. US residency is not required. **The Opportunity** * We’re looking for a Software Engineer to help Chord build the context layer for agentic commerce — the platform that enables AI agents to understand, reason, and safely operate real commerce businesses. * You’ll help build Chord’s AI analytics platform, including the agent harness and data layer it runs on, shipping real work from week one. You’ll do it mostly by directing coding agents well, then owning the result. A large part of the role is supporting our largest enterprise customer, which runs Chord in a private cloud, and becoming their main technical point of contact. Our stack includes a Python backend (Flask/FastAPI, Celery, SQLAlchemy on Postgres) and a React/TypeScript frontend built with Vite, running on Docker and Kubernetes. As our next Software Engineer, you will be a key member of the engineering team and will report directly to our VP of Engineering. **As our next Chordian, you will:** * Build on our AI analytics platform, including the agent harness, the semantic layer, and the data tooling behind it. * Work product tickets end to end: triage, spec, design, implement with agents, review, and ship, making sound design calls with limited direction. * Support our largest enterprise customer’s private\-cloud deployment on a two\-week release cycle, including UAT fixes, deploy\-day support, and bug turnaround, and become their main technical point of contact within your first few months. * Shape our coding\-agent workflow, where agents pick up tickets from Slack and Linear, by finding where it breaks and owning the fixes. * Review pull requests from teammates and agents, and help raise the bar on how we use coding agents. * Document your work, including runbooks, ticket specs, and release notes. To be successful in this role, you’ll need: * About 3 to 6 years of experience shipping production software, including debugging in production. * Experience building or debugging LLM\-backed features in production, such as agent loops, tool calling, and tracking down non\-deterministic failures. * Something real you’ve shipped with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) that you can show us. * Experience with Python or TypeScript/React, and a willingness to work in both. * The ability to read code you didn’t write, including agent output, and spot what’s wrong, including design and maintainability problems, not just bugs. * Clear written communication, including with customers, and comfort being the person a customer turns to when something breaks. * Experience with enterprise software releases, UAT cycles, or private\-cloud deployments is a plus. * Comfort reading SQL is a plus. Most of ours is generated from a YAML semantic layer (similar to LookML), so writing it by hand matters less. * Experience building or using MCP servers or clients, including auth and tool design, is a plus. * Experience owning containerized releases on Kubernetes, including image builds, versioning, rollback, and fixing vulnerabilities a scan flags, is a plus. * Customer\-facing or support experience is a plus. Working at Chord, you can expect: * An investment in your physical and mental well\-being; we offer 100% employee Medical Benefits coverage, with 69% dependent coverage. * Flexible PTO; we encourage you to take the time you need to be your best self at work. * An onboarding package and annual work from home stipend to ensure you have everything you need to be successful while working remote. * Generous Parental Leave with customizable transition back to work program. * The benefits of working from home, with opportunities to spend quality time with the team at Chord in\-person events throughout the year. * To make an impact! We’re an early\-stage company, which means there is space to champion ideas, and create and lead initiatives at any level in the Organization. This is a full\-time, salaried position that includes Equity. * **About your application and the interview process** ---------------------------------------------------- Chord is an equal opportunity employer, and we value diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. If you’re unsure about your qualifications for this position, we still encourage you to apply. Our interview process for the role begins with an exploratory conversation with a member of the hiring team. After that, we’ll invite you to Zoom sessions with a range of stakeholders from across our organization. We aim to get to know you and allow you to learn more about our team and product while being respectful of your time. **The pay range for this role is:** 150 \- 200 USD per year(New York, NY) 150 \- 200 CAD per year(Remote (Montreal, QC, CA))

jobs.title: Plan Check Engineer
jobs.description: **Description** --------------- **Join Our Team – Plan Check Engineer (Building Services)** The City of San Ramon is seeking a qualified and motivated Plan Check Engineer to join our Building Services team! If you are passionate about engineering, public safety, and making a positive impact in the community, we encourage you to apply! **The Ideal Candidate:** The ideal candidate will have demonstrated experience performing both structural and non\-structural building plan reviews, with a strong understanding of applicable California building codes, construction practices, and structural design principles. Possession of a Registered Professional Civil Engineer (PE) license in the state of California is required, and there is a 5% pay bonus for having a Professional Engineer (PE) license. A Structural Engineer (SE) license and experience performing plan review within a municipal jurisdiction is desirable. The successful candidate will be detail\-oriented, technically proficient, and capable of independently evaluating construction documents for code compliance. Experience using Bluebeam and Tyler EPL is highly desirable. Equally important is the ability to communicate effectively and professionally with engineers, architects, contractors, homeowners, and other stakeholders while providing clear, consistent, and customer\-focused guidance and comments throughout the plan review and permitting process. **DEFINITION** Under general direction, performs field and office civil and transportation engineering work related to the planning, design, construction and maintenance of City and regional projects and programs in the areas of capital improvement, traffic operations and safety, and building services, including conducting plan checks, preparing project schedules, plans, specifications, and cost estimates; advertises for construction, coordinates engineering activities with contractors and other agencies and monitors contracts; and performs related work as required. **SUPERVISION RECEIVED AND EXERCISED** Receives general supervision from a Senior Engineer, Division Manager, and/or Department Director. May coordinate and supervise the work of lower\-level technical and clerical staff. **CLASS CHARACTERISTICS** This is the journey\-level in the professional engineering classification series and incumbents may perform the full range of the engineering functions, but with primary emphasis on infrastructure development and traffic issues in a developing City. Incumbents may be assigned to either the Engineering Services Department or the Transportation Services Department. This class is distinguished from the higher level of Senior Engineer in that the Senior Engineer handles complex projects and has full supervisory authority over lower\-level Engineers and Inspectors. It is distinguished from the lower\-level of Assistant Engineer in that the Associate Engineer has project management responsibilities in addition to performing the full range of professional engineering duties on routine projects and performs more complex plan checks. This class is further distinguished from the Senior Civil Engineer in that the latter is the full supervisory\-level class in the series and has ultimate responsibility for organizing, assigning, supervising, and reviewing the work of staff involved in a major functional area or project/program of the Engineering Division. **EXAMPLES OF TYPICAL JOB FUNCTIONS** **(Illustrative Only)** *Management reserves the right to add, modify, change, or rescind the work assignments of different positions and to make reasonable accommodations so that qualified employees can perform the essential functions of the job.* * Serves as plan check engineer or project manager on projects, including defining project scope and selecting consultants; negotiates contracts, change orders and amendments; prepares and monitors project schedules; monitors, reviews and coordinates project design and construction; evaluates contractor requests for extra work; monitors contractor's work and enforces terms of the contract; and processes payments and change orders; coordinates projects with businesses, utilities and other City departments. * Conducts field and construction site inspections; ensures contractor compliance with contract/plan documents and time and budget estimates; recommends field changes. * Prepares and reviews traffic signal timing plans and updates as needed; constructs traffic signal computer models used to prepare timing plans and prepares traffic signal designs and specifications. * Analyzes housing development plans and local infrastructure plans for their effect on traffic congestion, road access issues, traffic flow and related traffic related issues and develops mitigation plans. * Prepares designs, specifications, plans, estimates and reports for assigned Capital Improvement projects and the development and modification of City infrastructure. * Conducts civil and traffic engineering and related  , over the telephone, and in writing. * Use tact, initiative, prudence, and independent judgment within general policy, procedural, and legal guidelines. * Establish, maintain, and foster positive and effective working relationships with those contacted in the course of work. **Minimum Qualifications** -------------------------- **Education and Experience:** *Any combination of training and experience that would provide the required knowledge, skills, and abilities is qualifying. jobs.title: Field Engineer - St George
jobs.description: Civil Science is growing our construction team in Utah and is seeking a **Field Engineer** to support UDOT transportation projects in Utah (Regions 3 \& 4\). This is an excellent opportunity for an entry\-level engineer or recent graduate who wants hands\-on field experience working directly on active highway and infrastructure projects. Through our Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), you’ll have the chance to grow your career and save for retirement. * **Room to Grow:** Say goodbye to corporate red tape. Our agile structure empowers you to take ownership of projects, explore new roles, and accelerate your career. * **Work\-Life Harmony:** Your time outside of work matters. We offer flexibility to ensure your career complements your personal life. * **Comprehensive Benefits (Fulltime Employees):** Enjoy three weeks of PTO, eight holidays, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short/long\-term disability, tuition reimbursement, and a 401K plan. **About Civil Science** **Civil Science** isn’t just another engineering firm—we’re a 100% employee\-owned company with over 40 years of expertise and a bold vision for the future. Our team of talented engineers, surveyors, planners, and technicians partners with clients across the public and private sectors to deliver innovative and impactful solutions. At Civil Science, we believe in investing in our people. As an employee\-owner, you’ll enjoy unmatched opportunities for leadership, mentorship, and career growth, all within a culture that values collaboration, excellence, and entrepreneurial spirit. If you’re ready to join a firm that’s shaping the future of civil engineering, we’d love to have you on our team! jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: **ABOUT CIVILGRID** CivilGrid is the trusted civil design platform powering affordable infrastructure renewal and growth. We give utilities, civil engineers, and municipalities a single, collaborative source of truth for what's underground so teams can plan, design, and build faster, smarter, and safer. Our platform consolidates utility records, geotechnical and environmental data, paving moratoriums, and jurisdictional requirements directly from 3,000\+ utilities, agencies, and municipalities with full chain\-of\-custody documentation. Teams at PG\&E, Mark Thomas, and dozens of leading engineering firms use CivilGrid to cut research time by up to 88%, reduce project costs, prevent dig\-ins, and accelerate delivery on the projects that keep communities running. We're a venture\-backed Series A startup tackling a $4\.7T US infrastructure market that has been underserved by software for decades. Founded by industry insiders, each with 10\+ years in utilities and civil engineering, we move fast, ship work that matters, and stay close to the customers and field teams we build for. **WHY THIS ROLE** As a small team, we all wear many hats and enjoy tackling new challenges. When it comes to tech, we're seeking experienced individuals who can efficiently identify problems and devise solutions. As a Full Stack Engineer, you will be a foundational team member with the opportunity to work on all aspects of the application and shape the technical future of CivilGrid. Joining at this stage, you will build core systems that will help us scale quickly, and benefit from tremendous upside as we grow. This role will report to one of our Engineering Managers. It is a hybrid role with expectations that you are working from our downtown Boston office at least 3 days per week if hired. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** * Design and build end\-to\-end features, covering everything from database models to user\-facing components using React * Tackle a variety of areas: web and mobile applications, mapping interfaces, data processing pipelines, algorithmic relevancy, and real\-time collaboration tools * Profile and tune performance across the entire stack to ensure efficient and responsive systems * Implement and maintain analytics, health monitoring, alerts, and logging to maintain operational visibility and system reliability **WHAT YOU'LL BRING** * 5 years of experience working with JavaScript or TypeScript, particularly with React and Node.js (or equivalent frameworks) * Start Up Ready: Autonomous, moves fast, takes initiative without being asked, eagerness to learn and take ownership of hard problems * Strong foundational knowledge of PostgreSQL is a plus * Familiarity with geospatial frameworks (PostGIS, GeoJSON, map rendering libraries, etc.) is a plus * Conduct code reviews, mentor junior engineers, and offer constructive feedback to help grow the team’s technical capabilities * Strong verbal and written communication, able to articulate ideas clearly and collaborate effectively * A degree in Computer Science **HOW WE WORK** We're a small, but rapidly growing team that ships. Expect direct feedback, real ownership from day one, and proximity to customers — huge utilities, public agencies, and engineering firms whose work depends on what we build. We default to in\-person collaboration where it matters and remote\-friendly flexibility otherwise. We hire people who care deeply about their craft and the communities our customers serve. **COMPENSATION \& BENEFITS** **The base salary range for this role is** *$132,039 \- $201,101* Base salary is only one part of your total compensation package at CivilGrid, which also includes meaningful early\-stage equity, comprehensive benefits, and the opportunity to shape a category\-defining company. The base salary range listed above may encompass various levels and/or geographic locations; final offers are determined based on the candidate's experience, skills, level, and work location. In addition to base and equity, we offer: * Company\-funded medical, dental, and vision insurance — including medical plans at no cost to the employee * FSA (health and dependent care) * Unlimited PTO and a culture that expects you to actually use it * 401(k) plan * A high\-trust team, real ownership, and the chance to do the most meaningful work of your career **EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY** CivilGrid is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. Employment decisions at CivilGrid are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, please contact us — we're happy to help. Compensation Range: $132,039 \- $201,101

Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations. ### **What you need to have to be considered** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. * 5\+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline. * 4\+ years of hands\-on experience designing and developing enterprise ETL/ELT pipelines and large\-scale data processing solutions. * 3\+ years of strong programming experience in Python and SQL; experience with Java or Scala is preferred. * 3\+ years of experience working with cloud platforms, primarily AWS, with additional exposure to Azure or GCP. * Hands\-on experience with Databricks, Apache Spark, and distributed data processing frameworks. * Experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, Cloud Composer, or Azure Data Factory. * Knowledge of cloud data technologies including PostgreSQL, Cloud SQL, Snowflake, BigQuery, and modern data warehousing concepts. * Experience implementing DataOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and deployment frameworks. * Strong understanding of data governance, metadata\-driven frameworks, data quality controls, and security best practices. * Proven ability to troubleshoot complex data platform issues and optimize performance across cloud\-based environments. * Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with proficiency in the Microsoft Office Suite. ### **Salary and Other Compensation** Applications will be accepted until December 25, 2026\. jobs.title: Software Engineer L2
jobs.description: **About Curative** Curative is building the future of health insurance with a first\-of\-its\-kind employer\-based plan designed to remove financial barriers and make care truly accessible: one monthly premium with $0 copays and $0 deductibles\*. Backed by our recent $150M in Series B funding and valuation at $1\.275B, Curative is scaling rapidly and investing in AI\-powered service, deeper member engagement, and a smart network designed for today’s workforce. Our north star guides everything we do: healthcare only works when people can actually use it. That belief drives every decision we make: from how we design our plan, support our members, to how we collaborate as a team. If you want to do meaningful work with a team that moves fast, experiments boldly, and cares deeply, Curative is the place to do it. We’re growing fast and looking for teammates who want to help transform health insurance for the better. **Summary** We are hiring forward deployed software engineers to be the single technical owner of a business\- critical internal platform. Each engineer owns one surface end to end: architecture, production, roadmap, and stakeholder relationships. Candidates are matched to a team after the interviews: growth, plan accounting, provider payments, or pharmacy benefits. **How we build** At Curative, AI writes most of the code. Engineers direct it. We use agentic AI coding tools as the primary development surface. A senior engineer here routinely runs multiple agents in parallel: one implementing a feature, one resolving review comments, one chasing down a flaky test. The engineer’s job is to set context, make the decisions the AI can’t make, and keep the bar high on what ships. This is not a role for someone who wants to hand\-roll every line. It is also not a role for someone who will accept whatever the AI produces. We are looking for the engineer in between: strong enough fundamentals to catch a wrong answer in a few seconds, disciplined enough to review every diff, and ambitious enough to drive several times the output of a traditional IC. On a surface where the output has to add up and the system has to stay up, that discipline matters more than usual. Strong systems and architecture thinking is important, as is product taste. This is a fully remote position. **What you’ll own** * The codebase. A full\-stack Python \+ TypeScript application with real domain complexity. Code review, architecture, and quality bar are yours. * Production. Cloud infrastructure, deploy pipeline, observability, on\-call, incident response, and cost. Some surfaces are always\-on; design for resilience. * Sensitive data. Platforms touch PHI and/or financial data. Privacy discipline is built in, not bolted on. * Operational metrics. Beyond uptime: whether numbers reconcile, workflow completion rates, how much manual work the software actually eliminates. Surface what the data shows and close the loop. * Stakeholder relationships. You’re the engineer in the room with ops specialists, accountants, marketers, or network leads. Translate pain into scope, push back when a request won’t solve the real problem, earn trust by shipping. * The roadmap and strategy. Co\-own the plan with product and business stakeholders. Sequence work, flag what’s infeasible, propose what nobody has asked for yet. * Integrations. A growing set of connections to internal services and external partner, provider, or financial systems. * AI agents. Build and extend agents (we already run them on the Claude API) that take manual, repetitive work off people’s plates. * AI leverage tooling. Skills, evals, fixtures, prompts, and integrations that make agents effective on your codebase. * The domain. You won’t arrive an expert, but within 90 days you’ll know the workflows well enough that every prompt carries the right context. **What we’re looking for** **Foundational skills (non\-negotiable)** You need these because you are the last line of defense on what the AI produces. The bar is not “can write it from scratch in an interview.” The bar is “can read a 400\-line AI\-generated diff and spot the subtle bug in 90 seconds.” On these platforms, that bug is often a number that’s quietly wrong. * 5\+ years shipping production software. Enough reps that you recognize bad code before you can articulate why. * Real fluency in Python and TypeScript. Not “I can read it,” but fluent. You will direct work in both every day: Next.js and React on the frontend, FastAPI and SQLAlchemy on the backend. You should be equally unbothered by a typed codebase and by an older JavaScript one. * Strong SQL and relational database fundamentals. You can read a query plan, spot an N\+1, know when a migration is unsafe at scale, and reason carefully about the joins and aggregations that decide what a number ends up being. * Sharp written communication. You will spend more time writing prompts, specs, and PR descriptions than writing code. Note: Prior healthcare, insurance, or domain\-specific experience is not required. We care far more about your track record owning a product surface and the systems behind it, in a role where the business could see the results. Any industry counts. What we do look for is real interest in the problem space your team owns. **AI\-first working style (also non\-negotiable)** * You already use Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or equivalent as your primary development tool, not as a side autocomplete. * You have opinions about how to structure prompts, when to split work into subagents, and how to keep AI output from drifting. * You review every AI\-generated diff. You do not merge on vibes. * You treat the AI as a junior engineer with infinite throughput: high leverage, zero judgment, needs supervision. * You enjoy building tooling that makes AI more effective on your codebase: skills, evals, fixtures, integrations. * You see AI leverage as what makes it possible for one engineer to own a full product surface and stay close to users, not as a reason to stay heads\-down in a terminal. **Strongly preferred** * A portfolio of AI\-assisted work: skills you wrote, agents you built, automations you shipped. * Experience being the single owner of a non\-trivial service in production. * Domain experience in one of our team areas helps: growth or marketing engineering; financial systems such as billing, payments, or reporting; or real\-time, high\-availability services. * Experience with document and file ingestion at scale: parsing messy real\-world spreadsheets, PDFs, and email attachments into structured data. * Experience with sales or CRM systems, especially replacing one. **Why this role** Healthcare is one of the highest\-leverage places software can make a difference, and the platforms that run a health plan are where a lot of that leverage lives: winning employers, getting the money right, and keeping benefits working in real time. We are a company where a single engineer can own one of those platforms end to end. That is a scope most companies split across several teams. Your day might span building an agent that reads an inbound RFP into a structured quote request, debugging why two systems disagree on a number, digging into reliability and usage metrics to understand why throughput dipped, demoing a new workflow to an ops lead, and setting the technical strategy for your platform. If you have been looking for a role where you own the full loop, from problem discovery through production, where the work has a number attached to it that you can watch move, and where AI\-first isn’t a buzzword but the actual way work gets done, this is it. **Perks \& Benefits** * Curative Health Plan: 100% employer\-covered medical premiums for you and 50% coverage for dependents on the base plan. + $0 copays and $0 deductibles with completion of the Baseline Visit + Preventive and primary care built in + Mental health support + One\-on\-one care navigation + Chronic condition programs: diabetes, weight, and hypertension + Maternity and family planning support + 24/7/365 Curative Telehealth + Pharmacy benefits * Comprehensive dental and vision coverage * Employer\-provided life and disability coverage with additional supplemental options * Flexible spending accounts * Generous time off policy plus 11 paid annual company holidays * 401K for full\-time employees * Up to 8–12 weeks paid parental leave, based on role eligibility
