jobs.description: **Job Title: Junior Data Analytics Engineer** **Department: Data, Operations, \& Finance** **Reports to: Manager of Data Analytics Engineering** **Location: Remote** **Effective Date: TBD** **ABOUT THE DC PUBLIC CHARTER SCHOOL BOARD (DC PCSB)** Every day, we’re doing the work to ensure that 44,000\+ public charter school students, families, and communities receive a quality education that makes them feel valued and prepared for lifelong learning, fulfilling careers, and economic security. DC PCSB is an independent agency of the District of Columbia government. Our mission, vision, values, and work are rooted in the principle of ensuring that every DC student has access to a quality education. **ABOUT THE ROLE** The Data Team collects, maintains, stores, analyzes, reports on, and secures school\-related data. We build and maintain analytics products, including data exports, analytic reports, a school\-facing data portal, a governed data warehouse, and data pipelines. Our partners include agency staff and leadership, the Board, charter school leaders, and the public. As a Junior Data Analytics Engineer, you will help build and maintain data products that support charter school oversight and informed decision\-making. You will work on a team of Analytics Engineers and Data Engineers and report to the Manager of Data Analytics Engineering. This early\-career position is designed for someone with zero to two years of relevant experience. You will contribute through clearly defined assignments and assist more experienced Analytics Engineers across the team with complex work by completing components of data preparation, database maintenance, analysis, and reporting under their guidance and review. You are expected to take ownership of your assigned work, actively seek advice when needed, and apply feedback to strengthen your skills and deliver reliable results. jobs.title: Security Operations Engineer
jobs.description: This is an exciting opportunity to work for one of the top law firms in the U.S.! Davis Wright Tremaine LLP is looking for a **Security Operations Engineer** to join our team in our **Portland** office. This position offers the flexibility to be fully remote while working within reasonable commuting distance from any of our offices. Davis Wright Tremaine LLP is seeking a Security Operations Engineer to help protect the firm's systems, users, and information through advanced security monitoring, incident response, threat hunting, detection engineering, vulnerability management, and security automation. This is a hands\-on, journeyman\-level role for a security professional who can independently investigate complex security events, proactively hunt for threats, develop and tune detections, and engineer solutions that improve the effectiveness of Security Operations. The ideal candidate is comfortable working across endpoint, identity, cloud, email, and network technologies and is interested in using automation and AI to make security operations faster, more consistent, and more effective. At Davis Wright Tremaine, you will find challenging assignments, opportunities for professional growth and community involvement, and a culture of inclusion. DWT fosters inclusiveness and authenticity. Regardless of position, everyone here has a voice and the support is unparalleled. **On a typical day you will:** * Monitor, triage, investigate, and respond to security alerts across endpoint, identity, network, cloud, email, SaaS, and data\-security environments. * Independently investigate suspicious activity, correlate telemetry across security platforms, determine scope and impact, and coordinate containment and remediation. * Conduct proactive threat hunting based on threat intelligence, attacker behaviors, and MITRE ATT\&CK techniques. * Design, build, test, and tune detection rules and behavioral analytics to improve security coverage and reduce false positives. * Identify gaps in security telemetry, detections, or controls and work with technical teams to close those gaps. * Develop security automations, scripts, API integrations, and response workflows using technologies such as PowerShell, Python, SOAR, CrowdStrike Fusion, and ServiceNow. * Use AI and AI\-enabled security tools to accelerate investigations, threat research, detection development, scripting, and other Security Operations activities while independently validating AI\-generated results. * Monitor emerging vulnerabilities and threats, determine their applicability to the DWT environment, prioritize risk, and partner with technology teams to validate remediation. * Own the optimization of the firm's CrowdStrike Falcon investment: assess module adoption, sensor and policy coverage, and configuration to maximize automation and measurably reduce risk. * Design, build, and maintain ServiceNow\-centered security automation workflows, including bidirectional Falcon integrations, enrichment, and response orchestration * Support incident response from initial detection through containment, recovery, root\-cause analysis, and post\-incident improvement. * Develop and maintain investigation playbooks, operational procedures, detection documentation, and security knowledge articles. * Partner with Infrastructure, Endpoint, Identity, Network, and other technology teams on security projects and control improvements. * Participate in after\-hours or on\-call incident response as required. **Join us if you have:** * 4\+ years of progressively responsible cybersecurity experience, including hands\-on experience in security operations, incident response, threat hunting, detection engineering, or a related discipline. * Bachelor's Degree in Cybersecurity, Information Security, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, training, certifications, and relevant professional experience. * Demonstrated ability to independently investigate security events and communicate technically defensible conclusions. * Hands\-on experience with enterprise EDR/XDR and SIEM technologies. * Experience creating, testing, or tuning security detections and hunting queries. * Working knowledge of attacker tactics, techniques, and procedures and frameworks such as MITRE ATT\&CK. * Experience with PowerShell, Python, APIs, SOAR, or other security automation technologies. * Experience investigating and prioritizing vulnerabilities based on technical and business risk. * Strong understanding of Windows environments, endpoint security, identity and authentication, networking, and cloud security concepts. * Ability to analyze raw security telemetry rather than relying solely on tool\-generated conclusions. * Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively across technical teams. * Experience with CrowdStrike Falcon EDR/XDR, Next\-Gen SIEM, Fusion/SOAR, Identity Protection, or Charlotte AI. * Experience with Microsoft Defender, Entra ID, Azure/Microsoft 365 security technologies, Purview, or Security Copilot. * Experience with ServiceNow Security Incident Response or similar incident\-response platforms. * Experience creating KQL, Sigma, YARA, IOC, or behavioral detections. * Experience developing integrations using REST APIs. * Familiarity with ISO 27001, NIST CSF, CIS Controls, or similar security frameworks. * Security experience in a legal, financial, healthcare, or other regulated professional\-services environment. **Who We Are** Davis Wright Tremaine LLP is an AmLaw 100 law firm with 9 offices nationwide. We are relentlessly committed to client service and look for candidates who share that commitment. At DWT, client service means having empathy for each client’s and each lawyer’s work and personal pressures, business objectives, and legal needs; anticipating their needs; and having the capabilities and commitment to deliver what matters most to them. **What’s in it For You?** DWT offers competitive compensation in addition to ample benefits including but not limited to: * Choice of health and vision insurance plans * 2 paid volunteer days for qualifying community service work * Dental plan * Fertility and adoption benefit * Paid sabbatical after 13 years of service * Tuition reimbursement * Commuter benefits * Retirement contribution This job description intends to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by individuals assigned to this position. It is not intended to include all duties and responsibilities. *Davis Wright Tremaine LLP seeks to hire, develop and grow lawyers and business professionals who combine deep legal expertise, technological fluency, business acumen, and emotional intelligence—creating an excellent, inclusive, adaptive workforce that fuels exceptional client outcomes.* *At Davis Wright Tremaine LLP, every employee has the right to work in an environment free from all forms of unlawful discrimination.**It is our policy to hire, promote, transfer, terminate, and make all employment\-related decisions without regard to an employee’s sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical condition), race, color, ancestry, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, religious creed, age, marital status, physical or mental disability, genetic information, medical condition, military condition, military or veteran status or any other basis prohibited by applicable local, state, or federal laws.* *Davis Wright Tremaine provides reasonable accommodations for those who need them to complete the application or recruiting process and for employees who need reasonable accommodations to perform the essential functions of their positions due to a disability or for religious reasons. If you need to request accommodation during the application or recruiting process, please email* *humanresources\_confidential@dwt.com**.* \#LI\-AF1

Control Tower, ITAM, and ITOM. * Own one deliverable at a time, taking approved user stories and technical designs through to scripts, workflow configurations, and tested application features. * reports, and dashboards. * Follow approved architecture, secure coding, configuration, documentation, and development standards. **Cybersecurity, risk \& asset management** * Support implementations entitlement data, and software compliance. * Develop workflows for asset intake, assignment, lifecycle transitions, end\-of\-life identification, and remediation. * Support integration of technology asset data with CMDB, vulnerability response, and security operations processes. **IT operations, integration \& testing** * Support technical work across Discovery, CMDB, CSDM, Service Mapping, and Event Management, particularly where data supports cyber visibility and resilience. * Assist with configuration item relationships, identification/reconciliation, Service Graph Connectors, and data quality validation. * Build and troubleshoot REST/SOAP integrations, IntegrationHub flows, MID Server components, import sets, and transform maps under technical leadership. * Develop and run unit, integration, and automated tests, and resolve defects through system testing and hypercare. * Maintain technical designs, configuration records, testing evidence, deployment steps, and handover materials. * Participate in Agile ceremonies, development reviews, demonstrations, and technical knowledge sharing. * Explore reusable development approaches, Now Assist, AI Control Tower, and AI\-enabled automation relevant to client requirements. **The team** Our Cyber Strategy \& Transformation offering develops and transforms cyber programs in line with a client's strategic objectives, regulatory requirements, and risk appetite. A cyber product: Security Incident Response, Unified Security Exposure Management or Vulnerability Response, IRM, TPRM, BCM, or AI Control Tower. You'll provide technical leadership across product lines and engineering teams, guiding decisions that improve scalability, reliability, security, and long\-term business performance. You'll serve as a trusted technical advisor, connecting business priorities with engineering strategy and emerging technologies, including AI. Through your expertise in complex systems, architectural design, and technology investments, you'll help build sustainable engineering capabilities and enable innovative solutions that create value for customers and support business growth. **What You’ll Do and Impact:** * Define architectural direction for critical systems and platforms to ensure scalable, secure, reliable, and maintainable technology solutions. * Shape cross\-functional technical strategies by partnering with engineering and business leadership to align technology decisions with business priorities and long\-term growth. * Guide the evolution of enterprise platforms and shared technology capabilities to improve system integration, engineering efficiency, and scalability across product lines. * Evaluate AI platforms, machine learning architecture, and model lifecycle capabilities to inform technology investments and support responsible, scalable AI solutions. * Establish engineering standards, architectural principles, and design patterns that improve software quality, consistency, security, and maintainability. * Influence technology investment decisions by evaluating build\-versus\-buy options, third\-party solutions, and open\-source technologies to balance business value, cost, and technical risk. * Provide technical guidance on complex architecture and engineering challenges, reviewing designs and code when needed to resolve critical issues and unblock delivery. * Partner with engineering teams to translate architectural direction into practical solutions that support successful delivery of business\-critical initiatives. * Assess emerging technologies, architectural risks, and system dependencies to recommend improvements that strengthen platform performance and long\-term sustainability. jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, FinTech
jobs.description: **About DraftKings** -------------------- At DraftKings, AI is becoming an integral part of both our present and future, powering how work gets done today, guiding smarter decisions, and sparking bold ideas. It’s transforming how we enhance customer experiences, streamline operations, and unlock new possibilities. Our teams are energized by innovation and readily embrace emerging technology. We’re not waiting for the future to arrive. We’re shaping it, one bold step at a time. To those who see AI as a driver of progress, come build the future together. ### **The Crown Is Yours** As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you’ll design, implement, and scale production\-grade data and machine learning pipelines that drive measurable business outcomes. You’ll partner closely with data scientists, engineers, and product managers to build systems that are well\-structured, observable, and scalable. The Fintech Data Science team builds and maintains systems that protect DraftKings and its customers from fraud, payment risk, and abuse. Our mission is to enable explainable and reliable decision\-making across all financial and operational flows — from registration and deposits, to gameplay and withdrawals. ### **What you’ll do** * Design, build, and maintain ETL and feature engineering pipelines that power risk and payment applications. * Develop production ML systems, from training and evaluation through deployment and monitoring. * Partner with data scientists to productionize models that integrate into DK’s decisioning systems. * Build reliable, well\-tested data workflows — from SQL\-based feature transformations through model training and deployment. * Establish observability and monitoring for data quality, model drift, and service reliability. * Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and incident response, helping to maintain strong engineering practices. * Mentor junior engineers and contribute to shared tooling, documentation, and process improvements across the DS organization. * Support on\-call rotations and post\-incident reviews to ensure continuous system improvement. ### **What you’ll bring** * 3\+ years of experience writing production Python applications and working with structured data (SQL and data modeling). * Strong software engineering fundamentals — object\-oriented design, testing, and version control. * Familiarity with ML Ops frameworks such as model registry, orchestrations, and feature stores. * Experience building or maintaining data and feature pipelines in a data\-heavy environment. * Understanding of the ML lifecycle, including feature engineering, training, and model serving. * Ability to debug production issues across data, model, and infrastructure layers. * Strong collaboration and communication skills; able to translate technical solutions into operational outcomes. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related technical field (Master’s preferred). ### **Join Our Team** We’re a publicly traded (NASDAQ: DKNG) technology company headquartered in Boston. As a regulated gaming company, you may be required to obtain a gaming license issued by the appropriate state agency as a condition of employment. Don’t worry, we’ll guide you through the process if this is relevant to your role. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific pay range and how that was determined during the hiring process. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. DraftKings is proud to be an equal\-opportunity employer. jobs.title: Application Security Engineer
jobs.description: * Remote \- US: Select locations * Remote * Engineering * Full Time Dropbox is a Virtual First company. For this role, we are hiring in Zones 2 and 3\. Zones are determined by your zip code; if you’re within 100 miles of a listed metro area (straight\-line radius), you’re included in that Zone. Please out our blog post on this topic and more here. ### **Responsibilities** * Build and maintain security tools, automation, and libraries to enable secure\-by\-default development across engineering teams. * Design and implement custom security rules (e.g., Semgrep, CodeQL) to detect and prevent common and emerging vulnerability patterns. * Act as a subject matter expert on application security across web, mobile, and desktop environments. * Improve and scale the Secure Development Lifecycle (SDLC) by integrating tools, checks, and processes into engineering workflows. * Perform targeted code reviews, and develop follow\-up tooling or controls to prevent regressions. * Collaborate cross\-functionally with engineering, product, GRC, and AI/ML teams to proactively address security risks, especially in fast\-moving and emerging tech areas. Many teams at Dropbox run Services with on\-call rotations, which entails being available for calls during both core and non\-core business hours. If a team has an on\-call rotation, all engineers on the team are expected to participate in the rotation as part of their employment. Applicants are encouraged to ask for more details of the rotations to which the applicant is applying. ### **Requirements** * 4\+ years of experience in application security or security engineering roles. * Hands\-on experience building or using security automation tools to improve developer workflows and product security. * Demonstrated ability to work across the SDLC, including supporting and interpreting findings from penetration tests and bug bounty reports. * Familiarity with modern tech stacks, including microservices, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud\-native environments. * Solid understanding of common vulnerability classes (e.g., injection, XSS, authN/authZ issues) and practical mitigation strategies. * Comfortable working in cross\-functional environments and supporting multiple product and engineering teams simultaneously. * Experience participating in or supporting incident response or security on\-call rotations is a plus ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in application security engineering, with a strong focus on security tooling and automation. * Demonstrated ability to write and maintain custom security rules and integrate them into developer workflows. * Experience with machine learning systems, particularly generative AI, and the ability to support secure development in AI\-driven products. * Experience developing internal libraries or frameworks that reduce or eliminate entire classes of vulnerabilities. * Proficient in software development, with experience contributing production\-level code in one or more modern languages. * Familiarity with securing diverse application types, including web, mobile, and native platforms. * Experience with data security, including tooling for data protection, access control, and encryption. * Strong communication skills and ability to build trusted partnerships with cross\-functional teams. ### **Durable Skills** AI fluency means using these tools to *amplify* human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve: * **Awareness:** Understand yourself and others. * **Judgment:** Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations. * **Adaptability:** Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change. * **Connection:** Communicate, collaborate, and build trust. Dropbox is an equal opportunity employer. We are a welcoming place for everyone, and we do our best to make sure all people feel supported and connected at work.

jobs.title: AI Engineer I
jobs.description: Information and Transform If you are a current Duly/SBC/QMG employee, please apply through the Internal Career Site. At **Duly Health and Care**, you are supported to do your best work and make a meaningful impact every day. You will be part of a collaborative, physician\-led team that works as one and puts patients at the center of everything we do. With a connected network of providers, care teams, and services across primary and specialty care, surgery centers, imaging, lab, and therapy, you are part of a system designed to deliver high\-quality, coordinated care. Together, we create an environment where you can grow, contribute, and help improve the experience and outcomes for every patient we serve. **Benefits:** * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits that include healthcare navigation assistance. * Access to a mental health benefit at no cost. * Employer provided life and disability insurance. * $5,250 Tuition Reimbursement per year. * Immediate 401(k) match. * 40 hours paid volunteer time off. * A culture committed to community engagement and social impact. * Up to 12 weeks parental leave at 100% pay and a financial benefit for adoption and surrogacy for non\-physician team members once eligibility requirements are met. **Primary Purpose** The AI Engineer I is an early\-career role within the Data \& Analytics team, working with the AI/ML team to implement, deploy, and support the AI platforms and models that improve patient care, operations, and the colleague experience. This position focuses on conversational AI and generative AI solutions, including the Kore.ai platform and large language model (LLM) applications built on Claude, and on the automation, monitoring, and operational practices that keep those solutions reliable, secure, and cost\-effective. This role is a strong fit for someone with solid programming and cloud fundamentals who wants to grow into AI engineering and MLOps in a healthcare setting. No prior healthcare or Epic experience is required; we will train you. **Major Responsibilities** ***AI platform implementation and integration (40%)*** * Help configure, build, and integrate conversational AI and virtual assistant solutions on the Kore.ai platform * Support the implementation of Claude\-powered applications, including API integrations, prompt and system configuration, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, and tool or agent workflows * Integrate AI solutions with enterprise systems, data sources, and APIs in collaboration with data engineers and application teams * Support testing of AI solutions, including functional testing, regression testing, and evaluation of output quality, accuracy, and safety * Document solution designs, configurations, integrations, and release notes ***Deployment, monitoring, and operational support (40%)*** * Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure\-as\-code for the deployment of models, prompts, and AI applications across environments * Monitor the performance, availability, usage, latency, and cost of AI solutions, and respond to alerts and incidents * Provide day\-to\-day support and troubleshooting for AI platforms and the users who depend on them, escalating to vendors and senior engineers as needed * Support model and prompt versioning, evaluation, and retraining or refresh using the organization's ML platform and MLOps practices * Follow organizational standards for responsible AI, data privacy, security, and the protection of PHI/PII, including access control and audit practices ***Collaboration and continuous improvement (20%)*** * Partner with data scientists, data engineers, architects, application teams, and business stakeholders to define requirements and deliver reliable AI solutions * Communicate technical concepts to non\-technical audiences, including clinical and operational leaders * Learn from senior engineers and data scientists through code reviews and mentoring * Stay current with advances in generative AI, conversational AI, and MLOps practices and share learnings with the team * All other duties as assigned **Minimum Education and Experience** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, data science, information systems, engineering, or a related field; or 2 years of related experience; or an equivalent combination of education and experience * 0\-2 years of experience in software development, data engineering, DevOps, or machine learning (internships, co\-ops, research, and academic projects count) * Proficiency in Python and working knowledge of SQL * Experience working with REST APIs and JSON * Experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, or GenAI frameworks beneficial * Experience with conversational AI or chatbot platforms, such as Kore.ai, beneficial * Experience with Git, CI/CD, and cloud platforms (Azure preferred), Databricks, or MLflow beneficial * Healthcare or Epic experience not required; training provided **Minimum Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities (KSA)** * Solid foundation in software engineering practices, including version control, testing, and code review * Understanding of how LLMs work, including their strengths and limitations * Understanding of the machine learning lifecycle, including deployment, monitoring, and retraining * Strong analytical, organizational, and problem\-solving skills, including troubleshooting production issues * Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts to all levels of the organization * Ability to work both independently and in a team\-oriented environment * Intellectual curiosity and a desire to learn and adopt new AI and MLOps techniques * Awareness of ethical AI, data privacy, and information security considerations helpful If you are committed to putting our patients first and helping shape the future of care, you belong at Duly. The compensation for this role includes a base pay range of **$53,950 \- $85,000,** with the actual pay determined by factors such as skills, experience, education, certifications, geographic location, and internal equity. Additional compensation may be available through shift differentials, bonuses, and other incentives. Base pay is only a portion of the total rewards package. **Artificial Intelligence Disclosure** Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools may be used in some portions of the candidate review process for this position, however, all employment decisions will be made by a person.

jobs.title: Principal AI Research Engineer
jobs.description: Our mission at Duolingo is to develop the best education in the world and make it universally available. It's a big mission, and that's where you come in! At Duolingo, you'll join a team that cares about finding innovative solutions to complex technical problems, running countless experiments (300\+ at a time!) with our massive user base to make data\-driven decisions, and educating our users and employees alike. You'll have limitless learning opportunities, mentorship and collaboration with world\-class minds, and a variety of projects with large scopes — while doing work that's both fun and meaningful. Join our life\-changing mission to develop education for our half a billion (and growing!) learners around the world. **About the role** ------------------ We are looking for an industry expert AI Research Engineer to join our team to lead Duolingo's company\-wide modeling efforts, training custom models to improve the learning experience, including tutoring, speech recognition, and personalization. The ideal candidate will have an extensive track record as an AI research engineer, with extensive experience across various machine learning techniques, including NLP, deep learning, SFT, RL approaches (RLVR, PPO, GRPO, etc.), DPO, ASR, and more. They will have experience at all levels of the ML stack, including feature engineering, curating training data, model training, benchmarks and evaluations, deployment, and monitoring. #### **You will...** * Help lead a full\-stack team of frontend, backend, and other AI Research engineers, fostering a collaborative and innovative work environment. * Define the technical strategy and engineering foundations for Duolingo's ML efforts across infrastructure, training, serving, and product use cases. * Contribute to the development and training of a variety of large\-scale machine learning models. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to understand their needs, to align the models' outputs with company objectives. * Partner with senior leadership to drive strategic product and business decision making as a member of the engineering and AI leadership group. * Stay up\-to\-date with the latest developments in machine learning, and apply this knowledge to drive advancements in our projects. * Mentor team members, providing guidance and support in their professional development. * Ensure the delivery of high\-quality, scalable, and efficient machine learning solutions #### **You have...** * Proven experience as an AI research engineer, for example, in LLMs, NLP, speech, or related fields. * Strong background in training and deploying large models in an applied setting. * Advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field with a focus on machine learning or artificial intelligence, or equivalent experience. * Excellent leadership and communication skills, with the ability to manage and inspire a team. * Deep understanding of machine learning concepts, frameworks, and best practices. **Benefits:** Take a peek at how we care for our employees' holistic well\-being with our benefits here. **Job Alerts:** Sign up for job alerts here. **Accommodations:** We will do everything we can within reason to make sure that your interview takes place in an environment that fairly and accurately assesses your skills. If you need assistance or accommodation, please contact accommodations@duolingo.com. **Equal Employment Opportunity:** Duolingo is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. Real Duolingo employees always use an email that ends in @duolingo.com or @recruiting.duolingo.com. Stay alert and double\-check these details before sharing any information. jobs.title: Sr. Staff Engineer
jobs.description: About Us: Eagleview is a leading provider of aerial imagery, property insights and software that transforms the way people work. Eagleview holds more than 300 patents and owns a large geospatial data and imagery library encompassing 94 percent of the US population. Eagleview provides the most accurate data, enabling customers in the government, construction, solar and insurance industries to make timely, informed and better decisions. Overview: The Sr. Staff Engineer in Strategic R\&D will serve as a technical leader within the Strategic R\&D department. This is an exciting opportunity to set technical direction and drive cutting\-edge applications across 3D computer vision and AI/ML, from 3D reconstruction to production machine learning models that analyze aerial imagery at scale. You will partner with a dynamic, talented team and across the organization to build scalable, secure, and high\-performance solutions, mentor engineers, and shape the growth of groundbreaking technologies. This is a full\-time, remote role with a salary range of $157,800\-$192,000, bonus potential. Responsibilities: * Lead the design, implementation, validation, and documentation of 3D computer vision and AI/ML systems, taking ideas from research prototype through to production\-ready capability. * Develop and advance algorithms for 3D reconstruction, camera pose estimation, optimization, and rendering, working across scene representations such as point clouds, meshes, NeRFs, and Gaussian Splatting. * Build and deploy deep learning models for imagery analysis, such as detection, segmentation, and classification of defects in aerial imagery, and drive existing models to reliable production delivery * Define and lead data, labeling, experimentation, and evaluation strategy to improve model performance, scalability, and accuracy, and make well\-reasoned technical tradeoff decisions. * Architect and drive the deployment of models and pipelines on AWS for distributed training and large\-scale inference, including MLOps practices such as model versioning, monitoring, and retraining. * Set technical direction and contribute to the research and product roadmap for 3D reconstruction and applied AI/ML, partnering with Engineering, Product, and business leaders to align R\&D with company strategy. * Mentor and develop engineers, raise the technical bar through design, code, and research reviews, and influence technical practices across teams. * Communicate complex technical concepts and results to technical and executive audiences, and contribute to patents, publications, and other intellectual property. * Stay current with the latest research and trends in 3D reconstruction, computer vision, machine learning, and foundation models, and translate them into practical advances for Eagleview. Qualifications: * MSc/PhD in Computer Vision, Machine Learning, Computer Science, or related fields (or BSc with equivalent experience). * 12\+ years of relevant industry or applied research experience (8\+ years with a PhD), including a track record of delivering 3D computer vision or machine learning solutions into production. * Deep expertise in 3D reconstruction techniques such as Multi\-View Geometry, SfM, and SLAM. * Deep expertise in deep learning and computer vision, including object detection, segmentation, and image classification, with modern architectures such as CNNs and vision transformers. * Expert proficiency in Python and PyTorch, with experience implementing and optimizing complex neural networks. * Experience architecting, training, deploying, and operating modelsat scale on AWS or other cloud platforms, including MLOps and working with large labeled datasets. * Demonstrated technical leadership: setting direction, mentoring others, and influencing across teams and stakeholders without relying on formal authority. * Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to resolve ambiguous, complex technical challenges. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills for technical documentation, collaboration, and executive\-level communication. **Preferred** * Hands\-on experience with NeRFs, Gaussian Splatting, or similar neural rendering technologies. * Experience working with aerial/satellite imagery, photogrammetry, or geospatial datasets. * Experience with vision foundation models or vision\-language models, or with automated inspection, anomaly detection, or quality\-control systems. * Experience with Docker, containerized applications, and workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow or Step Functions. * Record of patents, publications, or recognized contributions to the research community. * Experience in agile software development methodologies. **Core Competencies** The successful candidate will demonstrate strength in the following competencies as well as foundational competencies which can be found here: * Drive \& Follow Through – Takes initiative and turns ideas into action. * Adaptability in Uncertainty – Adjusts quickly and performs through change. * Customer\-Centered Mindset – Puts customer needs at the center of decisions. * Judgment \& Problem Solving – Makes sound decisions and solves problems effectively. * Role\-Specific Expertise – Applies strong functional expertise to deliver results. * Results Accountability – Owns outcomes and delivers on commitments. * Work Prioritization \& Execution – Focuses on priorities and delivers on time. EEO Statement: This job description is not an exclusive or exhaustive list of all job functions that a workforce member in this position may be asked to perform. Duties and responsibilities can be changed, expanded, reduced, or delegated by management to meet the business needs of the company. The compensation offered to the successful candidate will be based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, the candidate’s work experience, education and licenses, work\-related training, key skills, the core duties of the role and its associated responsibilities, additional benefits offered, and the location where the work will be performed. All Fulltime (30\+ hours) employees are eligible for PTO, Sick, and Parental Leave; Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance; 401(k) Plan; Health Savings Account; Life Insurance; Employee Assistance Program; Pet Insurance. This is a full\-time, remote role with a salary range of $157,800\-$192,000, bonus potential. As an Equal Opportunity and E\-Verify Employer, Eagleview Technologies does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected status or characteristic. Protected veterans and individuals with disabilities are encouraged to apply. We are committed to giving all applicants equal opportunity to participate in the application process and are open to discussing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities.

This is a hands\-on engineering role focused on building reliable, secure, observable, and highly automated IT operations across cloud, on\-premises, and distributed environments. You will work across networking, compute, virtualization, containers, endpoints, identity, and security platforms, applying modern engineering practices to improve operational efficiency, reliability, and scalability. prevent incidents, and continuously improve systems. **Responsibilities** * Engineer, operate, and continuously improve hybrid cloud and on\-premises infrastructure, including networks, servers, virtualization, containers, storage, and endpoint environments. * Develop automation and orchestration solutions for infrastructure provisioning, configuration, patching, maintenance, and operational workflows. * Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and configuration management practices to ensure consistent, repeatable, and secure infrastructure operations. * Build and maintain observability capabilities, including monitoring, logging, metrics, alerting, and automated incident detection and response. * Implement and maintain infrastructure security controls, including identity and access management, endpoint protection, vulnerability management, and threat detection. * Integrate and manage enterprise security and infrastructure platforms, including third\-party monitoring, endpoint detection and response (EDR), and managed security services. * Apply Site Reliability Engineering principles to improve availability, performance, resilience, and operational efficiency. * Troubleshoot complex infrastructure and security issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement preventative improvements. * Develop standardized operational tools, processes, and automation that can be applied consistently across distributed sites and environments. * Collaborate with engineering and operations teams to support the computing infrastructure associated with specialized technical and production equipment, including system reliability, security, backup, and lifecycle management. * Collaborate with software engineers, security teams, vendors, and local IT personnel to support reliable infrastructure operations. * Evaluate emerging technologies, including AI\-assisted operations and intelligent automation, for practical application. **Requirements** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 5\+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, IT operations engineering, cloud engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, or related disciplines. * Strong hands\-on experience with hybrid infrastructure, including on\-premises systems and public cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure. * Solid understanding of enterprise networking, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, switching, VLANs, VPNs, and firewalls. * Experience administering and troubleshooting Windows and Linux server environments, virtualization platforms, and enterprise endpoints. * Proficiency in scripting or programming with Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar languages to automate operational tasks. * Experience with infrastructure automation and configuration management tools such as Terraform, Ansible, or equivalent technologies. * Experience implementing and operating monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability solutions. * Working knowledge of cybersecurity principles, including network security, identity and access management, endpoint security, vulnerability management, and incident response. * Experience supporting production infrastructure, diagnosing complex issues, and implementing long\-term reliability improvements. * Strong problem\-solving, communication, and cross\-functional collaboration skills. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and container orchestration platforms. * Experience with modern observability platforms such as Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, Splunk, or equivalent solutions. * Experience integrating security platforms, including EDR/XDR, SIEM, vulnerability scanning, and managed detection and response services. * Familiarity with zero\-trust security principles, network segmentation, and modern identity management. * Experience with CI/CD, GitOps, APIs, and software engineering practices applied to infrastructure operations. * Experience implementing automated remediation, self\-healing infrastructure, or AI\-assisted IT operations (AIOps). * Familiarity with backup, disaster recovery, business continuity, and infrastructure resilience practices. * Experience supporting geographically distributed infrastructure or multi\-site enterprise environments. * Familiarity with semiconductor fabrication, advanced manufacturing, industrial automation, or other equipment\-intensive environments, including the IT infrastructure supporting specialized production and engineering systems. Experience in these environments is a plus, not a requirement. **Why Join Enablence** You'll work on challenging infrastructure and engineering problems supporting advanced technology development and operations. This role offers the opportunity to apply modern cloud, security, automation, and reliability engineering practices across a diverse technology environment. You'll collaborate with experienced engineers, contribute to meaningful technical improvements, and help build scalable, secure, and highly automated IT operations. jobs.description: **Job Description** ------------------- **ABOUT DBI** For over 20 years, DBI has been a leader in the evaluation of damaged structures, consistently redefining the standards of excellence in our industry. We deliver independent analysis to clients in the insurance and legal industries. Hard evidence, expertise and accuracy drive our work. In a complex and ever\-evolving industry, our mission is to bring clarity to every client we serve. DBI is part of the Cor Partners family of companies, serving the insurance, risk management and legal communities. Headquartered in Midtown New York City, we have more than 30 locations across the United States, including Atlanta and Dallas, and both our footprint and our team are growing. We believe the best ideas come from looking at familiar problems in new ways. That forward\-thinking, innovative and people\-focused mindset is what sets us apart, and technology is central to how we grow. **SUMMARY OF JOB PURPOSE**: DBI is building new enterprise applications on two fronts: platforms for our clients, and the systems our own teams use every day. Both share one goal: to make complex work simple, clear and elegant for the people who use it. Our work runs on dense documents, site data, cost estimates and expert judgment, often thousands of pages for a single claim. It arrives as spreadsheets, CSVs, PDFs, reports and feeds from other systems, some well structured and some barely structured at all. Turning that into fast, clear and correct answers for clients and consultants is a data problem first, with AI and design challenges close behind. The Senior Software Engineer plays a central role in building these platforms end to end, from the data that feeds them through the services, APIs and screens clients use. The role is hands\-on: designing, building, shipping and supporting production software, and helping set the engineering standards the team builds on. The Senior Software Engineer is involved early, applies critical thinking from raw data through to what the client sees, and helps shape solutions rather than building to a fixed spec. The first major project is a new client\-facing enterprise application that DBI is building in house, which the Senior Software Engineer will help take from the first line of code through delivery, with a strong pipeline of projects to follow. The Senior Software Engineer reports directly to the Partner and Creative Director and is expected to travel 10–20% of the time for project work, training and company needs. **THE TECHNOLOGY TEAM** The Senior Software Engineer joins a small, close\-knit team that works collaboratively, with a strong culture and a high standard for quality, and works alongside: * The Partner and Creative Director, who leads the team and is hands\-on in project work. * The IT Director, who leads DBI's environments, infrastructure, and security, and brings deep engineering experience to the team. * The Senior Director of Data Science \& AI, who sets AI and engineering direction and is closely involved in the engineering itself, from approach and code to releases and data migration. * The Product Manager, who shapes the product, roadmap and priorities, and works with engineering at every stage, from requirements and data modeling through architecture and testing. * The IT team, who support DBI's systems, users and day\-to\-day operations. **PRIMARY JOB RESPONSIBILITIES**: * Design, build, ship and support production web applications end to end, including data models, backend services, APIs and the frontend screens clients use. * Build the ingestion and transformation layer that brings data from spreadsheets, CSVs, PDFs and other systems into a consistent data model shared across DBI's applications, working with the Senior Director of Data Science \& AI and the Product Manager. * Help maintain and evolve the schemas, contracts and APIs other applications depend on, changing them as the business and source data change. * Build validation, audit trails, versioning and lineage into the data flow, so any figure on screen can be traced back to the file it came from. * Build the checks, reconciliation, and monitoring that keep our data accurate and catch bad data before a client does. * Build frontend features from designer mockups, including import and validation screens, dashboards, reporting and document generation. * Work with the Senior Director of Data Science \& AI on AI\-assisted features, such as extracting and classifying data from documents, with human review where accuracy matters. * Implement secure authentication and role\-based access for staff and clients using Microsoft Entra ID. * Partner with the IT Director on environments, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, releases and security. Support deployments, monitor production, and resolve defects, data issues and performance problems. * Write and maintain automated tests, including data quality, API and UI tests. * Help define DBI's engineering standards for s ns such as MCP, and evaluating and monitoring model output. * Document processing at scale: OCR, PDF parsing, table extraction and the realities of scanned and inconsistent source files. * ETL or ELT pipelines across semi\-structured and unstructured sources. * Data governance in practice, including lineage, audit trails, versioning and data quality. * Node.js and TypeScript services, including GraphQL APIs. * Deployment with Docker and Azure services such as Blob Storage and Azure Database for PostgreSQL. * Application monitoring with Azure Application Insights or similar tools. * Experience integrating enterprise applications such as Workday and NetSuite, including APIs, identity, master data and transactional workflows. * Microsoft Entra ID, OAuth, or similar identity and access management for web applications. * Infrastructure as code, preferably Bicep. * Automated testing frameworks, preferably Playwright, and a working knowledge of computer\-use agents. * Advanced frontend work, including design systems, component libraries or data visualization. * Working with external development teams. * Experience in insurance, claims, forensics, engineering, legal, construction, regulated financial services or another field where accuracy and the ability to show your evidence matter. **SKILLS AND ABILITIES** * A drive to make complex things simple, with care for how people experience the software. * Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non\-technical audiences, including clients. * Strong attention to quality and detail, and pride in delivering polished work. * Ability to work independently and as part of a small, collaborative team. * Strong time management and organizational skills; able to balance multiple projects and deadlines. * A security\-first approach, following secure development practices and treating sensitive client data with care and discretion. **WHAT WE OFFER** * Meaningful work: build the platforms DBI's clients and consultants rely on, with real data and real impact. * Room to grow: we are a growing Technology team and company * Modern tools and learning: current AI coding tools, cloud environments, and support for ongoing learning. * Stability with momentum: the backing of an established firm and the Cor Partners family, with the energy and close\-knit culture of a team building something new. **WORKING CONDITIONS**: This is a hybrid role, with work performed in a DBI office two days a week and remotely the rest of the week. This role may require flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, or holidays, to support releases, production issues, or project deadlines. The position also requires 10–20% travel to support projects, training, satellite office locations, and company operations. In addition, this role may involve visits to client sites, new office buildouts, and renovations, which can include active construction zones. While safety protocols will be followed, the employee may occasionally be exposed to noise, dust, or other environmental conditions typical of a construction site. **PHYSICAL ACTIVITIES AND REQUIREMENTS**: The work requires frequent use of a computer, keyboard, and other office equipment, requiring close visual acuity to view a computer screen, read printed documents, and review code. The employee must be able to sit or stand for extended periods of time, walk between office locations, and participate in meetings or project discussions. This role may also require handling and transporting equipment such as laptops, monitors, and other technology hardware. The employee should be able to lift, carry, push, or pull items weighing up to 40 pounds. Occasional bending, stooping, crouching, or reaching may be required. The employee may be required to work in active construction zones, which could involve exposure to noise, dust, or limited ventilation. Physical agility and awareness are required to safely move through these environments.

jobs.description: **Company Description** Eurofins Scientific is a network of independent companies providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic, and labelling is accurate. Eurofins is dedicated to delivering testing services that contribute to the health and safety of society and the planet, and to its corporate responsibility to protect the environment and ensure diversity, equity, and inclusion across the entire network of Eurofins companies. With over 50 laboratories and more than 40 service centers nationwide, Eurofins Environment Testing provides full\-service environmental analysis across all 50 states. Our network supports public and private clients—including DoD, DOE, and municipalities—through robust logistics and continuous investment in people, technology, and infrastructure.We offer comprehensive testing for air, water, soil, sediment, tissue, and waste, covering a wide range of analytes including PFAS, metals, VOCs/SVOCs, dioxins/furans, radiochemicals, and more. **Job Description** As an Applied AI Engineer, you will design and deploy AI\-powered applications that extract, organize, and analyze laboratory information from forms, reports, and instrument\-generated documents. jobs.description: **EverHealth \- Staff Software Engineer** EverCommerce (Nasdaq: EVCM) is a leading service commerce platform, providing vertically\-tailored, integrated SaaS solutions that help more than 745,000 global service\-based businesses accelerate growth, streamline operations, and increase retention. Its modern digital and mobile applications create predictable, informed, and convenient experiences between customers and their service professionals. With its EverPro, EverHealth, and EverWell brands specializing in Home, Health, and Wellness service industries, EverCommerce provides end\-to\-end business management software, embedded payment acceptance, marketing technology, and customer experience applications. Learn more at EverCommerce.com. We are building an extraordinary company and looking for talented and motivated people to join our team. You can learn more about our Company, Culture and Values here: https://www.evercommerce.com/about\-us/careers/ **EverHealth,** a business within EverCommerce, provides modern end\-to\-end solutions for healthcare providers. Our open, connected ecosystem of solutions and services helps providers engage patients, increase revenue, improve business efficiency, and remain market competitive. We serve 72,000\+ healthcare practices and counting. EverHealth consists of SaaS products including DrChrono, iSalus, CollaborateMD, Updox, eProviderSolutions, AlertMD, and MD Coder. With two EHRs and platform\-level solutions such as communication platforms and a clearinghouse, EverHealth delivers a turn\-key, end\-to\-end solution for the software needs of a modern healthcare practice. We are looking for a **Staff Software Engineer** to focus on advancing revenue cycle management (RCM) capabilities within our **CollaborateMD** product. RCM is at the heart of how our customers get paid, and we are building a new generation of RCM tools that pair modern workflow software with AI agents to help billing teams work smarter, resolve issues faster, and collect more of what they’ve earned. You’ll help design and build AI\-powered features, including agents that help users work faster and more accurately. CollaborateMD is an established product with a large, long\-lived codebase. lifecycle * Build secure, reliable software that keeps PHI within our AWS environment and meets HIPAA, SOC 2, and HITRUST requirements, backed by strong testing, monitoring, and operational practices developing RESTful APIs, distributed microservices, multi\-threading, and event\-driven architectures * Strong working knowledge of modern frontend frameworks (TypeScript, Angular preferred) * Extensive expertise in database modeling, indexing, and performance tuning across relational document stores (PostgreSQL preferred) * Expertise with AWS core and serverless architecture (RDS, ECS, Lambda, API Gateway, SQS/SNS, EventBridge, IAM, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch, S3\) * Demonstrated experience with Docker and containerized deployments * Daily, hands\-on use of AI coding and agent tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) across the development lifecycle in your own work * Experience integrating LLMs or AI agents into production software, including orchestration, evaluation, and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows * Experience with AWS Bedrock or Bedrock AgentCore * A product engineering mindset focused on solving problems and delivering outcomes, not just technology * Ability With a widely distributed team, we are used to working remotely across different time zones. **This role can be based anywhere in the United States.** Candidates based in the Chicago area will work hybrid, meeting with the team in person 1–2 days per week. Candidates elsewhere in the U.S. will work remotely. Please note that you must be eligible to work without sponsorship to qualify for this position, and this role may require travel to our Corporate Headquarters in Denver, Colorado, or to other office locations around North America. **Benefits and Perks:** * Hybrid or remote work, depending on location * Continued investment in your professional development * Day 1 access to robust health and wellness benefits, including an annual wellness stipend * 401k with up to a 4% match and immediate vesting * Flexible and generous (FTO) time\-off * Employee Stock Purchase Program **Compensation:** The target base compensation for this position is $150,000 to $170,000 USD per year in most US locations. jobs.title: Data Engineer (Remote)
jobs.description: **The Team You'll Join** ======================== First American Title Insurance Company, one of the nation's largest title insurers, provides comprehensive title insurance coverage and professional services for residential, commercial, and new construction purchases, along with refinances and equity loans. Join the global title operations team that supports title and escrow operations across the company, helping create a smoother path through each transaction for the customers, partners, and communities we serve. You’ll work alongside talented operations professionals and business partners to support title and escrow teams, improve the customer experience, help solve complex challenges, and move the industry forward. Along the way, you’ll be part of a supportive, relationship\-driven culture where people are invested in your growth and success. **The Impact You'll Make** ========================== We're looking for a Data Engineer II to design, build and run scalable cloud data solutions. These solutions feed analytics, real\-time applications, AI/ML and our enterprise data products. You'll build reliable pipelines, reusable frameworks and low\-latency operational data stores, and you'll use AI\-assisted tools to deliver faster without lowering quality. You'll work closely with cross\-functional teams to understand needs, align priorities and deliver business value. **Our tech stack** Our platform is built primarily on Azure Databricks. We use Delta Lake, Lakebase, Unity Catalog, Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines, Lakeflow Jobs, Auto Loader, Databricks SQL and Declarative Automation Bundles. Experience with other modern data platforms, such as Snowflake, BigQuery and Redshift, is a plus. **How you'll contribute** * Design, develop, test and document data pipelines, data solutions and supporting applications. * Build and support batch and streaming pipelines that integrate and transform data from multiple sources and technologies into consistent, trusted datasets. Sources include databases, cloud storage, SaaS applications, APIs, files and event streams. * Contribute to the design and implementation of data architectures under senior engineering guidance. * Build reusable frameworks driven by metadata and configuration for ingestion, transformation and reconciliation. Use CDC, incremental processing, SCD patterns and idempotent backfills. * Tune distributed processing, SQL, storage and compute for performance and cost. * Build and support low\-latency operational data solutions on managed PostgreSQL platforms such as Lakebase, serving curated data to applications, APIs and AI agents. * Model data for analytics and AI, including semantic layers, feature pipelines and data preparation for RAG. * Ensure data is accurate and secure through testing, validation, data quality monitoring, access control, lineage and PII protection. * Troubleshoot and resolve data issues. Drive process improvements that automate manual work, optimize data delivery and improve scalability and reliability. * Build CI/CD pipelines and deployments as code, and use AI\-assisted tools to accelerate delivery while validating all generated output. * Monitor production pipelines and data products using observability, alerting and operational dashboards to ensure reliability and SLA adherence. * Share knowledge with teammates, participate in code reviews and contribute to Agile delivery. **What you'll bring** *Required* * A bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. * 3–5 years of data engineering experience on modern cloud data platforms. * At least 2 years of hands\-on Databricks experience, including Delta Lake (MERGE and upserts, schema evolution, time travel, Change Data Feed and table optimization), notebooks, jobs and Databricks SQL. * Advanced SQL and strong Python/PySpark skills, with experience tuning performance. * Solid understanding of data modeling, data warehousing and lakehouse design. * Experience building ETL/ELT pipelines and data warehouses that integrate structured, semi\-structured and unstructured data sources, including CDC, SCD and incremental processing patterns. * Experience designing and supporting operational data stores such as PostgreSQL, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Lakebase, Aurora PostgreSQL or similar platforms. * Hands\-on relational database and OLTP experience, including schema design, indexing, transactions and query tuning. * Experience with Git, CI/CD, automated testing and Agile delivery. * Azure cloud experience. *Preferred* * Experience with AI/ML data workloads, including feature engineering, MLflow, Vector Search or AI Functions. * Experience with AI\-assisted development tools. jobs.description: **Software Engineer** **Location: Hoboken, NJ (on site)** **About Faropoint** Faropoint is a real estate investment firm that buys and operates industrial properties (smaller warehouses close to where people live and work) across 20\+ U.S. markets. We run the firm on software we build ourselves: our in\-house technology team builds the production apps our investment teams use to source, underwrite, and manage billions of dollars in real estate deals. **What We Build** * FarOS, our deal platform and system of record, where every acquisition is sourced, underwritten, and tracked. * REXy, our machine learning models that predict market rents, lease renewals, and sale prices. * AI agents that read broker emails and offering memos and turn them into deals in FarOS, help prepare lease negotiations, and take routine work off people’s plates. * The Faropoint Brain, our knowledge layer: an MCP server that gives Claude and our agents secure access to our leases, investment memos, data lake, and models. * Slack apps and dozens of internal tools that bring all of this to where people already work. **The Role** We’re a small team that ships fast. With AI coding agents, ideas go from a conversation with a user to production in days or weeks, not quarters. Writing code is no longer the hard part. The hard part is making sure what we ship is correct, tested, maintainable, and actually used. You’ll work day to day alongside a senior software engineer and a data engineer across FarOS, our data platform, and our AI tools. You’ll start with the work that makes those platforms solid: migrations, testing, bug fixes, and tech debt. As you learn the systems, you’ll build new features, agents, and integrations, and own more of the platform. We’re looking for an engineer, not a relay between us and an AI tool. You use coding agents every day, and you understand, check, and can explain everything they produce. **What You’ll Do** Ship and harden FarOS and our core platforms \- Build, test, and maintain production software that powers Faropoint’s data and investment platforms (TypeScript, React, Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL on AWS). \- Strengthen the reliability and quality of existing systems through rigorous testing, debugging, and continuous improvement: migrations, bug fixes, and tech debt. \- Take on scoped technical projects: dig into the problem, propose an approach and its trade\-offs, then carry it out. \- Help improve test automation, CI/CD, and developer tools such as automated AI code review. Build AI agents and integrations \- Extend our agents, MCP tools, and Slack apps so people can act without leaving the tools they use. \- Wire our machine learning models and data platform into the products that rely on them. Build with AI coding agents, and own the result \- Make effective use of AI\-assisted development tools such as Claude Code every day, while taking full ownership of the correctness of everything you ship. \- Review what agents produce for correctness, security, and fit with our existing patterns before it merges. \- Write the tests, plans, and docs that let the next engineer, or agent, pick up where you left off. Work with the people who use what you build \- Partner closely with engineering, data science, and business stakeholders to turn loosely defined problems into working solutions. \- Talk with users across the firm to understand their workflows, ship something small, and improve it based on feedback. \- Pick up the business context as you go. No real estate background needed. **What You’ll Bring** **Must\-haves:** 1 to 3 years of experience building and shipping production software. \- A degree in computer science, mathematics, physics, engineering, or a related discipline. \- Strong programming skills and solid computer science fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, and how a software project is organized. \- Working proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript or Python, and comfort with SQL and relational databases. \- Comfort collaborating in Git: branches, pull requests, code review, and resolving merge conflicts. \- Daily use of AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar), and the judgment to verify their output. \- The ability to explain code you didn’t write, including an agent’s, and talk through design trade\-offs. \- A demonstrated ability to learn quickly and carry projects through from start to finish. You test your own work and ask for help when you’re stuck. \- A curious, self\-driven mindset, and the communication skills to explain technical work to non\-technical stakeholders. **Nice to have:** Experience building and testing a full\-stack web app (React, Node.js, PostgreSQL; Jest, pytest, or Playwright). \- Experience with database migrations or schema changes on a live system. \- Exposure to AWS (Lambda, containers, S3\) or CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions. \- Experience building with LLMs, agents, MCP servers, or Slack apps. \- Familiarity with financial models, spreadsheets, or an interest in finance, real estate, or investing. **Why Join?** * Real impact. Your code is used every day to find, price, and manage real buildings. * Speed. A small team and a short path to production. You’ll see your work in users’ hands quickly. * Room to grow. Start with well\-scoped work, then take on progressively greater technical ownership as you learn our systems. * Autonomy. You’ll choose how to solve problems, not just close tickets. **What We Offer** This position offers a base salary in the $120,000\-$160,000 range, plus discretionary bonus, competitive healthcare benefits, unlimited PTO, and a 401k match. **Equal Opportunity Employer** Faropoint is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diversity, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, parental status, disability status, or any other status protected by local law. jobs.description: **Who we are:** Formic is on a mission to reshape American manufacturing by making automation accessible to every factory. As labor constraints rise, costs increase, and global competition intensifies, automation is no longer optional for manufacturers that want to stay competitive. We deliver automation through a Robotics\-as\-a\-Service model that combines industrial robotics, proprietary software, and full\-service support into a single, integrated solution. By removing the traditional barriers of cost, complexity, and risk, we enable manufacturers to deploy automation quickly and realize measurable gains in throughput, safety, and operational efficiency without large upfront capital investment. Backed by leading investors including Lux Capital, Initialized Capital, Blackhorn Ventures, and Mitsubishi HC Capital North America, Formic is scaling rapidly and building the foundation for a new era of high\-performance, Made in America production. **About the Role** We're looking for an AI\-native, technically resourceful operator to rethink how IT works at Formic. You'll own the day\-to\-day technology experience for Formicans, from devices, applications, and employee support to infrastructure, security fundamentals, and external technology partners. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role with significant autonomy: you'll solve immediate problems while building smarter, more reliable systems that prevent them from recurring. The goal is simple: technology becomes something the company rarely has to think about because it simply works. **In this role, you will:** ***Own Employee IT*** * Serve as the internal owner of day\-to\-day IT support, troubleshooting issues across Mac and Windows devices, applications, accounts, authentication, peripherals, and connectivity. * Own the technology experience throughout the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, offboarding, equipment provisioning and recovery, account configuration, permissions, and secure access removal. * Administer our device fleet, including lifecycle, including purchasing, configuration, deployment, repairs, replacements, shipping, and returns. * Administer systems such as Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, 1Password, Microsoft 365, Apple Business Manager, VPN, and other SaaS applications. * Manage identities, accounts, groups, permissions, licenses, MFA, SSO, and application access. * Maintain clear, accurate, and accessible documentation of our systems, configurations, processes, and administrative access. * Establish effective IT support processes for request intake, prioritization, escalation, resolution tracking, and employee communication. * Identify recurring issues, address root causes, and implement solutions that reduce support requests and improve the employee technology experience. ***Own IT Infrastructure \& Office Technology*** * Own the reliability and functionality of our internet, Wi\-Fi, networking, conference rooms, displays, AV equipment, printers, shared devices, and other onsite technology. * Manage and troubleshoot network infrastructure, including routers, switches, firewalls, wireless access points, VPNs, and connectivity issues. * Own the technology supporting physical security, including badge access systems and security cameras, partnering with internal teams and external specialists as needed. * Ensure conference rooms and shared technology are consistently reliable, functional, and ready for use. * Resolve onsite technology issues and coordinate with ISPs, network engineers, low\-voltage contractors, security vendors, and other technical specialists when needed. * Drive technology insta ance, vulnerabilities, access controls, and administrative privileges, ensuring identified risks are tracked through remediation. * Exercise sound technical judgment in determining what to resolve internally and when to engage external specialists. * Hold vendors accountable for responsiveness, service quality, timelines, costs, and outcomes. * Continuously evaluate the effectiveness of our external IT partnerships, identifying opportunities to improve service delivery, operational efficiency, and cost effectiveness. * Assess which IT capabilities should be developed internally versus supported by **Bonus Points if you have:** * Worked in a startup or physical operating environment. * Administered Google Workspace, MDM/RMM, EDR, or identity systems. * Supported SOC 2 or other security compliance frameworks. * Worked effectively with external IT providers and held partners accountable for service quality and outcomes. * Worked with office networking, firewalls, VPNs, or physical\-security systems. * Experience implementing or improving IT ticketing, asset management, monitoring, or employee self\-service systems. * Built scripts, bots, internal tools, integrations, or AI agents because you got tired of doing something manually. * Created a home lab, side project, GitHub repo, Raspberry Pi graveyard, overly complicated Home Assistant setup, or other evidence that you genuinely enjoy messing with technology also counts. **What we look for:** We're building this company from the ground up, and every person we hire has an outsized impact on our culture, performance, and trajectory. While each team member brings unique strengths and perspectives, we look for people who align with our Operating Principles and embody them in action. If this sounds like you, Formic may be the right place for you! * **Fearless Optimism:** You make bold bets and default optimistic.
