jobs.title: Staff Software Development Engineer
jobs.description: Fortinet is looking for a Staff Software Development Engineer to work on our next generation of industry\-leading network security appliances. You will work side by side with software engineers and ASIC engineers on our flagship products — at the highest level, shaping the architecture and performance of sophisticated network security systems, and at the lowest level, coding product features line by line in firmware and microcode. You will join at a pivotal moment: a brand\-new processor generation is about to roll out, and you will own a critical part of it from first release through its entire product lifecycle. **Responsibilities** * Develop, support, and evolve data\-path software and ASIC microcode for our next\-generation network security platforms — driving new features, customer\-driven enhancements, and top\-priority escalations from launch onward. * Work across the full platform lifecycle: releases, new feature requests, and critical field issues, in partnership with silicon, driver, and product teams. * Participate ASIC/SoC verification, including coverage of the embedded networking and computing acceleration blocks, to ensure pre\-silicon confidence in complex multi\-block integration. * Identify performance bottlenecks; participate in hardware and system algorithm/architecture design, modeling, simulation, and performance evaluation. * Design hardware offload for network security features on cutting\-edge system architectures. * Conduct research on computer networking and security algorithms and propose improvements. Mentor other engineers and help set the bar for firmware quality, debug methodology, and verification coverage. * **Job Requirements** * 5–10 years of related experience in the networking industry, ideally with network processors, embedded data\-plane software, or SoC verification; or hands\-on experience training and post\-training large language models (fine\-tuning, alignment, quantization/distillation for embedded targets). * Solid understanding of computer architecture, network protocols, and related algorithms. * Background in embedded network platform software. * Experience designing hardware accelerator. * Strong C/C\+\+ and Python programming skills. * A track record of debugging hard problems across hardware/software boundaries — in simulation, on FPGA, or on real silicon. Passion and willingness to learn and explore new technologies and new methodologies. * **Nice to Have** * Experience with embedded processors and/or NPU/AI\-accelerator SoCs. * Experience in assembly language and microcode development. * Experience shepherding a product through its full lifecycle (multiple releases, NFRs, critical escalations). Experience with LLM training, fine\-tuning, or deployment on resource\-constrained hardware. * Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship. The US base salary range for this full\-time position is $179,000\-$219,000\. Fortinet offers employees a variety of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, 401(k), 11 paid holidays, vacation time, and sick time, as well as a comprehensive leave program. Wage ranges are based on various factors, including the labour market, job type, and job level. Exact salary offers will be determined by factors such as the candidate's subject knowledge, skill level, qualifications, experience, and geographic location. All roles are eligible to participate in the Fortinet equity program. Bonus eligibility is reviewed at the time of hire and annually at the Company’s discretion. Why Join Us: We encourage candidates from all backgrounds and identities to apply. We offer a supportive work environment and a competitive Total Rewards package to support you with your overall health and financial well\-being. Embark on a challenging, enjoyable, and rewarding career journey with Fortinet. Join us in bringing solutions that make a meaningful and lasting impact to our 890,000\+ customers around the globe.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Security
jobs.description: Forward Financing is a financial technology company based in Boston, Massachusetts with team members throughout the United States, Dominican Republic, and Canada. The company is on a mission to unlock the capital that fuels small businesses across America. Recognized as a Best Place to Work by Built In Boston and certified as a Great Place To Work, Forward is investing in its employees, technology, and customer experience – with long\-term success in mind every step of the way. Our Engineering team serves as a key driver of innovation at Forward Financing. We build the software that powers a FinTech product that serves Small Businesses across the country. A key part of our strategy involves building security directly into our applications and business processes to protect our customers, our partners, and the funding we provide. We’re looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer, Security to support our growing scrum teams. This role can be fully remote (EST business hours). ### **In This Role You Will:** * Design, develop, and implement scalable and secure software solutions that improve the security of Forward’s applications and business processes * Collaborate with product managers, designers, the security team, and other stakeholders to translate business and security requirements into technical specifications * Be a technical leader; driving the enhancement of quality, scalability, reliability, and speed\-to\-market of Forward’s application security capabilities * Elevate software application security and quality through secure development best practices * Contribute to the security team’s broader work, including application security and detection and response * Work across multiple teams to deliver complex features and resolve technical challenges * Boost engineering productivity by creating technical artifacts, and coaching team through Design / PR reviews * Act as a mentor for junior engineers, instilling best practices and raising the bar * Build security features into our line\-of\-business applications, such as logging, authentication and authorization, and secure data transfer tooling * Build LLM\-powered systems that triage alerts, investigate security issues, and help us detect and respond to attackers faster ### **Why You Should Apply:** * **Mission\-driven company:** Forward is a trusted source of fast, flexible funding for small businesses that have often been underserved by traditional financing options. When you join the team, you will help ensure all small businesses have access to the financial support they need to succeed. * **Flexibility is a top priority**: Our employees are empowered to choose where they want to work (whether that’s from home, in the office, or a combination of both). ### **Role Requirements:** (Even if you don’t check every box, but see yourself contributing, please apply.) * 5\+ years Full\-Stack development experience, with a focus on the backend (Ruby preferred) * Experience building security\-sensitive features or systems, and a working knowledge of application security principles * Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills * Understanding of software architecture and design patterns * Demonstrated depth of technical knowledge in one or more areas of the SDLC * Experience in Agile software development * Typically has a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field or additional relevant experience ### **Nice To Have:** * Experience providing technical leadership and / or mentorship * Experience designing and implementing complex systems across multiple software applications and/or languages * Experience with identity and access management * Experience in application security, detection and response, or cloud security * Excellent written and verbal communication * Experience with TypeScript * Ability to influence others * Demonstrated project management skills **Compensation:** ----------------- **Annual Targeted Salary:** $150,000– $170,000 USD **Annual Target Bonus:** 10% At Forward Financing, we're committed to fair and transparent compensation. We believe in providing a compensation package that recognizes your skills, experience, and the unique value you bring to our team. We take a market\-basedapproach to pay, regularly reviewing benchmark data to ensure our compensation remains competitive, equitable, and aligned with our performance\-driven culture. Final offers are determined by a variety of factors, including the candidate's qualifications, relevant experience, specific skills, and internal equity. This approach ensures that our compensation is competitive and equitable. Your recruiter will provide specific details on the expected base and variable earnings as it pertains to this specific role. When we aren’t collaborating to drive business and support our customers, we’re finding virtual and in\-person ways to get to know our colleagues, celebrate team wins, and have fun together! **Our Culture: The Forward Compass** The Forward Compass is the standard we hold for ourselves and one another—guiding how we lead, collaborate, and show up every day to move in the same direction. * **Back the Builders:** We are wired to fuel customer progress, not just provide support. * **Rooted in People:** We create an environment that balances deep connection with the extreme ownership and honesty required to reach our highest potential. * **Flying V:** We move through coordinated effort with speed and urgency to achieve what no individual could do alone. * **Always Forward, Never Finished:** We pursue growth with a relentless drive that keeps us ahead of the competition. **About Us:** Forward Financing is a fintech company based in Boston, Massachusetts with team members throughout the United States, Dominican Republic, and Canada. The company is on a mission to unlock the capital that fuels small businesses across America. Whether facing challenges accessing traditional financing or simply needing a convenient, flexible solution, Forward is committed to funding more of the millions of small businesses nationwide. By simplifying the requirements, streamlining the process, and using advanced proprietary technology, Forward is often able to deliver approvals within hours and funds that same day – giving more businesses the financial opportunity they need to thrive. Plus, with their dedicated teams and award\-winning service, customers get personalized support when they need it most. Since 2012, Forward has expanded access to capital by providing over $4\.8 billion in funding to more than 92,000 small businesses. The company is A\+ rated by the Better Business Bureau with an Excellent / 4\.7 stars rating on Trustpilot.com. Recognized as a Best Place to Work by Built In Boston and certified as a Great Place To Work, Forward is dedicated to empowering both its team and the customers they serve, helping them succeed and thrive. ### **U.S. Equal Opportunity Employment Information** Forward Financing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and is committed to fostering a fair and inclusive culture built on a foundation of high performance and exceptional customer experience. With a laser focus on employee impact, we’re able to reduce biases and ensure the right people are in the right jobs to contribute to our mission. The varied perspectives of our people fuel innovation and make us a stronger team. By embracing what makes each of us unique, we create a supportive environment where people feel valued, accepted, and empowered to thrive. **California Employee Privacy Policy** Compensation Range: $150K \- $170K

Our culture thrives on the **HEART** values of the company and puts pride in our people. We encourage continued training and learning to grow you and your career with Fulton. **HEART:** Honesty and Integrity Effective and Results Oriented Always customer focused Respectful and considerate Team Player **Benefits:** At Fulton we value our employees and therefore offer competitive compensation, onsite fitness club, retirement plan, health insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, voluntary disability insurance, voluntary life insurance, employee assistance program, vacation time, paid holidays, profit share bonus. *Fulton is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Fulton is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.* Requirements: **OVERALL RESPONSIBILITY:** The Software \& Controls Engineer develops, tests, and maintains complex control systems that govern the operation of commercial equipment. This role requires a proficiency in software development and an aptitude for electronics and hands\-on hardware testing. Must value both function and form, and collaborate with cross\-functional teams to deliver solutions that meet or exceed targets for reliability, safety, features, cost and performance in a manner that is consistent with the company values and operating philosophy. **ACCOUNTABILITIES:** 1\. **Controls Development** – Designs, develops, and continuously improves control systems, inclusive of hardware, software and graphical user interfaces. Translates functional requirements into reliable, safe, and efficient equipment operation with a focus on an exceptional user experience. 2\. **Issue Resolution** – Troubleshoots, replicates and resolves complex system issues using structured root cause analysis to restore intended functionality and prevent future recurrence. 3\. **Travel** – Willing to travel to support development, training, troubleshooting, testing and data collection activities. 4\. **Documentation** – Creates and maintains clear, accurate technical documentation including test plans, process \& procedures, and user\-facing materials; communicates progress and issues effectively to stakeholders. 5\. **Agile Collaboration** – Translates requirements into user stories and works within Agile practices including sprint planning, backlog refinement, and demos; uses version control (Git) and issue tracking (Jira). **QUALIFICATIONS (Education, Certifications and Required Experience):** 1\. Experience troubleshooting embedded controls hardware and software. 2\. Experience with hydronic boilers a plus. 3\. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or related field. 4\. Preferred: Some experience in Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) ladder logic programming, with proficiency in procedural programming (e.g., C) and object\-oriented programming (e.g., C\+\+ or C\#). **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related discipline. **DEMONSTRATED CRITICAL COMPETENCIES:** 1\. **Communication** – Ability to ensure information is passed on to others who should be kept informed. Ability to express oneself clearly in conversation and interaction with others. Ability to express oneself clearly in business writing. 2\. **Analytical Thinking** – The ability to tackle a problem by using a logical, systematic and sequential approach. 3\. **Technical Expertise** – The ability to demonstrate depth of knowledge and skill in a technical area, and a propensity for continuing education and training. 4\. **Thoroughness** – Ensuring work and information is complete and accurate; carefully preparing for meetings, courses and presentations, following up to ensure the agreements and commitments have been fulfilled. 5\. **Stress Management** – The ability to keep functioning effectively when under pressure or with unpredictable surges in workload; and maintain self\-control in the face of hostility or provocation. **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**: 1\. **Repetitive Motion** – Substantial movement/motion of the wrists, hands and fingers. 2\. **Sitting** – Employee needs to remain seated for extended periods of time. 3\. **Vision** – Close visual acuity to perform an activity such as analyzing data, viewing a computer terminal, use of tools, etc. 4\. **Trave**l – Work requires travel by walking on foot, car or airplane and may include extended periods of walking or sitting. **Note: This position is on\-site in Pulaski NY and follows a hybrid schedule, with minimum of 3 days on\-site and up to 2 days remote per week.**

jobs.title: Data Integration Engineer
jobs.description: **Position Description** ======================== The Data Integration Engineer designs, builds, and supports the integrations that bring data from The Specialty Alliance’s enterprise financial and business systems—including NetSuite, Workday, and Coupa—into the landing zone of the Azure/Snowflake analytical environment. The role builds API\-based, file\-based, and other connector\-based integrations that are secure, reliable, monitored, and repeatable. The role owns ingestion from source to landing: authentication, extraction, incremental loading, schema handling, error handling, logging, and delivery of raw data into Azure storage and Snowflake landing/raw schemas with complete audit metadata. Downstream normalization, modeling, and semantic\-layer work is performed by data engineers and analytics engineers, who depend on this role for complete, timely, and traceable source data. Data from these systems supports financial reporting, revenue recognition, general ledger and close reconciliation, procurement and spend analytics, and workforce analytics. Integrations must meet the control, traceability, and access standards expected for financial and HR data. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== **Integration design and build** -------------------------------- * Build and maintain integrations from NetSuite, Workday, Coupa, and other financial and business systems into the Azure/Snowflake landing zone. * Use the appropriate pattern for each source: REST/SOAP APIs, vendor reporting services, database or query interfaces, SFTP/flat\-file exports, managed connectors, or event\-driven feeds. * Implement full and incremental extraction, including change detection, watermarks, pagination, rate\-limit handling, retries, and historical backfills. * Land data in Azure Data Lake Storage and Snowflake raw/landing schemas in source\-faithful form, with load metadata (source, extract time, batch ID, record counts, file hashes). * Configure Snowflake ingestion (external stages, storage integrations, COPY INTO, Snowpipe) in line with platform standards. * Document each integration: source objects, fields, extraction logic, schedules, dependencies, and known limitations. **Reliability, monitoring, and support** ---------------------------------------- * Build orchestration, alerting, and logging so failures, late data, schema changes, and volume anomalies are detected quickly. * Implement completeness checks and source\-to\-landing reconciliation (record counts, control totals) for financial and HR data. * Provide production support, troubleshoot failures, perform root\-cause analysis, and maintain runbooks. * Meet data\-delivery schedules tied to financial close and reporting calendars. **Security and controls** ------------------------- * Manage credentials, OAuth clients, integration users, and certificates through Azure Key Vault and approved secret\-management practices. * Apply least\-privilege access to source systems and landing zones in partnership with Security and system owners. * Support classification and protection of sensitive data, including employee PII, compensation, banking, and vendor data. * Follow change\-management, code review, and CI/CD practices; keep integration code under version control. * Retain extract evidence and lineage needed for audit and close support. **Collaboration** ----------------- * Work with NetSuite, Workday, and Coupa system owners and IT Enterprise Applications to understand data structures, custom fields, configuration changes, and release schedules. * Coordinate with vendors on API access, limits, and support issues. * Partner with the Enterprise Data Architect and data engineers on landing standards, naming, and handoff to modeled layers. * Assess new source systems, including systems acquired through practice onboarding or M\&A, and estimate integration effort. **Required Skills and Competencies** ==================================== * **Integration engineering:** Designs reliable full and incremental extraction with retries, idempotent loads, and backfill capability. * **Programming:** Strong Python and SQL; comfortable with JSON, XML, and CSV data structures. * **Data handling:** Manages schema changes, nested data, data types, and late\-arriving records. * **Operational rigor:** Builds monitoring, logging, and alerting as part of every integration. * **Security awareness:** Handles credentials and sensitive financial and HR data appropriately. * **Documentation:** Produces clear integration specifications and runbooks. * **Collaboration:** Works effectively with system owners, vendors, and downstream engineering teams. **Required Technologies** ========================= * Python (requests, data\-processing libraries) and SQL. * Azure data services: Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, Azure Key Vault; Azure Functions or Logic Apps. * Snowflake: stages, storage integrations, COPY INTO, Snowpipe, roles and grants. * REST/SOAP APIs, OAuth 2\.0, JSON/XML, SFTP. * Git and CI/CD (Azure DevOps or GitHub). **Desired Skills, Experience, and Technologies** ================================================ * NetSuite integration: SuiteTalk REST/SOAP web services, SuiteQL, saved searches, SuiteAnalytics Connect. * Workday integration: Workday web services (SOAP/REST), Reports\-as\-a\-Service (RaaS), integration system users and security groups. * Coupa integration: Coupa REST API, scheduled flat\-file exports, and Coupa data objects (requisitions, POs, invoices, suppliers). * Managed ingestion tools such as Fivetran, Airbyte, Matillion, or Informatica. * Orchestration and transformation tools such as Airflow, dbt, or Snowflake Tasks/Streams. * Infrastructure as code (Terraform or Bicep) and Snowflake environment automation. * Experience with healthcare, MSO, or multi\-entity organizations, including practice\-management or revenue\-cycle source systems. * Understanding of financial data (GL, subledgers, chart of accounts, AP, procurement) and HR data concepts. * Experience supporting SOX or audit\-sensitive data flows. * Certifications: SnowPro Core or Data Engineer; Microsoft Azure Data Engineer Associate. * Employment Notes The Specialty Alliance is an equal opportunity employer. This description reflects the principal responsibilities of the role and is not an exhaustive list; duties may change based on organizational needs.

jobs.title: Sr. DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: ### **Description** **Are you ready for a change?** At GS1 US, employees at every level play a vital role and provide a meaningful voice on issues that affect consumers across the country. We are a small company with a world\-class culture, and we make a huge impact on the way the world does business. ##### **What is in it for you:** As a Sr. DevOps Engineer at GS1 US, you have the opportunity to shape how we build, deliver, secure, and run the technology that powers our business. And you'll do it in a high\-performance, stable, and financially sound company. You'll have access to leadership and work closely with Product Owners, Developers, QA, Architecture, Security, Infrastructure, and business teams across the organization. GS1 US offers a high\-quality office environment (nice furniture, up\-to\-date technology, sit\-to\-stand desks, clean, well\-lit, etc.). Our world\-class work culture is something we are proud of and work on continuously. Providing work culture feedback at GS1 US is not just okay, it's expected AND acted upon. Your voice matters at GS1 US. In return, you'll be rewarded with great pay and benefits in a hybrid work culture. You'll work at a high\-performance company with a world\-class culture that invests in its employees. We don't just say culture is important to us, we have the data to back it up. **We are currently recruiting for this position, which offers $125,000–$155,000\. This position qualifies for participation in our annual employee bonus program.** GS1 US is seeking a highly skilled Senior DevOps Engineer to help deliver secure, reliable, and scalable technology solutions. This role is responsible for modern DevOps practices across software delivery, production support, Site Reliability Engineering, security automation, automated testing, and platform reliability. The ideal candidate has deep hands\-on experience with Microsoft Azure and Azure DevOps and is passionate about automation, operational excellence, developer enablement, and resilient cloud\-based applications. ##### **Key Responsibilities** **DevOps \& CI/CD Engineering** * Design, build, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps. * Develop reusable pipeline templates, deployment standards, and automation frameworks. * Support and improve build, release, and deployment processes across multiple application portfolios. * Implement configuration management, environment automation, and Infrastructure as Code where appropriate. * Promote DevOps best practices, governance standards, and engineering consistency across teams. * Enable development teams through self\-service automation and platform engineering capabilities. **Production Support \& Operations** * Serve as a primary escalation point for production incidents and critical business\-impacting issues. * Participate in on\-call rotations and incident response activities. * Monitor production environments, investigate alerts, perform root cause analysis, and coordinate remediation efforts. * Collaborate with application teams, infrastructure teams, vendors, and business stakeholders to restore service quickly and minimize downtime. * Develop and maintain operational runbooks, support documentation, recovery procedures, and handoff notes. * Drive continuous improvement based on incident trends, alert quality, deployment outcomes, and operational metrics. **Site Reliability Engineering** * Improve platform reliability, availability, performance, and operational resilience. * Define, monitor, and improve service health indicators, reliability targets, and operational readiness practices. * Implement observability solutions, monitoring, logging, alerting, and automated remediation where appropriate. * Identify and eliminate operational toil through automation and better engineering patterns. * Support capacity planning, performance tuning, release readiness, and proactive system health management. **Security \& DevSecOps** * Embed security controls throughout the software delivery lifecycle. * Implement and maintain vulnerability scanning, dependency management, secret management, and security automation. * Partner with Security and Infrastructure teams to support compliance with organizational policies and standards. * Support secure credential management, certificate lifecycle processes, and least\-privilege access controls. * Assist with audit readiness, governance initiatives, and risk\-reduction efforts. * Champion secure\-by\-design engineering practices across pipelines, repositories, and deployment workflows. **Quality Engineering \& Automated Testing** * Collaborate with development and QA teams to implement automated testing strategies. * Build and maintain automated quality gates in CI/CD pipelines. * Integrate unit, integration, API, regression, and smoke testing into deployment workflows. * Analyze test results and improve deployment reliability through continuous validation. * Promote shift\-left testing practices and actionable failure reporting. **Cloud Platform Engineering** * Support and optimize applications and services running in Microsoft Azure. * Troubleshoot cloud\-based applications, services, integrations, networking dependencies, and infrastructure touchpoints. * Assist with cloud governance, operational readiness, and platform modernization initiatives. * Partner with Cloud Engineering and Architecture teams on new technology implementations, migrations, and service improvements. * Evaluate and implement emerging DevOps, AI\-assisted engineering, and automation capabilities when they improve reliability or productivity. **Collaboration \& Technical Leadership** * Work closely with Product Owners, Developers, QA Engineers, Architects, Security teams, Infrastructure teams, and business stakeholders. * Mentor engineers and contribute to team knowledge\-sharing, support coverage, and onboarding materials. * Lead technical troubleshooting sessions and participate in solution design and architecture discussions. * Keep team documentation, standards, runbooks, and engineering playbooks current. ##### **Education and Experience** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. * 7\+ years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, Cloud Operations, or related roles. * 5\+ years of hands\-on Microsoft Azure experience. * 5\+ years of Azure DevOps experience developing and managing CI/CD pipelines. * Strong experience with Git\-based source control, branching strategies, and pull request workflows. * Experience creating automation using PowerShell, C\#, Python, Bash, or similar scripting languages. * Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability platforms. * Experience supporting production environments and participating in on\-call rotations. * Understanding of networking, application architecture, security, and cloud infrastructure concepts. ##### **How You Work** * Automation\-first engineer who looks for repeatable, scalable ways to eliminate manual work and toil. * Calm, methodical problem solver who uses critical thinking and root cause analysis to resolve issues quickly and prevent them from recurring. * Collaborative partner and mentor who shares knowledge openly and helps teams deliver faster and more reliably. * Clear communicator who documents thoroughly and keeps stakeholders informed during incidents and change. * Accountable and results\-oriented, driving a culture of reliability, security, and continuous improvement. ##### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure API Management, Azure SQL, Storage Accounts, and related Azure services. * Experience implementing Infrastructure as Code using Bicep, Terraform, ARM templates, or similar technologies. * Experience with Snyk, SonarCloud, dependency scanning, static code analysis, and DevSecOps practices. * Experience with automated testing frameworks, API testing, and quality engineering practices. * Experience supporting .NET applications, Angular applications, and API\-based architectures. * Knowledge of AI\-assisted software development, automation, and agentic engineering concepts. * Microsoft Azure certifications or related cloud certifications. This position is also eligible for company\-sponsored benefits, which include: * Health (medical, RX, dental, vision) \- effective immediately * 401(k) with Employer Safe Harbor and Profit Sharing Contributions \- effective immediately * Short and Long Term Disability Coverage * Mental Health and Wellbeing (6 employer sponsored therapy and coaching sessions) * Individual Wellness Platform * Paid Parental Leave * Generous PTO and Company Paid Holidays * LinkedIn Learning * Tuition Reimbursement * Kudos (employee recognition and engagement platform) * Catered Lunches 2x/week on in office days

jobs.title: Facility Process Engineering Lead
jobs.description: Business Introduction We manufacture and supply reliable, high\-quality medicines and vaccines to meet patients’ needs and drive our performance. Our network of 37 medicines and vaccines manufacturing sites delivered 1\.7 billion packs of medicines and 409 million vaccine doses in 2024 to help make a positive impact on the health of millions of people. Our supply chain is not just core to our operations; it’s vital to bringing our innovations to patients as quickly, efficiently and effectively as possible. Technology is transforming how we manufacture medicines and vaccines, enabling us to increase the speed, quality and scale of product supply. We need the very best minds and capability to help us on our journey to make more complex products, harnessing the power of smart manufacturing technologies including robotics, digital solutions and artificial intelligence to deliver for patients. Facility Process Engineering Lead Position Summary Help build a next\-generation biopharmaceutical facility from the ground up. GSK is making a significant investment in the Upper Merion Flex Factory, a state\-of\-the\-art facility designed to connect science, technology and manufacturing to deliver more medicines to patients, faster. This is a unique opportunity to help define how the facility will operate for years to come. As the Flex Facility Process Engineering Lead, you will turn ambitious manufacturing concepts into safe, compliant and operable process solutions and see them through from concept to operation. You will lead process engineering and process\-equipment delivery across design, procurement, construction, commissioning, qualification, start\-up and handover. Working closely with GSK, our design and delivery partners, equipment suppliers and site stakeholders, you will play a critical role in bringing the Flex Factory vision to life. Help shape the process foundation of a flexible, future\-ready biologics facility. You will integrate innovative process technology, advanced analytics and digitally enabled ways of working to create manufacturing capabilities that are safe, efficient, scalable and capable of supporting the next generation of medicines. Responsibilities This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following: * Lead process engineering and process\-equipment delivery for the Upper Merion Flex Factory across the full project lifecycle, from scope definition and early design through procurement, construction, commissioning, qualification, start\-up and handover. * Shape and deliver an integrated process design that is safe, compliant, constructible, operable, maintainable and cost\-effective, while meeting the facility’s approved scope and operational requirements. * Build, lead and develop a high\-performing process engineering team, including approximately 6–10 direct reports and an extended matrix of Design Partner, EPC\+ partner, equipment\-supplier and subcontract resources. * Serve as GSK’s principal process engineering interface with project partners, equipment suppliers and site stakeholders, providing technical direction and enabling effective decisions across engineering, science, manufacturing, Quality, Validation, EHS, Operations and Project Controls. * Lead the specification, design, procurement, fabrication, delivery and technical acceptance of process equipment, ensuring that equipment meets user requirements and is delivered in alignment with the approved project scope, schedule and budget. * Apply strong biopharmaceutical process\-engineering principles to equipment and facility design, including cleanability, bioburden control, hygienic design and CIP/SIP requirements, in accordance with applicable GSK standards, cGMP expectations and industry guidance such as ASME BPE and ISPE. * Own EHS in Design and process\-safety delivery for the process\-engineering scope, ensuring that applicable GSK requirements and national and local regulations are addressed and that identified risks are driven to timely closure. * Integrate process engineering and equipment delivery with the overall project execution strategy, ensuring that scope, resources, technical deliverables, procurement, fabrication, installation, commissioning, qualification and validation are properly sequenced within the integrated project plan. * Provide process engineering leadership for project governance and investment decisions, including scope development, funding requests, Stage Gate Reviews, Design Verification, value engineering, estimate development, cost forecasting and management of technical, schedule, cost and interface risks. * Monitor process\-engineering and equipment expenditures against approved estimates, maintain clear forecasts and support development and validation of project budgets with the EPC\+ partner, equipment suppliers and subcontract partners. * Own process commissioning, qualification and handover readines ry of the Upper Merion Flex Factory. The role requires meaningful on\-site engagement with the project team, site stakeholders, design and delivery partners, equipment suppliers and subcontract partners. This role requires, at minimum, three days per week on site, reflecting the importance of close partnership with on\-site engineering, operational and project\-delivery teams. We want to hear from you if you are motivated to lead engineering excellence in a meaningful, people\-focused environment. Apply now to join a team making a difference every day. **Skills** Asset Life Cycle Management, Data Integrity, Digital Fluency, GxP Regulations, Lean Management, Manufacturing Technologies, Pharmaceutical Manufacturing, Problem Solving, Risk Awareness, Standards Compliance Please visit GSK US Benefits Summary to learn more about the comprehensive benefits program GSK offers US employees. **Why GSK?** **Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.** GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2\.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Java, OAuth/SAML, AWS)
jobs.description: **About this role** At Gartner, we’re searching for passionate and versatile software engineers to join our User Platform (UPT) team. As a member of UPT, you’ll play a crucial role in shaping how our clients securely access Gartner’s web, mobile, and internal platforms—including G.com, Tools, GPI, and more. Our team is at the heart of authentication and authorization, leveraging industry\-standard protocols like OAuth and SAML to ensure a seamless and secure user experience. We embrace a modern microservices architecture on AWS Cloud, and you’ll have the opportunity to work with cutting\-edge technologies while collaborating with talented colleagues across the organization. If you thrive in a fast\-paced environment and enjoy solving complex challenges that impact real users, we’d love to hear from you. **What you will do:** * + Build and maintain backend services using Java Spring or similar J2EE frameworks. + Design and implement RESTful APIs/microservices, and work across the full stack to deliver robust web applications. + Work with Authentication and Authorization protocols like OAuth, SAML + Develop engaging, responsive user interfaces with ReactJS or similar JavaScript frameworks, and HTML/CSS. + Take ownership of your work, ensuring successful and timely delivery. + Thrive in a fast\-paced Agile/Kanban environment, collaborating closely with teammates. + Follow best coding practices, and create thorough unit and integration tests, as well as deployment scripts. + Help define and improve software architecture, working with technical leads to identify opportunities for enhancement. + Continuously seek ways to improve the user experience, software architecture, or adopt new technologies. Leverage your experience with open\-source technologies and applications. + **What you will need:** * + A bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science or a related engineering field, along with hands\-on software development experience. + At least 6 years of experience building customer\-facing web applications. + 5\+ years working with Java Spring or similar J2EE frameworks. + Good understanding of Authentication and Authorization frameworks + Deep understanding of RESTful API principles and security best practices. + Solid experience with unit testing and end\-to\-end testing. + Strong skills in front\-end development (JavaScript, React, HTML, CSS) are a plus. + Bonus points if you have experience with Docker, Any cloud AWS/GCP/Azure, CI/CD tools like Jenkins, or Kubernetes. + Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. A genuine passion for learning, including DevOps and new technologies. + **What you’ll receive:** * + Competitive compensation. + Limitless growth and learning opportunities. + A collaborative and positive culture \- join a diverse team of professionals that are as smart and driven as you. + A chance to make an impact – your work will contribute directly to our strategy. + Enjoy the flexibility of working from home and the energy of collaborating with peers in our dynamic offices. + 20\+ PTO days plus holidays and floating holidays in your first year. + Extensive medical, dental insurance and vision plan. + 401K with corporate match, immediate vesting. + Health\-and\-wellness\-related allowance programs. + Parental leave. + Tuition reimbursement. + Employee Stock Purchase Plan. + Employee Assistance Program. + Gartner Gives Charity Match. We embrace the vision, roadmap to success and the action it takes to make it happen. + **Intellectually Curious** \- Seek to learn, love to teach. We’re humble and embrace respectful, radical candor with a mindset of ongoing professional and personal development. + **Collaborative \-** One team, shared mission. We welcome feedback and understand the value of working together to accomplish more than what is possible individually. \#LI\-JD6 \#LI\-Hybrid \#LI\-Technology **Who are we?** At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world. Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission\-critical priorities. Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in \~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here. **What makes Gartner a great place to work?** Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance. We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients. Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations. We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work. **Gartner is the world authority on AI** At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes. It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you. **What do we offer?** Gartner offers world\-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers. In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring. jobs.description: **Job Description** **This role is categorized as hybrid. This means the successful candidate is expected to report to Warren Global Technical Center or Austin Technical Center three times per week, at minimum \[or other frequency dictated by the business if more than 3 days].** **The Role** The Quality \& Safety Data Platform team builds the governed data products behind GM quality, warranty, dealer, and vehicle analytics. We are hiring a hands\-on Level 8 individual contributor to lead modernization of those platforms on Azure Databricks and to make agentic AI part of how the team builds, validates, and operates them. You will own the architecture and delivery of lakehouse pipelines, and you will design agents, reusable skills, and orchestration workflows that speed up legacy ETL migration, data validation, and production support. You will set technical direction across QDAP, CARD, MTDR, GART, Compass, and PRTS, mentor senior engineers, and influence engineering standards beyond this team. Data engineering is the job. Agentic AI is how this engineer multiplies the team’s impact. **What You’ll Do** ### **Data platforms and modernization** * Architect, build, and operate reliable batch and streaming data products in Azure Databricks using Spark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Spark Declarative Pipelines, and Bronze/Silver/Gold or comparable lakehouse patterns. * Lead migration of legacy ETL and data warehouse workloads—including IBM DataStage, Oracle, DB2, and on\-premises platforms—to incremental Databricks pipelines. * Define cutover plans, source\-to\-target parity criteria, automated reconciliation, and data\-quality checks so migrated products are reliable and trusted. Prepare governed data for AI applications, including retrieval and vector search, evaluation datasets, lineage, and access controls. * ### **Agentic AI and orchestration** * Design, build, and operate agents and agentic workflows that automate data\-engineering tasks such as code conversion, pipeline generation, validation triage, troubleshooting, and technical documentation. * Engineer stateful, multi\-step and multi\-agent orchestration, including task decomposition, tool calling, state and context management, retries, timeouts, and recovery from partial failures. * Choose the right pattern for each problem—including deterministic workflows, planner/executor, supervisor/worker, or agent handoff—and define when a workflow should pause for human approval or use a non\-agent solution. * Integrate agents with governed data, Databricks workloads, APIs, and approved engineering tools using scoped permissions, validated inputs and outputs, and auditable interfaces. * Build and publish reusable agents, skills, orchestration patterns, and templates that can be adopted by other teams. * Establish evaluation and observability practices for agent releases. Measure task success, tool\-use correctness, grounding, latency, and cost using representative evaluation datasets and production signals. * Apply appropriate safeguards, including prompt\-injection defenses, credential and secret controls, PII protections, sandboxing where appropriate, human approval, and audit trails. ### **Technical leadership and operations** * Set the engineering bar for CI/CD, workload identity, security, cost management, observability, and production support across the team’s data and AI solutions. * Mentor senior engineers, provide technical direction across teams, and partner with quality, warranty, aftersales, and platform stakeholders to turn ambiguous needs into measured outcomes. jobs.title: Sr/Lead Process Engineer
jobs.description: The field of gene therapy is growing rapidly and Genezen is here to meet the exacting needs of our clients. We provide process development, produce GMP viral vectors, and provide cell transduction for gene and cell therapy clinical trials and are proud to be a part of the process that leads to new cures. **WORKING AT GENEZEN** Many people have worked in environments where you feel like just another nameless part of an enormous machine. Genezen is different. We want our employees to be innovative, collaborative problem solvers who are dedicated to meeting the challenges of working at a fast\-growing company. We are dedicated to empowering our employees to be their best and making Genezen a rewarding place to work. Every employee contributes to the success of the company and you can be part of that team. **JOB SUMMARY** The Senior/ Lead Process Engineer serves as a technical leader for process engineering activities supporting Genezen's gene therapy development, clinical, and commercial manufacturing operations. This role provides independent engineering judgment and cross\-functional leadership across Manufacturing, Facilities, Quality Control, Supply Chain, and Process Development, with accountability for process and equipment performance, technical problem solving, process improvement, technology transfer, commissioning and qualification, and delivery of medium\- to large\-scale engineering projects. The Senior/Lead Process Engineer translates complex operational and process needs into practical, compliant, and sustainable solutions; influences technical direction; and provides guidance to engineers and cross\-functional teams without direct supervisory responsibility This position may be filled at the Senior Engineer or Lead Engineer level, based on the scope of technical leadership, depth of relevant experience, and demonstrated ability to lead complex work independently. **JOB RESPONSIBILITIES** * Serves as a technical lead and subject matter expert for process engineering activities supporting development, technology transfer, clinical manufacturing, and commercial manufacturing operations. * Independently evaluates complex process, equipment, and facility issues using engineering principles, process data, risk assessment, and root\-cause analysis; develops and implements solutions aligned with quality, safety, operational, and business objectives. * Leads complex capital and operational improvement projects involving process equipment, automation and control systems, utilities, and facilities, with accountability for technical scope, design review, vendor coordination, schedule, budget, testing, turnover, and overall project performance. * Provides technical leadership for product and process technology transfers by assessing process requirements against facility and equipment capabilities, identifying gaps and risks, and defining engineering solutions and implementation plans. * Leads or provides senior\-level technical support for investigations, deviations, CAPAs, change controls, and recurring process or equipment issues; ensures actions address root causes and improve process reliability. * Defines and drives process and equipment monitoring strategies, performance metrics, and continuous improvement initiatives to improve capability, robustness, throughput, and operational readiness. * Authors, reviews, and approves engineering procedures, specifications, technical assessments, protocols, reports, and standards for accuracy, compliance, and consistency with site and regulatory expectations. * Provides technical direction, coaching, and work guidance to engineers, technicians, contractors, and cross\-functional team members; facilitates alignment and escalates technical risks and decisions to stakeholders as appropriate. * Represents Process Engineering in cross\-functional forums and communicates technical recommendations, project status, risks, and decisions clearly to operations, quality, and site leadership. **SPECIAL JOB REQUIREMENTS** * Incumbent will be required to be part of the on\-call schedule to support manufacturing operations. * Criminal background check required * Other duties as assigned **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE** **EDUCATION / CERTIFICATIONS / LICENSES** **Essential/Desired** B.S. in Chemical or Mechanical Engineering, or similar field of study Essential **ON\-THE\-JOB EXPERIENCE** 8\+ years of relevant working experience in a comparable position in gene therapy or other biotechnology industry. Essential **SKILLS / ABILITIES** Ability to communicate effectively in writing and orally across the organization and at multiple levels. Essential Must be capable of multi\-tasking, planning and performing assignments that have loosely defined objectives which require investigation of numerous variables. Essential Ability to apply knowledge of multiple engineering disciplines to evaluate and develop solutions for operational issues. jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer / Technical Lead
jobs.description: Going helps more than 2 million members travel more for less. We find exceptional flight deals, from mistake fares to deep discounts, and get them to members before they disappear. Our membership has grown on one promise: we save you money on the trips you actually want to take. We are a small, fully remote team with outsized reach. Every engineer's work lands in front of millions of travelers, often the same week it ships. Now we're rebuilding how we build: simplifying our platform, raising our quality bar, and using AI where it measurably makes a small team faster. We're hiring a Senior Data Engineer / Technical Lead for our flight data platform: streaming ingestion with Kafka, normalizing and merging flight offers across providers, an S3 data lake (Parquet, Iceberg), and the Elasticsearch cache that serves the prices and deals members see. You'll also own our current deal\-detection system until the new platform replaces it. This role is half technical lead, half business owner. You'll own the platform's technical strategy and know what's being worked on, why it matters, and who's doing it. You'll also own its outcomes with the business: setting goals, reporting what moved and why, and deciding what we do next alongside Product, Marketing, Operations and Analytics. * **Reports to:** Director of Engineering * **Location:** Remote (US time zones) **What you'll do** ------------------ * **Own the platform end to end.** Own the architecture, reliability and roadmap of our data platform, from Kafka ingestion through the lakehouse to the services that consume it. Make the key technical calls, know which to delegate, and keep the platform's contributors and the other team leads aligned through design docs and code review. * **Be the business's data partner.** Own your team's goals. Plan initiatives anyone in the company can understand, report progress and learnings at our cross\-functional metrics meeting, and bring a cause and a proposed path when something is off track. * **Use AI with judgment.** Use coding agents and LLM tools where they make you and the platform's contributors faster, verify what they produce, and help set the review and testing standards for AI\-generated pipeline code and SQL. * **Make the data trustworthy.** Build the validation, monitoring and alerting that catch bad data before members do, and lead the response when something slips through. * **Design for change.** Build source\-agnostic models so we can add or replace data providers without breaking consumers, and make replay and backfill routine instead of risky. Know what the platform costs, where it's slow, and what we can remove. Start simple and earn complexity. * **Partner with Data Science and Analytics.** Make it easy for them to build on reliable data, from dashboards and models to AI\-powered member features. **What you know** ----------------- **Required:** * You’re legally authorized to work in the United States and able to work US\-hours. * **An experienced data engineer.** 6\+ years in data engineering, including 2\+ years as the technical lead for a production data system: owning its technical direction and driving decisions with the engineers around it. * **A technical lead, not a manager.** You stay hands\-on in the code and drive technical decisions without needing to make all of them yourself. * **An owner of outcomes.** You want to own goals with the business, explain why numbers moved, and propose what to do next. * **A systems thinker.** You reason clearly about trade\-offs between scalability, reliability, cost, and complexity, and you can explain them to people who aren't data engineers. * **AI\-pragmatic in practice.** You use coding agents and LLM tools daily, know where they help and where they fail, and verify their output. You've helped other team members adopt them. * **A strong data modeler.** You design models that are source\-agnostic and evolve without breaking their consumers. * **Fluent in streaming.** You understand Kafka (or similar), delivery semantics, idempotency, and how to replay and backfill safely. * **Lakehouse\-literate.** You understand Iceberg (or Delta/Hudi), catalogs, and distributed query engines, and how they behave at scale. * **Strong in Python and SQL.** Python is the primary language of our data platform. * **A clear remote communicator.** You write well, work async effectively, and can turn a technical incident into a plain\-English update. **Preferred:** * Experience in flights or travel: airfare data, GDSs, NDC, metasearch, OTAs, or airline retailing * Experience with pricing, alerting, or real\-time data pipelines * Subscription or membership business experience, including experimentation and A/B testing * Hands\-on experience with some of our stack: AWS (S3, Glue Data Catalog, EKS), Confluent Cloud (Kafka, Schema Registry, Avro), Apache Iceberg and Parquet, Starburst (Trino), Elasticsearch, Postgres and Redis, Kubernetes, Terraform, Datadog, and Ruby on Rails (our primary backend framework) * Experience supporting data science, ML, or LLM\-powered features, including building or operating LLM\-powered pipeline steps (e.g., enrichment, matching, or data\-quality checks) and evaluating their output * Took a data platform through a major migration or simplification (e.g., consolidating systems or moving to managed services) **Why you might love working here** ----------------------------------- * The salary for this role is $165,000 \+ equity * 100% remote work environment * Annual team retreats, with past destinations including Asheville, Scottsdale, Washington D.C., Vancouver, and Mexico City * Open vacation policy, with a 15\-day minimum * Comprehensive health, vision, dental, and life insurance * 401(k) with a 5% match * $750/quarter remote work, wellness, and wisdom stipend * Up to 12 weeks of paid family leave * Meetup stipend when you cross paths with a co\-worker * Continuing education \& development reimbursement * Challenging problems to solve and an awesome team to collaborate with every single day *We want you to bring your authentic self to work every single day. We accept you for who you are and consider everyone on an equal opportunity basis without regard to ancestry; age; appearance; color; gender identity and/or expression; genetics; family or parental status; marital, civil union, or domestic partnership status; mental, physical, or sensory disability; national, social or ethnic origin; past or present military service; sexual orientation; socioeconomic status; race; religion or belief; hair length; organ donor status. Going is an E\-Verify employer.* *If you require a reasonable accommodation or assistance for any part of the interview and employment process, please contact us at* *careers@going.com* *and let us know the nature of your request.*

We are on a mission to support our customers with meeting the needs of their communities and implementing our technology in ways that are equitable and inclusive. With comprehensive cloud\-based solutions for communications, government website design, meeting and agenda management software, records management, and digital services, Granicus empowers stronger relationships between government and residents across the U.S., U.K., Australia, New Zealand, and Canada. By simplifying interactions with residents, while disseminating critical information, Granicus brings governments closer to the people they serve—driving meaningful change for communities around the globe. Want to know more? See more of what we do here. Job Summary: **Position Summary** -------------------- The Senior DevOps Engineer is an advanced engineering position responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting automation, deployment, monitoring, and operational reliability across cloud and hosted application environments. This role partners closely with software engineering, site reliability, security, infrastructure, and architecture teams to improve continuous integration and continuous delivery processes, infrastructure automation, platform operations, and service resilience across increasingly complex environments and delivery pipelines. The successful candidate will demonstrate deep hands\-on experience with DevOps practices, cloud infrastructure, systems administration, automation, and troubleshooting, along with the ability to independently lead complex technical efforts from planning through implementation. This position is intended for senior engineers who are expected to apply advanced technical judgment and drive significant improvements in platform reliability and efficiency by applying AI across CI/CD, observability, incident response, and infrastructure designing and operation—optimizing builds and pipelines; detecting and diagnosing failures faster; using predictive insights to spot anomalies and bottlenecks; and recommending cost and resource\-utilization improvements, while also providing technical leadership, mentoring, and day\-to\-day guidance to other engineers. The role includes leadership of complex projects and technical workstreams, coordination across teams, and influence over engineering practices and delivery outcomes.**Career Growth and Work Environment** -------------------------------------- This is a senior individual contributor position intended for engineers who operate with a high degree of independence, advanced technical judgment, and strong technical leadership capability. The Senior DevOps Engineer is expected to lead complex technical work, drive meaningful platform and operational improvements, influence engineering direction, mentor other engineers, and serve as a trusted technical leader across DevOps, cloud operations, automation, and reliability initiatives. This is a full\-time position and may include participation in a rotational on\-call support model. The role may support systems and environments critical to business operations and therefore requires strong adherence to established operational, security, and compliance standards, along with a willingness to take ownership of complex issues, improve documentation and process maturity, guide less experienced engineers, and lead technical initiatives that strengthen delivery and operational effectiveness. While this role includes technical leadership and mentoring responsibilities; it does not include formal HR people management. **Security Requirement:** Responsible for Granicus information security by appropriately preserving the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability (CIA) of Granicus information assets in accordance with the company's information security program. What Your Impact Will Look Like: **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Own and support software delivery activities, including build, deployment, release, and environment management processes across multiple complex applications and infrastructure environments. * Design, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines used to build, test, secure, and deploy applications with greater efficiency, consistency, resiliency, and scalability. * Architect, provision, configure, and maintain infrastructure in cloud and hosted environments using automati timization, and reliability engineering). * Mentor engineers and lead initiatives to scale AI capabilities, frameworks, and best practices. * Have experience using Python (or similar) to build operational tools with guardrails. Pay Range: USD $128,000\.00 \- USD $165,000\.00 /Yr. About Us: Don’t have all the skills/experience mentioned above? At Granicus, we are trying to build diverse, inclusive teams. We do not have degree requirements for most of our roles. If you don’t meet every requirement above but are excited to learn more, we encourage you to apply. We might just be able to find another role that could be a perfect fit! **Security and Privacy Requirements*** Responsible for Granicus information security by appropriately preserving the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability (CIA) of Granicus information assets in accordance with the company's information security program. * Responsible for ensuring the data privacy of our employees and customers, their data, as well as taking all required privacy training in a timely manner, in accordance with company policies. **The Team*** We are a remote\-first company with a globally distributed workforce across the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, India, Armenia, Australia, and New Zealand. **The Culture*** At Granicus, we are building a transparent, inclusive, and safe space for everyone who wants to be a part of our journey. * A few culture highlights include – Employee Resource Groups to encourage diverse voices * Coffee with Mark sessions – Our employees get to interact with our CEO on very important and sometimes difficult issues ranging from mental health to work\-life balance and current affairs. * Microsoft Teams communities focused on wellness, art, furbabies, family, parenting, and more. * We bring in special guests from time to time to discuss issues that impact our employee population **The Impact*** We are proud to serve dynamic organizations around the globe that use our digital solutions to make the world a better place — quite literally. We have so many powerful success stories that illustrate how our solutions are impacting the world. See more of our impact here. The Benefits: At Granicus, we offer a **comprehensive and flexible benefits package** designed to support your well\-being, growth, and work\-life balance—starting from day one. Here’s what you can expect as a U.S.\-based team member: **Flexibility \& Balance** * **Flexible Time Off –** Take the time you need to rest, recharge, and live your life. * **Company\-Wide Wellbeing Days –** Paid days off to unplug and focus on your mental health. * **Work From Home Reimbursement –** Support a productive home office environment. **Health \& Wellness** * **Multiple Health Plan Options –** Including a 100% employer\-paid plan. * **Employer HSA Contributions –** When enrolled in a High\-Deductible Health Plan. * **Fitness Reimbursement Program –** Stay active, your way. * **On\-Demand Mental Health Support –** Access to Headspace and other wellness tools. **Family \& Future** * **Paid Parental Leave –** For both birthing and non\-birthing parents. * **Traditional \& Roth 401(k) –** With a generous company match. * **Life \& AD\&D Insurance –** 100% employer\-paid coverage for peace of mind. **Growth \& Recognition** * **Online Learning Platforms –** Fuel your professional development. * **Competitive Salary \& Bonuses –** Your contributions are valued and rewarded. Equal Opportunity Employer: Granicus is committed to providing equal employment opportunities. All qualified applicants and employees will be considered for employment and advancement without regard to race, color, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, physical or mental disability, age, genetic information, sexual or affectional orientation, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, familial status, military or veteran status or any other status protected by applicable law.

jobs.description: Overview: Gray Construction is currently looking for a Project Engineer to join our Reno, NV team. Assist the Project Manager to develop project proposals. * Create and maintain departmental electronic files, forms, and brochures. * Read and route incoming mail.
