jobs.title: Engineer, Machine Learning
jobs.description: Great Lakes Cheese is beginning an AI\-enabled decision intelligence journey. We will invest deliberately, validate value through focused use cases and use successful outcomes to guide future investment. In this role, you will translate that strategy into production\-ready solutions in partnership with business and technology teams. You will build AI agents, automation and predictive models on data from SAP ECC, SAP BW, MES and our plant operations. You will work directly with plant, supply chain, quality, finance and HR leaders. Your work will improve how we make cheese: yield, quality, planning and the daily decisions behind them.This is a builder role with meaningful ownership. You will contribute to the standards, patterns and tools used by future hires and the existing data team. You will also share practical knowledge as the team expands from on\-premises BI into cloud and AI engineering. **Job Responsibilities** ------------------------ **AI and agentic solutions** * Develop, test, and integrate production AI and agentic solutions using large language models, retrieval\-augmented generation, machine learning frameworks and, where appropriate, coordinated agent workflows to support process automation. * Build AI agents with Claude (API, Agent SDK, MCP, Skills) and Microsoft Copilot (Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Azure AI Foundry) that connect securely to SAP, MES and Microsoft 365 data. * Automate repetitive, high\-volume work across finance, supply chain, quality, HR and IT with Python, APIs and low\-code tools. * Build, test, and integrate machine learning capabilities across manufacturing use cases such as yield and giveaway optimization, demand forecasting, quality prediction, downtime analysis and predictive maintenance. **Model lifecycle, governance and adoption** * Execute model selection benchmarks, performance, validation, and knowledge retrieval optimizations to implement reliable AI models and support organizational governance standards. * Set up evaluation, monitoring and guardrails for accuracy, cost, security, data privacy and responsible AI use. * Document best practices for version control, CI/CD pipelines, testing protocols, and agent templates to ensure consistent quality and knowledge sharing across projects. **Partnership and enablement** * Build functional prototypes for assigned use cases, evaluate performance against established parameters, and transition successful models into production. * Share reusable Python, cloud and AI engineering practices with the existing SAP BW and database team through documentation, pairing and solution reviews. * Help evaluate vendors, tools and platforms, and present results to business leaders in plain language. **Required Education and Experience** ------------------------------------- * Bachelor’s degree in computer science (required). * Two years of professional experience in software, data or ML engineering, including meaningful hands\-on experience building and deploying AI, ML or LLM\-based solutions. * Strong Python skills (must\-have): production\-quality code, pandas/PySpark, REST APIs, packaging, testing and debugging. * AI agents and copilots: Hands\-on experience building AI agents or copilots using one or more enterprise AI platforms or frameworks, such as Claude, Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI Foundry, LangGraph, LangChain or LlamaIndex. Experience should include tool integration, orchestration and human\-in\-the\-loop controls. * Demonstrated experience designing and deploying agent workflows with tool use, orchestration, memory where appropriate and human\-in\-the\-loop controls. * AI frameworks and LLMOps tooling: familiarity with observability, tracing, prompt management, evaluation and model\-hosting tools such as Langfuse or Hugging Face. * Automation track record: automated business or IT processes end to end and can show the time or cost saved. * RAG and LLM engineering: embeddings, vector search, chunking strategy, prompt design and evaluation, working knowledge of Hugging Face models and libraries. * Machine learning fundamentals: regression, classification, time\-series forecasting and model validation with scikit\-learn, PyTorch or similar. * Strong SQL and experience working with large enterprise datasets. * Infrastructure and platform: Foundational knowledge of cloud AI and data platforms, such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, Azure OpenAI or Azure AI Foundry, with exposure to compute, storage, networking, environment management and cost monitoring. * Ability to explain technical results to non\-technical business users and plant teams. **Preferred Education and Experience** -------------------------------------- * Bachelor’s degree in computer science (required). * Two years of professional experience in software, data or ML engineering, including meaningful hands\-on experience building and deploying AI, ML or LLM\-based solutions. * Strong Python skills (must\-have): production\-quality code, pandas/PySpark, REST APIs, packaging, testing and debugging. * AI agents and copilots: Hands\-on experience building AI agents or copilots using one or more enterprise AI platforms or frameworks, such as Claude, Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI Foundry, LangGraph, LangChain or LlamaIndex. Experience should include tool integration, orchestration and human\-in\-the\-loop controls. * Demonstrated experience designing and deploying agent workflows with tool use, orchestration, memory where appropriate and human\-in\-the\-loop controls. * AI frameworks and LLMOps tooling: familiarity with observability, tracing, prompt management, evaluation and model\-hosting tools such as Langfuse or Hugging Face. * Automation track record: automated business or IT processes end to end and can show the time or cost saved. * RAG and LLM engineering: embeddings, vector search, chunking strategy, prompt design and evaluation, working knowledge of Hugging Face models and libraries. * Machine learning fundamentals: regression, classification, time\-series forecasting and model validation with scikit\-learn, PyTorch or similar. * Strong SQL and experience working with large enterprise datasets. * Infrastructure and platform: Foundational knowledge of cloud AI and data platforms, such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Databricks, Azure OpenAI or Azure AI Foundry, with exposure to compute, storage, networking, environment management and cost monitoring. * Ability to explain technical results to non\-technical business users and plant teams. **Working Conditions** ---------------------- * Occasional exposure to industrial operations including: temperature extremes from approximately 35ºF to 100ºF; noise levels in excess of 85 dB; moisture and moving machinery. * Work is performed in an office setting. **EEOC \& Disclaimer** ---------------------- Great Lakes Cheese is an Equal Opportunity Employer \- Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities.

jobs.title: Junior Data Engineer
jobs.description: Description: **Reports to:** Senior Full Stack Data Engineer **Location**: On\-site at our Dykstras Auto \- Grand Rapids location at 4782 44th St SE, Kentwood, MI 49512 **About the Role** GreatWater Garages operates automotive repair shops across multiple locations, and each acquisition brings new systems and data. We're hiring a Junior Data Engineer to help build and support the platform that connects those systems and supports reporting and analytics. You'll learn from an experienced senior engineer and work alongside two analysts on our Azure and Databricks environment. You'll start with well\-defined tasks and take on more ownership as you grow. **What You'll Do** You'll split your time between supporting the data platform and helping with our business systems. Your supervisor will set priorities and review your work. **Data Platform** 1\. Write and maintain Python and SQL code that moves data from source systems into our Databricks lakehouse, with guidance from senior engineers. 2\. Help build reusable, configuration\-driven ingestion so new locations and data sources can be added with less manual work. 3\. Help create clean, well\-documented tables that reporting and analytics teams can rely on. 4\. Monitor pipelines, investigate failures, and help fix them. 5\. Write tested code, keep it in GitHub, and take part in pull requests and code reviews. **Business Systems** * Help business teams set up and update objects in systems such as Salesforce, Monday.com, VSimple, and NetSuite, including boards, fields, and workflows. * Suggest useful additions, such as extra columns or fields that improve tracking and data quality, and bring them to your supervisor for approval. * Help spot missing, duplicated, or inconsistent records at the source and work with business teams to correct them. * Document how data moves between systems and keep a record of the configuration changes you make. Requirements: **What You Bring** * A degree or equivalent experience in computer science, information systems, or a related field, or a comparable portfolio of projects or coursework. * Working knowledge of Python, including functions, modules, and basic error handling. * Working knowledge of SQL, including joins, aggregations, and writing queries to troubleshoot data. * Some exposure to cloud data tools, such as Databricks or Azure. Experience with Spark or another cloud platform is a plus. * Familiarity with version control (Git) and a willingness to learn code review and deployment practices. * Curiosity about how data problems start and how they move through systems. * Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to ask good questions when requirements are unclear. * Good judgment about access controls, credentials, and sensitive data. * Able to travel up to 20% of the time. **Bonus Points** * Experience with automated testing, such as Pytest. * Exposure to Power BI or other reporting tools. * Experience with a CRM or ERP system, such as Salesforce or NetSuite. * Experience with data from multiple locations or acquired businesses. * Experience with Jira or writing technical documentation. **What Success Looks Like** **In your first 3 months, you will:** * Learn our Databricks platform and business systems. * Ship your first pipeline change to production with support from a senior engineer. * Complete your first requests from business teams, such as setting up a new board or fields. * Begin documenting how data flows between systems. **Within your first 6 months, you will:** * Understand the architecture and dependencies of our core data flows. * Independently deliver a small pipeline or integration, including monitoring and documentation. * Take ownership of a defined part of the platform or a business system integration. * Contribute to code reviews and suggest improvements to data quality or reliability. **Supporting Employees Beyond the Work:** At GreatWater, we believe a rewarding career should come with support that goes beyond the shop floor. From strong health coverage and paid time off to training, career growth, and programs that invest in your future, our benefits are built to help you thrive at work and at home. (Benefits begin the date of hire, except for 401k which begins on the 90th date of employment.) * Front Loaded PTO \+ 6 paid holidays * Paid Parental Leave (1 week) * Teammate Discounts on services * 401(k) Match: 100% of first 3% \+ 50% of next 2% * Health, Dental \& Vision Insurance * HSA Match up to $15 per paycheck * Company paid Life Insurance \& AD\&D ($25,000\) * Employee Assistance Program (24/7, free) * Voluntary Benefits: STD, LTD, Accident, Critical Illness, Life * Training \& Tuition Reimbursement, including ASE test fee reimbursement * LEARN to EARN Program: Technician pay growth tied to ASE certifications Notice Regarding the Use of Artificial Intelligence in Application Review **Notice of AI Use in Job Application Review** As part of our commitment in creating a fair, efficient, and consistent hiring process we may use artificial intelligence (AI) to help our recruiting teams organize, summarize, and analyze information provided by candidates, including resumes, application responses, and other materials submitted during the application process. AI may be used to identify patterns, highlight relevant skills, and experience, and assist in comparing a candidate's qualifications with the requirement of a specific role. These tools are to improve efficiency and consistency while supporting more informed hiring decisions, which will ultimately be made by the hiring team.

jobs.title: Machine Design Engineer I/ Machine Design Engineering Specialist
jobs.description: Ready to join a global leader in air movement and ventilation? At Greenheck Group, joining our team means more than just starting a job, it’s joining an award\-winning culture prioritizing your growth and development. Our unwavering commitment in supporting our team members both personally and professionally has earned us national recognition time and time again. As an innovative, environmentally responsible manufacturer of commercial HVAC systems, Greenheck Group designs and manufactures industry\-leading air movement and ventilation solutions through our family of trusted brands. Our products are found in commercial, institutional, and industrial facilities worldwide, from schools and hospitals to factories and stadiums. Since 1947, we’ve proudly invested in our people and our communities, fostering innovation, leadership, and opportunity at every level. We are more than products, we are a team of inspired people doing extraordinary things. As a Machine Design Engineer I / Machine Design Engineering Specialist for Greenheck Group you will perform basic tasks related to the design and manufacture of machinery, tooling and automation, while diagnosing and troubleshooting issues with existing tooling as well as designing for new construction. **WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING** * Under direct supervision, design and development of basic machine and tooling designs and redesigns in coordination with engineering and manufacturing functions. * Manage basic individual projects in accordance with predetermined completion dates. * Prepare bill\-of\-materials on new and changed designs and special design requests under direction of design team * Maintain accurate and current documentation. * Assist the release of design into production, including any necessary testing and training required for implementing new or changed designs * Evaluate basic material selection, cost analysis, and vendors as required to implement new designs. * Review, along with purchasing personnel, the selection and specification of newly purchased component parts for product designs * Participate in the prototyping and testing of new designs, including the interpretation of test results. May be required to set up and run test equipment * Lead basic projects to review the testing of machine start\-up, interpreting results and recommending and/or implementing necessary corrective action based on test results for final run\-off of the machine for the customer. * Analyze product designs for manufacturing feasibility and make recommendations to delivery time, cost and part quality. * Support business units with equipment breakdowns, process improvements, LEAN manufacturing. * Provide technical direction to shop floor personnel/maintenance to correct design problems as they arise. * May travel to production facilities to assist the review of installation and/or design problems and make a determination to resolve the situation. * May also be involved in technical committees, standard committees, etc. **WHAT YOU SHOULD HAVE AS A MACHINE DESIGN ENGINEER I** * 0\-2 years of relevant work experience in engineering, design, or machine design required. * 4 Year / bachelor's degree in engineering required. * Strong working knowledge of CAD systems and understanding of machine design. **WHAT YOU SHOULD HAVE AS A MACHINE DESIGN ENGINEERING SPECIALIST** * 0\-2 years of relevant work experience in engineering, design, or machine design required. * 2 Year / associate degree or equivalent years of job experience required. * 4 Year / bachelor’s degree preferred. * Strong working knowledge of CAD systems. **SOME THINGS WE THINK YOU SHOULD KNOW** * Minimal travel is required. * Will work on\-site in Schofield WI. **COMPENSATION \& BENEFITS** Greenheck Group takes pride in providing competitive pay along with a comprehensive benefits package as part of our total rewards program. jobs.title: AI Builder - Sales Tools
jobs.description: Groupon connects 42 million customers with local experiences \- restaurants, events, wellness and travel \- and the million\-plus merchants who deliver them. Our mission is to get people offline and into the real world at prices that make it possible. We're an AI\-native company in the middle of a platform transformation, moving from a deals marketplace to an experience discovery platform that works for customers and merchants at the same time. **Senior AI Builder, Sales Tools** ================================== **About the Role** ================== Groupon's North American and international sales teams sign and grow the local merchants who power our marketplace. The tools they use every day decide how much selling actually happens: who to call next, how to reach them, what to say, and what happened afterward. Today that stack mixes third\-party software with AI tools we built in\-house. You will own it end to end and, as it matures, extend into the tools merchants use to run their business on Groupon. This is an AI builder role. You don't write tickets and wait, and you don't hand\-write SQL or code either: your agents write it, and you read it well enough to know when it's wrong. You run a fleet of coding and data agents (Claude Code or similar) that pull the data, build the tool, instrument it, and test it. Your job is to decide what to build, direct the agents, judge whether the output is right, and get it into reps' hands in days, not quarters. Product passion means you care about the rep's day more than the stack: you ship what makes selling easier, and you measure it. You will have the model budget, agent access to our sales and marketplace data, and permission to ship to reps from your first week. This is a high\-leverage seat: one builder, a fleet of agents, and the reps who use what you ship a desk away. You report to the SVP of Global Operations, work day to day with Sales leadership, and hand what works to shared engineering and data teams to harden and scale. Groupon is rebuilding itself as an AI\-native company. In 2025 we returned to growth in both billings and revenue for the first time in a decade, with $1\.7B in gross billings and 16\.2M active customers, and our CEO has publicly committed to embedding AI agents into every function. **What You'll Do** ================== * Build the tools our sales reps and managers use every day: prioritization, prospecting and outreach, calling and email, coaching, and account alerts. Build them with agents, not with a backlog. * Ship your first working tool to reps within your first two weeks, then ship every week after that. Sit with the sales teams, shadow calls, and kill what reps don't use. * Put AI agents inside the product: rank who to call, draft the outreach, coach the manager, summarize the account. Build the evals that prove each one helps, and retire the ones that don't. * Own the numbers: rep productivity, contact rates, tool adoption, and revenue per rep, with decisions made on clean experiments. * Decide what we build and what we buy across the sales stack, on top of our CRM. With agents, build is often the faster answer; you prove it case by case, including who maintains it. * Turn what you build into agents and playbooks that reps and managers run themselves. **Basic Qualifications** ======================== * 2\+ years building and shipping software products, as a product manager, engineer, or founder. * You build with AI coding agents every day (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar) and have shipped software real users depend on that way, end to end, without an engineering team doing it for you, at work or on your own. * Your agents write your SQL and analysis, and you can read what they wrote: you catch the bad join, the double\-counted metric, or the experiment that can't answer the question before it reaches a decision. * You have shipped at least one LLM feature measured with evals, not demos. * A track record of moving a business metric through experiments you designed and instrumented, with results you can quantify. * Experience building products for a sales, support, or operations workforce, or on top of a CRM. **Process:** ============ * Recruiter Screen * Case study * Interview loop * reference checks * Offer Interviews include a live session where you build with agents; we provide the tools. **Preferred Qualifications** ============================ * Shipped LLM or agentic features into production: ranking, assistants, multi\-step agents with tool use, MCP or similar orchestration. * Experience with Salesforce and sales engagement platforms. * Experience in a marketplace, local commerce, or SMB\-facing business, including self\-service products for merchants or customers. **Compensation and Location** ============================= For New York, NY\-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $175,000 to USD $225,000 per year. For Chicago/Dallas, TX\-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $160,000 to USD $205,000 per year. You will be eligible to participate in Groupon's annual bonus program, and may be offered an equity award and other types of compensation. You will also be eligible for benefits including medical, dental and vision coverage, a 401(k) plan, and paid time off. This role is hybrid and is not eligible for fully remote work. You will spend at least half of your time in our Chicago, Dallas or New York office, alongside the sales teams you build for. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. **Equal Opportunity** ===================== Groupon is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. Groupon will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records consistent with applicable law, including the New York City Fair Chance Act. Accommodations may be available based on religious and/or medical conditions, or as required by applicable law. To request an accommodation, contact \[accommodations email]. **Groupon** **is an AI\-First Company** We're committed to building smarter, faster, and more innovative ways of working and AI plays a key role in how we get there. We encourage candidates to **leverage AI tools** during the hiring process where it adds value, and we're always keen to hear how technology improves the way you work. If you're passionate about AI or curious to explore how it can elevate your role **you'll be right at home here.** Groupon's purpose is to build strong communities through thriving small businesses. To learn more about the world's largest local e\-commerce marketplace, click here. You can also find out more about us in the latest Groupon news as well as learning about our DEI approach. If all of this sounds like something that's a great fit for you, then click apply and join us on a mission to become the ultimate destination for local experiences and services. **Beware of Recruitment Fraud:** Groupon follows a merit\-based recruitment process without charging job seekers any fees. We've noticed an increase in recruitment fraud, including fake job postings and fraudulent interviews and job offers aimed at stealing personal information or money. jobs.title: Platform Analyst, Talent Engineer
jobs.description: **About HOF Capital** HOF Capital is a global multi\-stage venture capital firm that partners with the world’s best founders and helps them build generational category\-defining technology companies. Since launching its first fund in 2016, the firm has invested in some of the most successful technology startups of the past decade (e.g., SpaceX, Anthropic, OpenAI, Neuralink, xAI, etc.) and achieved top\-tier investment performance throughout its history, which has enabled the firm to grow rapidly to \~$13B of assets under management (AUM). HOF’s LPs include many of the world’s leading institutions and business owners. Beyond capital, our platform team gives founders what they need to win, from customer introductions to top talent. **The role** You will build HOF’s community of early\-career engineers, researchers, operators, and students. You don’t need to be an engineer, but you know what separates an ML researcher from an infrastructure engineer from a hardware engineer, and what each kind of company actually needs. Or you’re curious enough to learn it fast. You use that to put the right people in front of the right portfolio companies. Engineers trust you because you take the time to understand their work, and they show up to your events because they’re worth their time: intimate dinners, and technical talks with brilliant minds, not mixers with name tags. You’ll work side by side with our investment team, and some of the people you meet will become the founders we back. **What you will own** * **The talent network.** Build and maintain a standing network of high\-potential engineers, researchers and students, organized by discipline (ML, infrastructure, embedded and hardware, product engineering, etc.) and seniority. Get to know them individually and personally so you know when they’re likely to move and can match them to the right opportunity. * **Student and university relationships.** Identify and build lasting relationships with top programs and student\-led clubs through treks, sponsorships, and other events. Use those relationships to place students and new grads in internships and first jobs across the portfolio, and to fill every recruiting event we host with the most relevant engineers. * **Engineering community events.** Plan events engineers actually want to attend, from small dinners and poker nights to hackathons. Build each guest list around portfolio companies and roles behind the event, run it with the investment team, and follow up so every event leaves behind relationships worth keeping. * **Deal signal.** The best founders often come out of your network. Spot the engineers and researchers who are about to leave and build something, and make sure HOF is the first call. You’ll work closely with our investors, and for the right person, this grows into sourcing deals alongside them. * **Portfolio hiring support.** Take in engineering and intern searches from portfolio companies, work directly with the founder on what the role actually requires, get them in a room with the best\-fit candidates, and manage our recruiting partners on searches we can’t fill directly. * **Founder and deal support.** Help founders build their early technical teams, and help the investment team show founders what HOF can do for them on hiring. * **Systems and reporting.** Design how the network runs: how candidates and searches are tracked, what gets measured (placements, event conversion, network growth), and how results are reported to the team. **What we are looking for** * **An eye for exceptional people.** You can spot the person in the room who’s going to be great before their resume says so, and you can explain why. * **A natural connector.** You get real satisfaction from introducing two people who should know each other, and the introductions you make tend to turn into something. * **You’ve built a community, not just joined one.** You started, led, or grew a talent community people actually wanted to be part of, such as a student club, hackathon, builder group, or online community. You can point to what it became because of you. * **Taste for events.** You know what engineers want to show up to, and you’ve run something people talked about afterward. * **A working map of engineering.** You know how engineering breaks down, across ML, infrastructure, hardware, and product, well enough to know who fits where. Or you’re curious enough to learn it fast. A technical background helps but isn’t required. * **Relentless follow\-through.** You’re organized and follow\-up\-heavy. Nobody you meet falls through the cracks. * **Early in your career.** 0 to 2 years of experience in any field. What you’ve built matters more than where you’ve worked. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Applied AI
jobs.description: MEDHOST is hiring for a Senior Software Engineer, Applied AI to join their team! The Senior Software Engineer, Applied AI is a senior\-level engineering position that builds and owns AI\-powered systems, features, and development workflows for IBM i enterprise applications. Applied AI — as distinct from AI research — is the practical implementation and deployment of AI technologies to solve real\-world problems in production: integrating existing models and frameworks (such as IBM Bob, LLMs, and agent toolchains) into working software, building reliably and scaliably, and focusing on measurable business outcomes rather than advancing theoretical algorithms. This engineer bridges the gap between data science and software engineering, taking AI from concept to deployed, maintainable production reality. The role requires deep IBM i expertise — particularly in Db2 for i SQL (schema design, query optimization, stored procedures, and data modeling) and solid RPGLE/CL engineering — combined with the ability to direct AI tools across the full development lifecycle: from specification drafting and AI code generation through testing, debugging, documentation, and modernization. The engineer authors precise technical specifications that drive AI code generation, reviews and validates AI\-produced outputs, and integrates approved solutions into production with full engineering accountability. This is not a traditional write\-code\-from\-scratch role. It is an engineering role for someone who thinks at the level of technical architecture and specification, uses AI to accelerate and scale implementation, and applies rigorous human judgment to ensure every AI\-generated artifact meets quality, security, and compliance standards before it reaches production. **WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE DIFFERENT:** Most software engineers write code. In this role, you apply Applied AI — directing AI tools to generate, validate, and deploy that code — and your value comes from the precision of your specifications, the rigor of your review, and the depth of your IBM i expertise. You will spend more time crafting technical intent than typing syntax, more time validating AI reasoning than debugging from scratch, and more time building reusable AI\-driven workflows than executing repetitive tasks manually. If you are energized by working at the intersection of AI capability and engineering discipline, and you want to shape how an organization delivers software in an AI\-first world, this position is built for you. The remote role is eligible to anyone in the U.S. and Canada. **RESPONSIBILITIES:** **1\. AI\-Driven Technical Specification and Design** ----------------------------------------------------- * Author AI\-ready technical specifications — versioned Markdown documents precise enough for an AI agent to implement a feature with no additional explanation required from the author. * Define solution design, data flow, component boundaries, integration points, IBM i object structures, API contracts, and error\-handling rules in sufficient detail that AI can generate correct, production\-quality SQL (DDL, DML, stored procedures, triggers, and views), RPGLE, and CL. * Collaborate with Product Owners, UX designers, and QA from day one of each feature to ensure technical specs align with business intent and are testable end\-to\-end. * Contribute to Gate Reviews by presenting the technical approach, answering feasibility and risk questions from stakeholders and architects, and demonstrating technical viability through AI\-generated prototypes built from the spec. * Maintain specs under version control; freeze approved versions during the build phase and manage change control for spec updates that arise during implementation. **2\. Applied AI Code Generation, Review, and Validation** ---------------------------------------------------------- * Direct AI coding assistants (e.g., IBM Bob, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent) to generate Db2 for i SQL (schemas, queries, stored procedures, views, and indexes), RPGLE, CL, and supporting artifacts from approved technical specifications — applying Applied AI principles to focus on production quality and maintainable outcomes. * Critically review, test, and validate all AI\-generated code — verifying correctness, security, performance, and conformance to IBM i engineering standards — before any output is integrated or promoted. * Use AI for code comprehension, impact analysis, and reverse\-engineering of existing legacy IBM i programs to produce current\-state technical documentation that supports modernization and change. * Leverage AI tools for automated unit test generation, test data preparation, and regression coverage across SQL routines, RPGLE service programs, and CL procedures. * Maintain human accountability for every promoted artifact: AI accelerates delivery; the engineer owns the result. **3\. Technical Leadership and IBM i Engineering Excellence** ------------------------------------------------------- ion, automated testing, and promotion to production. * Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, AI agent orchestration frameworks, or similar AI toolchain integration for IBM i or enterprise development environments. * Experience in Agile delivery, cross\-functional spec drafting teams (Product Owner / UX / QA / Tech Lead model), and distributed engineering teams. * Experience with IBM i modernization patterns — APIs, hybrid cloud integration, and ILE restructuring — using Applied AI\-assisted analysis and code generation. * Advanced Db2 for i experience: query plan analysis (Visual Explain), SQE optimizer hints, index advisor, SQL performance monitoring via QSYS2 plan cache views, and migration of legacy DDS\-based file access to modern SQL DDL and embedded SQL. * Experience building or contributing to an internal AI Center of Excellence, including creating reusable Applied AI patterns, skills, ADRs, or development standards. **Salary Range:** 90 \- 135k USD, annually **WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN THIS ROLE:** * AI generates a majority of implementation code; the engineer's time is invested in specification quality, architectural decisions, and rigorous validation — not repetitive coding tasks. * Technical specifications are precise enough that AI can implement a feature correctly without additional clarification from the author. * Applied AI\-generated code meets production quality standards on the first review pass due to specification depth and prompt precision. * Other engineers on the team measurably improve their Applied AI development practices as a result of mentoring and shared reusable AI assets. * As\-built specifications are accurate and version\-controlled, enabling future AI\-driven changes to proceed from a reliable baseline. * SQL and Db2 for i data\-layer artifacts (schemas, stored procedures, indexes, and queries) are well\-designed, optimized, and documented, reducing data\-access bottlenecks and providing a maintainable foundation for RPGLE and application\-layer code. DISCLAIMER This description outlines the basic tasks and requirements of the position and is not a comprehensive listing of all duties. Management reserves the right to modify duties and responsibilities as organizational needs evolve. **WHAT WE OFFER:** * Plenty of opportunities to grow your career * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits * 3 weeks of vacation plus 5 personal days to recharge * Employee stock ownership and RRSP program * A chance to give back through community involvement Flexible work arrangements to suit your lifestyle * **About us:** MEDHOST, founded in 1984 and headquartered in Franklin, Tennessee, is a leading provider of healthcare information technology solutions. Serving healthcare facilities nationwide, MEDHOST offers a comprehensive suite of products, including electronic health records (EHR), financial management systems, and patient engagement platforms. Their mission is to empower healthcare organizations to enhance patient care and improve business operations through innovative, user\-friendly solutions. In January 2024, MEDHOST was acquired by N. Harris Computer Corporation, further strengthening its position in the healthcare IT industry. **About Harris Computer:** Harris provides mission critical software solutions for the Public Sector, Healthcare, Utilities and Private Sector verticals throughout North America, Europe, Asia and Australia. jobs.title: Agent Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: **About HeyGen** ---------------- At HeyGen, our mission is to make visual storytelling accessible to all. Over the last decade, visual content has become the preferred method of information creation, consumption, and retention. But the ability to create such content, in particular videos, continues to be costly and challenging to scale. Our ambition is to build technology that equips more people with the power to reach, captivate, and inspire audiences. Learn more at www.heygen.com. . **About the Agentic Video team** -------------------------------- The Agentic Video team owns HyperFrames which is our open\-source framework for turning code into video. Our agent’s videos are just an HTML composition. Agents author it and humans collaborate with agents in our Studio to refine it before it renders deterministically to video. Since launching in April 2026, HyperFrames has grown to nearly 90,000 GitHub stars. More than 350,000 developers use it every week to render over 7 million videos, and most of them work through a coding agent. Now we're building on top of it by creating the best coding agents for video and a collaborative video ecosystem for teams. These agents run in our cloud on a user's behalf as well as locally on a developer's own machine. They write and run code, generate media, and then hand their work to a cloud rendering platform that turns it into finished video at scale. **About the role** ------------------ You will build and own the infrastructure that lets HyperFrames agents run safely and reliably, wherever they run. That covers: * our sandboxing platform * durable execution for long\-running agent sessions * governance and security for agents in our cloud and on users' machines * HyperFrames cloud rendering This is a senior, high\-ownership role. Much of the work is greenfield, and you will set the technical direction and roadmap for agent infrastructure as well as execute on it. You'll work closely with the engineers building our agents, the team behind the open\-source framework, and our core engineering and research teams. **What you'll do** ------------------ * **Own the sandboxing platform.** Every agent session writes and runs code: HTML, JavaScript, shell commands and headless browsers. You'll design the isolation model using microVMs and kernel sandboxes (Firecracker, Kata, gVisor or similar), Linux namespaces and cgroups. You'll own network egress policy and short\-lived, least\-privilege credentials for every run. * **Make agent execution durable.** Ensure resumable execution that checkpoints model calls and tool invocations, so an agent session survives pod failures, deploys and retries without losing the user's work. * **Govern agents in the cloud and on the desktop.** Decide and enforce what an agent may touch: tools, files, network access and credentials. Build the permission, policy and audit layer for cloud agents and for our local agent running on users' machines. * **Run code\-to\-video rendering at scale.** Own HyperFrames cloud rendering: the fleet of headless browsers and encoders behind millions of weekly renders. Drive down cold start, render time and cost per render, and keep output deterministic. * **Make every run observable.** Trace each agent run end to end, from prompt through model calls, tool calls and render. Feed that data into the evaluation pipelines we use to measure quality. * **Set the bar.** Lead design reviews, mentor engineers, own reliability and on\-call for the platform, and decide what we build versus buy. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * **You have built and operated infrastructure that runs untrusted code at scale.** For example: code\-execution sandboxes, agent platforms, CI runners, serverless or function platforms, or notebook and compute backends. We want to hear about an incident you handled and what you changed afterward. * **You know isolation deeply.** You are fluent in containers and Kubernetes and the security boundaries around them: namespaces, cgroups, seccomp, network policy, and at least one of Firecracker, Kata, gVisor, or Sysbox. You can reason about multi\-tenant risk and the blast radius of running someone else's code. * **You build distributed systems that recover from failure.** You have shipped durable or resumable execution, such as Temporal or a checkpointing workflow engine, and you think carefully about concurrency, race conditions, and retries. * **You care about performance.** You have measured and reduced cold\-start time, p99 latency, or cost per job on a production system. * **You operate at a senior or staff level.** You have 5\+ years of software engineering experience. You have led the technical design of a platform other teams depend on, and you are strong in Python or TypeScript. * **You take ownership.** You do not wait for a spec. You find the most important problem, fix it, and tell people what changed. A degree in computer science or a related field is welcome but not required. Equivalent experience counts. **Nice to have** ---------------- * You have run a code\-sandbox or agent\-execution product, at a company like E2B, Modal, Daytona, Fly.io, or Cloudflare, or inside a large AI lab. * You have built tool or MCP integrations, retrieval systems, or permission layers for AI agents. * You have built tracing or evaluation pipelines for LLM systems, for example with OpenTelemetry. * You have run headless\-browser or media workloads at scale (Chrome/Puppeteer, FFmpeg, GPU encoding). Cloud rendering is now part of the job. * You have built security or policy tooling that runs on developer machines. That covers the local\-agent governance work. * You maintain or contribute to a widely used open\-source project. **Show us something you've built** ---------------------------------- With your application, please include a short note (a few sentences is fine) about infrastructure you have built and run in production: a sandbox, a runner, a workflow engine, or an agent platform. Tell us what it did, how you knew it was working, and one failure you found and fixed. A link to code or a write\-up is a bonus. **Compensation \& Benefits** ---------------------------- * $225,000 – $300,000 annual base. * Equity in a high\-growth AI company. * 401K Match. * Health, dental, and vision benefits. * Flexible PTO. * Opportunity to help define a new category in AI video. * High ownership, high velocity, and direct impact on revenue growth. **Equal Opportunity** --------------------- HeyGen is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diversity and are committed to building an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer

jobs.title: Director, Bioinformatics – DRAGEN Array
jobs.description: What if the work you did every day could impact the lives of people you know? Or all of humanity? At Illumina, we are expanding access to genomic technology to realize health equity for billions of people around the world. Our efforts enable life\-changing discoveries that are transforming human health through the early detection and diagnosis of diseases and new treatment options for patients. Working at Illumina means being part of something bigger than yourself. Every person, in every role, has the opportunity to make a difference. Surrounded by extraordinary people, inspiring leaders, and world changing projects, you will do more and become more than you ever thought possible. **About the role** ------------------ Illumina Infinium microarrays are used worldwide and at very large scale in research, clinical and agricultural genomics, across applications such as genotyping, pharmacogenomics, cytogenomics, methylation and custom content. DRAGEN Array is Illumina's software for turning array data into accurate results, and there is a large opportunity to take it well beyond today's applications. Illumina is seeking a Director, Bioinformatics to lead DRAGEN Array SW bioinformatics. We are looking for a leader who will define where array analysis should go next, build the plan to get there, and lead the team in delivering it. **Key responsibilities** ------------------------ * **Vision and strategy:** Define a multi\-year vision for array data analysis at Illumina: where the field is heading, which applications and capabilities matter most, and how DRAGEN Array becomes the reference solution. Be accountable for its impact on the array business. * **Roadmap:** Propose and own the technical roadmap. Set priorities with Product Management and make clear trade\-offs between new capabilities, quality and support of products on the market. * **Execution:** Turn the roadmap into delivered releases at production quality, with software engineering and verification, following design controls and good programming practice, including for clinical and regulated use. * **Methods leadership:** Raise the bar on methods across the array portfolio, from signal processing and genotype calling to copy number and new applications. Mentor the team in creating new methods, set evaluation and validation standards, and benchmark against competing solutions. * **Scaling the team:** Lead and grow a team of \~10 bioinformatics scientists. Increase what the team delivers through structure, processes, automation and AI\-assisted development; develop individual contributors into technical and team leaders; hire for current and future needs. * **Cross\-functional partnership:** Work closely with the array assay and product teams to support new and existing BeadChips, and with the DRAGEN NGS bioinformatics teams to share methods and code and give customers a consistent experience across Illumina array and sequencing products. * **Technology and competitive landscape:** Track competing arrays, analysis software and new technologies, and decide which to evaluate and pursue. * **External engagement:** Build relationships with key opinion leaders (KOLs), customers and partners. jobs.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer, AI Productivity
jobs.description: **We're transforming the grocery industry** At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers. Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table. **Instacart is a Flex First team** There’s no one\-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in\-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work. **Overview** ------------ Instacart's AI Productivity team builds the AI\-powered platforms and tools that help our engineers and the broader R\&D organization move faster, reduce toil, and deliver higher\-quality experiences for customers, shoppers, retailers, and brand partners. We have been at the forefront of applied AI for years, and we move quickly: we prototype, ship, learn, and retire what is no longer the best answer. As a Senior Staff Software Engineer, you will set the direction for how AI changes the way Instacart builds products and software, and you will drive that change across the whole company. You will stay close to where the AI industry is heading, anticipate where the industry and Instacart will be 18 to 36 months from now, and turn that view into strategy, pilots, and adoption at scale. That means more work handled in the background by orchestrated, cost\-efficient, and compliant agents, so people can focus on the work that needs human judgment. This is a hands\-on, high\-visibility role. You will write code, partner with senior engineering and finance leadership, evaluate vendors and prototypes, and lead organizational change, including the cultural and people side of adoption. This position is remote\-friendly within North America. **About the Job** ----------------- * Define and drive the company\-wide strategy for AI\-assisted software and product development, anticipating where the industry and Instacart are headed over the next 18 to 36 months. * Lead adoption of AI tools and agentic workflows across engineering and R\&D, including company\-wide rollouts, and own the organizational change that comes with them: culture, learning, communication, and working through resistance. * Increase engineering throughput by growing the volume of background and parallel agentic work each person can handle, with high quality, strong safeguards, and clear cost controls. * Build and prototype hands\-on: lead large features, pilots, and proofs of concept that change how work gets done, and scale the ones that prove their value. * Define how we measure impact, moving beyond "are people using it?" to "are they using it effectively?", and report outcomes clearly to executive audiences. * Partner with engineering leaders, Security, Legal, and Finance to manage AI cost, security, and compliance as usage grows. * Evaluate vendors and emerging tools, deciding what to buy, what to build, and what to retire. * Mentor and influence senior engineers across all pillars, and represent AI productivity across the company through forums such as lunch\-and\-learns and brown bags. **About You** ------------- ### **Minimum Qualifications** * 10\+ years of professional software engineering experience building and operating production systems at scale. * Production experience with large language models at the frontier: you have shipped LLM\-powered capabilities in real products and understand what good inference engineering looks like. Using AI tools alone is not enough. * A track record of scaling AI beyond yourself to an entire organization, with measurable outcomes and a candid account of the organizational challenges you faced. * Experience navigating the business side of AI, including cost management, security and compliance, and vendor evaluation and procurement. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Track record of building and driving adoption of AI tools or platforms across an engineering organization of 500\+ engineers, not just a single team. * Experience measuring and communicating the impact of AI on developer productivity and throughput (for example, DORA/SPACE metrics, agent task volume, cycle time) to executive audiences. * Experience managing AI spend at scale, including cost modeling, budgeting, and optimization across models and vendors. * Hands\-on experience with agentic systems, including orchestrating background and parallel agents with strong safeguards. * Deep knowledge of AI safety, security, privacy, and compliance practices (for example, guardrails, PII handling, and data governance), and experience partnering with Security and Legal on them. * Experience fine\-tuning or adapting foundation models, and building retrieval and evaluation systems around them. * Demonstrated technical leadership and mentorship across multiple organizations, including influencing senior staff engineers, VPs, and C\-level leaders. \#LI\-Remote Instacart provides highly market\-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy here. Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please read more about our benefits offerings here. For US based candidates, the base pay ranges for a successful candidate are listed below. CA, NY, CT, NJ $304,000 \- $321,000 USD WA $292,000 \- $308,000 USD OR, DE, ME, MA, MD, NH, RI, VT, DC, PA, VA, CO, TX, IL, HI $279,000 \- $294,500 USD All other states $254,000 \- $268,000 USD

jobs.title: Module Development Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Details:** ================ **Job Description:** -------------------- Job Description: Join Intel and build a better tomorrow. Intel is undergoing an exciting transformation, with a vision to create and extend computing technology to connect and enrich the lives of every person on Earth. Join us and help create the next generation of technologies that will shape the future for decades to come. The Intel Foundry Technology Development (TD) team is seeking an experienced Senior Lithography Module Development Engineer to drive the development, optimization, and manufacturing readiness of advanced lithography processes for next\-generation mask making technologies. TD Lithography Module Development Engineers are responsible for the development and execution of current and next\-generation lithography manufacturing processes. They enable the manufacture of innovative device architectures, demonstrate the manufacturing viability of complex novel processes, and support high\-volume manufacturing (HVM) operations. In this senior technical role, you will provide leadership in advanced patterning technologies, lithography process and equipment development, defect reduction, and yield improvement. jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed Product Manager (NYC)
jobs.description: Fin, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences. Our AI Agent Fin is the highest\-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always\-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end\-to\-end across every channel, with minimal set\-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system. Together with Salesforce, the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI. Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. **What's the opportunity?** --------------------------- In AI, proximity to customer reality is the moat. Even the best model doesn't run itself: it takes someone who gets close enough to a customer's business to make it work, and that closeness doesn't happen on its own. That's where the **Forward Deployed Product Manager** comes in. You'll work directly with our biggest customers at the moments that matter most in their journey with Fin, whether that's proving out value in an evaluation, getting a deployment live, or expanding what's possible once it's working, and get them to real, measurable success with Fin faster than they'd get there on their own. What you learn with them feeds back into the product, so every customer after them gets there faster and better too. This is a very novel role in the industry, still being shaped, and you'll help sharpen what great looks like at Fin: evolving the playbooks, and shaping how we win and deliver on our biggest, highest\-stakes deals. This is a high\-ownership, high\-visibility role for a PM who wants real time with customers and hands\-on time with the product, and who's comfortable making progress before every answer is known. **What will I be doing?** ------------------------- * **Own outcomes for a portfolio of strategic customers deploying Fin.** Understand their business, their support operation, and their technical environment well enough that the deployment plan you propose earns trust immediately. * **Run the full arc yourself.** Pitch and demo Fin, scope the solution, hands\-on configure it (including custom development if required), and unblock whatever gets in the way, whether that's a product gap, a technical integration, or a cross\-functional snag. * **Be the AI expert in the room.** Customers should leave every conversation with you knowing more about how to get outstanding results from Fin. * **Partner tightly with Sales, Success, and R\&D** so each deployment feels like one team to the customer, not a relay race. * **Turn what you learn in the field into product.** Bring specific, evidence\-backed input, not just feature requests, to shape the roadmap. * **Build the playbook as you go:** the deployment patterns, templates, and best practices that make the next ten deployments faster than the first. * **Help define what Forward Deployed PM means at Fin**. It's a very novel role across the industry, still being shaped, and you'll help sharpen what it looks like here. Success in this role looks like your customers thriving with Fin, and the product getting sharper because of what you learned from them. It's product management at its core, not solutions engineering, customer success, or professional services. **What skills do I need?** -------------------------- * **Experience:** No minimum years required. We care about impact, drive, and potential, evidenced through the skills below, not tenure. * **Customer obsession:** Deep empathy paired with a bias for action. You're motivated by solving the real problem and delivering measurable results. * **Communication \& storytelling:** You can pitch Fin to a room of executives, then get into the technical weeds with their engineers, adjusting depth and tone without losing either audience. * **Technical fluency:** You're able to talk to engineers and customers about modern tech stack, from APIs and SaaS infrastructure to LLMs and low\-code tooling. You're comfortable onboarding a customer into more technical product setups. * **Evidence\-based thinking:** You use data, not anecdotes, to make the case for a deployment plan or a roadmap bet, and you're comfortable pulling and interpreting data (conversation logs, usage, CX metrics) to find the story. * **Cross\-functional influence:** You navigate organizational boundaries easily, and bring people together to  solutions engineering, or customer success The base salary range for candidates within the San Francisco Bay Area is $199,800\- $222,000\. Actual base pay will depend on a variety of factors such as education, skills, experience, location, etc. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All regular employees may also be eligible for the corporate bonus program or a sales incentive (target included in OTE) as well as stock in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs). \#LI\-Hybrid **Unleash Your Potential** When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. At Fin, we want to give people what they need to do the best work of their careers. Our benefits and programs are designed to support your health and wellbeing, your family, your time away from work, and your financial future. Offerings vary by location in line with local practices and requirements. Learn more about working at Fin and the benefits we offer at fin.ai/careers. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. **Policies** Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week. We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. As an organization, our policy is to not advocate on behalf of the company or our employees on any social or political topics out of our internal or external communications. We respect personal opinion and expression on these topics on personal social platforms on personal time, and do not challenge or confront anyone for their views on non\-work related topics. Our goal is to focus on doing incredible work to achieve our goals and unite the company through our core values. Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non\-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

jobs.description: **Who We Are** Johns Manville is a leading manufacturer and marketer of premium\-quality insulation and commercial roofing, along with glass fibers and nonwovens for commercial, industrial and residential applications. Our products are used in a wide variety of industries including building products, aerospace, automotive and transportation, filtration, commercial interiors, waterproofing and wind energy. A proud member of the Berkshire Hathaway family of companies, we serve customers in more than 80 countries around the globe. We are committed to delivering positive and powerful experiences, because we are successful only when our employees and customers thrive. We are passionate, we care about people, we perform at a superior level, and we protect others and our environments. **Pay Range** $98,800\.00\-$135,900\.00 Annual This is the base salary pay range that an applicant can expect to make upon hire. Pay within this range will vary based upon relevant experience, skills, and education among other factors. In addition, this position is eligible for an incentive bonus. The Electrical \& Controls Engineer II supports manufacturing operations by leading electrical, controls, automation, power distribution, and capital improvement projects in Willows, CA. This role manages projects from concept through startup, driving safety, reliability, productivity, and operational performance improvements. Responsibilities include executing capital projects ($300K\-$2M), supporting plant operations, and ensuring compliance with corporate and industry standards. **Key Responsibilities** * Lead electrical, controls, automation, and power distribution projects from design through commissioning. * Manage multiple capital projects ($300K\-$2M), including scope development, budgeting, scheduling, and execution. * Design, program, and support PLC, HMI, SCADA, VFD, instrumentation, motor control, and industrial network systems. * Support low\- and medium\-voltage power distribution systems, including MCCs, switchgear, transformers, and 4160V equipment. * Troubleshoot equipment and process issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement reliability improvements. * Drive electrical safety initiatives, including Arc Flash, NFPA 70E, LOTO, and protective device coordination programs. * Manage contractors, integrators, OEMs, and engineering firms throughout project execution. * Lead FAT/SAT testing, startup, commissioning, and operator training activities. * Develop and maintain electrical drawings, one\-lines, control documentation, and operating procedures. * Support energy reduction, infrastructure modernization, process optimization, and continuous improvement initiatives. * Partner with Operations, Maintenance, Reliability, Safety, and Corporate Engineering teams to support manufacturing excellence. **Requirements** **Education** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Engineering Technology, or a related field. **Experience** * 3\+ years of electrical, controls, or automation engineering experience in a manufacturing environment. * Experience executing capital projects ranging from $300K\-$2M. * Strong understanding of industrial power distribution, automation, and manufacturing processes. **Technical Skills** * Allen\-Bradley PLCs and FactoryTalk applications * SCADA, HMI, instrumentation, and process controls * Industrial Ethernet and control networks * VFDs, motor controls, MCCs, and switchgear * Electrical system troubleshooting and power distribution * Arc Flash, NFPA 70E, and electrical safety programs * Root cause analysis and reliability improvement * Capital project management and execution **Additional Qualifications** * Strong project leadership, communication, and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced manufacturing environment. * Willingness to travel up to 10% throughout North America. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with manufacturing infrastructure and utility systems. * Experience with medium\-voltage systems (4160V\+). * Arc Flash, coordination, and power quality study experience. * Knowledge of compressed air, boilers, cooling towers, environmental systems, and process equipment. * PMP certification or demonstrated project leadership experience. **Please Keep in Mind** If you do not meet 100% of these requirements, we at JM still want to hear from you. So, if you are interested in the role, we encourage you to apply so we can learn how your skills and talents can contribute to our team. **Benefits** Johns Manville (JM) offers a wide range of benefits to employees. Some are subsidized by the company and others are fully employee\-paid. Health benefits include a choice of comprehensive medical plans, a dental plan, vision plan, wellness program and critical illness insurance. JM sponsors a 401(k) plan which includes a sizeable company match. JM offers paid vacation and also provides paid sick and parental leave for eligible employees. Additionally, Johns Manville provides basic life Insurance, short\-term and long\-term disability coverage, an employee assistance program, and business travel accident coverage. Supplemental life insurance and accidental death and dismemberment insurance are available as well. The company also offers a variety of tax saving accounts; health spending account, traditional flexible spending account, and a dependent care spending account. JM also offers a tuition reimbursement program for undergraduate and certain graduate programs. Johns Manville supports employee growth with vast educational opportunities and a company\-wide mentoring program. This program pairs employees and leaders to grow skills, build stronger internal networks and strengthen the company’s succession planning process. Johns Manville also offers soft and hard skills training facilitated by internal and external presenters. Our talent management team prioritizes the holistic growth of our workforce. **Diversity \& Inclusion** Johns Manville believes diversity and inclusion in our workplace is critical for the long\-term success of our company. We are committed to retaining, developing and attracting a diverse workforce that fosters an inclusive work environment in which all employees are treated with dignity and respect. This is the right thing to do for our employees, our company and our communities. Incumbent must be physically able to perform essential job functions. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential job functions. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. We maintain a drug\-free workplace and perform pre\-employment substance abuse testing.
