jobs.title: Founding Enterprise Sales Engineer
jobs.description: **About Kastle** ---------------- Kastle is building the AI employee for banks. We help financial institutions scale their contact center and compliance operations with autonomous AI agents that process payments, originate loans, and guide customers through some of the biggest financial decisions of their lives. We’ve processed **over $2 billion in transactions**, raised a **$24M Series A**, and are backed by **Insight Partners and Y Combinator**. We’re building AI for environments where precision, reliability, and performance matter. Our mission is to redefine how the critical industries powering America operate. **About the Role** ------------------ As Kastle’s Founding Enterprise Sales Engineer, you’ll own how we demonstrate, architect, and prove the value of our platform to financial institutions. You’ll work directly with the founders and Account Executives to win our most strategic customers. From the first discovery call through technical evaluation and close, you’ll understand how a prospect operates, identify where AI can make the biggest difference, and build demonstrations that make that opportunity tangible. Our customers need to understand how an agent will connect to their systems, follow their policies, handle exceptions, and serve their borrowers. You’ll turn those questions into a clear solution and a credible path to production. As our founding hire in this function, you’ll also build the foundation for sales engineering at Kastle: our demo environments, technical discovery process, and standards for bringing engineering into a deal. What you learn in customer conversations will directly influence what we build next. This role is for someone who loves building, understands how to win enterprise deals, and wants to help create a function from the ground up. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * **Own the technical sale.** Partner with founders and Account Executives from discovery through close, identifying technical requirements, addressing objections, and helping prospects make confident buying decisions. * **Go deep into customer workflows.** Understand borrower journeys, operational bottlenecks, existing systems, and compliance requirements. Identify the strongest initial use cases and define measurable success criteria. * **Build demos that win deals.** Configure AI agents and create tailored demonstrations around a prospect’s workflows, policies, and customer experience. * **Lead technical evaluations.** Scope and run proofs of concept, coordinate resources, troubleshoot issues, and demonstrate results against agreed success criteria. * **Architect the solution.** Map integrations with loan servicing systems, APIs, data sources, and telephony platforms. Identify dependencies and constraints early. * **Build trust across the buying team.** Work directly with executives and engineering, security, compliance, and operations teams to address their questions and requirements. * **Set deployments up for success.** Partner with Forward Deployed Engineers and Product Managers to transfer customer context, agreed scope, architecture, and commitments into implementation. * **Build the sales engineering foundation.** Create reusable demo environments, integration prototypes, technical collateral, and evaluation playbooks. Help define how the function grows. * **Shape the product.** Bring customer needs and competitive insights directly to the engineering team, helping distinguish immediate deal requirements from broader product opportunities. **What We’re Looking For** -------------------------- * **4\+ years of relevant experience** in sales engineering, solutions engineering, or a technical role working directly with enterprise customers. * Experience owning technical discovery, custom demonstrations, and evaluations within complex enterprise sales cycles. * Strong technical fundamentals. You can work with APIs, understand authentication and data flows, and write Python, JavaScript, or similar code to build prototypes and integrations. * Clear communication across audiences, from engineers reviewing an architecture to executives evaluating a business case. * Commercial judgment. You know which technical questions matter to a buying decision and how to focus your effort on resolving them. * High agency and attention to detail. You can take an ambiguous customer problem, structure an approach, and drive it forward with limited guidance. * A builder’s mindset. You’re excited to create the tools, processes, and standards that future hires will use. * Curiosity about how businesses operate and a willingness to learn banking and lending workflows in depth. **Especially Relevant Experience** ---------------------------------- * Building or selling conversational AI, voice agents, contact center software, or workflow automation. * Navigating enterprise security reviews and integration requirements. * Joining an early sales engineering team or building a customer\-facing technical function. **Why Join Kastle** ------------------- * **Build a foundational function.** Define how Kastle demonstrates its product, runs technical evaluations, and wins enterprise customers. * **Work directly with the founders.** Have a short path from customer insight to product and company decisions. * **Own consequential work.** Help financial institutions adopt AI in workflows that affect millions of customers. * **Grow with the company.** Help shape the team, hiring standards, and operating approach as sales engineering scales. * **Great team:** work side by side with a world\-class team product and GTM teams that will reshape the trajectory of your career * Competitive compensation and meaningful equity.

jobs.title: Security Engineer
jobs.description: **What is Kalshi?** ------------------- Kalshi has defined a new category: prediction markets. Kalshi allows people to trade on the outcome of any events and turn any question about the future into a financial asset. Kalshi fought for years and legalized prediction markets in the US for the first time in history, is currently the fastest growing financial market in America, and has thousands of markets across politics, economics, financials, weather, tech, AI, culture and more. We believe prediction markets have the potential to be the largest financial market because they turn anything into a financial position. * Our vision: well… build the largest financial market on the planet. * Our mission: bring more truth to the world through the power of markets. Our culture is simple: we hire really talented people, work really hard, and enjoy the climb. We are looking for ambitious and exceptional people to join our (relatively small) team to help us build the next generation of financial markets. **About the Role** You will work closely with engineering and product teams to embed security into the development lifecycle, proactively identify vulnerabilities, and build scalable security solutions that allow Kalshi to move quickly without compromising the integrity of our platform. **What You’ll Do** * Develop reusable security components and frameworks that strengthen the security of our products and infrastructure. * Design and implement platform\-wide security controls that proactively mitigate common vulnerabilities and emerging threats. * Identify, prioritize, and remediate security vulnerabilities across our technology stack. * Collaborate with engineering teams to investigate and address findings from internal security assessments, penetration testing, and external vulnerability reports. * Partner with product and engineering teams throughout the development lifecycle to ensure new products and features are secure by design. * Build and integrate automated security tooling that enables engineers to identify vulnerabilities earlier and ship secure software with confidence. **What You Need** * 4\+ years of software engineering experience. * 2\+ years of experience in application security, product security, platform engineering, and/or infrastructure security. * Strong understanding of application security principles, common vulnerabilities, and mitigation techniques. * Ability to translate complex security and business requirements into practical, scalable engineering solutions. * Desire to work in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment alongside exceptional engineers. **Nice to Haves** * Experience building and securing cloud\-native applications and distributed systems. * Experience with AWS and implementing security controls across cloud infrastructure. * Experience with automated security tooling, static analysis, vulnerability detection, and threat modeling. * Experience securing financial platforms, exchanges, trading systems, or other high\-throughput, security\-critical applications. * Experience working in a highly regulated environment. **NYC Pay Transparency Disclosure** **Salary Range:** $200,000–$300,000 annually, plus equity and benefits. This range reflects current market data for this role. Kalshi has minimal hierarchy and broad variance in experience levels within each title; if your compensation expectations exceed this range, we encourage you to reach out — we’re always happy to discuss. **Our Culture** --------------- Meritocracy is at our core, and we value people who take ownership and figure (usually hard) things out. We dream big. We love our craft deeply and are proud of what we put out in the world. We are committed to our vision of building something big… but also useful: a product that brings more truth through the power of markets. Kalshians are Kalshi’s most important asset: we pick Kalshians carefully, so we trust them fully on day 1\. **Commitment to Equal Opportunity** ----------------------------------- Kalshi is committed to creating a culture of inclusion and belonging, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe it is our collective responsibility to uphold these values and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to join us in our mission. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law. If you are passionate about what you do and want to use your talents to support our mission and values, we’d love to hear from you.

lead or senior/staff developer, with a focus on backend service development. * Strong proficiency in AWS cloud services development and infrastructure management. * Experience with relational databases (MSSQL and MySQL) and NoSQL DB. * Proven experience in designing and architecting scalable, high\-performance systems. * Experience in the financial industry is highly preferred. * Experience with PHP is highly preferred. * In\-depth understanding of agile methodologies and experience leading agile teams. * Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams. * Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail. * Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment and adapt to changing priorities. jobs.title: Embedded Software Designer (Networking)
jobs.description: **At** **Kepler Communications****, we're not just imagining the future of on\-demand space connectivity \-** ***we're leading it!*** Our mission is to provide real\-time on\-orbit connectivity for critical missions, enabling a new era of data\-driven intelligence and innovation. With **33 satellites launched to date,** Kepler operates the first commercial optical data relay constellation, enabling real\-time, continuous space communications while supporting advanced on\-orbit compute and hosted payload capabilities. Industry\-leading technology is only part of the story. **What sets Kepler apart is our team:** bold thinkers, skilled builders, and passionate problem\-solvers who thrive on pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in space. We believe great ideas come from diverse perspectives, and we’re committed to creating an environment where you can grow, lead, and make a global impact. If you’re ready to reach higher, move faster, and do work that shapes the future space economy \- this is your launchpad. **Come build the future with Kepler!** **What We Offer:** * **Competitive compensation** with a robust equity plan to share in our success. * **Comprehensive coverage for health, dental, and vision insurance**—including dependents. * **Unlimited vacation, supportive parental leave policy,** and company\-wide holiday shutdown. * **Semi\-annual company\-wide parties** and frequent in\-office team events. * **Relocation packages** available for approved roles. * **$1,500 annual professional development fund** to support your growth. * **Fully stocked Toronto office kitchen** with snacks, drinks, games and top\-notch kitchen appliances. * **Town Halls, Celebration Calls, and Company\-wide events** to stay connected and engaged. * **We’re a certified** **Great Place to Work**®, seven years in a row! We're on the hunt for a top\-tier **Embedded Software Designer**, who enjoys getting close to the hardware and wants to build the networking software that runs on it. You’ll work with network architects, FPGA developers, and fellow embedded software developers to build and debug networking features on embedded Linux, from customizing Yocto layers and working with memory\-mapped peripherals to profiling memory usage on target hardware. You’ll bring hands\-on embedded Linux experience and an active interest in networking. Maybe you’ve implemented or debugged a routing protocol, contributed to a networking stack, or built a home lab to experiment with routing and trace where packets get dropped. Experience with routing software or programmable packet processing is a plus, and we welcome experience across networking stacks. ### **Key Responsibilities:** * Design, develop, and maintain embedded Linux software that supports networking and application layers across spacecraft and ground systems * Develop, integrate, and debug networking protocols and features, including routing, packet forwarding, and secure communications * Build and maintain the low\-level software that connects the networking stack to the hardware, including device drivers, kernel modules, and interfaces to FPGA logic and memory\-mapped peripherals. Customize Yocto layers to integrate and deliver these components * Work with network architects, FPGA developers, and fellow embedded software developers to define requirements, review designs, and troubleshoot issues across software and hardware * Profile CPU and memory usage on target hardware, measure networking performance, and address bottlenecks and reliability risks across the stack * Develop automated tests and validation tools for both networking behaviour and hardware integration. Document designs and interfaces so others can maintain and extend them * Contribute to software architecture, design reviews, and code reviews. Mentor other engineers and help improve development and debugging practices * Use tools such as Containerlab to create repeatable network topologies for testing routing, packet forwarding, and failure recovery. Validate hardware\-dependent behaviour on target systems ### **Required Skills \& Qualifications:** * 4\+ years of experience developing embedded software for complex, high\-reliability systems * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience * Proficiency in C or C\+\+ for embedded systems, with a solid understanding of concurrency, interrupt handling, and working with memory\-mapped peripherals * Hands\-on embedded Linux development experience, including work with components such as device drivers, kernel modules, or device trees. Familiarity with using Yocto/OpenEmbedded recipes and layers to customize Linux images * Strong debugging and performance analysis skills, including the ability to diagnose hardware/software integration issues and profile CPU and memory usage on target hardware * A practical understanding of IP networking fundamentals, including addressing, routing, and packet forwarding, and an interest in developing and debugging networking software. Experience from a home lab, personal project, or open\-source contribution counts alongside professional experience * Experience with automated testing, validation tooling, or hardware/software integration testing, and familiarity with CI pipelines, Git, and code review * Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across networking, FPGA, and embedded software teams * Willingness to use AI\-assisted engineering tools with sound judgment and verify their output ### **Bonus Points:** * Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field * Experience developing software for aerospace applications * Experience implementing or extending networking protocols, developing routing or forwarding software, or programming packet\-processing pipelines * Familiarity with Containerlab or similar tools for building repeatable network test topologies, especially for automated validation in CI * Hands\-on debugging of packet flow across Linux and FPGA or other hardware datapaths * Experience validating network behaviour during link failures, route changes, or traffic bursts * Experience implementing embedded security features such as secure boot, hardware security modules (HSMs), certificate and key management, authentication, or encrypted communications **Employment Equity \& Accommodation Statement** Kepler Communications is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals, including women, Indigenous peoples, persons with disabilities, members of visible minorities, and people of all sexual orientations and gender identities. If you require accommodation during any stage of the recruitment process, please contact our People \& Culture team at accommodation@kepler.space, and we will work with you to meet your needs. At Kepler Communications, all hiring decisions are made by people. Human recruiters are involved in every step of our recruitment process. We use AI\-based tools (such as Lever AI and HireEZ) to assist with the initial review of applications by ranking candidates based on job\-relevant criteria. These tools support \- but do not replace \- human judgment.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer - RL & Optimization
jobs.description: Overview: Keysight is a mission\-critical design enablement partner for organizations solving the world’s most complex engineering challenges. With deep engineering expertise and leading design, emulation, and test solutions, our \~16,800 employees help customers in over 100 countries accelerate innovation across communications, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace and defense, semiconductor, and artificial intelligence markets. Learn more about what we do. At Keysight, people come together to explore new ideas, challenge what's possible, and advance the technologies defining the future. Here, you'll find opportunities to do your best work, take your career further, and thrive in an award\-winning culture. Learn more about our benefits. Software \& AI Labs is seeking a Reinforcement Learning Engineer to join the Models \& Data Science program. The program develops the core AI/ML models behind Keysight’s design, simulation, calibration, and measurement solutions. The Reinforcement Learning Engineer will develop RL agents and optimization methods for automated measurement sequencing, closed\-loop RF tuning, and adaptive calibration. This early\-career role is suited to a recent graduate with a strong foundation in reinforcement learning and software engineering who wants to apply RL to real RF and measurement problems. The successful candidate will work alongside senior ML engineers and RF measurement experts, learn Keysight’s calibration and characterization workflows, and grow into ownership of RL components that ship in Keysight products. Responsibilities: * Master’s or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Robotics, or a related field. * 0\-2 years of industry experience. Graduate research, internships, and thesis work in reinforcement learning count toward the requirement. * Solid understanding of reinforcement learning fundamentals, including policy gradient, actor\-critic, and value\-based methods. * Hands\-on experience implementing or training RL algorithms such as PPO, SAC, or DDPG. * Proficiency in Python and PyTorch. * Experience with RL tooling such as Gymnasium, Stable\-Baselines3, RLlib, or equivalent. * Strong foundation in linear algebra, probability, and optimization. * Good software engineering habits, including version control, testing, and readable code. * Clear written and verbal communication and the ability to work well in a team. Qualifications: * Coursework or experience in RF, microwave engineering, electromagnetics, or signal processing. * Familiarity with S\-parameters, VNA measurements, calibration methods (SOLT, TRL), or de\-embedding. * Experience with Bayesian optimization or Gaussian process methods. * Experience applying RL to control, robotics, hardware\-in\-the\-loop, or design optimization problems. * Working knowledge of C\+\+ or CUDA. * Experience with instrument control (SCPI, IVI, VISA) or scikit\-rf. * Experience with generative models (VAEs, GANs, Diffusion) for data augmentation. * Publications, open\-source contributions, or competition results in reinforcement learning. California pay range: MIN $113,000\- MAX $188,330 **Note:** For other locations, pay ranges will vary by region This role is eligible for Keysight Results Bonus Program and US Employees may be eligible for the following benefits:* Medical, dental and vision * Health Savings Account * Health Care and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts * Life, Accident, Disability insurance * Business Travel Accident and Business Travel Health * 401(k) Plan * Flexible Time Off, Paid Holidays * Paid Family Leave * Discounts, Perks * Tuition Reimbursement * Adoption Assistance * ESPP (Employee Stock Purchase Plan)

If you're ready to join a team where your voice matters, your growth is supported, and your impact is celebrated, KE is the place for you. **Job Purpose** This role supports the Product \& Engineering division by building and operating the shared engineering platform that KE’s product, BI, and AI teams rely on. jobs.title: Associate Director, Data Science
jobs.description: **Who We Are** At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize the mission\-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. So why work at Kyndryl? We are always moving forward – always pushing ourselves to go further in our efforts to build a more equitable, inclusive world for our employees, our customers and our communities. **The Role** As a Data Scientist at Kyndryl, you will play a critical role in transforming complex business challenges into measurable, high\-value outcomes through advanced analytics and machine learning solutions. Partnering closely with business stakeholders, data engineers, and AI engineers, you will identify high\-impact opportunities across areas such as forecasting, propensity modeling, optimization, and customer analytics—driving innovation that shapes the future of enterprise operations. In this role, you will own the end\-to\-end data science lifecycle, taking solutions from initial problem definition and hypothesis development through exploratory data analysis, feature engineering, experimentation, and rigorous model validation. Utilizing tools such as Python, SQL, scikit\-learn, TensorFlow, and PyTorch, you will build predictive and prescriptive models while working alongside Data Engineering to establish reliable, governed datasets and reusable features. You will also partner with AI Engineering to productionize your solutions through scalable pipelines, APIs, and enterprise applications. Beyond model development, you will champion responsible AI practices—ensuring explainability, bias assessment, privacy, security, and strong model governance—while continuously monitoring deployed models for drift and performance to recommend timely optimizations. You will serve as a trusted analytical advisor, translating complex statistical findings, model assumptions, and expected business value into clear, actionable insights for both technical teams and executive stakeholders. If you are passionate about leveraging data and machine learning to drive operational efficiency, revenue growth, and superior customer outcomes, this role is for you. **Your Future at Kyndryl** Kyndryl’s focus on providing innovative IT and AI solutions to its customers means that as a Data Scientist, you will work with cutting\-edge cloud and enterprise technologies while continuously learning and growing your technical skills. You will have the opportunity to contribute to large\-scale, transformative projects and collaborate with a global network of data, AI, and technology professionals. Kyndryl currently does not require employees to be fully vaccinated against COVID\-19, however, if you are hired to work at a client, customer, or partner location, you may be required to show proof of vaccination to align with their respective COVID\-19 vaccination policies. Those who believe they are eligible may apply for a medical or religious accommodation prior to the start of employment. **Who You Are** You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. Equally as important, you bring a growth mindset—keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer\-focused, prioritizing measurable customer and business success in your work. Finally, you are open and borderless—naturally inclusive and collaborative in how you work across multidisciplinary teams. Required Skills and Experience * 7\+ years of experience developing statistical, predictive, and prescriptive machine learning models to solve complex business problems. * Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL, alongside practical experience with core data science and machine learning libraries (such as Pandas, NumPy, scikit\-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch). * Deep understanding of statistics, probability, experimental design, feature engineering, model selection, and rigorous model evaluation. * Demonstrated experience working with, cleaning, and extracting insights from large, complex, and imperfect enterprise datasets. * Practical familiarity with cloud data and AI platforms, such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, Databricks, or Microsoft Fabric. * Solid understanding of MLOps principles, including model versioning, testing, deployment, drift monitoring, and end\-to\-end lifecycle management. * Proven ability to translate ambiguous business challenges into structured analytical approaches and measurable success criteria. * Strong communication and data storytelling skills, with the ability to clearly articulate analytical findings, model limitations, and business value to both technical and executive stakeholders. * Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across business, data engineering, analytics, and AI engineering teams. * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline. Preferred Skills and Experience * Hands\-on experience deploying and scaling machine learning solutions within an enterprise production environment. * Direct experience working with Microsoft Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI Foundry, or comparable enterprise AI platforms. * Exposure to Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), and AI agents—particularly where predictive models complement agentic solutions. Relevant professional certifications in Data Science, Machine Learning, Microsoft Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, or NVIDIA. * The base compensation range for the position in the U.S. is \- $143,640 to $273,000 based on a full\-time schedule reflects the minimum and maximum target compensation Kyndryl, in good faith, believes it may pay for the role at the time of this posting. Your actual compensation may vary depending on multiple factors legally permitted in the applicable jurisdiction, including, but not limited to, geography, relevant job\-related skills, education and experience, certification and licenses, internal pay equity, and market and business consideration. The pay or salary range will not be below any applicable state, city or local minimum wage requirement. There is a different applicable compensation range for the following work locations: California (San Francisco Bay Area): $172,440 to $327,600 California (All Other): $158,040 to $300,360 Colorado: $143,640 to $273,000 Massachusetts/ Virginia: $143,640 to $300,360 New York City: $172,440 to $327,600 Washington: $158,040 to $300,360 Washington DC: $158,040 to $300,360 This position will be eligible for Kyndryl’s discretionary annual bonus program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Kyndryl’s applicable plans. You may also receive a comprehensive benefits package which includes medical and dental coverage, disability, retirement benefits, paid leave, and paid time off. Note: If this is a sales commission eligible role, you will be eligible to participate in a sales commission plan in lieu of the annual discretionary bonus program. Applications will be accepted on a rolling basis. **Being You** Diversity is a whole lot more than what we look like or where we come from, it’s how we think and who we are. We welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. But we’re not doing it single\-handily: Our Kyndryl Inclusion Networks are only one of many ways we create a workplace where all Kyndryls can find and provide support and advice. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you – and everyone next to you – the ability to bring your whole self to work, individually and collectively, and support the activation of our equitable culture. That’s the Kyndryl Way. **What You Can Expect** With state\-of\-the\-art resources and Fortune 100 clients, every day is an opportunity to innovate, build new capabilities, new relationships, new processes, and new value. Kyndryl cares about your well\-being and prides itself on offering benefits that give you choice, reflect the diversity of our employees and support you and your family through the moments that matter – wherever you are in your life journey. Our employee learning programs give you access to the best learning in the industry to receive certifications, including Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Skillsoft, and many more. Through our company\-wide volunteering and giving platform, you can donate, start fundraisers, volunteer, and search over 2 million non\-profit organizations. At Kyndryl, we invest heavily in you, we want you to succeed so that together, we will all succeed. **Get Referred!** If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

jobs.title: AVP, Data Security Engineer
jobs.description: **Where Ambition Meets Innovation** Build a career that matches all your initiative with an impressive dose of innovation. The AVP Data Tokenization Engineer will design, implement, integrate, and maintain enterprise tokenization and data protection solutions across applications, databases, and data platforms. The Engineer will partner closely with application development, database, infrastructure, architecture, cybersecurity, and business teams to identify sensitive data, determine appropriate protection methods, and integrate tokenization capabilities into enterprise applications and workflows. The role will also focus on the automation, scalability, performance, monitoring, and lifecycle management of tokenization services while reducing sensitive data exposure across the enterprise. The AVP Data Tokenization Engineer will help shape the future direction of data protection and tokenization at LPL, including the expansion and modernization of capabilities used to protect sensitive data across the organization. **Responsibilities:** * Design, engineer, implement, and maintain enterprise data tokenization and de\-tokenization solutions across applications, databases, data jobs.title: Sr DevOps Engineer – AI-First Development
jobs.description: **Position Overview** The primary responsibility of the Senior DevOps Engineer (AI\-First Development) is to create, maintain, and continuously improve the development pipelines and application cloud environments that support every change shipped through the AI\-First Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) for Central Development. This role owns end\-to\-end delivery for Central Development applications, from source control and continuous integration through build, test, release, and deployment, as well as the configuration and ongoing operation of the application cloud environments those pipelines deploy into, built on the shared delivery path and cloud foundations maintained with Central DevSecOps. The role operates within an AI\-First SDLC in which AI agents serve as primary producers of pipeline code, infrastructure\-as\-code, environment configuration, and deployment artifacts, while the engineer provides platform direction, context engineering, human\-in\-the\-loop governance, and final accountability for the reliability of Central Development’s delivery pipelines and environments. The Senior DevOps Engineer is an experienced DevOps, infrastructure, or platform engineer who has adopted modern AI\-assisted development tools as a core part of their daily workflow and is prepared to grow into deeper agent orchestration, context engineering, and verification responsibilities. Prior experience with every specific AI\-First practice listed below is not required; demonstrated pipeline and cloud engineering judgment, strong code review skills, and a track record of effective AI tool usage are. All duties are to be performed in accordance with departmental and Las Vegas Sands Corp.’s policies, practices, and procedures. All Las Vegas Sands Corp. Team Members are expected to conduct and carry themselves in a professional manner at all times. Team Members are required to observe the company’s standards, work requirements and rules of conduct. **Essential Duties \& Responsibilities** * **Pipeline Ownership, Agent Workflow Design, and Orchestration** + Create, own, and maintain Central Development’s pipelines, including source control workflows and build, automated test, artifact packaging, release, and deployment pipelines across its applications and environments, using the shared CI/CD templates. + Design, build, and maintain AI agent workflows that produce CI/CD pipeline code, infrastructure\-as\-code, environment configuration, and deployment artifacts from specifications and platform requirements. + Decompose platform and delivery requirements into discrete, verifiable pipeline tasks and infrastructure changes that AI agents can execute effectively within defined boundaries. + Select and configure appropriate AI models, agent frameworks, and infrastructure tooling for each workflow based on blast radius, operational risk, and cost considerations. + Construct and maintain platform context that provides agents with approved pipeline and infrastructure patterns, environment standards, naming and tagging conventions, and operational rules needed to produce correct and consistent outputs. + Contribute to the platform toolchain, including reusable pipeline skills, automation hooks, and project memory files that provide persistent context across agent sessions. Authoring of advanced toolchain components may be developed on the job. + Systematically capture incident patterns, pipeline failures, and deployment issues from each delivery cycle and encode them back into shared context, platform skills, and agent configurations so that subsequent work becomes more reliable. + Participate in collaborative refinement sessions to align on platform requirements, environment constraints, and context packages before agent execution begins. * **Cloud Environment Setup and Operations** + Configure, and maintain Central Development’s application environments (development, test, staging, and production), including compute, storage, databases, and managed services, using infrastructure\-as\-code built on shared enterprise modules. + Work with Central DevSecOps on landing zones, resource organization, identity and access configuration, and environment baselines, and apply them consistently across Central Development’s environments. + Provision and manage Central Development’s use of the container platforms and hosting services that pipelines deploy into, such as Kubernetes clusters, container registries, and serverless or app services. + Manage environment configuration, pipeline credentials and secrets (using enterprise\-approved secrets management), and environment promotion workflows to keep environments consistent and free of configuration drift. + Implement monitoring, logging, alerting, and backup and recovery for cloud environments, and lead troubleshooting, incident response, and root\-cause analysis for pipeline and environment issues. + Monitor and optimize cloud resource utilization and cost through rightsizing, autoscaling ion or license, as required by law or policy. * 5\+ years of professional DevOps, infrastructure, or platform engineering experience, including time in senior or lead positions where the candidate owned the design, delivery, and maintenance of CI/CD pipelines and production cloud infrastructure. * Demonstrated daily use, over the past 6 months or more, of at least one modern AI\-assisted development tool such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Windsurf, with the ability to speak concretely about effective usage patterns and failure modes. * Strong foundational knowledge in at least one major programming or scripting ecosystem (such as Python, Go, TypeScript, Bash, or PowerShell) and hands\-on experience with at least one modern infrastructure\-as\-code framework (such as Terraform, Pulumi, Bicep, or comparable). Familiarity with additional platform layers is a plus. * Experience setting up, configuring, and operating production cloud environments on at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including networking, identity and access management, compute, and managed services. Azure experience is a plus. * Hands\-on experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or comparable), including build automation, automated test integration, artifact management, and deployment strategies such as blue\-green, canary, or rolling releases. * Demonstrated experience conducting thorough code reviews, identifying defects in both human\- and AI\-generated outputs, and providing constructive technical feedback. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical decisions and trade\-offs to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate effectively and interact appropriately with management, other Team Members and outside contacts of different backgrounds and levels of experience. **Preferred Qualifications** * Practical experience constructing structured context for LLMs, including prompt design, RAG pipelines, context window optimization, project memory files (such as CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md), and integration with MCP servers. Familiarity with tactical context management techniques such as plan mode, context editing, and multi\-session splitting. * Experience authoring reusable skills, configuring automation hooks, building custom MCP servers, or otherwise assembling agent toolchains that enable repeatable, production\-grade pipeline and platform workflows. * Hands\-on experience with container ecosystems (Docker, Kubernetes) and related tooling such as Helm, container registries, and GitOps tools (such as Argo CD or Flux). * Experience with monitoring and observability tooling (such as Azure Monitor, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or comparable) and with incident management and on\-call practices. * Experience working within a regulated industry such as gaming, finance, healthcare, or hospitality. Understanding of data privacy and responsible AI principles. * Experience delivering to on\-premises, hybrid, or isolated environments with differing regulatory requirements, so the same pipelines and modules can be deployed across business units and jurisdictions. * Relevant cloud certifications (such as Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert, Azure Administrator Associate, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, or comparable), and familiarity with configuration management tools (such as Ansible), secrets management platforms (such as HashiCorp Vault or cloud\-native equivalents), and cloud cost management practices. **Physical Requirements** Must be able to: * Physically access assigned workspace areas with or without reasonable accommodation. * Work remotely as necessary. * Work indoors and be exposed to various environmental factors such as, but not limited to, CRT, noise, and dust. * Utilize laptop and standard keyboard to perform essential functions of the job.

As a GTM AI Engineer, you will design, build, and operate the AI\-powered systems that make our sales, marketing, customer success, and partnerships teams more effective. You will sit at the intersection of engineering and revenue. You'll turn messy go\-to\-market workflows into reliable, measurable automation, such as agents that research accounts, tools that surface buying signals, and pipelines that keep our data trustworthy. You'll work directly with GTM stakeholders to find high\-leverage problems, ship quickly, and prove impact with data. #### **Responsibilities:** * Design and build LLM\-powered agents and workflows outputs, covering accuracy, hallucination rates, cost, latency, and adoption. * Use LaunchDarkly's own products, such as feature flags, AI Configs, and experimentation, to roll out, test, and iterate training, documentation, and playbooks so AI tools are adopted and trusted. * Stay current on the AI tooling landscape and recommend build vs. buy decisions. #### **Qualifications:** * 4\+ years of software engineering, data engineering, or ML/AI engineering experience (or equivalent hands\-on experience) * Strong proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript, plus SQL * Hands\-on experience building jobs.description: **Annual Salary Range: $100k \- $120k plus a quarterly bonus plan. This role is 100% on site at our San Diego, CA office.** LendSure Mortgage Corp. is a fast\-growing Wholesale Lender offering Non\-QM loan solutions. LendSure helps mortgage originators grow their business by offering loan solutions to borrowers who do not fall into conforming guidelines. At LendSure Mortgage Corp., we have created an environment where high\-energy professionals can learn, excel, grow and feel great about their contributions to our success. We are committed to attracting and retaining top talent throughout the United States. LendSure offers full salary, benefits, and opportunity to grow within the company. **Overview** LendSure is seeking a highly analytical, technically capable, and entrepreneurial Forward\-Deployed Product Manager focused on applying artificial intelligence to our workflows. This is a hands\-on role that combines product management, business process analysis, systems architecture, and AI\-assisted software development. The successful candidate will work across all areas of the company\-including business units and technical teams\-to understand existing workflows, identify opportunities for enhancements and automation, and design better ways of working. In addition to defining product requirements and coordinating with in\-house and external development teams, this individual will be expected to take substantial ownership of design and implementation tasks. Using modern AI tools and AI\-assisted engineering techniques, they will rapidly prototype new tools, applications, automations, and workflow enhancements; refine those products in dialogue with our development teams and end users; and ultimately integrate those solutions into production. This role should propose and drive adoption of modern AI tools across our workflows while nevertheless ensuring that new tools and processes integrate smoothly with LendSure's existing infrastructure and operations. This requires someone who can think holistically about systems, anticipate downstream impacts, and balance innovation against reliability, maintainability, security, and continuity. The role will involve frequent interaction with business stakeholders and senior executives. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable conducting a detailed workflow discovery session with an operations team, designing a technical solution, building a working prototype with AI assistance, troubleshooting an integration, and presenting a strategic recommendation to company leadership. **Key Responsibilities** * Conduct discovery across business departments to understand and document existing workflows, identify inefficiencies, and uncover opportunities for automation and improvement. * Design and document optimized future\-state workflows, including process changes, system requirements, and implementation plans, with particular emphasis on AI. * Evaluate and prioritize initiatives based on impact, complexity, cost, and expected returns. * Design new applications, internal tools, integrations, and workflow automations. * Build prototypes and production solutions using AI\-assisted development tools, taking projects from initial concept through implementation. * Ensure solutions integrate effectively with existing systems and can be maintained and built upon for future business processes and product channels. * Develop and execute testing strategies, including functional, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing (UAT). * Facilitate stakeholder workshops, demonstrations, and working sessions to gather feedback and drive decisions. * Present findings, recommendations, and project results to senior executives. * Coordinate production rollouts, including documentation, training, and change management. **Qualifications** * Experience in product management, business process engineering, systems analysis, software development, or a related discipline. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate complex processes and develop practical solutions. * Hands\-on experience with AI\-assisted development tools, including the ability to use them effectively for application development and technical troubleshooting. * Ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications, system architectures, data flows, and integration designs. * Understanding of APIs, databases, software architecture, and modern application development practices. * Familiarity with software testing, deployment, and ongoing application maintenance. * Excellent communication and organizational skills, including the ability to manage multiple initiatives and work effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. **Preferred Experience** * Experience in mortgage lending, financial services, or another complex business environment. * Familiarity with wholesale mortgage lending workflows, including Sales, Processing, Underwriting, and Closing. * Experience with the Encompass LOS or the Salesforce CRM. * Proficiency with AI coding agents and development platforms that support agentic coding and application development. * Experience building internal applications, dashboards, workflow automation tools, and operational utilities. * Familiarity with cloud platforms, modern application architectures, and low\-code/no\-code development tools. * Experience introducing new technology and processes into established organizations. **What We're Looking For** The ideal candidate is a **builder who thinks like a product manager and approaches problems like a business process engineer**. We are looking for someone who is naturally curious about how businesses operate and enjoys challenging conventional approaches. You should be resourceful, entrepreneurial, and comfortable taking initiative without waiting for detailed instructions or predefined solutions. You should also be pragmatic and business\-oriented, recognizing that the best solution is not necessarily the most technically sophisticated one. The ability to balance innovation with practical considerations, anticipate unintended consequences, and gain buy\-in from stakeholders is essential. Finally, you should enjoy working across organizational levels, from collaborating with frontline employees to presenting directly to senior leadership. Above all, we are looking for someone who takes ownership, moves quickly, embraces emerging technology, and is motivated by the opportunity to meaningfully improve how an entire company operates. Since our founding, LendSure has achieved significant success, growing the organization from a concept to one with sales teams nation\-wide and operational centers in California, Rhode Island, and Georgia. Our loan originations surpassed $100mm in our first 18 months. LendSure's success is due to our innovation and a company culture based on service excellence, where employees are provided with the resources and support to help them grow and achieve greatness. LendSure is highly committed to attracting, developing and retaining top talent throughout the United States. **This employer participates in E\-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I\-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.**

jobs.title: Senior Core Engineer (Platform Team)- US
jobs.description: **About Lyzr** -------------- Lyzr is the full\-stack agent infrastructure platform that lets enterprises build, govern, and deploy a secure, autonomous AI workforce. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: Macmillan is one of the Big 5 Publishers with mission\-critical systems running royalties, distribution, and the supply chain that books move through from manuscript to consumer. Those systems cannot be turned off. They also cannot stay as they are. The organization has committed to a multi\-year modernization of its core technology platforms, the build of a Publishing Operating System that enables imprints to operate more efficiently, and the productionization of AI capabilities across the publishing lifecycle. This is a rare opportunity to help redefine the technology foundation of a global publishing company in the AI era. **The Role** We're hiring a senior engineer who takes a vague problem and ships a reliable, secure, well\-built solution, with minimal hand\-holding. You will own meaningful pieces of our product from the first conversation with a product manager to production and beyond. You work the way strong engineers work in 2026: AI coding assistants are part of your daily toolkit, and they make you faster, not less careful. You know when to let an agent draft the boilerplate and when to slow down and think. You review generated code with the same rigor you'd apply to a teammate's pull request, and you stay accountable for everything you ship. We care less about which languages and frameworks you already know and more about how you think. You learn new stacks quickly, dig into unfamiliar systems until they make sense, and anticipate how today's design will behave at ten times the load, under attack, or at 3 a.m. **What You'll Do:** * **Own outcomes end to end.** Take features from ambiguous problem to production: scope, design, build, test, ship, operate, and iterate on what you learn. * **Partner with product.** Work directly with product managers and non\-technical stakeholders to clarify the real problem, push back on scope when needed, and trade off what to build against what to cut. * **Design for scale and failure.** Think through data flow, concurrency, latency, cost, and failure modes before they become incidents. Spot the bottleneck in the design review, not the postmortem. * **Ship high\-quality software.** Write clear, tested, maintainable code. Set up the CI/CD, observability, and automated checks that let the team ship quickly with confidence. * **Use AI as a force multiplier.** Apply AI coding assistants and agents across design, implementation, debugging, testing, and documentation, and share the workflows that work with the team. * **Operate what you build.** Monitor, debug, and improve production systems. Take part in on\-call, incident response, and blameless postmortems. * **Raise the bar.** Lead design reviews, write short design docs or ADRs, mentor teammates, and help us hire and onboard great engineers. **What We Are Looking For** We hire for judgment and range, not for a checklist of tools. You don't need to match every line below. * **5\+ years** building and shipping production software, with a track record of owning significant systems or features from design through operation. * **Strong fundamentals** in at least one mainstream language and stack, plus the ability to become productive in a new one within weeks. Show us how you've done it before. * **Self\-reliance.** You unblock yourself: read the source, trace the request, reproduce the bug, and form a hypothesis. When you do need help, you ask a sharp question with context. * **Systems\-level thinking.** You reason about architecture, data models, APIs, queues, caches, and failure domains, and you can explain where a design will break as load, data, or team size grows. * **Clear communication.** You explain technical trade\-offs to product managers in plain language, write concise design docs, and keep people informed asynchronously without being chased. * **Production experience.** You've debugged real incidents, used logs, metrics, and traces, and improved reliability after something went wrong. * **Fluency with AI coding assistants.** You use them daily, know their failure modes (plausible but wrong code, hidden security flaws, overengineering), and verify their output. **How We Work With AI** AI assistants are standard equipment here. What sets great engineers apart is the judgment they bring to them. * **You are the engineer of record.** Generated code is your code. You understand it, test it, and can defend it in review. * **You decompose problems well.** You give agents clear context, small well\-scoped tasks, and good acceptance criteria, and you know when a task needs a human to think first. * **You verify, not trust.** You rely on tests, types, linters, and your own reading to catch subtle bugs, insecure patterns, and invented APIs. * **You teach what works.** You share prompts, workflows, and lessons learned so the whole team gets faster. **What We’d Love to See** * Experience in the publishing or media industry * Cloud\-native and infrastructure\-as\-code experience on any major provider * Event\-driven or distributed systems experience **Salary range:** $175,000 \- $200,000 **Overtime eligible:** Exempt *This position is classified as remote but is tied to our New York, NY office located at 120 Broadway. Employment is subject to New York State tax withholding under applicable regulations.* Macmillan Publishers is the U.S. trade company that is part of the Holtzbrinck Publishing Group, a large family\-owned group of media companies headquartered in Stuttgart, Germany. Holtzbrinck Publishing Group's publishing companies include prominent imprints around the world that publish a broad range of award\-winning books for children and adults in all categories and formats. U.S. publishers include Celadon Books, Farrar, Straus and Giroux, Flatiron Books, Henry Holt \& Company, Macmillan Audio, Macmillan Children’s Publishing Group, The St. Martin's Publishing Group, and Tor Publishing Group. In the UK, Australia, India, and South Africa, companies in the Holtzbrinck Publishing Group publish under the Pan Macmillan name. The German publishing company, Holtzbrinck Deutsche Buchverlage, includes among its imprints S. Fischer, Kiepenheuer \& Witsch, Rowohlt, and Droemer Knaur. jobs.title: Software Developer – ColdFusion and Database Development - Digital Inspections
jobs.description: **Overview** **Contract Software Developer – ColdFusion and Database Development** **Project:** Digital Inspection Development and CMMS Integration **Company:** Management and Engineering Services, LLC (MES) **Engagement Type:** Independent Contract Software Development **1\. Project Overview** Management and Engineering Services, LLC (MES) is seeking an experienced software developer with demonstrated ColdFusion and database development experience to design, develop, and integrate digital inspection functionality into MES's proprietary Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS). The project involves developing up to ten (10\) digital inspection forms that can be accessed through multiple identification methods, including room number, building FMSS ID, building name, or voice command. The digital inspections will allow authorized users to conduct inspections electronically, document compliance findings, and automatically initiate unscheduled maintenance work orders when an inspection item is identified as not in compliance. The functionality will integrate directly with the existing CMMS work order database and maintenance assignment structure. **2\. Scope of Services and Functional Requirements** **A. Digital Inspection Development** The developer shall design and develop up to ten (10\) digital inspection forms within MES's existing CMMS platform. Potential digital inspections include, but are not limited to: * Exterior Building Inspection * Interior Building Inspection * Fire and Life Safety Inspection * Integrated Pest Management (IPM) Daily Field Log * IPM Inspection Checklist * Weekly Trap Check Log * Hantavirus Cleanup Record * Bed Bug Room Inspection The final inspection list and associated questions, response options, and inspection requirements will be provided or approved by MES. Each digital inspection shall: * Provide a structured checklist with questions and designated response options. * Allow the end user to identify whether an inspection item is in compliance or not in compliance. * Capture and retain inspection results in the CMMS database. * Associate inspection records with the applicable building, room, or facility. * Record the inspection date and applicable inspection information. * Allow authorized users to retrieve completed inspection records. **B. Inspection Retrieval and Identification** The developer shall create functionality allowing an end user to retrieve the appropriate digital inspection using one or more of the following methods: * Room number. * Building FMSS ID. * Building name. * Voice Voice command or voice\-assisted search. Voice retrieval may require integration with a speech\-recognition service. Developer to identify the recommended approach and any associated licensing or recurring costs before implementation. For example, a user could state: "Interior room inspection for room 101 in the XX Motel." The system shall identify the appropriate building and room, retrieve the corresponding inspection form, and present it to the user for completion. The developer shall ensure that the inspection retrieval process accurately identifies the intended location and inspection type. If the system cannot confidently identify the requested location or inspection, it should prompt the user to clarify or select the correct record before proceeding. **C. Automated Unscheduled Work Order Creation** A primary requirement of this project is the automatic creation of an unscheduled repair work order when an inspection item is identified as not in compliance. When an end user identifies an inspection item as not in compliance, the system shall automatically initiate a corresponding work order within the existing CMMS. The work order database fields shall automatically populate as follows: **Work Order Field** **Required System Action** Work Order Title Automatically populate based on the inspection finding and associated issue Work Order Category Repairs Unscheduled Work Order Status Pending Creation Date Automatically populate with the date the work order is generated Priority Status Routine – 8 Hours Assigned Shop Automatically assign to the appropriate maintenance shop, such as IPM Shop, or another designated shop based on the inspection finding Standard Procedure Automatically attach the applicable standard procedure, when one exists Work Instructions Automatically populate the applicable instructions associated with the finding or standard procedure Additional requirements: · The work order shall be linked to the originating inspection record. The inspection will retain its original responses even after a work order is created. The work order is a separate maintenance record linked to the inspection, so the original compliance finding is never overwritten. * The work order shall be associated with the correct building, room, or facility. * The system shall retain the inspection finding that triggered the work order. * The work order shall be routed to the appropriate maint  before coding begins. **5\. Testing and Acceptance Criteria** The developer shall coordinate with MES to test all developed functionality before final acceptance. Testing shall include: * Successful retrieval of the correct inspection by room number, building FMSS ID, and building name. * Successful voice\-assisted inspection retrieval. * Accurate recording of inspection responses. * Confirmation that compliant inspection items do not generate unnecessary work orders. * Confirmation that items marked not in compliance automatically generate the appropriate unscheduled repair work order. * Accurate population of all required work order fields. * Correct assignment to the designated maintenance shop. * Successful attachment of applicable standard procedures and automatic population of work instructions. * Accurate linkage between the inspection record and generated work order. * Successful generation and retrieval of inspection reports. * Verification that historical inspection records remain accessible. Final acceptance will be determined by MES following successful testing and confirmation that the developed functionality meets the agreed\-upon requirements. **6\. Confidentiality and Non\-Disclosure Agreement** Due to the proprietary nature of MES's software platform, source code, database architecture, client information, and business processes, the contractor must execute an MES Non\-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) before receiving access to any software, databases, technical documentation, or confidential company information. The contractor shall: * Maintain strict confidentiality regarding all MES proprietary and confidential information. * Use confidential information solely for the purpose of completing the assigned development project. * Not disclose, copy, distribute, or use MES source code, database information, software designs, or business information outside the scope of this engagement. * Not share system access credentials or permit unauthorized access to MES systems. * Not use MES proprietary information or developed functionality for another client or project. * Return or securely dispose of confidential materials and access credentials upon completion or termination of the engagement, as directed by MES. All developed source code, software modifications, database enhancements, technical documentation, and project\-specific deliverables shall be subject to the intellectual property ownership provisions established in the contractor agreement. **7\. Project Coordination and Communication** The contractor shall coordinate directly with designated MES personnel throughout the engagement. The contractor shall: * Participate in an initial project kickoff and technical requirements review. * Review the existing CMMS architecture and database structure before beginning development. * Provide periodic progress updates and communicate development milestones. * Identify technical limitations, integration concerns, or additional requirements that may affect the project. * Obtain MES approval before implementing changes outside the agreed\-upon scope. * Demonstrate completed functionality to MES before final acceptance. **8\. Engagement Terms** This is a contract\-based software development engagement. Project schedule, estimated hours, compensation, payment milestones, and anticipated completion date will be established separately with the selected contractor. The contractor is expected to provide the technical expertise necessary to develop, test, document, and integrate the specified digital inspection functionality into MES's existing proprietary CMMS platform. **Required Qualifications:** Demonstrated ColdFusion and database development experience is required. Experience with CMMS platforms, automated work order workflows, voice\-assisted applications, and enterprise software integrations is strongly preferred. **To Apply:** Please submit a résumé highlighting your ColdFusion development experience,. Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Lead Artificial Intelligence Engineer (Hybrid)
jobs.description: Serves as a hands\-on technical leader responsible for designing, building, evaluating, deploying, and maintaining production AI, machine learning, and generative AI systems. Operating as a player\-coach, this role splits time between writing production code, architecting end\-to\-end ML/MLOps pipelines on Databricks and AWS, and technically leading a team of AI/ML engineers and data scientists. Rather than focusing solely on high\-level strategy, this lead also drives technical execution—translating complex business problems into benchmarked, scalable, and measurable production models. Responsibilities Essential Functions *The list of essential functions, as outlined herein, is intended to be representative of the duties and responsibilities performed within this classification. It is not necessarily descriptive of any one position in this class. The omission of an essential function does not preclude management from assigning duties not listed herein if such functions are a logical assignment to the position.* * Hands\-On Model Development: Designs, trains, tunes, and deploys classical machine learning models (e.g., XGBoost, Random Forest, gradient boosting, forecasting, and regression models) and deep learning solutions to solve high\-impact business problems. * Generative AI \& Agentic Systems: Builds and ships production generative AI applications, including Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, vector search implementations, embedding strategies, foundation model fine\-tuning, and multi\-agent / agentic AI architectures. * End\-to\-End MLOps \& Production Ownership: Architects and maintains scalable MLOps workflows covering CI/CD for ML, automated retraining, experiment tracking, model versioning, deployment, latency/cost optimization, and live production monitoring (data drift, model degradation, and business value measurement). * Databricks \& Cloud Pipeline Engineering: Develops and operationalizes production ML pipelines using Python, PySpark, and Databricks on AWS—leveraging MLflow (tracking and Model Registry), Model Serving, Vector Search, Feature Store, Unity Catalog, and Databricks Workflows. * Model Evaluation \& Benchmarking: Builds rigorous offline and online evaluation frameworks to benchmark model quality prior to and following release, tracking domain\-relevant metrics such as precision, recall, F1, AUC\-ROC, and ranking/retrieval metrics like nDCG. * Feature Engineering \& Data Readiness: Partners with data teams to design ML\-ready feature pipelines and reusable feature stores that support both predictive ML and generative AI workloads. * Engineering Excellence \& Code Quality: Leads by example through active code reviews, architectural design reviews, automated testing, version control, and reproducible experimentation standards across the team. * Technical Team Leadership: Mentors, coaches, and manages a team of AI/ML engineers and data scientists—providing hands\-on technical unblocking, career development, and delivery accountability. * Cross\-Functional Execution: Collaborates directly with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to scope technical feasibility, define measurable success criteria, and prioritize the AI/ML delivery roadmap. * Governance \& Responsible AI: Implements practical governance, security, lineage, documentation, and compliance controls directly within the ML platform (e.g., via Unity Catalog and model registries) to ensure transparent, auditable, and reliable AI systems. Education and/or Experience * Bachelor’s degree (Master of Science preferred) in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, Statistics, or a related quantitative field from an accredited college or university. * Six plus (6\+) years of progressive, hands\-on experience in AI/ML engineering or applied data science, with a proven track record of personally developing, deploying, and maintaining machine learning and/or generative AI models in production. *(Note: Experience solely in enterprise IT, AI strategy, or traditional data engineering/ETL without direct production ML model ownership is not sufficient.)* Certificates, Licenses, Registrations, and Designations * None required. *(Databricks Certified Machine Learning Professional or AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty is a plus.)* Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Core Programming \& ML Engineering * Expert\-level proficiency in Python and SQL, with strong software engineering fundamentals (version control/Git, unit/integration testing, CI/CD, modular production code, and code reviews). * Deep, hands\-on experience implementing and tuning specific machine learning algorithms (such as XGBoost, Random Forest, LightGBM, regression, classification, clustering, and time\-series forecasting) using modern ML frameworks (e.g., scikit\-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow). * Proven experience building distributed data and ML pipelines using PySpark. Databricks \& MLOps Platform * Strong hands\-on experience with Databricks (ideally on AWS), specifically utilizing MLflow (experiment tracking, model versioning, and Model Registry), Model Serving, Feature Engineering / Feature Store, Vector Search, Unity Catalog, and Databricks Workflows. * Comprehensive MLOps expertise across automated deployment, production model monitoring, drift detection, latency/cost optimization, benchmarking, and full model lifecycle management. Generative AI \& Evaluation * Hands\-on production experience building Generative AI solutions, including RAG architectures, LLMs, embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering, and agentic AI workflows, as well as model customization techniques (supervised fine\-tuning, parameter\-efficient fine\-tuning/PEFT). * Demonstrated expertise designing model evaluation and benchmarking frameworks, including hands\-on application of classification, regression, and retrieval/ranking metrics (precision, recall, nDCG, MRR, hallucination/faithfulness metrics) and production A/B testing or shadow deployments. * Strong statistical foundation in experimental design, hypothesis testing, causal inference, and uncertainty quantification. Technical Leadership \& Communication * Ability to operate as a hands\-on technical lead who can both architect/code complex solutions as well as provide guidance and input to the rest of the AI/ML team. * Ability to translate model performance, technical trade\-offs, and production metrics into clear, measurable business outcomes for executive and non\-technical stakeholders. This is a hybrid role with 3 days a week in\-office. Please no third\-parties. And no sponsorship is offered for this role. Pay: $170,000\.00 \- $185,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Application Question(s): * I confirm that I don't require sponsorship now, or will EVER require sponsorship, to work in the US. Please answer Yes, if that is true. Location: * Saint Petersburg, FL 33716 (Required) Work Location: Hybrid remote in Saint Petersburg, FL 33716
