jobs.title: Sr Director, Head of Data Engineering
jobs.description: **Head of Data Engineering** **ABOUT MPG** Market Performance Group (MPG) is a leading end\-to\-end, strategy \& services omnichannel commerce agency focused on creating the best PATH FORWARD — from market strategy to in\-market reality — for today’s fastest\-growing consumer packaged goods (CPG) manufacturers. Over the years, we’ve built a strong reputation as a trusted partner and valuable resource to a broad range of companies, from Fortune 500 to Private Equity, in categories that include health \& wellness, food \& beverage, home and hardlines. We revel in the opportunity to guide our clients on their path forward, building and activating strategies that ensure success. Everything we do is driven by our unrelenting commitment to leverage our deep operational experience, unparalleled omnichannel expertise, and industry relationships to drive performance in today’s dynamic omnichannel marketplace. At MPG, we value our people and their contributions; they are critical to building the MPG Brand. Our leadership team has significant experience driving topline revenue and bottom\-line profit, having held senior operating roles at leading CPG manufacturers and retailers. Our highly regarded, seasoned team of 400\+ strategy and commercialization professionals brings strong operational experience and a collaborative approach. All team members are singularly focused on providing clients with pragmatic, real\-world market approaches, built on the strong consumer, category and marketplace insights needed to create sustainable, profitable brand growth. **Position Overview** MPG is seeking a **Head of Data Engineering** to lead the development and evolution of our enterprise data platform. This role will be responsible for building a scalable, reliable data infrastructure that supports both internal business operations and client\-facing data products. As a hands\-on technical leader, you will own the data engineering strategy, architecture, and standards while building and managing a growing team of engineers. This is an opportunity to shape a developing function from the ground up, drive technical decisions, and establish the foundation for how data is managed and leveraged across the organization. The ideal candidate brings a combination of deep technical expertise, strategic leadership, and a willingness to roll up their sleeves to solve complex challenges in a fast\-paced, evolving environment. *Reports to the Head of Product \& Technology. Based in the United States.* **What you own** **The platform and its architecture** * Own the data platform end to end: ingestion, warehouse design, transformation and modelling layers, semantic and serving layers, and the enterprise lake on Snowflake * Turn business strategy into a platform roadmap, sequenced so the highest\-leverage foundations land first * Make the build\-versus\-buy calls on orchestration, catalog, governance and BI tooling, with a bias toward a lean, well\-understood stack * Set the standards for modelling, testing, documentation, review and release, and hold the team to them **The team** * Hire and lead three senior data engineers, and grow the function from there * Run delivery: break down the roadmap, plan the work, unblock people, and be accountable for outcomes rather than tickets * Be the single owner of the data platform, so it can be delegated and trusted * Represent data engineering to product, platform engineering and business stakeholders, and turn what they need into a prioritized plan **Retailer scaling** This is the part that decides whether the platform works commercially. * Own how new retailer data sources get onboarded, and the sequence in which they land * Build ingestion as a repeatable operating system rather than a series of one\-off integrations, so adding a retailer does not mean adding a person * Work with partner data sources where they carry a retailer, and build and maintain our own connectors where they do not * Own the harmonization layer across retailers, so the same question returns a comparable answer regardless of where the data came from **Data that serves machines as well as people** * Model data for two demanding consumers at once: business users who run the company on your numbers, and AI systems whose usefulness depends directly on clean grain, clear semantics and machine\-readable metadata * Define what agent\-ready data means here in practice: freshness guarantees, lineage, column\-level documentation, and guardrails against ambiguous or misleading fields * Own reliability, performance and cost as analytical and AI\-driven workloads grow on Snowflake **Governance,** **trust** **and operations** * Establish the data quality and governance frameworks that make business\-critical numbers trusted by default * Set access, security and data\-contract standards across the lake, and make sure they are followed rather than documented * Build the operational muscle so the platform is dependable without heroics: monitoring,  d opinions on how a project should be structured and governed * Strong command of managed ingestion and the judgment to know its limits and when to build custom in Python against APIs and event feeds * Solid warehousing and dimensional modelling foundations, and the judgment to know when to bend them * Experience defining engineering standards, version control, CI/CD, environments and testing, and getting a team to actually adopt them * Comfort working directly with executives, making decisions and defending them, and operating with autonomy **Nice to have** * Experience with retail, CPG or e\-commerce data: point\-of\-sale, syndicated data such as Circana or NIQ, retailer portals, digital shelf, pricing and promotion * Experience building data for AI or LLM\-powered applications: retrieval, semantic layers, tool use * Experience standing up a data function from an early stage, where you set the standards rather than inheriting them * Familiarity with governance, cataloging and lineage tooling * Familiarity with Postgres or other operational databases feeding analytical platforms **Why this role is interesting** This is a founder\-level mandate for data engineering without the founder title. You are not inheriting a mature platform and a backlog, and you are not one senior voice among many. You decide how MPG builds, governs and serves data, and you get the autonomy that goes with it. The work runs in two directions at once. The business runs on the numbers you produce, and what we take to market is built on the data layer you design. Both get harder and more interesting with every data source we add If you want ownership of a platform that matters, the room to make the calls, and a team to build it with, this is that role. **Compensation** The expected base salary range for this position is $200,000 \- $250,000 annually, depending on experience, skills, and qualifications. In addition to base salary, this position may be eligible for performance\-based bonuses and other compensation programs. **Benefits** MPG offers a generous package of health benefits, including medical, dental, vision, STD/LTD, paid maternity/paternity leave and life insurance. Our compensation program provides market industry base salary, bonuses, and 401K. In addition to paid holidays, we reward an employee’s extra efforts through unlimited paid time off. **Diversity and Inclusion** MPG provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training. We are committed to ensuring that Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging (DEI\&B) are at the foundation of our culture. Through DEI\&B, we embrace the beauty in all of the unique qualities of our employees, communities and clients. MPG’s DEI\&B efforts empower us to collectively reach our full potential by fueling innovation, connection, and growth. We recognize the value of having a diverse and engaged team. We are an organization driven by PEOPLE. Our commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging was born from our core values. We believe that by leveraging the unique perspectives and experiences of our employees, MPG can unlock more comprehensive, innovative, and long\-standing results for both our client and retailer partners. As our journey continues to evolve, we have made intentional commitments to further champion DEI\&B. The foundation of our pledge starts with our promise to each other, our clients, and the community. © 2026 Market Performance Group All rights reserved.

jobs.title: Post-Doctoral Research Fellow - Algorithms in Laryngology Research
jobs.description: Site: Massachusetts Eye and Ear Infirmary Mass General Brigham relies on a wide range of professionals, including doctors, nurses, business people, tech experts, researchers, and systems analysts to advance our mission. As a not\-for\-profit, we support patient care, research, teaching, and community service, striving to provide exceptional care. We believe that high\-performing teams drive groundbreaking medical discoveries and invite all applicants to join us and experience what it means to be part of Mass General Brigham. **Job Summary** The Postdoctoral Fellow will independently drive the technical development of a multidisciplinary research initiative focused on advancing laryngology through real\-time machine learning, computer vision, and quantitative analysis of laryngoscopy videos. This role will involve designing, coding, training, testing, validating, and translating algorithms that track laryngeal anatomy, classify examination states, extract clinically meaningful video\-derived metrics, and support future clinical decision\-support tools. The fellow will work with laryngologists, clinical research staff, engineers, and collaborators at Mass Eye and Ear and Mass General Brigham to move the project from proof\-of\-concept research toward reproducible, clinically useful deployment. This position is best suited for a highly independent researcher with demonstrated computer vision expertise and hands\-on coding experience who is interested in applying advanced AI methods to important clinical problems in laryngology. **Qualifications** **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:** ** Data Collection \& Processing:** * Extract, curate, and manage clinical research datasets, including flexible laryngoscopy videos, frame\-level annotations, laryngeal keypoint data, high\-fidelity voice recordings, operative data, patient\-reported outcomes, and relevant clinical metadata. * Develop and maintain reproducible pipelines for video ingestion, annotation, quality control, de\-identification, preprocessing, dataset versioning, and secure data management. * Work with clinicians and research staff to standardize video and outcomes data collection protocols across clinic, operating room, and follow\-up settings. ** Research \& Analysis:** * Independently design, implement, train, and debug computer vision and deep\-learning models for real\-time laryngeal structure tracking, examination\-state classification, anatomic feature detection, lesion or abnormality localization, and quantitative laryngoscopy. * Design reproducible training experiments; diagnose model failures, overfitting, and data\-quality problems; and rigorously evaluate accuracy, generalizability, latency, robustness, and clinical interpretability. * Translate model outputs into clinically meaningful metrics and visualization tools that can support research, standardized examination quality, documentation, and eventual clinical decision support. ** Publication \& Dissemination:** * Lead and contribute to manuscripts on AI applications in laryngology, quantitative laryngoscopy, real\-time video analysis, clinical validation, and related patient outcomes research. * Prepare abstracts, posters, oral presentations, technical reports, grant materials, and documentation for scientific meetings, collaborators, and potential translational partners. ** Clinical \& Translational Research Support:** * Collaborate closely with laryngologists, research assistants, engineers, and clinical teams to test algorithms against real clinical workflows and to identify failure modes, usability needs, and implementation barriers. * Participate in translational activities including clinical validation planning, regulatory and data\-governance discussions, intellectual property development, and interactions with internal and external collaborators. ** General Research Support:** * Maintain readable, version\-controlled codebases, model documentation, datasets, and reproducible training workflows in accordance with institutional research ethics, HIPAA, data security, and reproducibility standards. * Independently manage technical priorities and milestones, proactively troubleshoot obstacles, provide regular updates to the team, and contribute to grant writing and continued development of the laryngoscopy AI platform. * Mentor junior staff, students, and research assistants in data annotation, computational methods, experimental design, coding practices, and scientific communication. **EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:**  PhD or equivalent degree in computer science, biomedical engineering, electrical engineering, computational neuroscience, data science, statistics or a closely related field **strongly** preferred.  Demonstrated hands\-on experience implementing, training, and troubleshooting deep\-learning models for computer vision, with strong fundamentals in model evaluation and experience in image or video analysis.  Advanced Python programming and hands\-on experience implementing and training computer vision models in PyTorch (or a comparable framework) are required. Experience with OpenCV, Git, Linux/Unix, GPU computing, and reproducible research workflows is preferred; DeepLabCut experience is a plus.  Excellent verbal and written communication skills, strong publication record or evidence of scholarly productivity, demonstrated ownership of substantial coding projects and ability to work independently, and interest in collaborating with clinicians to translate AI research into healthcare applications.  Applicants should briefly describe one or two machine\-learning models they personally built or substantially modified, including their coding contributions, challenges, and quantitative results; links to shareable code are encouraged. Salary Range \- $71,750\.00 \- $73,544\.00/Annual **Additional Job Details (if applicable)** **WORKING CONDITIONS:**  Work will involve close interaction with clinical and research environments, including laryngology clinics, voice laboratories, and occasional operating room or procedural settings.  Work may involve patient\-facing research activities, clinical video review, and collaboration with physicians, clinical staff, engineers, students, and research assistants.  The role will require prolonged periods of programming, data analysis, model training, manuscript preparation, and written documentation.  Partial remote work may be possible. Most job functions, including clinical workflow observation, team meetings, data collection, and institutional activities, will require in\-person presence at Mass Eye and Ear. **Remote Type** Onsite **Work Location** 243\-245 Charles Street **Scheduled Weekly Hours** 40 **Employee Type** Regular **Work Shift** Day (United States of America) **EEO Statement:** 5110 Massachusetts Eye and Ear Infirmary is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religious creed, national origin, sex, age, gender identity, disability, sexual orientation, military service, genetic information, and/or other status protected under law. We will ensure that all individuals with a disability are provided a reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. To ensure reasonable accommodation for individuals protected by Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973, the Vietnam Veteran’s Readjustment Act of 1974, and Title I of the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, applicants who require accommodation in the job application process may contact Human Resources at (857\)\-282\-7642\.**Mass General Brigham Competency Framework** --------------------------------------------- At Mass General Brigham, our competency framework defines what effective leadership “looks like” by specifying which behaviors are most critical for successful performance at each job level. The framework is comprised of ten competencies (half People\-Focused, half Performance\-Focused) and are defined by observable and measurable skills and behaviors that contribute to workplace effectiveness and career success. jobs.title: Principal Engineer, AI/ML
jobs.description: Role Overview: We're looking for a Principal Engineer to architect, fine\-tune, and deploy on\-device small language models (SLMs) for consumer security at scale. While you won’t own the agent orchestration platform itself, you’ll work closely with it to ensure models behave correctly in multi\-turn conversations and make reliable tool\-calling decisions. This role sits at the intersection of edge ML, applied LLMs, and production engineering. Success requires navigating real\-world tradeoffs: latency vs. capability, privacy vs. accuracy, on\-device vs. cloud execution, and cost vs. performance. This is a Hybrid position located in a hub location of Frisco, TX, San Jose, CA, Newport Beach, CA, or New York, NY. You will be required to be onsite on an as\-needed basis, typically 1\-4 days per month. We are only considering candidates within a commutable distance to this location and are not offering relocation assistance at this time. Position Details: **About the role:** * Design and deploy small language models optimized for on\-device inference (Mac, iOS, Android, Linux) * Lead model optimization efforts including quantization, pruning, distillation, and efficient inference pipelines * Fine\-tune models to improve tool selection accuracy and conversational behavior in security\-focused workflows * Build evaluation frameworks to measure model efficacy, tool\-calling accuracy, conversation quality, and safety in production * Create synthetic data and workflow simulations to train and validate security\-relevant conversations * Partner closely with agent orchestration systems to optimize multi\-turn dialogue behavior and state handling * Implement cost\-optimization strategies such as intelligent on\-device vs. cloud routing, prompt caching, batching, and token efficiency * Integrate cloud\-based LLMs when deeper reasoning or broader context is required * Build production ML systems that detect threats and protect users directly on\-device * Set technical standards and architectural direction for AI/ML across the security platform * Influence engineers, architects, and technical leaders through design reviews, technical guidance, and engineering best practices. * Design and maintain scalable AI evaluation harnesses that enable automated testing, benchmarking, and regression detection across model quality, tool\-calling behavior, safety, and production workflows. * Develop red\-team testing frameworks and adversarial evaluation methodologies to measure and improve model robustness, security, and resiliency against emerging threat scenarios. * Build reusable AI engineering platforms, tooling, and infrastructure that accelerate model experimentation, evaluation, deployment, and operational monitoring across multiple teams and products. **About you:** * 10\+ years of software engineering experience, with 5\+ years focused on ML/AI * Proven experience shipping ML models to production with transferrable skills to deploy these on edge or mobile platforms * Experience with conversational AI systems and tool/function\-calling architectures * Strong Python and systems programming skills (C\+\+ or Rust) for performance\-critical code * Drive cross\-functional technical initiatives that span multiple products and engineering organizations. * Deep expertise in model optimization (INT4/INT8 quantization, pruning, distillation) * Hands\-on experience with PyTorch and at least one edge deployment framework (TensorFlow Lite, CoreML, ONNX Runtime, or llama.cpp) * Experience building evaluation and benchmarking frameworks for ML systems * Experience applying ML systems in security, safety, or other adversarial domains * Master’s degree in CS, ML, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience) is a plus \#LI\-Hybrid Company Overview: McAfee is a leader in personal security for consumers. jobs.title: Principal Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** ACES CØDE is a Microsoft engineering organization focused on reducing operational demand across the Microsoft Cloud including but not limited to the avoidable support cases, repeated troubleshooting, and manual interventions that arise when cloud products, platforms, or processes do not work as intended. Our mission is to engineer this demand out of the Microsoft Cloud by turning customer and operational signals into lasting product improvements, intelligent diagnostics, autonomous resolution systems, and AI\-powered capabilities. As cloud services grow in scale and complexity, we are moving beyond simply reacting to problems after they occur. We work to understand why operational demand exists, prevent it at the source where possible, resolve it autonomously when it does occur, and continuously learn from those signals to make our products and support experiences more reliable. We look for teammates who can navigate ambiguity, reason from data and customer signals, work across technical and organizational boundaries, and turn complex problems into durable, measurable outcomes. Within this mission, the ACES CØDE engineering team is building domain\-specific agents and intelligent services that are transforming Azure customer support and product quality, moving from reactive, human\-only workflows toward AI\-first systems that resolve customer issues and product repairs at Azure scale. We are seeking a Principal Applied AI Engineer to serve as a hands\-on technical architect and senior developer for production agentic AI services. You will define and implement the architecture for next\-generation AI agents, including LLM orchestration, multi\-agent coordination, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), tool integration, and evaluation systems. You will write production code, lead complex technical initiatives, establish engineering standards, and guide engineers across organizational boundaries through technical influence rather than people management. This is a deeply technical individual contributor role with broad architectural scope and direct accountability for production outcomes. You will turn ambiguous customer and business problems into scalable systems, make critical design decisions, build foundational components, and help teams ship secure and reliable AI services that handle thousands of customer cases per month. Every day, our customers stake their business and reputation on our cloud. You can help Azure EngOps provide our customers with the world\-class cloud services they need to succeed. Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day, we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. **Responsibilities** * Architect and build production agentic AI systems: Design and implement scalable AI agents and services, including LLM orchestration, multi\-agent workflows, RAG pipelines, tool integrations, memory and state management, and human\-in\-the\-loop experiences. * Lead through hands\-on engineering: Write, review, and maintain production\-quality C\# and Python code. Define quality thresholds and graduation criteria for moving agents from experimentation through shadow mode and into autonomous operation. * Own production quality and reliability: Ensure AI services meet demanding standards for correctness, availability, latency, scalability, cost, and safety. Diagnose complex production issues, lead technical incident response and root cause analysis, and engineer systemic improvements. * Design for responsible and secure AI: Embed responsible AI principles, privacy protections, prompt\-injection defenses, tool authorization, data boundaries, action controls, auditability, and fail\-safe behavior into system architecture and implementation. * Make consequential technical decisions: Evaluate models, frameworks, platfo , applied AI, and evaluation\-driven development. Create reusable guidance and help teams develop the judgment to determine where AI agents should and should not act autonomously. **Qualifications** **Required Qualifications:*** Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 6\+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR equivalent experience. **Other**: Ability to meet Microsoft, customer, and/or government security screening requirements is required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to, the following specialized security screening: Microsoft Cloud Background Check. This position is required to pass the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire or transfer and every two years thereafter. **Preferred Qualifications:*** 8\+ years of professional software engineering experience designing, building, and operating production software systems. * Strong proficiency in C\# and/or Python, with demonstrated ability to design and implement production\-quality services and distributed systems. * Experience serving as a technical architect or technical lead for complex, cross\-team engineering initiatives. * Experience with applied AI systems, including LLM\-based applications, prompt engineering, RAG architectures, agent frameworks, or machine learning services. * Experience with cloud platforms, preferably Azure, and cloud\-native engineering practices including microservices, APIs, containers, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and observability. * Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related Our mission is to build the data platform of AI, powering a new class of data\-first applications and driving a data culture. Within Microsoft Fabric, the Platform team builds and operates the unified foundation that brings together all Fabric workloads into a single, cohesive experience. The platform provides shared infrastructure, governance, security, and a unified data model that enables customers to manage their entire data estate in one place. This team is central to delivering Fabric as a complete, end\-to\-end intelligence platform. Every AI agent is only as good as the data it can reach. As a Software Engineer II on the OneLake team, you'll build the highly scalable systems that connect AI to data across clouds, platforms and formats. OneLake is the open data lake at the heart of Microsoft Fabric and the data foundation for the AI agents built on it. Enterprise data rarely lives in one place. Our team brings it together without copying it: with shortcuts, mirroring and catalog federation, data in Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, Databricks and on\-premises systems shows up in OneLake as a single copy, ready for Spark, SQL, Power BI and AI. And the scale is real: OneLake handles over 110 billion interactions a day, more than 15 million shortcuts are in active use, and storage has grown over 300% in a year. That creates some of the most interesting distributed systems problems in the industry. How do you make data that lives in another cloud feel local, fast and secure? How do you keep metadata in sync with many external catalogs, bridge open table formats like Delta Lake and Apache Iceberg, and enforce one consistent security model across all of it? You'll own real services end to end, from design and code to performance and live operations, working alongside experienced engineers who will invest in your growth. What you build will reach tens of thousands of organizations, and our features are announced at Microsoft's biggest events, like Ignite. If you love distributed systems, cloud storage and open data, come help us connect the world's data. We do not just value differences or different perspectives. We seek them out and invite them in so we can tap into the collective power of everyone in the company. As a result, our customers are better served. **Responsibilities** * Design, build and ship highly scalable services that connect data across Azure, AWS, Google Cloud and other platforms, powering OneLake features such as shortcuts, mirroring and catalog federation. * Solve the core problems of multi\-cloud data access: performance, caching, metadata sync, and interoperability between open table formats such as Delta Lake and Apache Iceberg. * Build security into everything you ship, from authentication and permissions to credential management and network isolation. * Own your features end to end, from design and code reviews through deployment, monitoring and live\-site support, including a shared on\-call rotation. * Work with product managers, peer engineering teams and customers to turn real scenarios into simple, reliable features. * Write clean, well\-tested code, use AI\-assisted tools such as GitHub Copilot to move faster, and share what you learn to raise the team's engineering bar. * Embody our culture and values. **Qualifications** **Required Qualifications** Bachelor's degree in computer science or related technical field AND 2\+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, or Python * + OR equivalent experience. **Additional Job Requirements** Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: Microsoft Cloud Background Check: * This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter. **Preferred Qualifications** * Master's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 3\+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, or Python + OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 5\+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, or Python + OR equivalent experience. * Experience building cloud services, distributed systems or microservices on Azure, AWS, Google Cloud or a similar platform. * Familiarity with data lakes or data platforms, such as cloud object storage (Azure Data Lake Storage, Amazon S3, Google Cloud Storage), Spark or Databricks, or open table formats like Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg and Parquet. * Understanding of authentication, authorization or networking concepts for cloud services. * Experience improving the performance or reliability of a production service, for example through monitoring, debugging or on\-call work. \#AZUREDATA \#AZDAT \#ONELAKE \#FABRIC Software Engineering IC3 \- The typical base pay range for this role across the U.S. is USD $102,100 \- $202,200 per year. Partner with application development teams, architects, infrastructure engineers, security teams, and platform organizations to develop migration strategies and execute migration plans. * Design, build, and validate cloud landing patterns, deployment architectures, infrastructure automation, and operational tooling. * Develop proofs\-of\-concept and laboratory environments to evaluate migration approaches, cloud services, deployment models, and modernization opportunities. * Perform hands\-on implementation of migrations, including application refactoring, containerization, deployment automation, configuration management, and production cutovers. * Design and implement infrastructure\-as\-code solutions using modern automation frameworks and cloud\-native deployment tools. * Build and enhance CI/CD pipelines to support automated testing, deployment, release management, and operational readiness. * Evaluate existing application architectures and identify opportunities to improve scalability, resiliency, security, observability, and operational efficiency in the cloud. * Implement and support container\-based platforms, Kubernetes deployments, service infrastructure layers. * Develop reusable migration frameworks, engineering standards, automation patterns, and best practices to accelerate future cloud adoption. * Partner with platform engineering teams to evaluate emerging cloud technologies and incorporate industry best practices into migration programs. * Mentor engineering teams on cloud\-native development, automation, DevOps practices, infrastructure\-as\-code, and modern deployment methodologies. * Provide technical leadership during migration planning, readiness reviews, and production rollout activities. * Contribute to cloud governance, operational excellence, resiliency testing, disaster recovery planning, and production support readiness. What you’ll bring to the role: * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience. * 8\+ years of experience designing, building, and supporting large\-scale enterprise applications and distributed systems. * Demonstrated experience successfully migrating applications from on\-premises environments to public cloud platforms. * troubleshoot complex technical issues. * Experience with containerization technologies and Kubernetes platforms such as GKE, EKS, OpenShift, or equivalent. * Strong understanding of cloud networking, jobs.title: Senior Software Developer - Autonomous Vehicles
jobs.description: NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self\-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in an inclusive, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world. NVIDIA is at the center of the autonomous vehicle revolution, building the AI computing, software, and simulation platforms that leading automakers and mobility providers rely on to deliver safe, scalable self\-driving. Working within the planning and control organization, the Active Safety team builds software to warn and assist a driver in dangerous situations. This team collaborates closely with our perception, safety, and systems engineering team to guide the end\-to\-end functionality of these products. The successful candidate will Initially focus on longitudinal safety systems, which includes software that activates the brakes to avoid collisions (Automatic Emergency Braking), In this capacity, said candidate will help extend the current system into the next generation of products, ensuring that existing systems continue to exceed industry standards. **What you'll be doing:** Maturing and productizing features within this team entails a diversity of activities, including: * Developing safety critical algorithms using fundamental physics, control systems, planning algorithms, and/or vehicle dynamics * Defining and verifying product requirements through detailed analysis, simulation, in\-car testing, and benchmarking existing products * Collaborating with our internal safety teams to perform safety analysis using classical HARA and DFMEA processes * Debugging and isolating performance issues and limitations based on real\-world testing Collaborating with multiple customers. and manufacturers directly and supporting a variety of carlines and platforms * **What we need to see:** * BS or higher in an engineering or technical field (Mechanical, Electrical, Computer Science, Physics, etc.) or equivalent experience * 5\+ years of practical experience * Proven ability writing C\+\+ in a production environment * Comfort with an Agile/Scrum software development environment using Gerrit (or similar) Comfort developing software with GIT in a Linux environment * **Ways to stand out from the crowd:** We definitely appreciate candidates with any of the following experience ... * A background in automotive systems and familiarity with Euro NCAP, KNCAP, and UNECE certification. Previous experience shipping real\-world control systems * Experience with regulatory standards such as ISO 26262 or equivalent * Experience in the physics and kinematics of wheeled vehicles. Theoretical expertise in control systems, filter design, and/or state estimation * Experience with perceptions systems, especially the fusion of radar and camera systems * Practical vehicle testing experience on test tracks Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job\-related factors. The expected base salary ranges for this position are: 157,500 USD – 299,000 USD for Level 3; and 187,500 USD – 364,000 USD for Level 4\. You will also be eligible for equity and benefits . Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 29, 2026\. This posting is for an existing vacancy. NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes. jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test - SDET
jobs.description: We are looking for Senior Software Development Engineer in Test to join our Compute CUDA Quality Assurance team for NVIDIA's Enterprise SWQA release schedules. Are you passionate about automation development, test and validation infrastructure? Do you excel using AI tools to aid in solving complex issues? We'd love to have your skills on the team! As an engineer on this automation team, you will automate testbench independent test specification and execution workflows for worldwide chip validation teams running tests on silicon along with automation framework/infrastructure development. You will develop a system operating at large scale, running hundreds of tests per day in distributed heterogeneous servers with NVIDIA's GPUs connect to verify multiple designs/POR in many configurations those are sitting in automation farm or in cloud. You will continuously innovate and develop scalable, reliable, high performance systems and tools to enable the next generation of chips. **What you’ll be doing:** * Develop test plan and orchestrate testing for Compute software releases on all new compute architecture platforms including Tesla GPUs, Nvidia turnkey systems and OEM systems. * Develop a robust test infrastructure incorporating advanced AI tools to significantly enhance our testing capabilities and streamlining operations for more efficient and accurate results. * Improve code coverage, elevating the overall quality of our codebase and reliability of our testing processes and develop roadmaps prioritizing software development schedule for full life\-cycle of tool development, test, and deployment * Collaborate across teams to identify new features and lead developers in definition, automation implementation, and productization of those features in timely manner * Build and operate key pieces of a complete infrastructure for automation framework development, as well as, lead and develop automation support and participate in automation of manual test cases, working closely with automation infrastructure * Focus on an efficient customer experience by improving both usability and ease to attain optimal performance * Test both software functionality and internal code/structure and run regression tests for existing CUDA/Driver features. Work in a dynamic agile software development team with very high production quality standards. * **What we need to see:** * BS or MS in Engineering (or equivalent experience) with 5\+ years testing SW development cycle. * Solid understanding of embedded systems, Linux, Python, C and C\+\+. * Experience with cloud infrastructure is a big plus * Proven experience with AI tools for automation and test plan development directly applied to daily tasks. This expertise is crucial for enhancing performance, developing robust frameworks, and increasing test coverage. * Strong technical skills, with deep understanding of orchestration \& automation systems, data centers and cloud architecture combined. * Solid understanding in QA methodology and pay attention to details. * Knowledge in Cluster and cluster management * Experience in developing test strategies, high quality test plans and test execution Proficient in building test setups and fine tuning in HW and SW along with hardware and software components that enable cloud computing services. * **Ways to stand out from the crowd:** * Expertise in packaging software in Linux (rpms, debs) and knowledge in Linux distribution (Centos, Ubuntu, SLES, RedHat, Fedora) * Apply AI\-powered tools to improve efficiency and quality, including test case/plan/script generation, defect detection, CBTP, bug fixing and day to day assistance * Experience with Configuration and deployment management (Ansible), Containers (Docker) and Virtualization infrastructure software (Xen, KVM) * Good understanding of C/C\+\+ toolchain in Linux including cross\-compilation (C, C\+\+, automake/autoconf, cmake, meson). Background with parallel programming, ideally CUDA C/C\+\+ and OpenACC * NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most brilliant people on the planet working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you! jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer, AI
jobs.description: WORK OPTION: The NBA currently provides eligible employees the option of working remotely one day per week. \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ **Position Summary** The National Basketball Association (NBA) is seeking a highly skilled Sr AI Site Reliability Engineer to own the reliability, performance, security and operational readiness of the league's enterprise AI platform and agentic systems. Reporting to the Head of Technology \& Infrastructure Operations, this senior technical expert owns AI SRE Operations, applying site reliability engineering discipline to AI gateways, AI identity, agent runtimes, model serving, integrations, and the connected AI enterprise infrastructure these services depend on. The role partners with AI platform engineering, Cybersecurity, application and business technology teams to translate the NBA's AI vision into resilient, observable, cost\-governed production services. It is an infrastructure engineering and operations role, not a model development role: development teams retain ownership of models and applications, while the Sr AI Site Reliability Engineer provides the platform enablement, operational standards and production support that let approved AI use cases run securely at enterprise scale. The position is an individual contributor role in the SRE AI Operations capability being established within Infrastructure \& Operations. **Major Responsibilities** **AI SRE Operations, Reliability and Incident Management** ---------------------------------------------------------- * Own AI SRE operations for the enterprise AI platform, defining and meeting service level indicators, service level objectives and error budgets for AI gateways, agent runtimes, model serving, inference, integrations and connected AI enterprise infrastructure. * Lead incident management for AI workloads, including on\-call protocols, post\-incident reviews and systemic reliability improvements across models, agents, integrations and MCP servers. * Operate the agent runtime and harness, including orchestration, scaling, memory, tool usage and workflow execution, so that agents run consistently, securely and reliably in production. Operate model serving and the inference platform, including compute, routing, optimization, caching and orchestration, supporting multiple model providers and both foundation and custom models at enterprise scale. * **AI Gateway, Identity and Agent Communication** ------------------------------------------------ * Operate and harden the AI Gateway as the single, governed entry point for all AI models, agents and AI applications, enforcing authentication, routing, guardrails, rate limiting, cost controls and policy on every AI interaction. * Operate the MCP Gateway as a secure broker between agents and MCP servers, enforcing identity, authorization, traffic policy and auditing for all agent\-to\-tool communication. * Establish and manage AI identity for users, agents and services, including service identities, delegated permissions, credential management and least\-privilege access to models, tools and data. Manage Agent\-to\-Agent (A2A) communication, discovery, orchestration and workflow coordination so that agents can securely collaborate, delegate tasks and share context across business domains. * **Agent, MCP and Integration Lifecycle** ---------------------------------------- * Maintain the agent registry as the centralized catalog of approved agents, tools, skills, versions, ownership and metadata, enabling secure discovery, reuse, lifecycle tracking and interoperability. * Manage the complete agent lifecycle, from development and testing through deployment, monitoring, updates, retirement and governance review. * Provide centralized management of MCP servers, tools, connectors and integrations, including consistent onboarding, versioning, access management and operational support. * Connect AI models and agents to enterprise applications, data platforms, APIs and event streams through standardized, supportable connectors with consistent security, error handling and monitoring. Partner with engineering, application and business teams to onboard approved AI use cases into secure, reliable production, with documented ownership, incident response and release acceptance. * **AI Deployment Automation, LLMOps and Observability** ------------------------------------------------------ * Automate AI deployment and agent lifecycle operations to reduce toil, promoting models, agents, prompts and workflows from development to production through secure, compliant and reliable releases. * Operate LLMOps pipelines covering model lifecycle, evaluation, monitoring, deployment, compliance and ongoing optimization, and support governed fine\-tuning of foundation models with enterprise data. * Provide centralized prompt management, including storage, versioning, testing, approval and optimization of prompts and agent instructions. Build end\-to\-end AI observability across prompts, response on experience operating AI, machine learning or generative AI workloads in production. * Demonstrated experience supporting AI platform services such as model serving, inference platforms, AI gateways, agent runtimes, integrations or MCP servers at enterprise scale. Background in complex, high\-availability IT infrastructure and cloud environments preferred. * **Knowledge, Skills and Abilities** * Expert\-level knowledge of site reliability engineering principles, including service level indicators, service level objectives, error budgets and incident management. * Working knowledge of large language model and agentic architectures, including AI gateways, AI identity, agent registries and runtimes, Model Context Protocol servers and agent\-to\-agent communication. * Deep experience with cloud platforms, container orchestration, enterprise integrations, and GPU or accelerator capacity management for inference workloads. * Strong proficiency in observability, automation and scripting, extended to AI telemetry such as prompt and response logging, tool call traces, evaluation metrics and token consumption. * Practical understanding of AI security, governance and cost management, including guardrails, data protection, access control, chargeback and inference optimization. Excellent cross\-functional communication skills across technical and leadership audiences. * **Salary Range:** $145,000\-$165,000 **Job Posting Title:** Senior Manager Employees currently are eligible to receive an annual discretionary performance bonus, awarded at the sole discretion of the Company and subject to any terms and conditions set by the Company. Employees and/or eligible dependents may be eligible to participate in the following Company\-sponsored employee benefit programs: medical; dental; vision; life/AD\&D insurance; short\- and long\-term disability; fertility and family\-forming assistance; wellbeing allowance; educational assistance; mental health coaching/therapy; tax advantaged accounts such as HSA and healthcare/dependent care FSAs; a 401(k) retirement plan; and time off benefits that include vacation, sick time, and personal days. We Consider Applicants For All Positions On The Basis Of Merit, Qualifications And Business Needs, And Without Regard To Race, Color, National Origin, Religion, Sex, Gender Identity, Age, Disability, Alienage Or Citizenship Status, Ancestry, Marital Status, Creed, Genetic Predisposition Or Carrier Status, Sexual Orientation, Veteran Status, Familial Status, Status As A Victim Of Domestic Violence Or Any Other Status Or Characteristic Protected By Applicable Federal, State, Or Local Law. **About the NBA** The National Basketball Association (NBA) is a global sports and media organization with the mission to inspire and connect people everywhere through the power of basketball. Built around five professional sports leagues: the NBA, WNBA, NBA G League, NBA 2K League and Basketball Africa League, the NBA has established a major international presence with games and programming available in 214 countries and territories in more than 50 languages, and merchandise for sale in more than 200 countries and territories on all seven continents. NBA rosters at the start of the 2026\-27 season featured 125 international players from a record\-tying 43 countries across six continents. The NBA's digital assets include NBA TV, NBA.com, the NBA App and NBA League Pass. The NBA has created one of the largest social media communities in the world, with more than 2\.5 billion likes and followers globally across all leagues, team and player platforms. The NBA's Tap to Watch provides seamless access to local, national and global live game telecasts via the NBA App, NBA.com, third\-party digital platforms and NBA partner platforms. NBA Cares, the NBA's global social impact platform, drives change on issues facing fans and communities in the areas of health and wellness, civic engagement, social justice and inclusion, and sustainability.

jobs.title: Principal AI Platform Engineer
jobs.description: The Principal AI Platform Engineer will serve as the NFL’s senior technical expert and primary architect for enterprise artificial intelligence infrastructure and services. This hands\-on engineering leader will be responsible for designing, building, securing, governing, and operating the foundational platforms that enable AI capabilities across the League. The role will provide technical leadership for implementation of the NFL AI Engineering Roadmap and establish reusable, secure, and operationally supportable platform capabilities for enterprise AI assistants, Microsoft Copilot, generative AI applications, AI agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP) services, Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions, AI\-assisted software engineering, and future AI\-enabled business services. This role requires deep technical expertise combined with the ability to establish enterprise standards and partner across Infrastructure, Security, Architecture, Data and Business Intelligence, Digital Media, Product, Legal, Privacy, and Service Management. The position is a senior individual contributor, directly engaged in architecture, engineering, prototyping, implementation, troubleshooting, and operational readiness. **Responsibilities:** * Define, maintain and evolve enterprise reference architectures for generative AI, enterprise AI assistants, Copilot, agent\-based systems, RAG platforms, MCP services and AI\-enabled business applications. * Design and implement the underlying AI platform infrastructure, including model integration patterns, AI gateways, security boundaries, identity integration, API management, and operational controls. * Lead evaluation, deployment, and operationalization of enterprise AI platforms and services. * Establish secure practices for connecting AI models and agents to NFL data, applications, APIs, and tools. * Create and maintain the NFL AI Service Catalog, including approved AI tools, models, MCP services, ownership assignments, support processes, and technical standards. * Architect and implement centralized AI observability capabilities, including monitoring, logging, audit trails, utilization reporting, prompt tracking where appropriate, anomaly detection, and integration with enterprise security monitoring platforms. * Establish technical controls and guardrails for AI systems, including data access controls, DLP integration, human approval requirements, sensitivity labeling enforcement, authentication, authorization, data governance, and agent action boundaries. * Design and implement operational standards for AI workloads including resiliency, disaster recovery, secrets management, deployment pipelines, change management, backup strategies, and operational support models. * Lead technical evaluation of AI gateways and other emerging infrastructure capabilities that enable centralized governance and control of AI services, models, agents, and MCP integrations. * Establish engineering standards for AI\-assisted software development, AI\-driven code review, automated testing, documentation generation, prompt engineering, and application modernization programs. * Partner with Infrastructure, Security, Architecture, Service Management, Data and Business Intelligence, Digital Media, Legal, and Product teams to ensure AI capabilities are delivered through approved enterprise processes. * Act as the senior technical advisor for enterprise AI architecture decisions, vendor evaluations, AI platform strategy, and emerging AI technologies. **Required Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 10\+ years of progressive experience in infrastructure, platform, or software engineering, including 3\+ years designing and operating production AI/ML or generative AI systems at enterprise scale. * Demonstrated hands\-on experience architecting and implementing production generative AI, machine learning, data, or intelligent application platforms. * Strong experience with public cloud architecture and services, preferably both AWS and Microsoft Azure, including identity, networking, compute, storage, API management, monitoring, security, and automation. * Experience integrating applications with large language models, model APIs, AI platforms, and enterprise data sources. * Practical experience with RAG architectures, vector search, embeddings, model integration, prompt orchestration, evaluation techniques, and enterprise knowledge retrieval. * Strong understanding of AI agent architectures, tool invocation, service identities, authorization boundaries, workflow orchestration, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls. * Experience building or operating API gateways, AI gateways, service meshes, platform control planes, or comparable centralized integration services. * Strong knowledge of enterprise identity and security concepts, including OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, managed identities, role\-based access control, an ar architecture diagrams, engineering standards, design documents, operational runbooks, and implementation plans. * Ability to communicate complex technical topics to engineering teams, business stakeholders, and senior leadership. * Demonstrated ability as a senior individual contributor, leading through influence across organizational and technical boundaries. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience deploying and governing Microsoft 365 Copilot or a comparable enterprise AI assistant across a large, distributed user base. * Experience building AI gateways providing centralized routing, rate limiting, cost attribution, content filtering, and audit for multiple model providers. * Familiarity with AI risk and governance frameworks, such as the NIST AI Risk Management Framework. * Experience with AI evaluation and red\-teaming practices, including prompt injection defense, jailbreak testing, and output\-quality regression. * Background supporting media, sports, entertainment, or live\-event operations. **Other key attributes / characteristics:** * Excellent written and verbal communication skills for technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Ability to balance innovation and delivery speed with security, reliability, governance, supportability, and cost management. * Strong ownership mindset with the ability to identify gaps, develop standards, and drive work through operational completion. * Sound technical judgment when assessing rapidly evolving technologies, vendor claims, architectural tradeoffs, and enterprise risks. **Travel:** Occasional travel to NFL offices, events, and other League locations **Terms/Expected Hours of Work:** NFL employees are required to work a minimum of 40 hours per week in the office. Salary $170,000 \- $230,000 USD ***Benefits Information*** *At the NFL, in\-person work at our offices is a top priority because it allows us to collaborate more effectively, build stronger connections, and maintain the culture that drives our success. This role requires onsite presence at an NFL office or stadium location, and remote and/or hybrid working options are not offered.* ***NO RELOCATION ASSISTANCE WILL BE PROVIDED.*** *The NFL is committed to building an inclusive work environment that reflects our incredible fan base. We provide an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all employees and applicants without regard to status as protected by applicable federal, state, and local laws.* ***WHO WE ARE:*** ***NFL Core Values:*** * *Respect: Everyone matters. We celebrate diverse opinions, honor hard work, and value every contribution.* * *Integrity: We do what's right, even when it's tough. We hold ourselves accountable and always follow through.* * *Team Responsibility: We support each other and our communities. No one is bigger than the game, and every action impacts others.* * *Resiliency: We set high standards, overcome adversity, and adapt to challenges, always striving for excellence.* ***NFL Leadership Attributes:*** * *Build Talent: We develop and nurture potential, empowering individuals to grow and succeed.* * *Execute: We take action with precision, delivering results that drive our goals forward.* * *Inspire: We motivate others through vision, energy, and a commitment to excellence.* * *Live Our Values: We embody our core principles in every decision and action.* * *Know the Business: We stay informed, understand our industry, and make decisions that strengthen our position.* * *Think Big: We challenge the status quo, envision bold possibilities, and strive for transformative impact* ***WHO YOU ARE:*** ***Talent Attributes: What we expect for our employees:*** * *Embody an enthusiastic, proactive can\-do attitude* * *Embrace grit, free from ego or entitlement* * *Excel as a relationship builder, with the ability to influence* * *Eager learner, driven by passion rather than just ambition* * *Encompasses an incredible work ethic with an agile mindset*

**Design and build agentic workflows:** Prototype and implement solutions using LLMs, APIs, retrieval, orchestration tools, and other appropriate technologies. * **Take solutions into use:** Work with measures with business partners, gather user feedback, and improve solutions based on their impact and use. * **Share reusable approaches:** Document useful patterns, tools, and lessons so teams can into technical solutions. * **Delivery from prototype to deployment:** Track record of moving a promising prototype into a workflow that people use, in partnership with the teams responsible for production systems and operations. * **Collaborative communication:** Ability to explain technical options clearly, work through constraints with cross\-functional partners, and build trust with both technical and nontechnical teams. * **Practical approach to AI risk:** Familiarity with collaborating on privacy, security, data access, and evaluation considerations when deploying AI solutions. Whether you are self\-taught, a recent graduate or an experienced vibe coder, we care more about what you can build than your formal credentials.
