jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Applied AI
jobs.description: **About Norm** Norm builds AI\-native professional services firms and the technology that powers them. Our mission is to help expert professionals deliver better work at greater scale. Developing the technology and the firms together lets us rethink how work gets done, how teams operate and what clients can expect. Professional judgment and experience guide what we build, while advances in the technology expand what our firms can deliver. Our shared agentic platform connects that progress across teams and services. Founded in 2023, Norm brings together experts across engineering, research, product, design and professional practice. Our legal and compliance platform serves institutions representing more than $35 trillion in combined assets under management. Norm also powers Norm Law, LLP, an affiliated AI\-native law firm whose attorneys advise leading institutions on complex corporate matters. **AI Fluency:** Norm prefers all team members to be fluent in AI. Successful candidates actively use AI in their day\-to\-day work to support thinking, creation, and problem\-solving. They use it to improve the quality and speed of their work and to continuously refine how work gets done end\-to\-end. Candidates should be prepared to demonstrate and discuss their AI usage throughout the interview process, including concrete examples of tools, workflows, and outcomes. We look for practical, hands\-on experience, not theoretical familiarity. **This Role** ------------- Applied AI builds Norm’s frontier AI products in close partnership with the people who use them. As an Engineering Manager, you’ll lead 4–8 engineers across one or two teams building AI agents for expert work. Your team works directly with attorneys at Norm Law and with enterprise clients, and you’re responsible for what it ships, how it ships, and how the people on it grow. This is a player\-coach role, with roughly half your time on people management and half on technical contribution, project coordination and delivery. You’ll remain close to production code, agent architectures and evaluations. **How You’ll Work** ------------------- The Applied AI team brings together full\-stack engineering, product and AI deployment experience. We work on the most difficult and valuable applications of AI to legal practice, including diligence, contract review, and fund formation, combining research, evaluations and product engineering across the full development cycle. You’ll work with Norm Law partners and associates: scoping products, reviewing live output and turning expert feedback into the next release. We start with a focused problem, build a high\-performing AI solution, then generalize what works. You’ll coordinate rollout plans with Engineering, Product and Design, work closely with the research team, and help other engineering managers develop through mentorship. **You Will** ------------ * Build a team that works hand in hand with attorneys. Set up the team so attorney judgment shapes product decisions, test sets and release gates from the start. * Build agent systems for document\-heavy expert work, including multi\-agent orchestration, ingestion and retrieval over large document sets, tool\-using agents with deterministic checks, and the evaluation infrastructure behind them. * Own the path from prototype to production. Get early versions in front of attorneys within weeks, measure how they use them, and decide with evidence whether to keep investing. * Contribute technically through production code, code review, architecture decisions, project coordination and execution. * Turn recurring patterns, such as document ingestion, an agent harness or a review interface, into shared components the rest of Norm’s engineering organization can build on. * Hire, coach and develop engineers through regular feedback, clear expectations and opportunities to grow. * Coordinate project delivery and rollout plans across teams, raising risks early and keeping commitments grounded in evidence. **Skills \& Experience \- Core** -------------------------------- * You are currently an engineering manager with at least 3 years of experience managing engineers, ideally on applied AI, forward\-deployed or product teams that shipped to demanding customers. * You still build. You can review production code, assess an agent architecture and tell a weak evaluation from a strong one. * You have taken software from early prototypes into production and can explain the technical and delivery decisions you owned. * You are steady in front of customers. You stay calm when stakes are high and raise risks before they turn into surprises. * You develop people. You have hired strong engineers and given them feedback they could act on the same week. * You collaborate effectively with technical and non\-technical experts and turn their judgment into practical product and engineering decisions. **Skills \& Experience \- Pluses** ---------------------------------- * Experience building and evaluating LLM\-backed products, agent systems or document\-heavy workflows. * Experience in legal, financial services or another regulated industry. You do not need a legal background; the team’s legal engineers and attorneys bring the domain expertise. * Experience generalizing successful product patterns into reusable components across teams. **What Success Looks Like \- 90 Days** -------------------------------------- * You understand your team’s products, architecture and attorney workflows, and have contributed to a shipped release. * You have clear priorities and a working delivery and feedback cadence with your engineers, attorney partners and peer managers. * Your team uses attorney\-reviewed examples and evaluations to guide product decisions and release readiness. * Your engineers have clear expectations and regular coaching, and you have identified the most important delivery and team\-development priorities. **Compensation and Benefits** ----------------------------- **Base salary:** $275,000 \- $325,000 per year The range displayed in this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salary for this position. Within the range, individual pay is determined by various factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. **Equity:** Included **Benefits:** 401(k) with employer match, health, dental, vision coverage, unlimited paid time off, free lunch in office daily, employee referral bonus program **Relocation:** **\[If applicable]** For candidates needing to relocate to NYC, we provide relocation reimbursement. **Work Location** ----------------- **Location**: New York City (One World Trade) **Work** **model**: Hybrid **In\-office expectation**: 3–4 days per week To learn more about Norm, visit our **website**.

jobs.title: Senior IT Systems Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About Northbeam** Northbeam is building the world's most advanced marketing intelligence platform, providing top eCommerce brands a unified view of their business data through powerful attribution modeling and customizable dashboards. Our technology helps customers accurately track ad spend, understand the full customer journey, and drive profitable growth. Machine learning has been at the heart of Northbeam since day one: our full suite of measurement, spanning multi\-touch attribution, MMM\+, and incrementality, is built on it, along with laser\-accurate first\-party data. Now we're taking that foundation further, using AI to help brands operationalize their data and turn Northbeam insights into automated decisions. We're experiencing rapid growth, have strong product\-market fit, and are looking for the right people to help us scale. This is a rare chance to make a meaningful impact at a fast\-moving, high\-growth company. At Northbeam, you'll join a team of driven, collaborative, and talented individuals who value personal growth and excellence. We'd love for you to be part of our journey. We're a remote\-friendly company with physical offices in San Francisco and Los Angeles. ### **About the Role** Northbeam is hiring a Senior IT Systems Engineer. We run lean; you will be the company's first dedicated IT hire and own internal IT end\-to\-end. You'll set up the systems, policies, and automations that let a 100\-person team stay productive, secure, and moving fast. Northbeam invests heavily in AI tooling across the company; you will be part of the core group that administers and shapes how we use platforms like Claude, ChatGPT, and Glean — including building automations with tools like n8n and establishing guardrails for AI use. This is a high\-autonomy role for someone who's comfortable with ambiguity, can prioritize ruthlessly, and gets energy from building things that didn't exist before. ### **Your Impact** * You own Northbeam's IT function end\-to\-end: the systems, processes, and standards that keep a 100\-person team productive and secure. * Every employee gets a smooth, reliable onboarding on day one and a clean offboarding on their last day. You define and iterate on the process, increasingly automating it over time. * You'll own device management: streamline the procurement process for new hires, manage upgrade requests, and decommission dated laptops for a primarily remote team. You manage Jamf, and all the policies, upgrades, exceptions, and so on. You ensure that endpoint security and MDM run smoothly in the background. * Employees will know exactly where to go for IT help, get fast answers, and increasingly solve their own problems through self\-service resources and automation or bots you've built. * IT is a strong contributor to Northbeam's security and compliance posture, partnering with engineering and leadership on the controls and processes that make audits straightforward * The company's SaaS spend is intentional and visible. You own the tool inventory (including renewal and user/seat management), new software request processes and review procedures, eliminate redundancy where it appears, and manage the IT budget. * IT decisions are documented and consistent — policies (acceptable use, BYOD, password, incident response) exist, are followed, and evolve as the company grows * The LA and SF offices have the network and AV infrastructure they need, with you dropping in occasionally to handle what can't be solved remotely ### **What You Bring** * 7\+ years of experience in IT systems administration, with at least one role where you built or significantly overhauled an IT function * Experience as the sole or first IT hire at a company of 50–200 people * Deep knowledge of Google Workspace administration and identity management * Strong experience with MDM platforms (Jamf preferred) and endpoint security tooling * Ability to design and implement automated workflows for onboarding/offboarding across both business and engineering systems * Hands\-on experience with AI platforms (Claude, ChatGPT, Glean, or similar) — not just as a user but as a builder of tools and an administrator managing rollout, permissions, and policies * A builder's instinct for automation: you reach for n8n, scripting, or AI\-assisted workflows before you reach for a spreadsheet * Technical enough to collaborate directly with infrastructure engineers on automation, tooling, and systems integration — you don't need to be a software engineer, but you need to speak the language * Familiarity with compliance frameworks (SOC 2 in particular) and what IT controls look like in practice * Excellent judgment about what to fix now vs. later — you'll inherit a long list and need to sequence it well * Strong communication skills — you'll work with everyone from engineers to execs to new hires on their first day ### **Bonus Skills \& Experience** * Experience developing AI usage policies or acceptable use guidelines for an organization * Familiarity with engineering tooling: GitHub orgs, AWS/GCP IAM, CI/CD access controls * Scripting skills (Python, Bash, PowerShell) for automation * Experience with SaaS procurement, vendor negotiations, and contract management * Experience running periodic access audits and producing compliance reports * Experience managing office network infrastructure (Meraki, Ubiquiti, or similar) Actual compensation may vary based on experience, skills, and location. In addition to your base salary, we offer an equity package, comprehensive healthcare benefits (medical, dental, and vision), and a 401(k) plan. Our team enjoys a flexible PTO policy, 12 company\-paid holidays, and 12 weeks of paid parental leave. We also provide a $500 work\-from\-home stipend to support your remote setup. **Interview Process** The interview process varies by role but typically begins with a 30\-minute interview with a Northbeam recruiter, followed by a video interview with the hiring manager. Next, candidates complete a role\-specific video interview followed by video or onsite interviews with several team members. The final step is a video interview with our CEO/Co\-founder. The entire interview process is usually 5\-7 interviews total and requires around 5\-8 hours of your time. We accept applications on an ongoing basis.

jobs.title: ML Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Opportunity** **About the Institute** Do you want to be part of an exciting new Institute focused on combining human and machine intelligence into working AI solutions? We are building a pioneering research and innovation hub in AI—one that will shape the way humans and machines collaborate for decades to come. Led by Prof. Samuel V. Scarpino, the Institute for Experiential AI is built around the challenges and opportunities made possible by human\-machine collaboration. The Institute provides a framework to design, implement, and scale AI\-driven technologies in ways that make a true difference to society. Our ability to respond to the opportunities afforded to society will depend on training and building a workforce that is AI\-capable and prosperous. Founded in 1898, Northeastern is a global research university and the recognized leader in experience\-driven lifelong learning. Our world\-renowned experiential approach empowers our students, faculty, alumni, and partners to create impact far beyond the confines of discipline, degree, and campus. **The Culture** Here at the Institute for Experiential AI (EAI) we are committed to the highest standards in all we do. Working at the EAI offers opportunities, an environment, and a culture that just isn’t found together anywhere else. This is the right place for you if you’re curious, motivated by the future of technology, and want to be part of a unique and diverse community that works on high\-impact research, educational, business, and societal problems. **Position Summary** Northeastern University's Institute for Experiential AI is opening an ML engineer with special focus on physical AI systems, knowledge aggregation and AI for control and optimization for a DOE Genesis project led by Dr. Ayan Paul. The ML Engineer will be based at the Boston campus, MA, conduct applied research, prepare work for submission to journal/conference publications, and contribute to extramural funding applications. The ML Engineer will work on projects that will include developing AI models for signal processing. Participation in this project will include scientific programming, data analysis, training AI models, manuscript preparation, meeting with collaborators, mentoring graduate students, etc. About the project: CLARA (Cognitive Layered Agentic Reasoning for ARIS) is a three\-year, Genesis Mission Phase II project led by Northeastern University with MSU/FRIB and Gravitate AI. It will build an agentic AI system for operating the Advanced Rare Isotope Separator (ARIS) at FRIB. ARIS operations are limited by the gap between LISE\+\+ simulations and observed beam behavior. As a result, weekly beam development takes 16 to 24 hours, about half of which goes to manual isotope calibration. Planning a new experiment takes about 20 days, and no predictive monitoring exists for roughly 200 time\-correlated machine parameters. CLARA addresses this with three objectives: * **Planning and tuning.** Bayesian optimization uses LISE\+\+ as a physics\-informed prior, alongside paired forward and inverse neural surrogates trained on simulation and EPICS archive data. These power a Planning Agent for non\-experts and an Expert Tuning Agent. * **Calibration.** Diffeomorphic image registration maps simulated particle identification (PID) distributions to measured ones from a single measurement. * **Monitoring and knowledge.** Quickest Change Detection models (classical CuSum and a transformer\-based DeepQCD) and a hazardous\-configuration classifier make up a Safety Agent with gated beam\-interrupt authority. A Critic module commits validated tunes to a knowledge graph built with eGoT. The targets are reducing experiment planning time to 1 to 2 days, beam development time to about 4 hours, and thus facilitating 500 to 800 extra beam hours per year. The project aims to advance from TRL 3 to TRL 6–7 and to validate transfer to at least one non\-ARIS separator. The ML Engineer hired for this position will work with Benjamin Gyori at Khoury College, Deniz Erdogmus at the College of Engineering, and Ayan Paul at EAI and is expected to develop AI algorithms, RAG pipelines and agentic systems for the Genesis project, collaborate with the FRIB experiment at the Michigan State University and Gravitate AI. Qualifications * MS in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, or related fields or currently enrolled in a master’s program. * A minimum of 3\-4 years of experience working with ML/AI (TensorFlow/Pytorch) and ETL pipelines. * Proficiency in Python and R. Experienced with Unix and remote computing clusters. * Having experience in wrangling large datasets, building databases and ETL is preferred. * An ability to write clean and well\-documented code and work with GitHub repositories. * Experience in signal processing in the spaciotemporal domain. * Excellent organizational skills including attention to detail and multitasking. * An ability to troubleshoot and problem\-solve in response to challenges, especially, in an iar domain. Experience with AWS is a plus but not required. Experience with high performance computing is preferred. * Values \& Abilities: * Excellent written and verbal communication skills and ability to communicate effectively with a variety of different stakeholders from various academic backgrounds. * Respect for diversity and the importance of interdisciplinary teams. * Self\-starter and innovative thinker and a team\-player who can collaborate effectively in a university setting. Open\-minded, assertive, and professional when collaborating and working within our team and with other groups within Northeastern University, Harvard Medical School, and University of Virginia. * Key Responsibilities: The Data Science and Machine Learning Engineer will be responsible for a wide variety of data\-oriented tasks, including: * Building data preprocessing pipelines for ML/AI models (TensorFlow/Pytorch) for data from ARIS. * Training machine learning models for signal processing * Documenting the entire process and all the codes generated and maintaining structured and regular commits in a Github repository. * Write reports/prepare slide decks describing work performed. * Contribute to scientific manuscripts and grant proposals where appropriate. **Position Type** Temporary **Additional Information** Northeastern University considers factors such as candidate work experience, education and skills when extending an offer. Northeastern has a comprehensive benefits package for benefit eligible employees. This includes medical, vision, dental, paid time off, tuition assistance, wellness \& life, retirement\- as well as commuting \& transportation. Visit https://hr.northeastern.edu/benefits/ for more information. All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply and will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, age, sex, sexual orientation, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. This job is for a current or anticipated job vacancy. **Pay Rate:** $40/hour

You'll be the frontend specialist on a small, cross\-functional product team. You'll build new features, including AI\-powered ones, and modernize areas customers use every day. You care about the details users notice, like accessibility, performance and consistency, and you make the engineers around you better. Frontend is your specialty, but you're comfortable working in our C\#/.NET backend when a feature needs it. **What You'll Do** * Build product, end to end * Design, build and ship features in Vue 3 (Composition API) and TypeScript, from refinement through production * Turn designs into polished, accessible, responsive interfaces * Partner with product and design to shape requirements, think through edge cases, and break work into small increments that can ship on their own * Build user experiences for AI\-powered features (assistants, generated content, long\-running and streaming responses) that feel fast, clear and trustworthy * Make small backend changes when a feature calls for them, such as adding a field to a C\#/.NET API or adjusting an endpoint **Keep a large frontend modern and healthy** * Modernize established areas of the product with current patterns and components * Extend and improve our shared component library and design system, including complex components such as rich text editing * Make the frontend fast at scale, including for large organizations with a lot of data * Keep the frontend healthy through dependency upgrades and build and pipeline improvements **Champion frontend quality** * Help define, document and evolve frontend coding standards * Write tests at the right level (unit, component and end\-to\-end) as part of building each feature * Mentor other engineers through code review, pairing and shared knowledge **Build with AI** * Work with AI\-assisted development tools every day (we use Claude Code, PlayerZero and others), and help improve the rules and context that guide them in our codebase **What We're Looking For Required** * 7\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with most of the last several years focused on frontend development for large, production web applications * Deep, hands\-on expertise with Vue.js, including Vue 3 and the Composition API * Strong TypeScript and modern JavaScript, along with semantic HTML and CSS/SCSS * Experience designing component architecture, state management (Pinia, Vuex or similar) and routing for a large single\-page application * A working knowledge of accessibility standards (WCAG 2\.1 AA) and responsive design, and the habit of applying them by default * Experience testing frontend code with unit and component tests (Vitest, Jest or similar) and end\-to\-end tests (Playwright, Cypress or similar) * Comfort working outside the frontend: consuming and contributing to RESTful APIs, and reading and changing backend code, ideally C\#/.NET Daily use of AI\-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or similar) * Clear written and spoken communication, and comfort sharing a point of view in planning and design discussions **Preferred** * Experience with micro\-frontends or with multiple applications running inside one shared shell * Built or maintained a design system or component library, working closely with designers * Experience with rich text editing (TipTap, ProseMirror or similar) * Built frontends for LLM\-powered features, such as chat interfaces, streaming responses, or AI\-generated content * Experience with C\#/.NET Core, Azure and Azure DevOps * Visual regression testing, frontend performance profiling, or real\-user monitoring (Datadog RUM or similar) * Security\-minded frontend habits for sensitive data, such as XSS prevention and careful auth and session handling * Enterprise B2B SaaS experience **Competencies** * Accountability * Adaptability * AI Curiosity / Innovation * Applied Learning * Business Acumen * Collaboration * Customer Focus * Dealing with Ambiguity * Decision Making * Driving for Results * Initiating Action * Technical / Professional Knowledge **About the Company:** Boards set the standard for what organizations can achieve. At OnBoard, our board management software helps boards function at a higher level so every organization can make a bigger difference in the world. Launched in 2011, today, OnBoard serves as the board intelligence platform for more than 5,000 organizations and their 12,000 boards and committees in 60 countries worldwide. With customers in higher education, nonprofit, healthcare systems, government, and enterprise business, OnBoard is the leading board management provider. OnBoard has grown from a class project at Purdue University in West Lafayette, Indiana in 2003 into the world's leading board management software platform today. Backed by JMI Equity and the acquisitions of eScribe and Govenda, OnBoard is positioned to become the industry leader in Board Management and Meeting Solutions for private and public sector entities. **Benefits and Perks:** * Fully remote work with company provided equipment (laptop, software, etc.) * Employment with a growing, casual, fun, philanthropic minded company * US Based Employees + Comprehensive, high\-quality medical/prescription drug plan options, as well as dental and vision plan offerings. + An employer contribution to your Health Savings Account (HSA) if you participate in a High Deductible Healthcare Plan. + Medical Flexible Spending Accounts available. + Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts available. + Basic life insurance in the amount of $50,000 or 1 X's your salary (whichever is higher). + Short and long\-term disability and Accidental Death and Dismemberment benefits at no cost to you. + 401K Retirement Savings Plan with automatic enrollment at the first of the month following 60 days of employment at 5% to help you secure your financial freedom. We offer a generous company match that starts on the first of the month following 60 days of employment. The company match is dollar for dollar on the first 3% of your pay that you contribute and $0\.50 on the dollar on the next 2%, for a total match of 4%. + Paid Time Off (PTO)/Holiday * CAN Based Employees + Employer paid Life and Accidental Death Insurance + Contribution to Health Care Spending Account + Dependent Life Insurance + Optional Life Insurance + LTD Insurance + Drug and Paramedical Coverage + Dental Insurance + Vision Insurance + EAP * AUS Based employees + Superannuation rate of 12% + Monthly stipend of $400 AUD to purchase private medical insurance * UK Based Employees (via EPG) + Pension \- Aegon - Passageways/OnBoard contributes 8% of the employee's basic salary - Employees can contribute up to 100% of salary subject to max limits - Enrolled from Day 1 of employment + Private Medical Insurance + Life Assurance + Income Protection + Critical Illness + Employee Assistance Programme + Serious Illness Benefit + Help@Hand + Cashplan **Diversity Statement \- Culture of Togetherness:** At OnBoard, our mission is to encourage and celebrate a culture of togetherness. Our power is in our people and we Pledge 1% to give back to our communities and across the globe. OnBoard is an equal opportunity employer and committed to a diverse and inclusive working environment. jobs.title: Sr. Data Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: Manages and evolves the enterprise data lake and data warehouse while ensuring the reliable, secure, and efficient flow of high\-quality data. Implements data processes, managing data architecture, designing ETL processes, and analyzing data for business insights. Responsibilities: * Design, implement and maintain scalable data pipnes on WS using S3, DMS, Glue, lambda, step function/MWAA \& Redshift. * Develop robust batch and near\-real\-time ETL/ELT workflow to ingest, cleanse, transform and load data from databases, legacy applications and event streams using Python \& Pyspark. * Design incremental/CDC mechanism, including restart ability, idempotency, duplicate handling and recovery. * Implement automated controls for completeness, accuracy, reconciliation, schema changes \& lineage. * Optimize Glue/Spark, Athena, Redshift \& S3 workload through partitioning, columnar formats, query tuning and appropriate storage/compute design. * Design near real time/event\-driven pipelines using Kinesis/Kafka where required, covering ordering, retry, idempotency and failure recovery. * Implement AWS data security, least privilege access, data classification and governance controls. * Monitor pipelines such as CloudWatch, troubleshoot failure and resolving production data incidents. * Enforce Git/version control, code review, automated testing and CI/CD practices. * Work with product owners, architect, reporting and business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable data solutions. * Document pipelines and operational procedures. Qualifications: **Qualifications Required*** Bachelor's degree in a computer\-related field from an accredited college or university and five (5\) or more years of experience in data engineering, building scalable and distributed ETL data pipelines in enterprise environments. * Experience building and operating scalable AWS\-based data platforms and pipelines using services including Lambda, Glue, Athena, S3, Redshift, DMS, MWAA (Airflow), and Step Functions, supporting batch, CDC, and near real\-time data processing. * Advanced proficiency in Python, SQL, and PySpark with hands\-on experience developing reusable ETL/ELT frameworks, data warehouses, data marts, and integrations across databases, APIs, event streams, and analytics environments. * Experience implementing data quality, governance, and optimization best practices, including automated validation frameworks, Lake Formation and Glue Data Catalog, performance tuning, and cost optimization across AWS data services. * Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex data concepts for business stakeholders; experience in healthcare, life sciences, and other highly regulated environments with HIPAA, GDPR, FDA, or similar compliance requirements preferred. * Experience with metadata management, data lineage, data observability, master data management, or enterprise data catalog solutions. * Knowledge with data modeling \& analytical data model, schema design, schema evolution, and data structure optimized for reporting and analytics. * Knowledge of data lake and data warehouse architecture include data partitioning and columnar storage format such as Parquet. * Relevant AWS certification, such as AWS Certified Data Engineer – Associate, or an equivalent cloud or data engineering certification. **WORKING CONDITIONS** * Flexible work hours in fun collaborative environment * Working remote requires a reliable internet connection * Must have the ability to travel, as needed for company meetings

jobs.title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: **About the role** Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is seeking a Principal Software Engineer to build a new Data Processing Unit (DPU) platform spanning networking and storage. You will solve problems involving packet processing, host\-to\-DPU data movement, concurrency, and predictable performance under congestion and resource pressure. You will be the technical owner of a substantial component: its architecture, interfaces, implementation, performance, and operational readiness. Starting from broad requirements, you will resolve design choices and drive delivery with partner engineers. You will propose changes that cross component boundaries and align them with subsystem owners. Deep networking expertise is essential; storage familiarity is required and substantial storage experience is especially valuable. **What you will do** * **Own component architecture and delivery.** Translate broad requirements into a component design and executable milestones. Make architectural and implementation decisions within agreed subsystem boundaries and carry the work through production. * **Design high\-performance data paths.** Build packet processing, network virtualization, forwarding, policy, or acceleration capabilities. Make deliberate choices about concurrency, buffering, memory ownership, and hardware interfaces. * **Define and coordinate interfaces.** Establish component contracts with networking, storage, firmware, and hardware partners. Resolve dependencies and drive integration; escalate tradeoffs that require subsystem\-wide decisions. * **Own component performance.** Define representative benchmarks and performance targets. Investigate throughput, tail latency, CPU utilization, and memory efficiency, validating improvements under load and resource pressure. * **Evaluate storage interactions.** Assess how component choices affect storage I/O performance, backpressure, and failure handling. Work with storage engineers to preserve correctness and reliable recovery. * **Deliver production readiness.** Own component instrumentation, fault handling, compatibility, and upgrade behavior. Drive qualification and operational improvements, including difficult cross\-layer debugging and production support. * **Guide engineers and engineering quality.** Mentor engineers, lead component design reviews, and establish useful tests and performance regression checks. Help feature owners make independent decisions within the architecture. * **Improve responsible AI practices.** Validate AI\-assisted work and help the team adopt effective coding, testing, debugging, and documentation practices. Reduce repetitive work while preserving quality, accountability, and a sustainable engineering experience. **Required qualifications** =========================== * 8\+ years of professional software engineering experience in systems or infrastructure software, including substantial hands\-on experience building high\-performance networking data planes. * Demonstrated ownership of substantial component architecture and delivery from broad requirements through production. * Deep experience implementing or optimizing packet processing systems, with strong knowledge of network virtualization, forwarding, encapsulation, and traffic management. * Strong C or C\+\+ proficiency and Linux systems knowledge, including concurrency, memory management, multicore processing, and performance profiling. * Familiarity with storage architectures and data paths, and ability to evaluate how component choices affect storage performance and failure handling. * Ability to diagnose complex correctness or performance issues across software layers using measurements and repeatable experiments. * Experience defining interfaces, coordinating technical dependencies, and owning component performance and operational readiness. * Clear design communication and experience mentoring engineers through reviews, implementation, and debugging. * A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. **Preferred qualifications** ============================ Experience in one or more of the following areas is valuable. Experience with every listed technology is not required. * **Packet processing.** DPDK or comparable user\-space frameworks; virtual switching, connection tracking, policy enforcement, or offload implementation. * **DPU acceleration.** DPUs, SmartNICs, AMD Pensando, NVIDIA BlueField/DOCA, P4, or comparable technologies. * **Storage.** Substantial storage development experience; block storage, NVMe, NVMe over Fabrics, RDMA, or storage virtualization. * **Hardware and production.** PCIe, DMA, SR\-IOV, IOMMU, zero\-copy techniques, hardware co\-design, staged deployments, fault injection, or upgrade compatibility. **What success looks like** =========================== You will deliver a critical component with a clear architecture, stable interfaces, and demonstrated performance and reliability. You will independently resolve component\-level decisions, coordinate integration, and help engineers deliver within that architecture. **Why join us** =============== Shape a new platform through architectural ownership of a critical component. You will make consequential software and hardware tradeoffs, partner with experienced networking and storage engineers, and carry your designs from exploration into production.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Voice AI
jobs.description: **About Owner** Owner is the AI\-native system local business owners use to succeed, starting with restaurants. We’re building the system that replaces the many tools owners use to run their business. It powers everything from the restaurant’s website, online ordering, CRM, POS, and more. **Product philosophy** Most small business software makes owners do the work to get what they want: sales growth and profit growth. Owner does the work for them agentically. Our system drives demand, converts it, and helps operators run their business day to day. As it improves, the business improves with it. Using Owner should feel like having a team of great operators, engineers, and marketers working for you. **Our vision** We’re starting by helping independent restaurants succeed online. But it’s not just restaurants that need our help. Most local businesses are struggling with these same problems. Huge technology corporations are taking their customers, bleeding their profits, and making it hard for them to survive. Once we nail the solution for restaurants – we’ll scale it into every other local business type. In the future we envision, tens of millions of local business owners will use our technology to succeed in the digital age. **Our traction** Since 2020, we've generated tens of millions in revenue and processed over a billion dollars of online orders. 1 in 5 Americans have used an Owner.com website. More importantly, we’ve helped over 20,000 restaurant owners, and saved them nearly $200 million in fees. **Our team** Our team is now in the low hundreds. We’ve got top talent from the most successful companies in SMB software, including: Shopify, HubSpot, DoorDash, ServiceTitan, Rappi, Faire and Stripe. We’ll be scaling even faster in 2026 to keep pace with our customer growth. **Where we work** Owner is a remote\-first, global company headquartered in San Francisco, with a sales hub in Toronto. For a few of our roles we prioritize in\-person collaboration at one of our office locations. Most of our teammates are distributed throughout the globe. Please review the role description and discuss with your recruiter for more details on location! **Role Overview** The Voice AI team builds the AI that answers a restaurant's phone. When a guest calls, our agent picks up, takes a pickup order validated against the live menu, answers questions about hours and the restaurant, and sends the order straight to the kitchen, or hands the call to staff when a person is the better answer. We also build the tooling that lets restaurants go live without an engineer in every launch. If a restaurant joins Owner, our team is how its phone turns into orders and revenue instead of missed calls, and how guests get what they need while staff stay focused on service. This is not a typical backend or ML role. Real\-time voice is unforgiving: a guest on the line notices every extra half\-second, every interruption handled badly, and every wrong modifier. The team works across streaming speech and LLM pipelines, telephony, turn\-taking, and recovery when speech, model, or network services fail mid\-call, and we measure quality on real calls, not demos. We're scaling well beyond our first live restaurants, and we automate everything we can, including with AI. As the Engineering Manager, you'll lead this team and own its delivery and technical direction. You'll build a team that ships quickly with a high bar for quality, and you'll own hiring, coaching, career development, and performance management. Your scope spans the real\-time voice experience, the systems that connect conversations to restaurant menus and ordering, and the tooling and engineering support that help restaurants launch and run reliably. This role is 100% remote and can be based anywhere in the United States or Canada. For San Francisco\-based candidates: we have a new HQ in the Presidio for optional in\-person collaboration. **Why we’re looking for you** Owner helps independent restaurants grow their business. The phone is still how a huge share of restaurant orders start, and too many of those calls go unanswered or get passed to a busy host. Our voice agents answer those calls, take orders, and help guests get what they need while restaurant staff focus on service. Real restaurants are already using it, and the product has proven the idea. The next challenge is scale. Improving call quality, making onboarding self\-serve, and keeping the agent reliable across more restaurants takes dedicated engineering leadership. Today, voice delivery, technical direction, and engineering support are spread across existing leads. We're hiring an Engineering Manager to own them, grow the team, and set the bar for how we build real\-time voice AI at Owner. **Our Tech Stack** * Voice \& Real\-time: LiveKit, Gemini, streaming STT/LLM/TTS pipelines, full call lifecycle persisted * Agents \& AI: Vercel AI SDK, tool calling, agent loops, conversation state * Backend: Node.js, TypeScript, MongoDB, PostgreSQL * Frontend \& Tooling: React, TypeScript, restaurant onboarding and launch tooling * Observability \& Evals: Datadog, Braintrust, LangSmith, call replay and regression testing **The impact you'll have** * Lead, hire, and grow the Voice AI team. Give direct feedback, support career growth, manage performance, and help engineers take ownership of systems and outcomes. * Set technical direction and turn product goals into focused plans. Partner with Product, Design, and Customer Success to prioritize work around restaurant needs and follow through from development to rollout. * Improve the conversation experience: response latency, turn\-taking, interruptions, and recovery when speech, model, or telephony services fail. * Make phone ordering dependable. Help the team handle menu options and modifiers, validate orders, prevent duplicate submissions, and hand calls off to restaurant staff when needed. * Establish quality measures grounded in real calls. Use call reviews, automated evaluations, and regression testing to improve order accuracy, task completion, and reliability as models and prompts change. * Own the team's production operations and engineering support. Build clear escalation paths, on\-call practices, and incident follow\-through, and turn recurring customer issues into product improvements. * Scale restaurant onboarding and launch tooling so more restaurants can go live with less manual engineering work. **What we’re looking for** * Experience managing software engineers, with ownership of hiring, coaching, career development, and performance. You can build trust, rally a team around a goal, and help experienced engineers do their best work. * A strong software engineering background and recent hands\-on work. You're comfortable setting architecture, contributing code, reviewing designs, and debugging across services. * Experience building and operating production voice AI or real\-time conversational systems, with depth in streaming speech pipelines or speech\-to\-speech models, telephony, latency, turn\-taking, and interruptions. * Experience with LLM tool calling, conversation state, and evaluations for systems whose responses vary. You can connect model behavior to whether a customer successfully completes a task. * Ownership of production reliability, including observability, incident response, and recovery from model, network, and downstream service failures. * Strong product judgment, clear communication, and a record of working closely with cross\-functional partners to ship useful products in a fast\-moving environment. **Compensation and benefits** * The estimated starting base salary range for this role is $240K\-$260K USD depending on level, location and experience, plus a generous pre\-IPO equity package. If you feel the range is too low, still please apply and let us know! * Other benefits include comprehensive health coverage, work from anywhere (remote\-first workplace), unlimited PTO \- plus extra fun perks! **Notice \- Employment Scams** Communication from our team regarding job opportunities will only be made by an Owner team member with an @owner.com email address. We do not conduct interviews over email or chat platforms, and we will never ask you to provide personal or financial information such as your mailing address, social security number, credit card numbers or banking information. If you believe you are being contacted by a scammer, please mark the communication as "phishing" or “spam” and do not respond. \#LI\-AB1

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, FeedForward 3D/4D Reconstruction
jobs.description: At Parallel Domain, we believe that autonomous systems – from self\-driving cars to contactless delivery drones – have the opportunity to drastically improve the quality of life for billions of people. That is why we love what we do: enabling our customers to develop their technology safely using the Parallel Domain data generation platform. Our platform revolutionizes the way our customers generate sensor data for AI development. We're looking for people like you to join us in pushing the boundaries of artificial intelligence and synthetic data.**About the role** ------------------ Before any physical AI system is trusted in the real world, it has to prove itself in ours. Parallel Domain turns real captured drives into faithful digital replicas — geometry, appearance and motion that perception stacks are trained and validated against. We are hiring a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to push our feed\-forward reconstruction stack forward — from static 3D toward full 4D scenes over time. You will join a small, deep team where your technical judgment carries real weight from day one, and your work will ship in a pipeline customers depend on. ### **What You'll Do** * **Advance our feed\-forward reconstruction models**. Improve how we predict geometry, camera pose and appearance from real capture with transformer\-based models, and extend it from static scenes to dynamic 4D. * **Train at scale**. Run multi\-node GPU training on large multi\-view and video datasets, and decide what to scale, what to ablate and when a result is real. * **Define what "good" means**. Build evaluation the team trusts for reconstruction quality, temporal consistency and geometric accuracy. * **Explore stronger priors**. Investigate where generative models, such as pre\-trained video diffusion, can help fill gaps the capture did not see. * **Land research in the product**. Work with the pipeline engineers to get results into production, and care whether they hold up there. * **Track the field**. This area moves monthly; form a view on where it is heading and argue for it. ### **What we're looking for** * **Hands\-on feed\-forward reconstruction experience**. You have built or trained feedforward 3D reconstruction models (for example in the lineage of DUSt3R, VGGT, π³ or D4RT), and you know where they work and where they break. * **A track record of models others relied on**. We weight demonstrated depth over years served : a recent PhD with the right focus and an experienced research engineer are both credible here. * **Large\-scale trainin**g. Practical experience with multi\-node, multi\-GPU training and telling a promising run from a stalled one early. * **Strong PyTorch skills** in a large shared codebase with real build and CI. * **Research judgment**. You turn an ambiguous direction into experiments that resolve something, and change your mind when the numbers say so. * **Clear communication** with researchers, pipeline engineers and leadership alike. ### **Strong pluses** These are listed in order of how much they matter to us. * **Feed\-forward Gaussian prediction**. Experience predicting 3D Gaussians directly from images in a single pass, rather than fitting them per scene. * **Top\-tier publications in feed\-forward reconstruction**. First\-author or significant work at CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICLR or SIGGRAPH in this area. * **Video diffusion models**. Familiarity with diffusion or flow\-matching video models, especially camera\-conditioned generation. * **Dynamic scenes**. Work on dynamic reconstruction, scene flow or temporal consistency. * **Real\-world capture**. Experience with automotive, robotics or drone data and its mess: imperfect calibration, motion blur, poses you cannot trust. * **Making big models fast, or open\-source contributions** to widely used reconstruction libraries. €120,000 \- €170,000 a year Fully remote within Europe. The team works on Central European hours, with regular overlap with North America. **Why join Parallel Domain?** We are assembling a team of creative, talented visionaries seeking to build a new technology that will change the world. You will be able to learn, build, and scale our team and technology in a collaborative, creative culture that values every team member. To attract and inspire the right talent, we offer:* Competitive compensation (range will be openly discussed early in our interview process) * Employer\-paid supplemental medical, mental health, dental, and vision benefits. * Flexible paid vacation, sick time, winter shutdown, and 11\+ holidays per year * Paid parental leave * Equipment budget to optimize your setup * Annual learning and development stipend Parallel Domain celebrates diversity and is committed to creating a safe and inclusive environment for all our people. We are committed to providing employees with an environment free of discrimination, bullying and harassment. All employment decisions at Parallel Domain are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications. We will maintain our commitment to and support of equal employment opportunity for all individuals without regard to race, national/ethnic origin, colour, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, marital status, family status, genetic characteristics or physical/mental disability. Our commitment extends to any other protected classes which may exist under applicable law. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross\-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross\-border trade. Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. jobs.title: Director, AI Quality, Evaluation & Observability Engineering
jobs.description: ### **Why Patients Need You** Pfizer's Commercial organization is putting GenAI and AI agents into work that shapes how medicines reach patients, from content creation and review to field and customer engagement. If we can't show that these systems are accurate, safe and behaving as intended, they don't belong in production. You will build the engineering capability that lets Pfizer prove it, before release and every day after. ### **What You Will Achieve** You will own the evaluation and observability capability for AI solutions across the Commercial portfolio, and you will be accountable for the Commercial AI evaluation and observability standards: the metrics, thresholds and technical criteria that inform production\-readiness and ongoing monitoring decisions. You will build shared tooling, datasets and metrics that let product teams measure quality, safety and performance consistently, catch regressions before release, and detect drift and failures in production. You will set your team's priorities and decide where its engineering capacity goes across the portfolio. Success means teams evaluate through your platform by default, release decisions rest on evidence, and production AI issues are caught by monitoring before users or auditors find them. ### **How You Will Achieve It** * Build and run a shared evaluation platform for GenAI and agentic solutions. It covers offline test suites, regression testing in CI/CD, LLM\-as\-judge and rubric\-based scoring, and structured human review workflows. * Set the Commercial AI evaluation and observability standards, including metrics for accuracy, groundedness, hallucination, safety, bias, robustness and task success and the minimum monitoring every production AI solution must have. jobs.title: Senior Manager, AI Engineer – Applied Intelligence
jobs.description: **ROLE SUMMARY** Applied Intelligence is the zero\-to\-one function of Pfizer’s commercial data science organization. It takes ambiguous, high\-value AI and machine learning problems in the commercial business, proves whether they can be solved and whether solving them is worth it, builds the first working version to production standards, and graduates it to the product team that will own and scale it. First versions are built to be understood, reproduced, and extended by teams who did not write them. As a Senior Manager, AI Engineer, you build the systems behind those first versions: the services, pipelines, agent runtimes, and data contracts that turn a proven idea into something that runs, can be trusted, and can be handed over. Current priorities include agentic decision systems that choose which healthcare professionals and consumers to reach, through which channels, and when. These systems take in new data as it arrives, keep track of what has happened and what is still pending, reason over the options, act through channels such as field teams, email, and digital media, and check whether the action worked. Large language models and agents are part of the design where their cost is justified, machine learning models carry the stable, well\-defined parts of the problem, and much of the work is careful software and data engineering. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role with informal technical leadership. You will own the architecture of a first\-version system or a major component of one, set the engineering bar through code review and example, and write much of the core code yourself. The role supports US commercial use cases, building capabilities designed to extend to International as they graduate into products. **ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES** * **System design —** Own the architecture of a first\-version decision system or a major component of it: the data model, service boundaries, agent and tool interfaces, and behavior when things fail. Design so new channels, audiences, and signals can be added with little rework, and write down the decisions and the trade\-offs behind them. * **Agentic systems in production —** Build components on large language models with structured outputs, tool use, orchestration across multi\-step workflows, memory and state, and evaluation and guardrails appropriate for a regulated environment. Manage their cost, latency, and quality, and make every automated decision traceable: the data it used, the reasoning and logic that ran, and the action that followed. * **Hands\-on delivery —** Build services, pipelines, and workflow orchestration, mostly in Python, writing much of the core code personally. Build reliability in from the start, with safe retries, clear handling of partial failures, and the ability to replay past data through a new version of the system. * **Data \& decision records —** Own the pipelines and data contracts the system depends on, from upstream data platforms to the channels that act on decisions. Integrate with de\-identification and access controls for patient and consumer data. * **Models in production —** Work with data scientists to put machine learning models and decision logic into production, review the statistical assumptions behind them, and build the monitoring that surfaces drift and degradation before they matter. * **Engineering judgment —** Calibrate rigor to the cost of being wrong now and the cost of fixing later. Apply full validation wherever errors carry real consequences, and run the systems you build with monitoring, alerting, and safe release of changes. * **Graduation —** Build so the receiving product team can own the system: tests, documentation, environments, and a structured handoff covering dependencies, which contracts cannot change without discussion, and what was deliberately left unfinished. Turn what works into shared components and documented patterns that the next first version starts from. * **Engineering standards \& partners —** Set standards for testing, continuous integration and deployment, environments, observability, and documentation. Review external partner engineering work against those standards and own how it fits into the system. * **Technical leadership \& mentoring —** Mentor engineers and data scientists on software and AI engineering practice, and raise the technical standard of the team through code review and example. **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS*** **Education \& experience —** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field with 6\+ years of relevant experience; OR a Master’s degree with 5\+ years of relevant experience; OR a PhD with 1\+ year of relevant experience. * **Production systems —** Has designed, shipped, and operated production systems with real reliability requirements, including owning the architecture of a system or a major component. * **Agentic \& LLM systems —** Hands\-on experience building production applications on ata analysis and sustained, detailed technical problem solving, including designing and interpreting statistical evaluations of models. jobs.title: Software Engineer II (BotStopper)
jobs.description: **Who We Are** -------------- Pindrop is a cybersecurity company delivering continuous identity verification across voice, video, and digital interactions. Powered by the Pindrop Intelligence Network, our unified trust platform helps enterprises answer three critical questions: **Is this identity synthetic?** Detect AI\-generated and manipulated voice and video. **Is this identity risky?** Identify fraud, suspicious behavior, and other risk signals. **Is this identity known?** Authenticate identities using voice, device, behavioral, and other signals. Pindrop brings this intelligence together across purpose\-built trust engines to help organizations make informed decisions in real time — protecting customers, workforce interactions, and emerging AI\-driven interactions. Pindrop protects billions of high\-risk interactions for enterprises, including leading financial institutions, insurers, and healthcare organizations. Its technology is informed by more than 8 billion real\-world interactions annually and protected by 300\+ patents. Recognized by TIME as one of the 10 Most Influential Software Companies of 2026 and by Inc. for Best in Business for Innovation, Pindrop is backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz, IVP, and CapitalG. ### ### **What you'll do** As a Software Engineer II on the BotStopper team, you will help build the cloud\-native services and machine learning inference infrastructure powering Pindrop BotStopper™\- our real\-time AI voice detection solution that helps enterprises distinguish human callers from automated interactions and recognize known registered AI voices. Built on Pindrop Pulse detection technology and supported by intelligence from the AI Voice Consortium (AIVC), BotStopper helps enterprises identify automated interactions, protect customer experiences, and respond to emerging AI\-driven challenges across contact centers. As a mid\-level individual contributor, you'll bring solid backend engineering experience, take end\-to\-end ownership of assigned features and components, and collaborate closely with Engineering, Research, Product, and SRE to transform emerging technologies into secure, scalable, production\-ready systems. *More specifically, you will:* * Develop, test, deploy, and monitor backend services and APIs supporting BotStopper's real\-time detection and scoring capabilities, ensuring low latency, scalability, and reliability. * Own the end\-to\-end delivery of assigned features and components from implementation and testing through production rollout and operational support. * Help develop backend capabilities supporting known\-AI\-voice identification, including integration with the AI Voice Consortium (AIVC) infrastructure. * Collaborate with Research to integrate detection models and ML\-driven signals into production workflows. * Actively participate in code reviews, sharing knowledge with peers and incorporating constructive feedback to improve code quality and maintainability. * Design and develop backend services and APIs that support integrations with IVR, Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS), telephony, and conversational AI platforms. * Support production operations through incident response, troubleshooting, and applying fixes to maintain system reliability. After an initial onboarding period of approximately three months, participate in the team's established on\-call rotation. * Utilize AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate engineering workflows, while responsibly validating generated code for correctness, security, and performance. ### **Who you are** * You maintain momentum when navigating partial requirements or production issues, recovering quickly from setbacks to continue delivering independently. * You share context, raise concerns constructively, and participate meaningfully in design and code review discussions with your peers. * You consistently deliver production\-ready services and APIs from start to finish, making sound engineering decisions based on available metrics and requirements. * You build trust by being transparent about progress, risks, and blockers, accurately representing work status and system behavior. * You use AI tools to accelerate development while thoughtfully reviewing and validating the output for correctness and security. ### **Your skill\-set** *Must Have:* * 2–5 years of professional software development experience, with a proven track record of shipping stable, secure code to production. * Deep proficiency in Go, Python, or comparable backend programming languages, with a strong grasp of data structures, algorithms, and concurrency patterns. * Strong Linux/Unix fundamentals and proficiency with Docker and container orchestration frameworks like Kubernetes. * Experience developing and operating cloud\-native applications using AWS, GCP, or comparable platforms. * Hands\-on experience with production data or messaging technologies such as PostgreSQL/Aurora, Redis, Kinesis, or similar systems. on under high\-volume production conditions. * Collaborate with experienced software engineers, research scientists, ML engineers, and product leaders who value thoughtful debate, technical depth, and continuous improvement. * Grow your career by learning to independently design solutions for complex problems and contributing to operational excellence, preparing you for the Senior Software Engineer level. * AI is changing both what we build and how we build it. You'll be encouraged to incorporate AI responsibly into your development workflow, experiment with emerging tools, and identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity and quality. ### **What we offer** As a part of Pindrop, you'll have a direct impact on our growing list of products and the future of security in the voice\-driven economy. We hire great people and take care of them. Here's a snapshot of the benefits we offer: * Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO) * Flexibility to work remotely from outside your country of residence for up to four weeks per year, subject to manager approval and applicable company policies. * Flexibility to work remotely from outside your country of residence for up to four weeks per year * Competitive compensation package, including RSUs (Restricted Stock Units) for all employees, so everyone shares in our long\-term success. * While we work flexibly, we prioritize meaningful in\-person moments through regular team on\-sites, company\-wide events, and intentional gatherings that foster connection, collaboration, and shared success. * Generous health and welfare plans to choose from \- including one employer\-paid "employee\-only" plan! * Best\-in\-class Health Savings Account (HSA) employer contribution * Low\-cost vision and dental plans for you and your family, providing comprehensive coverage and peace of mind. * Paid Parental Leave \- Including birth, adoptive \& foster parents * + One year of diaper delivery for your newest addition to the family! It's our way of welcoming new Pindroplets to the family! * Recurring monthly phone and internet allowance to help cover essential connectivity costs and support flexible work. * Enhanced fertility and GLP\-1 benefits to support family\-building journeys and personalized health needs. * Annual Learning \& Development stipend to support your professional growth, skill\-building, certifications, and continued education. \#LI\-Remote \#LI\-HB1 **Not sure if this is you?** ---------------------------- We want a diverse, global team, with a broad range of experience and perspectives. If this job sounds great, but you're not sure if you qualify, apply anyway! We carefully consider every application and will either move forward with you, find another team that might be a better fit, keep in touch for future opportunities, or thank you for your time. ### **AI \- A Transformative Force** At Pindrop, we view artificial intelligence as a transformative force that, when harnessed responsibly, can unlock unprecedented value for our customers, partners and society and enable and empower us to continue to deliver cutting\-edge technology to combat fraud and unblur the lines between what it means to be human versus machine. The AI tool may analyze your work experience and skills to assess fit for the role, but does not consider your name or contact details. Applications with the strongest match to job requirements are prioritized for human review; not all applications may be individually reviewed. ### **Pindrop is an Equal Opportunity Employer** Here at Pindrop, it is our mission to create and maintain a diverse and inclusive work environment. jobs.title: Software Engineer, PCA
jobs.description: **Job title:** Software Engineer, PCA **Reports to:** Team Lead, Engineering **Division:** Central Services **Location:** Alpharetta, GA/Remote US or Canada **Grade:** 19 **About Priority:** Priority Commerce is a leading financial technology company on a mission to deliver a personalized, easy\-to\-adopt financial toolset that accelerates cash flow and optimizes working capital for businesses. Our vision is to eliminate the barriers to unlocking revenue \- empowering businesses to grow faster and operate smarter. We achieve this through the Priority Commerce Engine, an innovative platform that combines payables, acquiring, and banking and treasury solutions. This unified approach allows businesses to streamline financial operations, reduce unnecessary costs, and uncover new revenue opportunities. At Priority Commerce, we're driven by results. We expect our people to ***be known for results*** \- bringing expertise, momentum, and relentless focus to every challenge, helping our clients and each other thrive. **About the Role:** We are building the next generation of financial management applications for the automotive vertical. We are a small, experienced team of agentic engineers, leading Priority's acceleration into AI\-native product development. You will work across the full stack: product features, the integrations that feed them, the platform and tooling underneath, and a share of your time on Priority's company\-wide AI transformation initiatives. **Responsibilities:** **What you will do*** Design, build and ship features end to end: back\-end services, APIs, front\-end screens, tests and deployment. * Build and maintain integrations with dealer management systems, banks and payment platforms through their supported APIs and partner programs. * Model and load operational data into our data platform with full change history. * Use AI coding agents daily, and help maintain the team's shared agent tooling and standards. * Contribute to internal AI initiatives such as evaluation tooling, internal assistants, and guardrails appropriate to a regulated financial company. * Participate in code review, sprint planning and production support. * Interface with customers, both remotely and on\-site, to gather feedback and improve our offerings. **How we work** You will help set the culture of a small team, so we are explicit about it:* **Own the outcome, not the ticket**. You ship it, watch it in production, and fix what breaks without being asked. * **Speed through judgment.** You decide quickly when something is reversible and slow down deliberately when it moves money or touches customer data. * **Say the hard thing early.** If a plan, a deadline or a design is wrong, you raise it before it costs us, including when it is your own work. * **Raise the bar for others.** You mentor through code review, write down decisions, and leave every system easier for the next engineer. * **Customer\-close**. You talk to dealers directly and build from what they actually do, not what we assume. **Security and compliance are part of the job*** We move money for businesses, so trust is the product. Here, that means: * You treat security as a design input. Least privilege, secrets management, input validation and audit logging are part of "done", not a follow\-up ticket. * You never build a shortcut around a control, even under deadline pressure. If a control is slowing the team down, you fix the control the right way and with the right people. * You understand why PCI DSS and SOC 2 exist, keep cardholder and customer data out of places it does not belong (including AI tools), and produce evidence as a by\-product of good engineering. * You keep customer\-facing and internal access strictly separate, and you design integrations so every money movement is traceable and reconcilable. * You report mistakes and near misses immediately and without spin. We treat those reports as a strength. **Candidate Requirements:*** 3 to 8 years of professional software development experience, or equivalent demonstrated ability. * Proficiency in TypeScript and Node.js, and in React. * Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases. * Experience integrating with third\-party APIs and handling external data. * Hands\-on experience using AI coding agents (such as Claude Code) as part of your daily development * workflow. You will be asked to demonstrate this during the interview process. * Familiarity with AWS, Docker and CI/CD pipelines. * Clear written communication and a track record of finishing what you start. * Located in the United States or Canada. **Nice to have*** Experience with NestJS, Fastify, TypeORM, MySQL, Redis, Vite or Tailwind. * PHP and Laravel, which run parts of our current production platform. * Experience working under PCI DSS or SOC 2 controls. * Exposure to automotive retail or dealer management systems. * Fintech or payments experience, including reconciliation or ledger\-style data. * Snowflake or another cloud data warehouse. * Keycloak or OpenID Connect. * Experience building evaluations for LLM\-based systems. **Work Environment \& Culture:** We believe that performance and experience go hand in hand \- *an exceptional employee experience is earned through contribution*. We are a results\-driven team, grounded in our core values: ownership, authenticity, service, trust, innovation, and camaraderie. Our culture is built for those who want to make an impact. We challenge each other to grow, celebrate progress, and support one another through shared goals and real connection. Whether you're building technology, serving clients, or supporting internal teams, you’ll be part of a company that empowers you to perform at your best and be known for results. **Compensation and Benefits:** **Compensation range: \[**$120K\-$145K USD, $95K\-$116K CAD**]** We invest in the whole employee \- personally and professionally. Our benefits package is designed to support your well\-being, growth, and success \- both inside and outside of work. **Financial Wellness** * Bonus programs * 401(k) match * Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP) * HSA and FSA options * Financial wellness resources and employee discount programs **Health \& Well\-being** * Medical, dental, and vision coverage * Mental health support for employees and dependents through Lyra Health * Family planning and women’s health benefits through Carrot * Gym membership reimbursement and virtual wellness programs (including yoga) **Time Off** * 3 weeks PTO to start, with unlimited PTO after year one **Growth \& Development** * Education expense reimbursement * Leadership development programs * Certified Payments Professional (CPP) certification support We believe great performance starts with feeling supported \- and we’ve built our benefits with that in mind. **Traditional Physical Requirements:*** Requires prolonged sitting, standing, bending, stooping and stretching. * Requires the ability to lift 10 pounds. * Requires eye\-hand coordination, manual dexterity and a normal range of hearing and vision (with or without correction). Join our team at Priority Technology Holdings, Inc. and be part of a dynamic and innovative company that is transforming the financial technology landscape. Together, we can shape the future of payments and banking solutions while providing unmatched value to our clients.
