jobs.title: Mobile Engineer
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Remote \- United States \& Canada **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- Engineering Small businesses represent 99\.9% of all companies, yet they're still forced to choose between clunky, outdated enterprise phone systems or their personal phones. This multi\-billion dollar market has been overlooked for decades, left to cobble together solutions that slow them down instead of helping them grow. Quo is changing that. We bring calls, texts, and customer information together into one easy\-to\-use, AI\-powered platform. We're not just building a phone system. We're setting a new standard for how businesses connect with their customers. Driven by our values, we move fast, build with determination, and obsess over delivering value to the businesses that have been underserved for far too long. Today, Quo is trusted by more than 120,000 companies and rated \#1 in customer satisfaction on G2\. We're backed by Y Combinator, Tiger Global, Craft Ventures, Slow Ventures, and other top\-tier investors. It's safe to say we're onto something big. ### **About the role** We're growing Quo's mobile engineering team as we invest seriously in mobile for the first time in years. You'll join an established, close\-knit team of mobile engineers shipping our iOS and Android apps, reporting into our mobile Engineering Manager. Mobile is becoming a first\-class surface at Quo: we're moving the team closer to our core phone workstream (the calling experience itself — low latency, high call quality, no dropped connections) and making sure mobile keeps pace as we ship new AI, revenue management, and task management features across the product. This isn't a platform\-architecture role — the big technical direction decisions for mobile are already staffed and largely mapped out for the next 6\-12 months. This is a hands\-on, feature\-delivery role: shipping real product improvements, working across shared Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) modules and native iOS/Android code, and partnering closely with product, design, and backend teams. Some of the things you'll do: * Feature Development: Shipping new features and improving existing functionality across iOS and Android to keep mobile at or near parity with our web and desktop experience. * Shared Module Work: Building and adapting shared Kotlin Multiplatform modules so they integrate smoothly and feel native on both iOS and Android. * Cross\-Platform Collaboration: Partnering with the rest of the mobile team (iOS and Android engineers) and our Mobile Foundations platform team to extend and integrate shared functionality. * Reliability \& Quality: Helping raise the bar on our core phone experience on mobile — call quality, reliability, and performance are a real differentiator for Quo. * Cross\-functional Delivery: Working closely with PMs, designers, and backend teams to ship customer\-facing work, often jumping into an existing workstream and building context quickly. Technical stack and tools: * Android is built in Kotlin, adapted to support Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) following clean architecture principles * iOS development is primarily in Swift with SwiftUI for new features, UIKit where necessary * Shared KMP modules include Apollo GraphQL, Ktor networking, OpenTelemetry, and feature\-specific modules (conversations, contacts, alerts, etc.) * Persistence layers today are Room (Android/KMP) and Realm (iOS) — how these reconcile long\-term is an active discussion, not yet locked * Dependency injection via kotlin\-inject; testing with JUnit, Mockk, Turbine, and Maestro for cross\-platform E2E * Collaboration tools: Linear, Slack, Notion, Figma ### **About you** * High agency and ownership. Our mobile team is small (currently 3 product\-focused engineers, growing significantly) and fully distributed across time zones. You're comfortable operating with fewer frameworks and more ambiguity than you'd find at a larger organization, and you go solve problems rather than waiting to be told to. * Strong communicator. You collaborate well cross\-functionally with PMs, designers, backend engineers, and other mobile engineers, and you're comfortable working async across time zones. * Solid mobile engineering fundamentals, whether that's native iOS (Swift/SwiftUI), native Android (Kotlin), or cross\-platform via KMP. * Low ego, direct communicator, ready to jump into a problem space, build context fast, and coordinate with the team as you go. * Comfortable with, or genuinely curious about, using AI tools to work faster and better. Nice to have: * Direct production experience with Kotlin Multiplatform * Experience with GraphQL (Apollo Client) and modern async/networking patterns (Ktor) * Familiarity with mobile observability/telemetry (e.g., OpenTelemetry) * Experience with E2E testing (Maestro) and modern build tooling (Gradle, KSP) * Experience with feature flags and gradual rollouts * Knowledge of mobile performance optimization and memory management ### **Compensation** The annual base salary range for this position is as follow, plus equity and benefits: * SF Bay Area, Los Angeles, Seattle, Portland, Boston, New York, and Washington, DC Metro: $170,000 \- $200,000 USD * All other US Locations: $153,000 \- $180,000 USD * Canada: $156,100 \- $183,600 CAD The ranges displayed reflect the target for new hire salaries, and within each range, individual pay is determined by your skills and experience, as well as relevant education. Your recruiter can share more and answer questions about the specific salary range during the hiring process. Salary is just one component of Quo's total compensation package. Your total rewards package will include equity, extensive medical coverage, a monthly lifestyle stipend, and a flexible PTO policy. **Who we are** ============== We're a remote\-first company with a culture of trust, autonomy, and action. As we rapidly grow, we're intentionally building communities in a handful of hub cities while continuing to hire great talent wherever they happen to live. If you're looking for a place to do your best work, we'd love to hear from you. And remember, there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate. We're looking for optimists with grit and determination, who are excited to face the challenges of a growing startup. Quo is the type of company where you can grow, and we encourage you to apply for this role even if you don't think you meet all the requirements. We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse work environment. It is important that you are able to bring your authentic self to work every day. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. \#LI\-Remote \#PostLI

jobs.description: **Summary** QuEra is seeking a Principal Photonics Engineer to own how the photonics subsystems of our quantum processing units (QPUs) come together. Free\-space beam delivery, photonic chips, lasers, electrical controls, and fiber all have to perform as one system, and that system is increasingly built with external partners. This is a senior individual\-contributor role. You will set the optical integration architecture, lead the technical relationship with key optics, laser, photonics and packaging partners, and take integrated subsystems from first light through production and system deployment. You will lead an interdisciplinary team of optical, mechanical, electrical and controls engineers, and work closely with our physicists. **Responsibilities** **System integration** * Own the photonics integration architecture of the QPU: how lasers, fiber delivery, free\-space beam paths, photonic chips, imaging optics and the vacuum system interface and perform together. * Translate system\-level requirements from physics and architecture teams into subsystem and component specifications, error budgets (power, wavefront, pointing, polarization, stability) and interface control documents. * Lead integration, alignment, bring\-up and verification of optical subsystems into full systems, from first prototype through production builds. * Define integration and test plans, acceptance criteria, and environmental and stability qualification (thermal, vibration, long\-term drift). * Lead system\-level troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis at QuEra and at customer sites, working with the local support team. **Partnership oversight** * Serve as technical owner for strategic partners and suppliers: optics and laser vendors, photonic foundries, and packaging or contract manufacturers. * Set technical requirements, statements of work, deliverables, and acceptance tests for partner\-developed components and subassemblies. * Run design reviews, milestone reviews and first\-article inspections with partners, and track schedule, quality and technical risk. * Evaluate and qualify new partners and technologies and advise leadership on make\-versus\-buy decisions. * Travel to partner and customer sites as needed. **Free\-space optics** * Architect free\-space optical systems for atom trapping, addressing and imaging, including beam shaping, relay and steering optics, high\-NA imaging, and optical modulators. * Perform optical modeling and tolerance, stray\-light and thermal analysis, and set alignment and metrology standards for assembly. * Drive design for manufacturability, serviceability and scale as systems move from the lab bench to deployable products. **Technical leadership** * Technically lead an interdisciplinary team through the product development process, and mentor senior and junior engineers. * Advance engineering practices at QuEra through design reviews, documentation standards and continuous improvement. **Qualifications** * Master's or PhD in optics, optical engineering, physics, applied physics or a related field. * More than 10 years of industry experience designing, building and integrating optical or electro\-optical systems. * A track record of taking complex optical systems from concept through integration into production and deployment. * Deep expertise in free\-space optics: beam propagation and shaping, lens and relay design, alignment, polarization, and optical metrology. * Hands\-on experience with lasers, fiber optics, photonics chips, and electro\-optic modulators. * Demonstrated system\-integration leadership: requirements flow\-down, error budgets, interface control documents, integration and test plans, and verification. * Experience owning technical relationships with external suppliers or development partners, including specifications, statements of work, design reviews and acceptance testing. * Proficiency with optical design and analysis software (e.g., Zemax OpticStudio, Code V) and familiarity with mechanical CAD and PLM/PDM tools. * Experience leading interdisciplinary teams of 2–5\+ engineers, and a history of mentoring. * Clear communication with physicists, engineers, partners and leadership. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with neutral\-atom, trapped\-ion or other AMO\-based quantum systems, such as optical tweezers, high\-NA imaging or laser beam delivery. * Experience integrating photonic integrated circuits with free\-space or fiber optics. * Experience characterizing, stabilizing and servoing diode, fiber or Ti:Sapphire lasers. * Experience with high\-power laser systems, ultra\-high\-vacuum optical interfaces, and thermal and vibration\-sensitive optomechanics. * Experience with design for manufacturing and design for cost, and with engineering change processes. * Experience managing joint development programs or co\-development agreements with industry or academic partners. * Commercial product development, including off\-site deployment and support at customer premises. * Experience at both an enterprise\-scale company and a startup. jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ **Intermountain Electric (IME)** brings decades of experience as a trusted leader in electrical contracting. Founded in 1946, we began as a small company in Denver, CO, and have since grown to be part of the largest specialty contractor in North America. Today, we work with owners and contractors nationwide, delivering complex construction solutions across various industries, including aviation, mission critical, entertainment, and healthcare. At IME, our people are our most valuable asset. We are committed to fostering a culture that prioritizes safety, quality, and professional growth. Joining IME is more than just finding a job—it's about building a career with opportunities to advance and make an organizational impact. Power your future with IME and be a part of a team that drives success in every project. **About this Role** ------------------- **\*****Travel required to project locations****\*** **Project Engineer – Mission Critical** For 80 years, Intermountain Electric, Inc. (IME) has been a trusted partner on the front lines of some of the most essential electrical projects, delivering safe, smart, and reliable electrical solutions through our people and partnerships, the IME Way. Through strategic planning, collaboration, and technical excellence, and guided by our values of Integrity, Safety, Ingenuity, Relationships, Craftsmanship, and Spark, we empower our professionals to innovate, support our field teams, and strengthen the partnerships that move our work forward. Join a team where your expertise fuels the systems that keep communities running! **Position Summary** The Project Engineer plays a key role in delivering large\-scale, mission\-critical electrical projects, including data centers, by supporting engineering and technical activities from concept through completion. They plan, schedule, forecast, resource, and manage project execution to ensure quality, accuracy, and successful outcomes on complex, fast\-paced construction projects. Through collaboration, innovation, and proactive problem\-solving, they drive continuous improvement and contribute to the successful delivery of highly coordinated electrical systems. **What You'll Do** ------------------ **Key Responsibilities** **Project Planning \& Ingenuity** * Demonstrate craftsmanship and attention to detail by thoroughly analyzing and interpreting construction drawings to ensure a complete understanding of project scope. * Assist in reviewing plans and specifications, developing detailed checklists that highlight contractual and technical items requiring ongoing attention—supporting integrity and accountability from the outset. * Collaborate with cross‑functional project teams to contribute to cost estimates and schedule development, applying ingenuity and analytical thinking to support well\-coordinated, schedule\-driven project planning. **Project Progress \& Craftsmanship** * Prepare clear, accurate statements of work, submittals, and change management documentation, promoting transparent communication and trust across project stakeholders. * Inspect equipment, materials, workmanship, and completed construction with a commitment to exceptional craftsmanship and quality, ensuring full compliance with project specifications. * Maintain precise and organized project records to track progress, changes, and compliance—reinforcing integrity, accuracy, and reliability in large, document\-heavy projects. **Safety Leadership** * Champion a safety‑first culture, modeling behaviors that protect people, projects, and communities. * Actively promote and ensure compliance with all safety regulations, standards, and best practices, reflecting our unwavering commitment to safety and care for others. * Monitor ongoing work to verify that materials, methods, and installations align with safety requirements and approved specifications. **Industry Engagement \& Relationships** * Serve as a brand ambassador, representing the company with professionalism, integrity, and ethical leadership in all interactions. * Build and strengthen relationships with clients, subcontractors, suppliers, and industry partners, fostering long‑term collaboration and trust. * Cultivate industry connections and stay engaged with market trends, helping position the company as a respected and reliable leader in electrical contracting. * Bring spark and enthusiasm to teamwork, collaboration, and external engagement—contributing energy, curiosity, and pride in our work. *Additional duties as assigned.* **What You'll Bring** --------------------- **Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities** * **Desire/willingness to travel domestically minimum of 50% of the time over extended periods.** * Strong capability in due diligence and risk assessment, supporting sound decision‑making and project integrity. * Impeccable ethics and professionalism with internal teams and external partners. * Strong analytical, organizational, and interpersonal skills that support work in  ilding productive relationships with clients, subcontractors, and suppliers to stay informed of industry and market trends. * Thorough knowledge of safety standards and best practices in electrical construction. **Education \& Experience** * Demonstrated hands‑on experience with exposure to larger\-scale or more complex commercial or mission critical construction projects * Experience contributing to projects with defined schedules, multiple phases, or coordination across trades. * Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, or a related field preferred; equivalent combinations of relevant education, training, and applied project experience will be considered. **What You'll Get** ------------------- **Working Conditions**: The majority of the time you will work in a typical office environment. Occasionally, you may travel to a construction job site. When on construction job sites you will encounter typical construction conditions including extreme temperatures, noise, dust, mud debris, welding, leading edge, trenching, and shoring, sometimes in a confined space. You may be required to visit multiple locations during any one day. **Benefits Overview:** IME provides an industry\-leading comprehensive benefits package. Full\-time employees are eligible to choose from a variety of healthcare coverage options, which become effective the first of the month after hire. In addition, employees are offered a substantial amount of PTO and are immediately eligible to make contributions to a generously matched and fully vested 401k. *\*Final salary and rates are based on education, experience, skills relevant to the role, and internal equity.\** Established in 1946, IME is part of Quanta Services, the largest specialty contractor in North America. We base our business model on always doing the right thing and pride ourselves in finding the best processes and practices in everything we do. As an electrical contractor, we install and service the power and lighting to commercial and industrial buildings in the Western US. The statements included in this job description are not intended to be all\-inclusive and other duties may be assigned as required. Intermountain Electric, Inc. (IME) is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and to creating an environment free of discrimination and harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. jobs.title: Senior Supply Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: **About Radiant** ----------------- Radiant is an El Segundo, CA\-based company building the world's only mass\-produced, transportable nuclear microreactors. The U.S. grid is under growing strain, with power demand accelerating, driving higher utility costs, rising carbon emissions, and interconnection backlogs. Radiant has a solution, transportable, on\-site power. Our first reactor, Kaleidos, is 1 megawatt: small enough to be factory\-built, transported by land, sea, or air, and deployed wherever power is needed. 1 MW can power 1000 homes for five years. Ship it back and we refuel for a 20 year operating life. We made energy a product that can be used for critical infrastructure like military bases, data centers, hospitals, and remote sites, as well as the commercial main street businesses that keep America running. Founded in 2020, Radiant is under contract to deliver power to the U.S. Army, Navy and Air Force and has signed pre\-order agreements with Equinix, with deployments beginning in 2028\. We are looking for a **Senior Supply Reliability Engineer** who has built supplier programs that prevent problems rather than react to them. You will own the development, qualification, and long\-term reliability of Radiant’s supply base — establishing the processes, standards, and supplier capabilities that ensure the right part arrives to the right standard, every time. While you’ll have the technical depth to handle complex non\-conformances and corrective actions when they arise, your primary focus is upstream: strengthening supplier processes, closing capability gaps, and building a supply base that performs without constant intervention. This is a builder role: the old house is being brought down, and a new foundation is being poured, but we still need to build the structure, apply the finishes, and pass final inspection. You’ll own what exists, upgrade aging systems, and create something the industry hasn’t seen before. You’ll mentor the engineers around you and help set technical standards, without formal people\-management responsibilities, and grow into the team’s technical lead as it scales. We’re not here to maintain the status quo in nuclear quality; we’re here to raise the bar. If you have the experience to know how supplier quality is usually done and the drive to do it better, this is the most meaningful quality work of your career, in an industry that hasn’t been disrupted in decades. **Responsibilities \& Duties** * **Own supplier qualification end to end:** risk screening, capability assessments, audits, and approval to the Approved Supplier List. Design the qualification approach by commodity and quality level, not just execute it. * **Own the supplier requirements framework:** quality clauses, commodity\-specific requirements, the Supplier Quality Manual, and PO quality requirements. Author what doesn’t exist and retire what doesn’t add value. Partner with design engineering, manufacturing, materials, and Supply Chain to translate technical requirements into supplier\-facing requirements before parts are ordered. * **Own procurement assurance and acceptance:** define how items are accepted across supplier types and quality levels (source inspection, receipt inspection, certification review, commercial grade dedication inputs) and build toward a graded, risk\-based model. * **Lead supplier audits, performance, and development:** plan and conduct audits against Radiant’s program, drive findings to verified closure, and build leading indicators that surface risk before it reaches Radiant’s dock. Turn findings into improvement plans with critical suppliers and track them to defined milestones. * **Drive systemic corrective action:** when supplier issues occur, lead root cause through verified effectiveness, then extend the fix across affected suppliers, commodities, and requirements so the failure mode doesn’t recur elsewhere. * **Develop the team:** mentor engineers, review their work, and help define how Supply Reliability scales as you grow into its technical lead. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (e.g., Mechanical, Manufacturing, Industrial, Materials), Engineering Technology, or a related technical field. * **5\+ years in quality engineering, with 3\+ years personally owning supplier\-facing quality** (supplier quality, supplier development, or supplier reliability) in a regulated industry: nuclear, aerospace, defense, space, medical device, or automotive. * **Built or substantially rebuilt a supplier quality program element** from a weak or nonexistent starting point: a qualification process, an audit program, a requirements/clause library, a supplier quality manual, or an acceptance framework. * **Demonstrated systemic prevention:** a track record of turning individual supplier failures into changes that prevented recurrence across multiple suppliers or commodities, with measurable results. * **Led supplier audits** against ISO 9001, AS9100, IATF 16949, or a ient to audit a supplier’s process controls and find gaps on the floor. * **NQA\-1 Lead Auditor qualification** (or ASQ CQA / AS9100 Lead Auditor). * Experience with **commercial grade dedication**, ISO 17025 accredited laboratories, APQP/PPAP, or AS9102 FAI. * Applied use of **data, automation, or AI tools** to improve quality processes. * Experience operating in an **early\-stage company or program**, or as the primary owner of a function in a resource\-constrained environment. **Who You Are** * You take **full ownership** of your domain: you see what needs building, write the procedure when one doesn’t exist, and drive it without waiting to be asked. * You reason from **first principles**: when a standard doesn’t map cleanly to the situation, you work from the underlying requirement, not precedent. * You **think in systems**: one supplier’s failure makes you ask which other suppliers, processes, and requirements share the same weakness. You’d rather fix the supplier’s process than write the corrective action. * You are **precise**: in a safety\-critical, auditable environment, imprecision in a record, a clause, or a finding has real consequences. * You care about the **mission**: quality in this industry is a safety imperative, not bureaucratic overhead. * You thrive in a **fast\-paced, resource\-constrained environment** with high ambiguity and real stakes. **Additional Requirements** * Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as necessary to accomplish our mission. * Must work 100% onsite at El Segundo HQ. * Must be willing and able to travel domestically and internationally to supplier sites (up to 30%) **Benefits and Perks** ---------------------- * Stock: Substantial incentive stock plan for all full\-time employees. * Medical: 100% up to base silver level plan for employee \+ 50% dependents, offers up to Platinum plans. * One Medical: Sponsored memberships for employees and their dependents. * Vision: 100% top tier plan coverage \+ 50% for dependents. * Dental: 100% top tier plan coverage, orthodontia extra, 50% for dependents. * Voluntary life, accident, hospital, critical illness, commuter and FSA/HSA are offered as employee contributed benefits. * 8\-weeks of paid parental leave for all parents. Additional paid pregnancy leave for CA employees. * Nuclear Engineering Certificate Program: 100% covered educational program with Penn State University, for eligible employees, to rapidly upscale into nuclear. * Daily catered lunch. Free snacks and drinks. * Flexible PTO policy. Remote workday allocation. * Company and team\-bonding events, happy hours and in\-person camaraderie. * Beautiful El Segundo headquarters close to the Pacific Ocean. **Total Compensation and Benefits** Radiant compensates people for impact and invests in those who continue to raise the bar. Radiant’s full\-time new hire compensation package includes base salary, substantial equity grants, and comprehensive health benefits. Total compensation and level are determined through a rigorous evaluation of interview performance, experience, education, and qualifications, and are designed to support continued growth as scope, responsibility, and impact expand at Radiant. The best of today’s advanced reactor builders don’t wait for job postings. They join the winning team. If that’s you, contact us directly for immediate opportunities: recruiting@radiantnuclear.com. *We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.* *This position involves access to technology that is subject to U.S. export controls. Any job offer made will be contingent upon the applicant’s capacity to serve in compliance with U.S. export controls.* Compensation Range: $115K \- $168K

jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Banking
jobs.description: **Rain** is the **world's first AI Financial Health Platform**, serving **3\.5 million employees** at leading organizations like **McDonald's, Marriott, and T\-Mobile**. Rain works in the background to optimize every employee's financial life to prevent shortfalls and build long\-term stability. Backed by **top investors including QED and Prosus**, Rain has **raised $150M in venture funding to fuel our next stage of hyper growth.** We are looking for an Engineering Manager to join our engineering team. This position is based in New York, NY. We are building a new NYC engineering team and looking for an Engineering Manager to lead the banking teams: the engineers who create our banking infrastructure, connect Rain to the banking system and make sure every dollar moves, and is recorded, correctly. You will lead tech leads, backend, frontend / mobile, and QA engineers who own our banking partner integrations, account and card infrastructure, money movements, and the ledgers and reconciliation that tie it all together. These systems have to be accurate, resilient, and audit\-ready, because workers rely on them for real paychecks and real bills. This is a chance to lead mission\-critical fintech infrastructure with real influence on architecture and product direction. You will be a people leader first and a technical leader close behind. You will set the bar for how the team builds, hire people who raise it, and stay close enough to the code to make sound calls and earn your engineers' trust. **What You’ll Do** * Hire, coach, and retain strong engineers, with regular feedback, clear expectations, and career growth plans for each person * Build a team that owns its outcomes: set clear context, then let senior engineers drive technical solutions end to end * Own the technical relationship with our sponsor and partner banks and banking vendors, from integration scope and timelines to issue escalation and certification * Partner with Product to shape the roadmap for new banking capabilities, and bring alternatives and trade\-offs when a better path exists * Own delivery: set priorities, sequence work, manage capacity and risk, and clear blockers quickly so progress is visible and commitments are met * Guide architecture and design reviews across a distributed microservices environment, balancing speed to market with correctness, idempotency, reliability, and long\-term maintainability * Work with Compliance, Risk, and Finance so that KYC/AML, fraud controls, and regulatory and partner\-bank requirements are built into the systems, not bolted on * Raise operational standards: observability, incident response, on\-call health, daily reconciliation breaks, and learning from every incident * Use data and team metrics (quality, incident rates, cycle time) to decide where to invest and to improve how the team works * Keep documentation for architecture, APIs, and workflows current * Stay hands\-on where it counts, through code reviews, prototypes, or unblocking a critical path, without becoming a bottleneck **What Success Looks Like** * Banking integrations and money movement that our partner banks, Compliance, and Finance trust * Ledger and reconciliation accuracy that holds up to audit and bank examination * Predictable, high\-quality delivery of banking initiatives tied to company goals * Visible growth in your engineers' scope, skill, and engagement * Measurable improvement in reliability and incident response over time **Who You Are** * 7\+ years in software engineering, with 3\+ years directly managing engineers * Experience in banking, payments, or lending infrastructure, such as bank or BaaS integrations, ACH, card processing, or ledgers. Experience working with sponsor banks or in a regulated environment is a strong plus * A strong engineering background: you lead technical discussions, facilitate architectural decisions, and weigh engineering quality against business priorities * A trusted partner to product managers, with experience taking multi\-quarter initiatives from concept to launch while keeping stakeholders aligned * Sound judgment on distributed systems trade\-offs, such as consistency vs. availability, and a firm grip on correctness in money movement * Comfort in a fast\-paced environment where speed and precision both matter **Required Technical Qualifications** * Expert\-level proficiency in Go (Golang) * Deep expertise in SQL (PostgreSQL), specifically regarding transaction isolation levels, locking strategies, and schema migrations at scale * Strong experience with message queueing systems (preferably Kafka) for building resilient, asynchronous workflows * Proven experience building reliable and scalable user\-facing applications * Advanced knowledge of AWS (ECS, EKS, RDS) and container orchestration using Docker/Kubernetes * Experience building or improving CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions/GitLab CI) and a "you build it, you run it" mentality toward infrastructure\-as\-code **Compensation** $260,000\-$280,000 Base \| Note this is a range and we take in a variety of factors when determining total compensation for the position. **How we care for our team** Along with competitive salaries, Rain offers great benefits including: * Flexible PTO * Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Disability coverage * Parental leave * Monthly stipend * Equity options **Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Commitments** As part of our dedication to the diversity of our workforce, Rain is committed to Equal Employment Opportunity and does not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ethnicity, gender, sex (including pregnancy), protected veteran status, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, or any unlawful criterion existing under applicable federal, state, or local laws. If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at Careers@rain.us. **What’s Next** Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. Our interview process tends to take about **4 weeks** to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here. Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility. Compensation Range: $260K \- $280K

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: Hi, I'm Akbay, Head of Engineering at Reflow. Most engineering roles at this stage ask you to execute. Pick up tickets, ship features, move to the next one. That's not what we're looking for. Reflow is building something that requires you to care about the outcome, not just the output. We track how work actually happens inside organizations and turn that into intelligence. The data is messy, the product surface is wide, and the problems are greenfield. You need to want to dig into that, not just be okay with it. I'm looking for someone who gets energy from complexity, moves fast without cutting corners on the things that matter, and wants to see their fingerprints on a product that real teams depend on. Someone who wants to build, and to own what they build. If that sounds like the kind of work you want to be doing, read on. Akbay **Why Reflow exists** ===================== Most organizations have no reliable way to understand how work actually gets done. They track outputs, not workflows. They measure activity, not intelligence. The result is a massive blind spot at the operational layer of every team. Reflow closes that gap. We're a workforce and workflow intelligence platform that sees how work flows through an organization and turns that into insight and automation. Our automation agents take the workflows we observe and run them for our customers, across browser and desktop apps, with the company\-specific context that general\-purpose agents don't have. We're early, growing fast, and automation is where we're putting a lot of our weight next. **What you'll actually do in the first 3 months** ================================================= Month 1: Understand the system and fix what matters most. Learn how a recorded workflow becomes an automation, how a run is executed, and how it recovers. Find the parts that hold the system back the most, fix them, and get the improvements shipped to clients, not just merged. By the end of the month customers should notice the difference. Month 2: Make the whole system better. Move from the most critical parts to all of them: workflow creation, execution, recovery, evals, observability and cost. Get to a point where we are confident in every update before it ships, and where we can bring on more clients without any drop in quality, speed or cost per run. Month 3: Drive the project. Take the lead on where automation goes next. Bring your own ideas, sharpen the vision, and keep a close eye on the market: what the model vendors and other agent products ship, what customers ask for, and where Reflow should go to stay ahead. Turn that into a roadmap and steer the project by it. **How the role looks beyond 3 months** ====================================== You own the AI automation project end to end: architecture, reliability, observability, cost, and the roadmap of what it can do next. You stay fully hands\-on, this is a building role. You work closely with the other engineers who contribute to automation, and you help set the technical bar for the project. Beyond automation, you help shape the other AI pipelines in the product, such as our AI companion and the systems that mine our activity data for insight. **Example projects on the horizon:** ------------------------------------ * Build an eval and benchmarking setup that covers our real customer workflows, with regression checks that run on every change. * Push run success rates up across changing UIs, sessions and edge cases, with recovery that fixes the run instead of failing it. * Bring cost per run down with model routing, caching and provider choice, without losing accuracy. * Build end\-to\-end tracing and observability, so any failed run can be replayed and diagnosed in minutes. * Turn live runs and human feedback into reviewed improvements, so automations get better from use, not just from engineering time. * Shorten the path from a recorded workflow to a working automation, with fewer iterations and no engineer in the loop. **What we mean by "own"** ------------------------- Some engineers think owning a system means being the one who gets assigned its tickets. That's not what we need. Owning automation means you know how it's doing today without anyone telling you. You know the success rate, the cost per run, the top failure reasons and which customers they hit. When a run fails, you find out why before a customer asks. When a model or prompt change looks good in a demo, you're the one who asks for the benchmark. You decide what gets built next, and you're accountable for whether it worked. **How we work** =============== High trust, high speed. We don't manage output through meetings or status updates. You'll know what matters, and you'll have the autonomy to go build it. Measured, not vibes. An AI change that wasn't measured didn't happen. We ship against baselines, eval sets and production metrics, not against a demo that looked right once. Cost is part of the design. Inference spend scales with usage. We treat cost per run as an engineering metric, next to accuracy and latency. AI is part of the craft. We use AI tooling actively across engineering. We expect you to have opinions about what works, for agents in production and for your own workflow. Direct collaboration. You'll work closely with backend, data and the client app team, and directly with the founders on roadmap and architecture. No long handoff chains. **Why you should or shouldn't apply** ===================================== This role is for you if: * You have built and run multi\-step agents in production, with real users, real failure modes and real cost. * You were a strong backend engineer before you worked with LLMs, and you still think like one: retries, idempotency, queues, failure handling, monitoring. * You can answer "how do you know it got better?" with numbers, and you have built the setup that produces them. * You care about cost per run as much as accuracy, and you've made tradeoffs between models, providers and architectures to get both. * You want to own a system end to end and be judged by whether it works in production. * You're energized by an ambiguous, fast\-moving space where the playbook is still being written. * You want direct access to the founders and real influence over where the product goes. This role is probably not for you if: * Your agent experience is mostly RAG chatbots, low\-code workflows, or prototypes that never left pilot scale. * You ship prompt changes because they looked better on a few examples. * You think of observability and evals as something to add once things settle down. * You prefer research to shipping, or want a clear spec before you start. * You need someone else to set up infrastructure, deploys or monitoring for you. * You want to manage people more than you want to build. **What we're looking for** ========================== **Required** ------------ * 6\+ years of backend engineering, with production services and pipelines you designed and owned: APIs, workers, queues, real load, on\-call. * Recent, hands\-on experience building agentic systems in production: multi\-step agents, tool use, MCP, agent loops with recovery and guardrails. * Built or owned eval, benchmarking and tracing for LLM systems: golden sets, regression suites, LangSmith, Langfuse or your own. * Experience managing LLM cost and latency in production: model routing, caching, provider choice. * Strong in TypeScript and Python. You'll work in both. * Architecture judgment: you can take a system that was built fast and set the direction for its next stage. * Strong written communication, we're distributed and context needs to travel well in writing. * Open to working across timezones with a globally distributed team. **Nice to haves** ----------------- * Experience with browser or desktop automation: Playwright, Puppeteer, DOM\-based actions, computer\-use agents. * Experience with model gateways and providers such as OpenRouter or Bedrock. * Familiarity with Django and ClickHouse, or similar stacks. * Experience running agents in virtual or sandboxed environments. * Previous experience at an early\-stage or fully remote company. **What Reflow gives you** ========================= * Full ownership of the system at the center of where Reflow is going next. * Work directly with the founding team, your architecture decisions will be visible and they'll matter. * Fully remote, work from wherever you do your best work. * A genuinely hard problem: making AI agents reliable, measurable and affordable on real company work. **Compensation:** ----------------- We offer competitive pay based on the market and where you’re located. The salary ranges in our job postings are intentionally wide because they need to cover both U.S. and international candidates. Our final offer will depend on things like your experience, skill set, and location.

jobs.title: Automation Engineer
jobs.description: We are seeking an Automation Engineer to build and operate the automated data workflows, reports, and data applications behind RAS data services. Reporting to the Director, Enterprise Data Solutions, you will work primarily in our enterprise business intelligence and data application platform (e.g., Sigma Computing) on top of the Snowflake data warehouse. You will turn manual, recurring, and high\-effort reporting and data\-handling processes into governed, scheduled, and monitored automations, and contribute to AI\-assisted and agentic workflows as they are introduced into the platform. **Key Duties** * Partner with Finance, Clinical Programs, Sales and Account Management, and Data Solutions teams to evaluate manual and repetitive data processes and identify, size, and prioritize automation opportunities. * Design, build, and maintain automated reporting and data applications in the BI platform (e.g., Sigma Computing), including workbooks, data apps, input tables and write\-back, actions, scheduled exports, and alerts. * Develop the Snowflake components that automations depend on, such as SQL views, stored procedures, tasks, streams, and dynamic tables. * Lead end\-to\-end automation delivery, from process discovery and requirements through development, testing, deployment, documentation, and ongoing maintenance. * Automate recurring financial and operational data processes (e.g., billing reconciliation, revenue reporting, client data deliveries, and program performance reporting) with built\-in validation, exception handling, and audit trails. * Establish monitoring, logging, alerting, and runbooks for every automation, and perform root\-cause analysis when something fails. * Develop reusable templates, components, and patterns that let the team scale automation consistently. * Integrate automations with adjacent systems through APIs, connectors, and scripting (e.g., Python or workflow tools such as Power Automate). * Apply version control, peer review, and release practices to automation assets. * Prototype and deliver AI\-assisted automation (e.g., Snowflake Cortex or agent tools) for tasks such as summarization, classification, and natural\-language reporting. * Ensure automations comply with HIPAA, data privacy regulations, and RedSail data governance policies. * Train and support users, maintain a catalog of automations, and drive adoption of self\-service capabilities. **Required Work Education/Skills** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data run in production. * Hands\-on experience with a modern cloud BI or data application platform (e.g., Sigma Computing, Power BI, or Tableau), including scheduled delivery, alerting, and user\-input or write\-back features. * Strong SQL skills on a cloud data warehouse (Snowflake preferred), including views, stored procedures, and scheduling constructs. * Strong understanding of business process HIPAA\-compliant environments, or willingness to complete required training. **Preferred Experience/Skills** * Direct experience or certification in Sigma Computing, or a Snowflake certification such as SnowPro. * Experience with generative AI or agent capabilities inside a data platform. * Exposure to additional automation and orchestration tools (e.g., Power Automate, UiPath, or Airflow). * Experience automating finance or billing processes, or working with pharmacy, pharmaceutical, or healthcare data. * Experience with infrastructure\-as\-code and CI/CD pipelines for data assets. * Background in process improvement frameworks such as Lean Six Sigma. #### **Work Location** * Hybrid at a RedSail Office + Spartanburg, SC + Irving, TX + Shreveport, LA + Oak Brook, IL + Cranberry Township, PA + Long Island, NY **Compensation \& Total Rewards** * The anticipated base salary range for this position is **$100,000\-120,000** per hour. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including relevant experience, skills, qualifications, and geographic location. * RedSail offers a comprehensive benefits package, including paid time off; medical, dental, and vision insurance; a 401(k) plan with a company match; professional development opportunities; and programs that support employee health and well\-being. jobs.title: Data Analytics Engineer
jobs.description: **Data Analytics Engineer (NYC)** **About Rent the Runway** **About Us:** Rent the Runway (RTR) is transforming the way we get dressed by pioneering the world's first Closet in the Cloud. Founded in 2009, RTR has disrupted the $2\.4 trillion fashion industry by inspiring women with a more joyful, sustainable and financially\-savvy way to feel their best every day. As the ultimate destination for circular fashion, the brand now offers infinite points of access to its shared closet via a fully customizable subscription to fashion, one\-time rental or ownership. RTR offers designer apparel and accessories from hundreds of brand partners and has built in\-house proprietary technology and a one\-of\-a\-kind reverse logistics operation. RTR has been named to CNBC's "Disruptor 50" five times in ten years, and has been placed on Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies list multiple times. **About the Team:** Data is core to RTR's strategy and is embedded across product, logistics, customer experience, and business operations. The Data Analytics team is responsible for delivering accurate, scalable data to the organization, including core data based tool models, data definitions, reporting foundations, insights, and self\-service analytics. We are now growing our Analytics Engineering function within the Data Analytics team to ensure our data models are scalable, maintainable, well\-governed, and aligned to the fast\-paced and evolving needs of the business. **About the Role:** We are looking for a Data Analytics Engineer to enhance our data ecosystem by ensuring scalable, well\-structured, and high\-quality datasets that drive insights across the business. You will be responsible for building and optimizing data models, developing ETL/ELT pipelines, and improving data infrastructure to support analytics and reporting, while unlocking AI capabilities in our reporting and analytics layer. willingness to develop expertise in FortiGate, FortiSwitch, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer, FortiAP, FortiClient EMS, and SD\-WAN. * Familiarity with Windows networking, basic Linux administration, Wireshark, network monitoring tools, Microsoft Office, and ITSM/ticketing platforms such as ServiceNow. * Strong customer service, communication, documentation, prioritization, and problem\-solving skills. **Preferred Experience** ======================== * Exposure to manufacturing, industrial, warehouse, or OT environments. * Experience or training with Cisco technologies, including Cisco Catalyst switches, routing fundamentals, wireless networking, Meraki, Packet Tracer, or basic Cisco CLI administration. * Basic knowledge of Azure or AWS networking, PowerShell or Python scripting, cybersecurity practices, ITIL principles, or regulated/GMP environments. * Certifications such as CompTIA Network\+, CompTIA Security\+, Fortinet Certified Associate, Cisco Certified Support Technician, or CCNA completed or in progress. *Our mission is to inspire advances in bioprocessing as a trusted partner in the production of biologic drugs that improve human health worldwide. jobs.title: Data and Analytics Engineer
jobs.description: **Position Overview** Resolve Pain Solutions partners with interventional pain management practices across the Southeast. We provide the operations, technology and support that let physicians and their teams focus on patients. Our IT team supports every practice, clinic and newly joined partner across the organization. Resolve is bringing its data platform and internal tools in\-house. You will be the hands\-on builder who owns that work: the pipelines that move data out of our EMR and practice management systems, the Snowflake warehouse, the Power BI dashboards our leaders rely on, and a new internal portal that replaces several outside apps. You will use AI coding tools such as Claude Code every day to move faster, and you will work closely with the Director of IT and a cross\-functional data governance committee that sets priorities and owns metric definitions. This is a builder role, not a report\-request role. This role will work closely with the Chief of Staff, senior leadership, physicians, Regional Business Managers, finance, compliance, IT, revenue cycle, laboratory leadership, and external partners.**Key Responsibilities** **Build and own data platform*** Take ownership of the weekly data loads from eClinicalWorks, AdvancedMD, ReferralMD and other sources into Snowflake, then automate them with APIs or scheduled extracts so no one pulls data by hand. * Build, maintain and monitor pipelines in Python and SQL, with alerts when a source changes or a load fails. * Model data in Snowflake for reporting: clean, documented tables for visits, scheduling, orders, referrals, revenue cycle and finance. * Maintain and extend Power BI dashboards for operations, executive leadership and providers, and build new dashboards for each department plus a summary view for the board. * Validate every metric against its source system and keep metric definitions agreed with the data governance committee. * Bring new sources online, including systems from newly acquired practices (for example athenahealth), Sage Intacct for finance and UKG for HR. * Protect patient data with role\-based and row\-level security, least\-privilege access and HIPAA\-aware handling of PHI across Snowflake, Power BI and cloud staging. * Keep documentation current: data\-source inventory, runbooks, data model and metric definitions. **Build and own internal apps*** Build modules for Resolve's internal portal on Microsoft Azure (App Service, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Entra ID, Microsoft Graph and GitHub Actions), replacing tools such as monday.com and our HR case desk. * Ship through a staging\-first release process with automated deployments. * Use AI coding tools to write, test and document code, with human review, and keep PHI out of any tool not covered by an approved business associate agreement. * Embed Power BI dashboards in the portal and connect portal modules to Microsoft 365 (Teams, Outlook and SharePoint). **Operational and business partnership*** Partner with operations, revenue cycle, finance, HR and clinical leaders to turn their questions into reliable data and tools. * Take requests through the data governance committee and keep stakeholders informed on priorities and delivery dates. * Serve as a second administrator on key data platforms so no system depends on one person. **Qualifications** **Required*** 3 to 6 years in data engineering, analytics engineering or BI development. * Advanced SQL, ideally in Snowflake. * Power BI data modeling, DAX and workspace administration. * Python for data pipelines and automation. * Git, with a disciplined approach to version control, testing and code review. * Experience with healthcare data such as EMR, practice management or revenue cycle metrics. * Comfort working with AI coding tools, and good judgment about when to trust their output. * Clear, plain\-language communication with non\-technical leaders. **Preferred*** Rivery, dbt or a similar ELT tool. * eClinicalWorks or other EMR data experience. * HIPAA and healthcare compliance experience. * Web app basics (TypeScript), Microsoft Azure or Microsoft Graph. * Experience in a multi\-site medical group or management services organization. nfdvOBOM9m

jobs.description: **About Rippling** ------------------ Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. As a Senior Backend Engineer, you’ll design and build the services, APIs, and platform primitives that power complex workflows across Rippling’s multi\-product platform. You’ll work on systems involving permissions, policy enforcement, approvals, payments, device and app management, procurement, asset tracking, auditability, and secure handling of sensitive workforce and financial data. This role also supports Rippling’s expansion of AI\-powered workflows across HR, IT, Finance, Spend, and core platform experiences. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role. You will work across international teams, exchange knowledge openly, and develop alongside colleagues committed to advancing machine learning engineering practices. SAP's culture encourages curiosity, inclusion, and growth, giving you opportunities to contribute meaningfully no matter your level. **Job Description** **What you'll bring** You have hands\-on experience building and operating ML systems in production, with solid skills in Python, data pipelines, and ranking or retrieval systems. * Python proficiency and hands\-on experience with ML frameworks such as PyTorch or scikit\-learn. * Experience building or maintaining data pipelines at scale. Spark, Databricks, Delta Lake, or equivalent. * Solid knowledge of ranking, retrieval, or recommendation systems; experience with multi\-signal fusion or semantic search is a plus. * SQL fluency and comfort working with large\-scale columnar data stores. * End\-to\-end ML ownership across training, evaluation, serving, and monitoring; experience with A/B experimentation is a plus. * Degree not required for this role. We also look for people who build trust naturally, communicate with clarity, keep the customer at the centre of what they do, and bring emotional intelligence and genuine problem\-solving ability to the challenges they face. In addition to the skills and experience specific to this role, all positions at SAP require candidates to be comfortable using AI tools, including agentic AI. Additionally, they should promote the adoption of AI practices within their teams. **What you'll build** You will build and maintain ML systems that power personalized learning experiences for enterprise employees, covering offline pipelines, online ranking, and feedback loops. * Build and maintain offline ML pipelines for signal extraction, feature engineering, and candidate generation. * Contribute to request\-time ranking logic that fuses signals from multiple ML routes into a personalized result. * Extract and transform employee signals; skills, proficiency, and learning history, into reusable, scenario\-agnostic feature snapshots. * Design and maintain quality gates that validate ML pipeline outputs before they reach the serving layer. * Build the experimentation infrastructure. This includes A/B schemas, offline evaluation, and ablation testing. These tools will help measure improvements accurately and thoroughly. * Collaborate with Data Scientists, Architects, and Product to refine algorithms and ship end\-to\-end ML systems. **Where you belong** You will join a small, high\-ownership pod building personalized learning experiences for enterprise employees at scale. The team runs offline ML pipelines, online ranking, and feedback loops in production, processing signals from millions of employees. jobs.title: Manager I, Development
jobs.description: **Description:** ================ SPS Commerce is a leading provider of cloud\-based supply chain management solutions, serving a global network of retail trading partners. We foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment where innovation and continuous improvement are highly valued. Join SPS Commerce and be part of a dynamic team that's transforming the global retail supply chain! **Position Summary:** ===================== We're seeking a Manager I, Development to lead a team of eight software engineers who build and maintain data transformation maps for SPS Commerce suppliers. The team reads data in one format, maps it, and writes it out to each trading partner's specification, working from a shared queue that supports our Customer Success and implementation teams. You will lead an experienced, self\-sufficient team, so your focus is keeping delivery on track, building trust, and helping each engineer grow. You will also own a clear mandate to bring AI into the team's daily work and automate repetitive mapping tasks. The team works in a dedicated mapping toolset that joined SPS through an acquisition and is cross\-training onto the SPS network mapping tools, and you will help guide that path. **Key Responsibilities:** * Keep the queue moving. Manage intake, escalations, and need\-by dates so the right work gets done at the right time and Customer Success partners stay informed. This is the largest part of the role, about half of your time. * Watch delivery health. Track delivery metrics, quality, and time to completion, and adjust resourcing or process when risk appears. * Develop your engineers. Hold regular 1:1s, learn each person's technical strengths and career goals, and build development plans, including cross\-training onto SPS network mapping tools, and conduct annual performance reviews for each engineer considering clear goals and regular feedback discussed throughout the year. * Lead AI adoption. Identify where AI can automate or speed up mapping and testing work, run experiments, and scale what works. * Run a global team rhythm. Hold stand\-ups, team meetings, and 1:1s across staggered U.S. and Philippine schedules so everyone stays connected and aligned. * Report clearly. Keep development leadership updated on queue health, delivery metrics, and risks. * Partner across teams. Work with Customer Success, implementation, product, and other development teams to improve tools, processes, and handoffs. Build the culture. Set the tone for a team centered on customer value, curiosity, and continuous learning. * **Required Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience * 3\-5 years of experience in EDI (electronic data interchange), data mapping, B2B integration, or related technical work * Demonstrated leadership or influence at the team level, such as people management, team lead, or formal mentoring * Working knowledge of EDI and common data formats and structures, including object\-oriented data structures * Working SQL skills * Hands\-on experience using generative AI tools in your daily work * Proven ability to collaborate across regions and time zones, with flexibility in meeting times and communication methods Strong written and verbal communication skills * **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience managing a delivery team * Hands\-on data mapping development experience, enough to step in when volume spikes * Background as an EDI Developer, EDI Analyst, or B2B Integration Engineer * Working knowledge of agile delivery concepts * Background in testing best practices * Experience leading teams across U.S. and Philippine time zones, with flexibility to work across both sets of business hours * Experience with UDT (Universal Data Transformation) tooling * Familiarity with RSX and UDT Hands\-on experience with Jira for project tracking and reporting * **Location:** This role is hybrid out of our Minneapolis office and also open to 100% remote candidates across the U.S. and Canada. What We Offer: At SPS Commerce, we are committed to ensuring that each employee's compensation reflects their unique experiences, performance, and skills in their role. We embrace diversity, equity, and inclusion, ensuring everyone feels accepted, valued, and empowered to make a meaningful impact. We are committed to affirmative action and equal opportunity in all aspects of employment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

jobs.title: AI Engineering Lead
jobs.description: **Building the people that build the world.** With platforms in HVAC and Detection and Measurement, SPX Technologies builds innovative solutions that enable a safer, more efficient, sustainable world. Through our RiSE talent development framework, we Reach, Identify, Strengthen, and Engage our employees to support them in their continued development. We’re a global company of problem solvers, collaborators, and innovators, and our businesses build solutions that impact the world. **How you will make an Impact (Job Summary)** SPX is a diverse team of unique individuals who all make an impact. As an Enterprise AI Engineering Lead, you will define and build the generative and agentic AI architecture supporting our business segments and corporate functions. You will establish enterprise standards and guardrails, develop production\-grade reference implementations, and advise business and technology leaders to turn AI opportunities into secure, governed, measurable business outcomes. **What you can expect in this role (Job Responsibilities)** While each day brings new opportunities at SPX, your core responsibilities will be: **AI Strategy \& Enterprise Architecture** * Own the blueprint. Define the enterprise AI reference architecture — LLM and agent platforms, RAG, orchestration, integration patterns, reusable components and deployment standards — with build\-vs\-buy guidance. * Set the roadmap. Create a pragmatic 12–24 month AI architecture roadmap aligned to SPX business priorities and our Azure\-first cloud and Microsoft Fabric data landscape. * Set the standards. Establish guidance for model selection, prompt and agent design, evaluation, and cost and performance management across AI platforms (Azure OpenAI / AI Foundry, Anthropic Claude, Copilot ecosystem). **Hands\-on Build \& Delivery** * Build, not just draw. Design and build reusable agentic AI components, accelerators and reference solutions: multi\-agent workflows, RAG pipelines, tool/function calling, MCP and agent\-to\-agent integration patterns, memory management, and copilots — including AI\-driven user experiences and, where valuable, generative UI. * Ship to production. Lead proofs of concept and take the successful ones to production with delivery teams and partners. * Raise the bar. Lead architecture, design and code reviews, and guide internal engineers and partner teams through delivery. **Governance, Security \& Responsible AI** * Make it operable. Establish LLMOps and observability practices: CI/CD, evaluation, monitoring, guardrails, and cost tracking for AI workloads. * Make it safe. Partner with Security, Legal, Privacy and Compliance to implement responsible AI: data access controls, IP protection, model risk, bias testing, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls. * Make it data\-ready. Define data readiness and integration requirements with data and platform teams across ERP, CRM, PLM, IoT/OT and document repositories, anchored on Microsoft Fabric as the enterprise data platform. **Business \& Executive Engagement** * Advise the business. Translate segment and functional business problems into AI solution designs and clear value cases, and present architecture decisions, trade\-offs and progress up to the executive level. * Guide the ecosystem. Support vendor, hyperscaler and partner evaluations, including technical due diligence. * Scan the horizon. Track emerging technology (agent frameworks, MCP/A2A\-style protocols, small and fine\-tuned models, multimodal) and recommend adoption where it adds value. **Enablement \& Technical Leadership** * Multiply others. Mentor developers, data engineers and solution architects, and raise AI literacy across IT and the business. * Lead by influence. Lead through influence across a virtual team of IT, data, security and business partners — without direct authority. **What we are looking for (Experience, Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, Education)** We each bring something to the table, and we are looking for someone who has: **Required Experience** * 10\+ years in software, data or solution architecture, with 3\+ years building production Generative AI / Agentic AI solutions. * Demonstrated hands\-on delivery of LLM applications, agentic and multi\-agent systems, and RAG, using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel or similar — including MCP, tool/function calling, prompt engineering, memory management and AI guardrails. * Strong Python and API development (FastAPI or similar), plus experience with vector databases, search and retrieval, microservices, Docker, Kubernetes and CI/CD. * Hands\-on experience on a major cloud AI platform — Azure preferred (Azure OpenAI, AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, AKS, Functions); AWS (Bedrock) or GCP (Vertex AI) also valued. * At least one enterprise\-scale AI or data platform taken from concept to production, with measurable business results. * Working knowledge of enterprise security, identity, data governance and compliance for AI. * Proven ability to communicate with executives and non\-technical stakeholders, with practical delivery skills: scoping, roadmapping, estimation, dependency management, and working with PMs and delivery teams. **Preferred Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities** * Experience in manufacturing, industrial, HVAC, engineering or IoT/OT environments. * Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Power Platform and the Copilot ecosystem, and enterprise systems integration (SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, Teams, SharePoint). * Fine\-tuning, small language models, or model evaluation experience (PyTorch, Hugging Face or similar); React/TypeScript for AI front ends. * Experience mentoring or leading small technical teams (5–10\) or cross\-functional initiatives. * Patents, publications or public technical contributions (a plus, not required). **Education \& Certifications** * Bachelor's degree required; Master's in Computer Science, AI/ML, Engineering or a related field preferred. * Cloud or AI architecture certifications (Azure, AWS or equivalent). **Travel \& Working Environment** * Hybrid schedule of three days onsite per week * Occasional travel to business segment sites **How we live our culture** Our culture is at the center of what we do and, more importantly, who we are. Our core values set a standard for how we manage ourselves, and our Leadership Model sets the standard for how we engage with each other. Whether you are an individual contributor or you lead a large team, each of us leads at SPX. **What benefits do we offer?** We know that the well\-being of our employees is integral. Our benefits include: * Generous and flexible paid time off including paid personal time off, caregiver, parental, and volunteer leave * Competitive health insurance plans and 401(k) match, with benefits starting day one * Competitive and performance\-based compensation packages and bonus plans * Educational assistance, leadership development programs, and recognition programs **Our commitment to embrace diversity to build a culture of inclusion at SPX** We value different backgrounds, experiences, and voices at SPX, and we are committed to challenging ourselves, openly communicating, and striving to improve every day. We believe in creating an inclusive work environment where everyone has a voice and is encouraged to realize their fullest potential. SPX is an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer committed to making selection decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation or identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis.
