jobs.title: Solutions Integration Engineer II
jobs.description: **Who we are** Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video\-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. **About the role:** As a Solutions Integration Engineer at Samsara, you will be an integral member of the Professional Services Organisation responsible for helping Samsara's most strategic customers build and implement B2B integrations with our IoT platform. In a given week, you may work with a large long\-haul trucking company, an industrial\-scale food producer, and a public utility to map a customer's integration needs to current and future API capabilities, help building custom integrations, provide guidance and technical training to implementation teams to follow best practices, troubleshoot issues and advocate for fixes on behalf of customers (working with our tech support team), and ensure a successful customer relationship. A successful Solutions Integration Engineer at Samsara will develop a thorough understanding of B2B integrations to ensure the proper technical solution is delivered to our customers. Your role will be cross\-functional, working alongside and connecting product managers, business operations, sales, and systems engineers, enabling you to experience multiple aspects of a hyper\-growth company from within. Since Samsara is a fast\-growing company with emerging IoT technology, you can expect this role to evolve, with opportunities to take on increasing levels of responsibility and impact our growth. **This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US** **except** **the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.** **You should apply if:** * **You want to impact the industries that run our world:** Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster. * **You thrive the most when solving problems:** Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable. * **You are a natural relationship builder:** Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross\-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team. * **You are the architect of your own career:** If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment. * **You want to be with the best:** At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there. **In this role, you will:** * Lead system integration projects with customer development teams, Samsara's partners, 3rd\-party systems integrators or build your own enterprise\-grade scalable solutions using various Samsara's Web integration technologies (APIs, Webhooks, Connectors, and more.) * Design/develop/define complex project scopes, technical specifications and business requirements between Samsara and multiple stakeholders \- from design through delivery and beyond * Plans complex projects that involve a variety of people, dependencies, uncertainty, risk and impact. Comfortable making delivery commitments for larger projects * Accounts for maintainability, portability, scalability, and reliability in technical designs and knows when to trade them for speed of delivery * Build robust and scalable integration architecture to help solve use cases like Real\-time Data Streaming, Event subscriptions, Batch processing, etc. * Build, test, validate, and review code to ensure completeness and highest quality deliverables *  ing with Modern Agile tools (e.g. Jira, Confluence) **An ideal candidate also has:** * Bachelors in Engineering, Computer Science, or related discipline * Minimum 3\+ years customer facing experience building and supporting Enterprise\-scale integrations or API scripting * Consistent track record of configuring and deploying complex technical solutions * Familiarity with B2B system integration projects and workflows * Bias\-to\-action and hands\-on experience delivering business results * Tinkering with hardware gadgets, sensors, or vehicles is a plus * Familiarity with fleets and logistics is a plus * Understanding of vehicle diagnostic systems is a plus **Total Rewards** At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high\-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above\-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance\-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high\-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above\-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long\-term success: a flexible, employee\-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. **Flexible Working** At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in\-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on\-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. **Belonging at Samsara** At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact. **Accommodations** Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process. **Our Commitment to Authenticity** We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information. **Fraudulent Employment Offers** Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us\-greenhouse\-mail.io or @mail3\.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

jobs.title: Principal Embedded Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Title**: Principal Embedded Engineer * Location: Cambridge, MA **About the Job** The Principal Embedded Engineer will serve as a key technical leader within the Global Device \& Packaging Unit (GDPU), responsible for the architecture, development, and delivery of embedded electronics and firmware for connected drug delivery and medical device platforms. This role provides technical leadership across embedded systems, electronics, firmware, connectivity, cybersecurity, and system integration activities. The individual will work closely with internal cross\-functional teams and external development partners to drive the development of robust, reliable, and compliant connected medical devices from concept through commercialization. The role is expected to influence technical strategy, establish engineering best practices, review critical design decisions, and provide oversight of external engineering partners supporting Sanofi programs. Join a global network that powers how Sanofi delivers — seamlessly, purposefully, and at scale. In Manufacturing \& Supply, you’ll help reimagine how life\-changing treatments reach people everywhere, faster. **About Sanofi:** We’re an R\&D\-driven, AI\-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve lives. **Main Responsibilities** **Embedded Systems Technical Leadership \& Architecture** * Lead system architecture and technical decision\-making for connected medical device programs. * Define and review embedded hardware and software architectures, interfaces, and design tradeoffs. * Drive system\-level integration across electronics, firmware, mobile applications, cloud platforms, and mechanical systems. * Lead technical reviews and provide guidance on design, verification, validation, and risk management activities. * Evaluate emerging technologies and contribute to platform and product technology roadmaps. **Firmware \& Compliance Leadership** * Provide technical oversight of embedded software development activities performed by internal and external engineering teams. * Ensure compliance with IEC 62304 and Sanofi software development lifecycle processes. * Review software requirements, architecture, risk controls, cybersecurity requirements, verification strategies, and development documentation. * Support software quality, traceability, configuration management, and release processes. * Drive adoption of software engineering best practices, coding standards, design reviews, and repository governance. **Electronics Engineering Leadership** * Provide technical oversight of electronics development, including microcontroller\-based systems, wireless connectivity, sensors, power management, battery\-operated designs, and PCBAs. * Review schematics, design analyses, test plans, and verification results. * Support design for manufacturability, reliability, serviceability, and lifecycle management. * Collaborate with internal and external hardware development teams to resolve technical issues and drive design improvements. **External Partner \& Cross\-Functional Leadership** * Provide technical leadership and oversight for external engineering partners, consultants, and suppliers. * Support supplier selection, technical assessments, design reviews, and performance evaluations. * Collaborate with Systems Engineering, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Cybersecurity, Human Factors, Manufacturing, and Product Management teams. * Communicate technical risks, mitigation plans, and recommendations to project teams and leadership. * Provide mentorship and technical guidance across multiple development programs. **About You** **Basic Qualifications** * 10\+ years of experience developing embedded software and electronic systems. * Bachelor’s degree is required. Electrical engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline is preferred. **Experience** * **Embedded systems expertise:** Strong expertise in embedded systems architecture and design, including microcontrollers, real\-time embedded software, wireless communication technologies, and system integration, with hands\-on experience in hardware/software co\-design and embedded electronics development. * **Medical device regulatory knowledge:** Knowledge of IEC 62304 software lifecycle processes, medical device development practices, IEC 60601, ISO 14971, cybersecurity principles, and quality system requirements. * **Software lifecycle and engineering tools:** Experience with software lifecycle processes, requirements management, risk management, verification, validation, and configuration management, including source control and Git\-based workflows. * **Technical leadership of complex product development:** Experience leading complex product development efforts involving embedded hardware and software, with the ability to lead technical decisions and drive alignment across diverse stakeholders, multidisciplinary project teams, and external engineering partners. * **Regulated product experience:** Experience developing products in regulated industries, preferably medical devices or combination products. * **Interpersonal and leadership skills:** Excellent technical leadership, communication, influencing, and problem\-solving skills. **Languages** * Fluent English required. * French and/or German language skills are a plus. **Additional Scope** This position does not have direct reports but is expected to provide technical leadership and oversight to external engineering partners, consultants, and cross\-functional project teams supporting Sanofi's connected medical device portfolio. **Why choose us?** * Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future\-focused team. * Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally. * Enjoy a thoughtful, well\-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact. * Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high\-quality healthcare, prevention and wellness programs and at least 14 weeks’ gender\-neutral parental leave. * Shape the future of medicine and vaccine delivery with cutting\-edge technology, ensuring seamless launches and a resilient global supply. * Power industry\-leading performance by leveraging digital, data, and AI\-driven innovation – at speed and scale * Transform lives worldwide by delivering life\-changing treatments anywhere, anytime. Sanofi Inc. and its U.S. affiliates are Equal Opportunity employers committed to a culturally inclusive workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race; color; creed; religion; national origin; age; ancestry; nationality; marital, domestic partnership or civil union status; sex, gender, gender identity or expression; affectional or sexual orientation; disability; veteran or military status or liability for military status; domestic violence victim status; atypical cellular or blood trait; genetic information (including the refusal to submit to genetic testing) or any other characteristic protected by law. \#GD\-SA \#LI\-SA \#VHD All compensation will be determined commensurate with demonstrated experience. Employees may be eligible to participate in Company employee benefit programs, and additional benefits information can be found here.

jobs.title: Senior Engineer I, Technical Customer Care
jobs.description: Job Description: Schneider Electric is a global leader in digital transformation of energy management and automation. Within the Industrial Automation business unit, Discrete and Hybrid Line of Business supports customers with end‑to‑end solutions combining hardware, software and services to improve efficiency, productivity and sustainability in an Industry 4\.0 environment. **What will you do?** The Global Expert Technical Support (Level 3\) acts as a trusted technical partner for customers and internal teams. This role handles the most complex technical issues that cannot be resolved by the countries at Customer Care Center (Level 1 or Level 2 ) or by ADE, SAE, PAE and Service and projects teams, and contributes to continuous improvement of offers, customer experience and knowledge sharing. **What are the key responsibilities?*** Investigate complex customer technical issues through advanced troubleshooting, replication, and root\-cause analysis. Resolve the issues through corrective solutions. * Engage directly with customers to understand their needs and provide reassurance throughout issue resolution. When required, support on\-site visits, pilot projects or field tests. * Collaborate closely with L1/L2 support, country technical teams, R\&D, quality, marketing, offer management and project leaders to address and resolve customer issues effectively. * Manage escalations and actively participate in continuous improvement processes such as Boards of Change and feedback loops to R\&D and Global project teams. * Act as technical reference for specific automation domains. * Contribute to the development and introduction of new products and solutions by sharing field experience and Voice of Customer. * Support lower‑level support teams to strengthen their technical capabilities. * Create, digitize and maintain technical knowledge content (FAQs, knowledge base articles, how‑to guides, demos, videos) to improve efficiency and customer satisfaction. * Promote and drive excellent digital customer experience, knowledge management and knowledge sharing across the organization. **What qualifications will make you successful?*** University degree or technical education in electrical engineering, automation, industrial IT or related fields, or equivalent practical experience and certifications. Typically 5–10 years of professional experience with strong technical exposure in industrial automation environments (system integrator, OEM, or end‑user), preferably including field experience with Schneider Electric and/or competitors’ solutions * Strong background in industrial automation systems and architectures specially in Industrial networks , communication protocols, PLC programing software, SCADA software and associated engineering tools. * Knowledge on concept of Software Defined Automation (SDA) and IEC61499 * Knowledge of motion control, drives, industrial networks and communication protocols. * Experience with SCADA and industrial software platforms. * Solid analytical, troubleshooting and problem‑solving skills. * Customer‑oriented mindset with the ability to explain complex technical topics clearly to different audiences. * Excellent collaboration and communication skills in an international, multicultural environment. * Fluent written and spoken English; additional languages are a plus. * Ability to prioritize, work autonomously and adapt in a fast‑changing environment. Within the pay range, individual pay is determined by several factors including performance, knowledge, job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. **Schneider Electric is there when it matters most to you** Our Total Rewards package outlines all the benefits and support you’ll enjoy as part of the Schneider Electric team: **Care for Yourself and Your Family.** We ensure you feel secure with benefits that help you and your family thrive: medical (with member reward points), dental, vision, and basic life insurance, Benefit Bucks, flexible work arrangements, paid family leaves, well\-being programs, 12 holidays per year, and 15 days of paid time off per year. **Invest and Plan Your Future.** We help you plan and invest for the future with competitive pay and programs including base salary, incentives, company share ownership, and 401(k) with match. **Grow Your Skills and Career.** We support development through performance discussions, global opportunities, the Schneider Career Hub, and learning platforms like Coursera. **Team Up in the Workplace.** We encourage collaboration, recognition, sharing your voice, and an inclusive workplace. **Support Your Community.** We make a difference through volunteer leave, programs with the Schneider Electric Foundation, youth education initiatives, and military leave benefits. *If you believe this job posting is not compliant with applicable state pay transparency laws in the U.S., please notify the Company as soon as possible upon discovery by completing this form* Job Posting Compliance Form*.* (External) English Company Boiler Plate: **Looking to make an IMPACT with your career?** When you are thinking about joining a new team, culture matters. jobs.title: AI Automation Engineer (Westlake, TX - In Office)
jobs.description: ### **About Us** At selfpublishing.com, we help purpose\-driven people turn their ideas into published books \- and those books into life\-changing impact. Through online education, coaching, and done\-for\-you services, we empower aspiring authors to get their stories out into the world. Our mission? Help 100,000 people publish a book by 2035, impacting 120M\+ lives through "Leveraged Impact.” (Check out our TEDx talk here). We’ve been featured on the INC 5000 list four times \- and we’re just getting started. ##### **About The Role** Internally, we call this role our **AI Builder**. Are you a hands\-on builder who ships AI that actually moves the numbers? Join selfpublishing.com to build the AI agents and automations that make our team more productive, our company more profitable, and our customers more successful. Your focus is clear: Build stuff that drives REAL value for our customers and employees \- and real business outcomes. Not demos. Not things that look cool. Not more strategy docs. When you do this well, revenue per employee goes up, revenue grows faster, and profitability increases. **Your Mission \& Results** * AI That Earns Revenue: Build and improve our AI products and agents, with a goal of $1\.5M\+ in AI\-driven revenue in 2027\. * Revenue Per Employee: Help key revenue roles (Sales reps, SDRs, and more) do more with AI and automation, so each person produces more. * Profitability: Automate manual work across the business to help get profit margin back above 25%. * System Reliability: Cut the time our team spends fixing system issues and errors as close to zero as possible. Make our systems accurate, not just "up." * R\&D Ownership: You own the Research \& Development line item. Explore new ideas and "big bets," then ship the ones that strengthen our systems, automate workflows, and support our strategic goals. * Goal: Measurable gains in revenue per employee, AI revenue, and profit \- with a list of shipped systems to show for it. **What You Bring** * A track record of shipping AI tools or automations that real people use every day \- not just prototypes. * Hands\-on experience with modern AI tools (LLM APIs, AI agents, AI coding tools) and automation platforms (n8n, Zapier, Make, or similar). * Comfort with APIs, webhooks, and connecting business systems \- CRM experience (we use HubSpot) is a big plus. * Scripting or coding ability (Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar). * A business\-first mindset: you size the impact before you build and measure it after you ship. * Comfortable being judged on outcomes \- revenue, profit, and hours saved \- not on how much you built. * Fail fast, fail forward: you'd rather ship, learn, and improve than wait for perfect. **Compensation \& Details** * Location: In\-person, 5 days a week, at our Westlake office. * Schedule: Full\-time, 40 hours per week. * Salary Range: $90,000 \- $125,000 **Ready to Apply?** If you're a builder who wants your work measured by revenue and profit instead of lines of code, we'd love to meet you. In your application, please include links or a short description of 1\-2 AI or automation projects you've shipped and what they changed. Apply now to join one of America's fastest\-growing companies \- and help revolutionize the publishing industry while making a real impact in the world. **The pay range for this role is:** 90,000 \- 125,000 USD per year(Westlake Office)

jobs.title: Software Engineer 1
jobs.description: At Serko, we believe something incredible happens when people come face\-to\-face. That’s why we’re on a mission to engineer a frictionless, next\-generation business travel marketplace. We don’t just manage travel; we are leveraging advanced AI and cutting\-edge tech to eliminate the complexity of global movement. When you join Serko, you join a global collective of passionate technologists who show up as their true selves to build world\-class products. With established hubs across New Zealand, Australia, North America, India and China \- your code and ideas will impact millions of corporate travelers worldwide. If you're ready to challenge the status quo and build the future of travel tech, your next journey starts here. Together you'll help build the application experience layer — the web applications, and the BFF and orchestration services behind them that connect our experiences to platform services. You'll deliver well\-scoped work to production with support, and learn how we build accessible, high\-quality customer experiences. You'll also learn to work agentically from day one, building the judgement to understand and check what you and your agents ship. **Requirements** **Who will thrive** ------------------- * **Curious, eager learners** who want to grow fast with strong mentorship and team support. * **Collaborative builders** who care about crafting accessible, high\-quality customer experiences. * **AI\-forward thinkers** excited to work agentically from day one while maintaining high engineering standards. **What you'll do** ------------------ * **Build the experience layer:** Contribute to our web applications, Backend\-for\-Frontend (BFF) layers, and orchestration services that connect our products to core platform services. * **Ship to production:** Deliver well\-scoped features with team support while learning our standards for accessibility and craft. * **Work agentically:** Use AI agents in your daily workflow, developing the judgment to thoroughly review, validate, and own everything you and your agents ship. **What you'll bring** --------------------- * Foundational experience in web development and backend services (through internships, projects, or early\-career roles). * A strong desire to learn modern engineering, accessibility, and production best practices. * Curiosity about AI\-assisted development, paired with attention to detail and a willingness to check your work carefully. **Benefits** At Serko, we aim to create a place where people can come and do their best work. This means you’ll be operating in an environment with great tools and support to enable you to perform at the highest level of your abilities, producing high\-quality and delivering innovative and efficient results. Our people are fully engaged, continuously improving, and encouraged to make an impact. Some of the benefits of working at Serko are: * A competitive base salary * Short Term Incentive Scheme * Focus on development: Access to a learning \& development platform, committed budget and opportunity for you to own your career pathways. * The pay range is between $90,000 \- $110,000 USD as a base salary offering annually.

jobs.title: Office & Operations Coordinator
jobs.description: **About Shark Byte Systems Inc. (SBS)** Shark Byte Systems Inc. (SBS) is an innovative computer vision and artificial intelligence company headquartered in New York City. We build robust, real\-time visual intelligence systems and inference models deployed to solve complex operational challenges. Our technical culture is hands\-on, high\-ownership, and run strictly on Linux infrastructure. **Role Summary** Shark Byte Systems Inc. (SBS) is looking for an organized, technically grounded, and proactive Office \& Operations Coordinator to serve as the operational backbone for both our NYC office and day\-to\-day technical workflows. In this multifaceted role, you will bridge day\-to\-day office operations with ongoing technical execution. You will work closely with our field technicians and software engineers, managing incoming support queues, directing task assignments, monitoring project milestones, purchasing hardware and project equipment, handling location\-setup billing transactions, and keeping our workplace running without friction. Because we do not run rigid sprint cycles, our work centers on continuous delivery, quick triage, and clear ticket prioritization. The ideal candidate brings familiarity with a Linux\-centric engineering workplace, communicates effortlessly across technical teams, and keeps projects moving forward in a fast\-paced environment. **Key Responsibilities1\. Technical Task Coordination \& Support Operations** * **Task \& Queue Management:** Manage ongoing technician assignments, monitor day\-to\-day workload capacity, and maintain clear task status visibility using Jira. * **Support Ticket Ownership:** Act as the first line for support ticket triage; prioritize incoming issues, direct assignments to the right technical specialists, follow up on blockers, and track issues to resolution. * **Operational Syncs \& Standups:** Organize and facilitate regular status check\-ins, technician handoffs, and priority reviews via Google Meet. * **Team Communication:** Keep operational channels clear, organized, and up to date using Slack (ticket updates, incident coordination, and field tech announcements). * **Process Improvement:** Continuously refine ticketing pipelines, intake forms, and resolution workflows to reduce turnaround times and support our technicians effectively. **2\. Project Procurement \& Location Billing Operations** * **Project Equipment Purchasing:** Source, order, and track delivery of specialized hardware, cameras, sensors, cabling, tools, and technical gear required for client deployments and technician project rollouts. * **Payment Gateway Management:** Administer merchant gateways/payment portals to process customer credit card charges for initial location onboarding. * **Billing Records \& Expense Tracking:** Maintain accurate purchase orders, receipts, transaction records, and invoice logs reconciled with the accounting team. **3\. Office \& Workplace Administration** * **NYC Workplace Logistics:** Manage on\-site office operations, desk setups, supply inventory, shipping/receiving of gear, and overall facility readiness. * **Vendor \& Facilities Liaison:** Serve as the point of contact for NYC building management, facilities personnel, maintenance, and internet/utility service providers. * **Onboarding \& Workstation Staging:** Partner with technical leads to coordinate workstation preparation (hardware procurement, seating, access passes) and schedule first\-week onboarding for new team members. * **Company Culture \& Events:** Organize team lunches, tech demonstrations, client site visits, and team social events. **Qualifications \& SkillsCore Qualifications (Must\-Haves)** * **Location:** Based in the Greater New York City area with the ability to work on\-site at our NYC office. * **Relevant Experience:** 2–5 years of experience in project management, technical operations coordination, or office administration within a tech company, IT services provider, or fast\-paced startup. * **Jira \& Ticket Management:** Practical hands\-on experience structuring Kanban boards, managing ticket queues, writing clear issue summaries, and tracking ticket lifecycles in Jira. * **Procurement \& Financial Admin:** Experience managing purchasing/procurement pipelines for equipment and navigating credit card payment gateways/billing tools (e.g., Stripe, Authorize.net, Square, or similar merchant platforms). * **Modern Collaboration Tools:** Proficiency with Slack (channel administration, thread organization) and Google Workspace (Google Meet, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Calendar). * **Communication \& Multi\-Tasking:** Exceptional written and verbal communication; ability to balance office logistics alongside fast\-moving technical ticket queues and purchasing requests. * **Project Methodology:** Experience with continuous flow, Kanban, or ITIL\-style incident and support queue management. **Familiarity \& Nice\-to\-Haves** * **Linux Familiarity:** Familiarity with or comfort working in a Linux\-centric environment (including basic command\-line interface literacy or shell basics, such as Ubuntu or Debian), as SBS operates on Linux systems and servers. * **Hardware \& Network Familiarity:** Prior exposure to or general familiarity with network routers, switches, and cameras is a plus. **Benefits \& Perks** * **Competitive Compensation:** Competitive base salary, commensurate with experience. * **Commuter Support:** Pre\-tax commuter benefits (MTA / transit passes). * **Time Off:** Paid time off (PTO) plus standard holidays. * **Health Insurance:** Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance coverage. Pay: $70,000\.00 \- $90,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Health insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Staff AI/ML Engineer, Edge Intelligence (Perception)
jobs.description: Job Description Help shape the future of physical AI in defense by building perception models for unmanned autonomous systems across aerial, maritime, land, and space domains. We’re looking for a deeply technical engineer who can turn emerging research into reliable autonomous capabilities and shares our conviction that AI can protect service members and civilians. As a Staff Engineer on the Model Development team within Applied AI, you’ll drive the design, training, adaptation, and evaluation of multimodal deep\-learning and foundation models for unmanned platforms. You’ll take hands\-on ownership of models that help autonomous systems understand their surroundings, recognize unfamiliar objects, and interpret scenes over time. Your work will account for limited compute, real\-time latency, noisy sensors, and changing environments, with rigorous evaluation of how perception performance affects downstream reasoning and autonomy. You’ll partner closely with teams in reasoning, MLOps, large\-scale simulation, autonomy, and inference to deliver capabilities as part of Hivemind Enterprise. What you’ll do * Design, implement, train, adapt, and evaluate perception models, with an emphasis on vision and multimodal foundation models for autonomous platforms. * Make and validate tradeoffs among vision foundation models, vision\-language models (VLMs), specialized deep\-learning models, and traditional computer vision methods. * Develop capabilities for detection, segmentation, tracking, and spatial and temporal scene understanding, including representations that support downstream reasoning and autonomy. * Build reproducible training and adaptation workflows using self\-supervised learning, supervised fine\-tuning, transfer learning, and distillation as appropriate. * Define data requirements, curation and annotation strategies, training objectives, and evaluation datasets that support meaningful comparisons across models and operating conditions. * Establish rigorous evaluations with real and simulated sensor data, measuring missed detections, false alarms, localization accuracy, temporal consistency, uncertainty, and generalization. * Incorporate latency, memory, compute, and power constraints into model architecture and training decisions in partnership with hardware, autonomy, and inference teams. * Diagnose model failures across environments and sensor conditions; use data mining, targeted curation, and training experiments to close performance gaps. * Deliver trained models, reproducible experiments, and clear performance evidence to partner teams, including documented limitations and interfaces for downstream use. * Set technical direction for perception model development, mentor engineers, and communicate experimental findings and tradeoffs to research, engineering, product, and organizational leadership. Required Qualifications * BS/MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, and/or similar degree, or equivalent practical experience. Typically requires a minimum of 7 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 6 years and a Master’s degree; or 4 years with a PhD; or equivalent work experience. * Demonstrated track record of developing and deploying perception models in production, with substantial hands\-on contributions to model design, training, and evaluation. In particular, a demonstrated track record of designing model architectures, training objectives, and loss functions. * Deep expertise in computer vision, modern deep learning, and vision or multimodal foundation models. * Strong command of training and adaptation approaches such as self\-supervised learning, supervised fine\-tuning, transfer learning, and distillation. * Experience defining datasets, training objectives, benchmarks, and reproducible experiments, with attention to data leakage, label quality, and distribution shift. * Fluency in traditional computer vision, geometry, and probabilistic methods, and an ability to combine them thoughtfully with learned models. * Strong Python programming skills and experience with training frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow. * Demonstrated depth in one or more perception areas, such as object detection, segmentation, tracking, 3D understanding, or video representation learning. * Experience working with real sensor data and evaluating model robustness across changes in viewpoint, lighting, weather, or sensor characteristics. * Familiarity with NVIDIA Jetson or other edge compute platforms and the tradeoffs involved in deploying perception models under resource constraints. Preferred Qualifications * MS or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or similar degree. * Experience optimizing models for edge deployment using quantization, pruning, distillation, or hardware\-aware architecture choices. * Experience with open\-vocabulary perception, vision\-language alignment, or adaptation to new domains with limited labeled data. * Experience with robotic or unmanned autonomous systems, including multimodal sensing (e.g. EO/IR, IMU, lidar, radar, etc.), geometric scene representations, sensor fusion, etc. * Experience with large\-scale datasets, distributed training, and reproducible experimentation across multiple GPUs. * Familiarity with synthetic data, sensor simulation, and methods for measuring and reducing simulation\-to\-real gaps. Compensation Range: $200K \- $300K

jobs.title: Principal Machine Learning and Image Processing Engineer
jobs.description: Akura Medical, a Shifamed portfolio company, is advancing a differentiated platform for the treatment of venous thromboembolism (VTE), which affects up to 900,000 Americans each year. The company recently received US IDE approval for its QUADRA\-PE study evaluating the Katana™ Thrombectomy System in acute pulmonary embolism patients. In parallel, Akura Medical is developing NavIQ™, a software platform that transforms CT angiograms into 3D pulmonary vascular models to enhance visualization, procedural planning, and clot assessment towards better safety, efficacy, and ease of use. Akura has recently completed a $53 million first close of its Series C financing, led by the Qatar Investment Authority, supporting the launch of a joint venture and a new R\&D and manufacturing center in Doha, Qatar. ABOUT SHIFAMED Founded in 2009 by serial entrepreneur Amr Salahieh, Shifamed LLC is a privately held medical device innovation hub focused on the development of novel medical products to address clinical needs in the rapidly evolving fields of cardiology and ophthalmology. Description: We are hiring a principal engineer to own our imaging ML, from data to deployed model. You will help set the technical direction, run the experiments that decide it, and turn the results into models that physicians use. Responsibilities, Skills \& Hands\-On Experience: * Build and train 3\-D segmentation and refinement models for CT scans and other imaging modalities. * Design experiments that hold up: a declared protocol, held\-out evaluation, paired statistics, and training to convergence before any verdict. * Turn segmentations into quantitative measures, such as vessel size, obstruction and perfusion. * Build model\-in\-the\-loop labelling with radiologists and annotation teams. * Orchestrate AI coding and research agents: set the direction, review their work, and catch what they miss. * Run training at scale on our GPU servers and keep every result reproducible. * Bring in new methods from the literature when they solve a real problem, and drop them when they do not. Education \& Work Experience: * A record of moving a hard metric in machine learning or image processing, with numbers. * Strong PyTorch and 3\-D deep learning: segmentation, multi\-scale models, topology\-aware losses. * Image processing fundamentals: resampling, geometry, morphology, skeletons, distance transforms. * Statistics for experiments: power, paired comparisons, confidence intervals, and knowing when a result is noise. * Daily work with AI coding agents, and a clear view of where they fail. * Medical imaging (CT, Fluoroscopy, DICOM and NIfTI, MONAI or nnU\-Net) is a plus, not a requirement. * Experience with regulated medical imaging software is a strong plus. Our salary ranges are calculated by role, level, and location. Please note that your position within that range will be determined by your job\-related knowledge, location, skills, experience, relevant education, and training/certifications. jobs.title: Staff Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description: ### **Description** We’re SmartThings, one of the leading IoT ecosystems in the world, creating the most effortless way for anyone to create a smart home. We're a wholly owned subsidiary of Samsung with corporate offices in Minneapolis and the Bay Area. More than 430 million people worldwide use SmartThings to control and manage their connected life. SmartThings delivers simple, powerful experiences across Samsung’s leading portfolio of phones, TVs, and appliances. We also offer the most versatile smart home experience as an open platform with a rich partner ecosystem (think IKEA, SONOS, Honeywell, and so many more). As a founding member of Matter, we are a leader in the industry to help make smart homes more secure, reliable and seamless to use. Come be a part of the leading edge of IoT innovation! **About The Team:** The Hub Platform team owns foundational software, infrastructure, and operational practices that power SmartThings hubs in the field, and we're building the architecture that lets us support future hub platforms as they come online. The SmartThings Hub acts as a secure edge gateway that translates and bridges local, cross\-protocol IoT devices to the SmartThings cloud, enabling centralized routing and execution across a unified ecosystem. We work across three pillars:* Hub Systems \& Architecture: the embedded Linux OS, secure boot chain, firmware rollout process, and hardware platform abstraction * Hub to Cloud Connections \& Attestation: secure hub\-to\-cloud connectivity, device claim, and attestation so every hub in the field is uniquely identified and trusted * Hub Developer Operations: the CI/build infrastructure that keeps the entire hub engineering org shipping reliably and the tooling that keeps engineers developing efficiently Our work sits at the intersection of embedded firmware and cloud services, and it directly determines the stability, security, and update reliability that millions of connected homes rely on every day. **About The Role:** We're looking for a **Staff Embedded Software Engineer** to be a technical owner and leader for the Hub Platform team. You'll help drive long\-term technical strategies for our core domains. You'll operate with autonomy to bring clarity to complex, cross\-functional challenges. You’ll act as a go\-to expert and point of contact for major initiatives, and partner closely with firmware, security, cloud, and product teams to shape how SmartThings hubs evolve. You'll also mentor engineers across the team, including senior engineers, and help guide how the team adopts AI\-assisted development and operational practices. This role is **hybrid, 3 days/week in our Minneapolis Office** (on iconic St Anthony Main across from Downtown...with paid attached parking!). The pay range for this role is **$139,000 to $198,000,** with an annual bonus target of 20%.### **Key Responsibilities** This position is a hybrid role, based onsite 3 days a week at our office in Minneapolis, MN. In this role, your primary responsibilities will include the following:* **Technical Strategy Ownership:** Define and drive long\-term technical vision for one or more Hub Platform team domains so that our solutions scale to support future hub platforms. * **Lead Complex Initiatives:** Act as a technical owner for large, complex, cross\-functional projects, architecting scalable solutions for evolving domain needs. * **Architect for Reliability \& Security:** Guide architecture and design decisions for systems like the firmware update pipeline, hub OS platform abstraction, B2B partner integrations, or hub\-to\-cloud connectivity, with stability, security, and operational excellence as first\-class concerns. * **AI Practices \& Vision Collaboration:** Help define how the team uses AI\-assisted development and operational tooling, evaluating where AI can meaningfully improve velocity and quality, and set a forward\-looking vision for responsible AI adoption in the organization. * **Cross\-Functional Partnership:** Collaborate with firmware, security, cloud infrastructure, and product management to keep technical direction aligned with product requirements and business needs. * **Mentor \& Elevate the Team:** Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers at every level, including senior engineers, and help build engineering practices that raise the bar across the org. * **Operational Excellence \& On\-Call:** Participate in observability, incident response, and on\-call rotations supporting the production firmware delivery, hub connectivity, and attestation services that the global hub fleet depends on. ### **Skills, Knowledge \& Expertise** **What You Bring On Day One (Required Qualifications)*** Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field * 8\+ years of production software engineering experience, with a demonstrated track record operating at a Staff\-level technical leadership capacity * Strong knowledge of embedded Linux systems and boot chain validation, including kernel/system\-level security, secure boot, and firmware signing * Strong knowledge of device security fundamentals: mTLS/PKI, attestation, secure provisioning, and trusted execution environments (e.g. TrustZone/OP\-TEE) * Strong experience designing and operating distributed, cloud\-based backend systems (AWS) that support firmware delivery, device connectivity, or IoT fleets at scale * Strong knowledge of AI development tools and practices * Experience with software virtualization and packaging (Docker or similar containerization tools) for building, testing, and deploying services * Proven ability to lead architecture and design reviews, set technical direction across teams, and bring about simple solutions to complex problems * Strong track record of cross\-functional collaboration with firmware, security, product, and partner engineering teams * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience translating technical strategy for both technical and non\-technical audiences **Desired Skills*** Proficiency in Rust * Experience with IoT fleet management: device provisioning, monitoring, and lifecycle management at scale * Experience with IoT connectivity protocols and standards (Matter, Thread, MQTT) * Experience with CI/CD infrastructure and build systems supporting embedded firmware (e.g. GitHub Actions runners, reproducible build pipelines) * Experience supporting partner ecosystem programs (e.g. OEM/partner integration models) ### **SmartThings Benefits** * We offer an attractive compensation package with comprehensive health benefits, including medical, dental, vision, and mental health; an HSA with employer contribution; life \& disability insurance; FSAs for health and dependent care expenses; a competitive 401k with a 5% employer match, and more. * All of our employees enjoy unlimited PTO, 12 paid holidays, and a generous parental leave policy (8 weeks fully paid parental leave and 8 more fully paid weeks for childbirth recovery leave). * Eligible employees benefit from our education reimbursement program, and all employees enjoy access to learning resources through O’Reilly. * Our commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging is embedded into our culture and our work, and everyone has frequent opportunities to join forums and groups and participate in ongoing projects. * We offer a parking stipend to cover the monthly garage cost. EV chargers are also onsite. * In\-office catered lunches on Thursdays. * Access to the onsite gym. Base compensation range for this position is $139,000 to $198,000 annually. Actual base within this range will depend on many factors including experience, skills, technical expertise and market alignment. In addition, this role is eligible for a 20% annual target bonus based heavily on individual performance. At SmartThings, we are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible environment for all. If you require accommodations to participate in our hiring process or to perform the requirements of the job, we will work with you to meet your needs in compliance with applicable laws. Please reach out to talent@smartthings.com and a member of our Talent Acquisition team will connect with you further!### **About SmartThings** **Creating a safer, smarter world with you.** SmartThings brings your home to life by being the leading open platform for the consumer Internet of Things. Bringing together developers, device makers, and service providers to make the world a smarter place. From a door that knows when to lock itself, to a living room that can get the party started or a sink that can help to call a plumber; the opportunities are endless to make everyday objects around us more useful. So if you’re innovative, not afraid to challenge status quo, collaborative and have a passion for technology, then you’ve found your next home with SmartThings!

jobs.title: Business Systems Engineer – People Systems & AI Automation
jobs.description: ### **Who is Sonar?** Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development. Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. ### **Position description** The Business Technology team is composed of passionate technologists who are fully engaged in delivering the best products that help teams deliver their best work. We are focused on reducing friction and getting the most value from solutions to enhance outcomes, and we are building an AI\-first approach to how Sonar runs its internal operations. This role sits at the intersection of People operations, enterprise integration, and AI\-driven automation. You will be the technical owner of Sonar’s People technology stack: our new global HR information system (HRIS), our recruiting and applicant tracking platform, time and attendance, performance and compensation tools, and the HR service desk in Jira Service Management. You will connect these systems to identity management, IT, finance, and our data warehouse, so that employee data is accurate, secure, and available wherever it is needed. AI is a core part of the job. You will design and build AI assistants, agents, and automations that answer employee and manager questions, triage HR requests, support recruiters, and remove manual work across the employee lifecycle, always with the right controls for sensitive data. As Sonar grows, your scope will extend to further business applications in the BizTech portfolio. Your success will give Sonar one trusted employee record, a seamless experience from candidate to new hire to alumni, and People teams who spend their time on people rather than on systems. ### **What you will do** You are confident in owning and evolving business applications for a fast\-growing, multi\-site, and multi\-national organization. jobs.title: Staff AI Engineer
jobs.description: Staff AI Engineer Remote, USA Series E healthtech company We empower people to improve and prevent chronic metabolic diseases, like type 2 diabetes and obesity, with a new standard of care. We are applying AI Digital Twin technology exclusively toward metabolic health. We start by building a dynamic model of each person’s metabolism, drawing on thousands of data points from CGMs, smartwatches, and meal logs, that maps their personal path to better health. Guided by a dedicated clinical care team, our members have lowered their A1C below the diabetes range, achieved lasting weight loss, and reduced or even eliminated medications, all while living healthier, happier lives. Opportunity We are seeking a Staff AI Engineer to join our Core AI team to shape the technical direction of our AI\-driven product using the latest techniques in Gen AI, AI agents, and deep learning. This is powered by our Digital Twin AI, which combines Predictive and Generative AI to provide individualized insights and recommendations that improve the health of our members every day. This is a senior technical leadership role for someone who wants to solve hard, ambiguous problems at the system level, not just within a single feature, but across the architecture, tooling, and standards that the whole Core AI team relies on. You’ll set technical direction across multiple AI products, mentor senior engineers, and be the person others turn to when a problem doesn’t have an obvious owner. Responsibilities Design and build the core architecture for AI systems spanning multiple product areas, ensuring coherence and reuse across different applications. Set the technical bar for the org: evaluation frameworks, testing philosophy, CI/CD for model behavior, and shared infrastructure used across multiple teams. Identify and resolve systemic engineering gaps before they become team\-wide problems, proactively, not just in response to escalations. Take direct ownership of the hardest, most ambiguous technical problems on the team, the ones without an established playbook, and build the solution end\-to\-end. Build and ship conversational agents, deep learning models, and personalization systems that require novel technical approaches. Improve AI/ML systems and services to drive behavior change and sustained metabolic health improvements across our member base. Raise the technical level of the team through code review and design review, this is IC technical leadership, not people management. You will not have direct reports. Partner with product, engineering leadership, and clinical/research teams to turn ambiguous goals into technical designs you then build. Other duties as assigned. Qualifications 8\+ years of industry experience developing AI and Machine Learning systems in production, with a track record of leading technical initiatives that span multiple teams or systems. Deep software engineering fundamentals: testing, CI/CD, system design, code review, with demonstrated experience designing evaluation infrastructure and shared tooling for LLM\-based systems, not just using it. Proven experience setting technical direction and engineering standards at an organizational level, not just within a single team or codebase. Experience creating and scaling applications leveraging LLMs, Generative AI, advanced Prompt Engineering, RAG, and iterative AI evals in production. Track record of mentoring senior engineers and influencing technical decisions beyond your own project. Experience with Voice AI or specialized Language Models (VLMs, multi\-modal, etc.) is a plus. Proficiency in Python and software engineering best practices at a level where you’re often the one defining what “best practice” means for the team. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field. This remote opportunity based out of the U.S. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time. Compensation The compensation range for this position is $250,000\-$265,000 annually.

jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer (Tech Lead)
jobs.description: **Tabs is the AI Operating System for Revenue, built for modern finance and accounting teams.** It combines deep revenue and accounting expertise with the agents and applications needed to run revenue work end to end. Tabs understands customer and contract context, applies accounting logic, and executes critical workflows with built in controls, auditability, and human oversight. With Tabs, finance teams can move from manually managing revenue workflows to directing outcomes while the system executes the work. ### **About the Role** We're looking for a hands\-on Technical Lead for our Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team that builds solutions for merchants whose needs go beyond what Tabs supports out of the box. This isn't a traditional feature team. You'll work on real customer problems, often with messy requirements, unusual integrations, tight timelines, and no obvious solution. Sometimes the right answer is a quick, pragmatic fix. Sometimes it's a custom workflow or integration. And sometimes you'll discover a problem that deserves to be solved properly in the core product. Your job is to help the team make those calls, build great solutions, and ship them. Some of it will be scrappy, some will become core product, and telling the difference is part of the work. **This is a role for an engineer who likes shipping fast, enjoys ambiguity, and thrives on untangling hard problems to find durable, root\-cause fixes.** You'll set the technical direction for the team while remaining hands\-on in the code. You'll work closely with customer\-facing teams, product, and the rest of engineering to turn ambiguous business problems into working software. You'll also help bridge the gap between customer solutions and the core platform: identifying what's worth reusing, what needs to be built properly, and what should stay a one\-off. ### **How We Work** * **We move fast.** Two\-week sprints, weekly ship goals, short feedback cycles. We value working software over elaborate plans. * **We get close to the problem.** We talk to merchants, understand their workflows, and figure out what actually needs solving. Requirements aren't always going to arrive neatly packaged. * **We work together.** We're an NYC\-based, in\-office team that values collaboration, whiteboards, and solving hard problems together. Lunch and dinner in the office are on us. ### **What You'll Do** * **Lead technically.** Set technical direction for the FDE team, make architectural decisions, review code, mentor engineers, and ship production software yourself. Be the technical point of contact between FDE and core engineering. * **Turn messy problems into working solutions.** Work with customer\-facing teams to understand complex requirements, make sensible tradeoffs, and build custom workflows, integrations, and tools that deliver real value. * **Lift up the rug.** Identify problems that keep coming up across merchants and work with core engineering and product to turn the right solutions into reusable capabilities. * **Own what you ship.** From initial problem\-solving through implementation, deployment, and production support. * **Help build the team.** Raise the engineering bar for the entire organization through mentorship, code reviews, technical standards, and hiring. ### **About You** * **You're an experienced engineer.** You have 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience and have built, shipped, and operated real production systems. * **You're a technical leader and a cross\-functional communicator.** You've led projects, influenced technical decisions, and helped other engineers do better work. You can explain tradeoffs to stakeholders, and collaborate effectively with other engineering teams. * **You've delivered for customers under real deadlines.** You'd rather ship a fix that works within the constraints than a perfect one that misses the date. * **You thrive in ambiguity.** You can work backward from a business problem, ask the right questions, and figure out what to build. * **You take ownership.** When something is broken, unclear, or blocking a customer, you don't wait for someone else to figure out whose problem it is. * **You understand how systems fit together.** You're comfortable with APIs, data models, integrations, and failure modes, especially at scale. * **You're comfortable with modern development tools.** Experience with TypeScript, Python, or similar languages. Familiarity with SQL and data pipelines is a plus. **Location:** NYC, 5 days onsite **Perks and Benefits (Full\-time Employees)** --------------------------------------------- * Competitive compensation and equity * Unlimited PTO * Up to 100% employer covered monthly healthcare premium (medical, dental, vision) * Lunch provided via Sharebite, plus dinner for any later in office days. * Parental leave up to 12 weeks * Tax free commuter and parking benefits * Voluntary insurances (Life, Hospital, Critical Illness, Accident) * Employee Assistance Program (Rightway) * Free One Medical Membership * 401k Tabs is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome teammates of all identities and do not discriminate on the basis of race, ethnicity, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. We’re committed to creating an environment where everyone can grow, contribute, and feel comfortable being themselves. Compensation Range: $175K \- $240K

jobs.title: Platform Manager
jobs.description: Finance \& Payments organization powers the financial backbone of a global marketplace, processing billions of dollars in transactions across 220\+ countries and regions. As a Product Manager for Data Platforms within Fintech \& Finance, you will build and evolve the data infrastructure and tooling that enables financial engineering, payments, tax, and treasury teams to operate with speed, accuracy, and compliance. You will work closely with product leadership, engineering, and cross\-functional teams to make data a core enterprise asset that optimizes our financial systems and reporting. This is a high\-impact role at the intersection of FinTech, data engineering, and Data Platform product management. **Key Responsibilities** · Own the product vision and roadmap for data platforms serving Finance and Fintech domains including payments data pipelines, financial reporting infrastructure, and compliance data systems. · Partner closely with Finance Engineering, Payments, Tax, Accounting, and Treasury teams to understand data needs and translate them into scalable platform solutions. · Drive development of self\-serve financial data products enabling analysts, accountants, and finance business partners to access trusted, timely data without engineering dependencies. · Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and auditability across financial datasets — critical for regulatory compliance (SOX, PCI\-DSS, GDPR) and external reporting. · Define and track KPIs around data freshness, pipeline reliability, financial data quality, and platform adoption. · Collaborate with Data Engineering and ML teams to build scalable ETL/ELT pipelines, data models, and financial data warehouses. · Lead platform governance initiatives — data lineage, access controls, PII handling, and financial data classification. · Manage the product lifecycle — from discovery and spec writing to launch, iteration, and deprecation. · Bring in fresh ideas on leveraging and implement AI agents at scale to solve complex data quality challenges around detective monitoring, data integrity, completeness, accuracy, accelerate current Core Datasets pipeline maintenance/ enhancements through AI agents. · Communicate roadmap and priorities clearly to senior stakeholders including Finance leadership and Engineering directors. **Qualifications** Required · 15\+ years of Product Management experience, with at least 5\+ years in data platforms, fintech, payments, or financial systems. · Deep understanding of financial data concepts like marketplace, payments, contracts, transactions, direct/indirect taxes, accounting, revops and financial and compliance reporting, etc · Shaped business or finance processes not just built pipelines to spec. Preferred · Experience at a fintech company, payments platform, or marketplace · Familiarity with payments ecosystem. multi\-currency, cross\-border payouts, fraud, and tax infrastructure. · Experience building financial data products consumed by non\-technical finance stakeholders. · Background in internal developer platforms or platform engineering. · Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Finance, Engineering, or a related field. **What Makes You Successful Here** · Trait, Why It Matters at Finance · Financial Acumen, You understand the nuances of payments, reconciliation \& reporting · Technical Depth, You can engage deeply with data engineers on complex pipeline design · Regulatory Awareness, Financial data demands precision and compliance rigor · Stakeholder Influence, You align Finance, Engineering, and Legal without formal authority · Customer Obsession, Internal finance teams are your users — their trust is everything · Bias for Accuracy, In fintech, data errors have real financial and legal consequences **Scope \& Impact** · Serve as the data platform owner for one of most critical domains — Finance and Payments. · Enable faster financial close cycles, more accurate revenue reporting, and compliant data handling at global scale. · Support public company obligations (is NYSE\-listed) by ensuring financial data infrastructure meets audit and reporting standards. · Directly influence tools used by Finance, Accounting, Tax, Treasury, and Payments teams across globally. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer – Customer Files Orchestration
jobs.description: **Job description** **Staff Software Engineer — Customer Files Orchestration** CoCounsel Legal is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to help build and operate the **Customer Files Orchestration Service** – the system that makes a customer's own documents usable by CoCounsel Legal's agents. Every file a customer brings to CoCounsel passes through this team: **upload, storage, extraction, embedding, and indexing** , orchestrated end\-to\-end. You make millions of customer files available to CoCounsel. Bringing a customer's content together with Thomson Reuters' world\-class proprietary content and the latest frontier models – including TR's own custom large language models – is what makes our products highly differentiated and our agent experiences genuinely grounded. This team is a critical part of what makes that combination possible. It is also, unavoidably, a hard distributed systems problem. Supporting millions of files means real engineering: dedicated workers, fair queuing so one busy customer cannot starve another, durable state, idempotent processing, and honest reasoning about consistency and delivery guarantees across systems this team does not own. The team owns what it builds, designing, implementing, testing, deploying, scaling, and operating the service end\-to\-end. As a Senior Software Engineer you own a meaningful part of that service outright. You are eager to ship something you’re proud of and become someone the team trusts. **Key responsibilities:** **Design \& Technical Ownership** * **Own the orchestration service end\-to\-end** – Take an ambiguous problem, shape it into a design, write the ADR, build it, ship it, and operate it. You and the team are accountable for the outcome, not just the pull request. * **Make and defend the calls that define this domain** – Where eventual consistency is safe and where only a strongly\-consistent read is correct; at\-least\-once with idempotent processing versus the real cost of exactly\-once; lease and heartbeat models for crash recovery; compare\-and\-swap state transitions across asynchronous service boundaries. * **Build the queuing and flow\-control machinery** – Fair queuing so one busy tenant cannot starve another, rate limiting, backpressure, circuit breaking, dead\-letter handling, and autoscaling. * **Treat our APIs as a product** – CoCounsel's file and workspace APIs serve a growing set of consumers beyond orchestration. We protect personal data across its full lifecycle, from collection and transfer through access, storage, retention, and deletion. We develop the platforms, technical controls, and governance tools behind privacy protection and regulatory compliance in global markets, and we bring privacy\-enhancing technologies and research into production at scale. We tackle challenges unique to operating a platform at global scale: translating rapidly evolving laws and policies into reliable technical controls, providing transparency and auditability across highly complex data systems, supporting different regulatory requirements across regions, and making privacy protection work at the quality and speed production systems demand. You will work across product privacy, data lifecycle management, data protection and residency, privacy engineering platforms, AI governance, and privacy\-preserving technologies, using techniques including automated compliance enforcement, data lineage and taxonomy, differential privacy, trusted execution environments, AI fairness, and privacy protection for generative AI. jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Come build what's next with Topsort!** **About Topsort** Topsort is a global Commerce AI company making advanced advertising and AI\-powered technology accessible to businesses of all sizes. Our technology helps retailers and marketplaces grow through smarter advertising, real\-time auctions, and intelligent product discovery. With a presence in 40\+ countries and a growing international team, we're building the technology behind the next generation of commerce. **What Is This Role Like?** We're looking for an **Senior AI Engineer** to join our T\-Brain team and help build the intelligence powering the next generation of commerce. T\-Brain is Topsort's AI platform, developing machine learning models that power predictions, recommendations, and smarter decision\-making across retail environments. In this role, you'll work at the intersection of Machine Learning, Data Science, and Software Engineering, developing models, running experiments, and turning complex data into scalable, production\-ready solutions. **What You'll Own** * **Machine Learning Development:** Design, train, evaluate, and improve ML models for predictions, recommendations, and other commerce applications. * **Experimentation \& Validation:** Design and run experiments, including A/B testing, to evaluate model performance and make statistically grounded decisions. * **Production ML:** Build, deploy, and maintain reliable ML solutions using cloud infrastructure, ensuring scalability and performance. * **Data \& Modeling:** Work with complex datasets to identify patterns, develop predictive models, and improve model effectiveness. * **Model Innovation:** Contribute to the development of large\-scale foundation models and explore how experimental findings can be applied across different use cases. #### **What Success Looks Like** * **Production\-Ready Models:** ML models are reliably deployed, maintained, and performing at scale in production environments. * **Validated Improvements:** Experiments demonstrate measurable improvements against established baselines, supported by sound statistical evidence. * **Model Performance:** Predictions and recommendations deliver consistent, measurable improvements in accuracy, relevance, or other defined performance metrics. * **Scalable Solutions:** Models and experimental findings can be adapted and extended across different clients and retail use cases. * **Continuous Improvement:** Monitoring, experiment results, and changing data patterns inform ongoing improvements in model performance and reliability. **What You'll Bring** *Don't check every box? We'd still love to hear from you. We value curiosity, strong judgment, and people who take ownership of results:* * **Relevant Experience:** 5\+ years of experience in Machine Learning Engineering, Applied Machine Learning, or Data Science, with hands\-on experience deploying models in production. * **Academic Background:** BSc. degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field**.** * **Machine Learning:** Strong experience developing, training, evaluating, and optimizing ML models for real\-world applications. * **Cloud ML:** Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure, including model training, deployment, and scalable ML pipelines. * **Python \& Data:** Strong Python skills and experience with SQL, data processing, and working with large datasets. * **Experimentation:** Solid statistical foundations and practical experience designing, running, and interpreting A/B tests to evaluate model performance. * **Software Engineering:** Strong coding practices and experience building reliable, maintainable, production\-ready ML systems. **Nice To Have:** * Experience in e\-commerce, Retail Media, AdTech, or personalization. * Experience with recommendation systems, search relevance, retrieval, or ranking models. * Familiarity with deep learning architectures, including neural networks and transformers, using frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow. * Familiarity with emerging ML research and experience applying new techniques to practical problems. **Who Thrives Here** *We set a high bar for engineering because the systems we build matter. You'll thrive here if you:* * **Ownership \& Quality:** You take responsibility for what you build, write production\-ready code, and leave systems better than you found them. * **Engineering Judgment:** You make thoughtful technical decisions, communicate tradeoffs honestly, and balance speed with long\-term reliability. * **Collaboration \& Communication:** You share knowledge, communicate openly, and work effectively across teams to solve complex challenges. * **Curiosity \& Attention to Detail:** You care about the details, continuously improve your skills, and explore new technologies with a critical mindset. *We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and to foster a workplace where diversity is valued and celebrated. We believe that diverse perspectives and experiences strengthen our teams and drive better outcomes. We respect and value any race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, caste, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, marital status, or military service.* **Do you sound like the right fit? Let's dive right in!**
