jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description: Build the product where anyone with expertise trains their own intelligence. Today that takes a builder and a benchmark. We're heading to a product where a lawyer or a banker describes what good looks like, and the platform does the research for them. **About Trajectory** -------------------- Trajectory is a research and product lab building the platform for continual learning, where agents get smarter with every interaction. AI is the most capable software ever built, and the least able to learn. Every correction and edit that happens in a product evaporates at the next session. Our platform turns the signal already sitting in product usage into continuously post\-trained models, and lets anyone train a large\-scale model with just a few agent prompts. We just launched self\-serve and work with Harvey, Rogo, Decagon, and NVIDIA. Our researchers worked on Gemini 3 at DeepMind and GPT\-4o at OpenAI, and our product team comes from Apple Vision Pro, Netflix, and Stripe. We've raised $60M in a Sequoia\-led Series A, alongside Conviction, Bessemer, NVIDIA, Jeff Dean, and Fei\-Fei Li. **The role** ------------ Trajectory makes it simple to train a model on production data. You can do it from the web app, with one click to train and evaluate and a live view of every run, or by connecting a coding agent and doing the same thing with a couple of prompts. As a Product Engineer, you'll build both of those interfaces, and both should be equally clean. You'll iterate quickly on feedback from the customers we work with every week, and work directly with our researchers to bring new research paradigms from a customer demo into the mainline product. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Build the platform frontend: training and eval flows, run monitoring, model comparison, and the in\-platform agent. * Design and own the agent SDK and its abstractions, so customers and coding agents can do everything the UI can. * Ship fast against real customer feedback, and tell customer\-specific requests apart from things that belong in the product. * Partner with researchers to turn new methods into product features. * Hold a high bar for craft in both the pixels and the API surface. **Who you are** --------------- * Strong full\-stack engineer with real product taste. You care how things look and feel, and how they read in code. * You've shipped high\-quality product to real users, or designed SDKs and developer primitives people love to use. * Comfortable working directly with customers and turning ambiguous feedback into shipped work. * You build with AI daily and are curious about how models are trained. * You move quickly and own problems end to end. **Nice to have** ---------------- * You've worked at a product company known for craft, or on a widely used SDK or API. * Experience with data\-dense interfaces, observability, or developer tools. * Founding or early engineer at a 0 1 AI product.

jobs.description: **Job Family** IT \- Development**About Us** At Transamerica, hard work, innovative thinking, and personal accountability are qualities we honor and reward. We understand the potential of leveraging the talents of a diverse workforce. We embrace an environment where employees enjoy a balance between their careers, families, communities, and personal interests. Ultimately, we appreciate the uniqueness of a company where talented professionals work collaboratively in a positive environment — one focused on helping people look forward and plan for the best life possible while providing tools and solutions that make it easier to get there. **Who We Are** We believe everyone deserves to live their best life. More than a century ago, we were among the first financial services companies in America to serve everyday people from all walks of life. Today, we’re part of an international holding company, with millions of customers and thousands of employees worldwide. Our insurance, retirement, and investment solutions help people make the most of what’s important to them. We’re empowered by a vast agent network covering North America, with diversity to match. Together with our nonprofit research institute and foundation, we tune in, step up, and are a force for good — for our customers and the communities where we live, work, and play. United in our purpose, we help people create the financial freedom to live life on their terms. **What We Do** Transamerica is organized into three distinct businesses. These include 1\) World Financial Group, including Transamerica Financial Advisors, 2\) Protection Solutions and Savings \& Investments, comprised of life insurance, annuities, employee benefits, retirement plans, and Transamerica Investment Solutions, and 3\) Financial Assets, which includes legacy blocks of long term care, universal life, and variable and fixed annuities. These are supported by Transamerica Corporate, which includes Finance, People and Places, General Counsel, Risk, Internal Audit, Strategy and Development, and Corporate Affairs, which covers Communications, Brand, and Government and Policy Affairs. Transamerica employs nearly 7,000 people. It’s part of Aegon, an integrated, diversified, international financial services group serving approximately 23\.9 million customers worldwide.\* For more information, visit transamerica.com. **Job Description Summary** The Senior Director of Software Engineering leads the enterprise adoption of AI\-assisted engineering, including agentic development environments such as Kiro. Define enterprise web, cloud and AI\-assisted engineering strategies, grow capabilities, and develop the team by providing technology vision and leadership, career development, and mentoring in design, framework and platform decisions. Define and communicate delivery plans, manage team budgets, and partner with leaders in key business and IT groups to deliver value through efficient use of development resources and responsible use of AI across the software development lifecycle.**Job Description** **What You Will Do:** AI\-Assisted Engineering* Own the strategy and roadmap for AI\-assisted software engineering across the development organization, positioning Kiro and related AI coding assistants as standard tooling across the software development lifecycle, from requirements and design through build, test, deployment and maintenance. * Lead the enterprise rollout and scaling of AI Assisted Engineering, including onboarding, enablement, licensing and usage management, and integration with existing developer tooling, source control, and CI/CD pipelines. * Establish spec\-driven development practices using Kiro specs (requirements, design and implementation task plans), steering files and agent hooks, so that AI\-generated code is traceable to approved requirements and consistent with enterprise architecture, coding and security standards. * Define and enforce guardrails for the responsible use of AI in engineering, partnering with Security, Risk, Compliance, Legal and Enterprise Architecture on data protection, intellectual property, model and tool access, secure configuration of Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, and auditability in a regulated financial services environment. * Maintain clear human accountability for AI\-generated output by setting standards for code review, automated testing, security scanning and quality gates that apply equally to human\-authored and AI\-authored code. * Measure and report the impact of AI\-assisted engineering using KPIs such as adoption, cycle time, deployment frequency, change failure rate, defect escape rate, developer experience and cost, and use the results to guide investment and prioritization decisions. * Build AI fluency across engineering teams through training, communities of practice, and shared assets such as reusable prompts, steering templates, spec patterns and reference implementations; identify and develop internal AI engineering c g employee development. Curiosity is the quality we value most. Much of our work involves solving complex problems, applying knowledge in new ways, and continuously improving how we operate. As technology evolves rapidly, we look for inquisitive people who are confident challenging the status quo and helping us drive change. *This job description is not a contract of employment nor for any specific job responsibilities. The Company may change, add to, remove, or revoke the terms of this job description at its discretion. Managers may assign other duties and responsibilities as needed. In the event an employee or applicant requests or requires an accommodation to perform job functions, the applicable HR Business Partner should be contacted to evaluate the accommodation request.* **What We Offer** For eligible employees, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support both the personal and financial well\-being of our employees. Compensation Benefits * Competitive Pay * Bonus for Eligible Employees Benefits Package * Pension Plan * 401k Match * Employee Stock Purchase Plan * Tuition Reimbursement * Disability Insurance * Medical Insurance * Dental Insurance * Vision Insurance * Employee Discounts * Career Training \& Development Opportunities Health and Work/Life Balance Benefits * Paid Time Off starting at 160 hours annually for employees in their first year of service. * Ten (10\) paid holidays per year (typically mirroring the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) holidays). * Be Well Company holistic wellness program, which includes Wellness Coaching and Reward Dollars * Parental Leave – fifteen (15\) days of paid parental leave per calendar year to eligible employees with at least one year of service at the time of birth, placement of an adopted child, or placement of a foster care child. * Adoption Assistance * Employee Assistance Program * Back\-Up Care Program * PTO for Volunteer Hours * Employee Matching Gifts Program * Employee Resource Groups * Inclusion and Diversity Programs * Employee Recognition Program * Referral Bonus Programs **Inclusion \& Diversity** We believe our commitment to diversity and inclusion creates a work environment filled with exceptional individuals. We’re thrilled to have been recognized for our efforts through the Human Rights Campaign Corporate Equality Index, Dave Thomas Adoption Friendly Advocate, and several Seramount lists, including the Inclusion Index, 100 Best Companies for Working Parents, Best Companies for Dads, and Top 75 Companies for Executive Women. To foster a culture of inclusivity throughout our workforce, workplace, and marketplace, Transamerica offers a wide range of diversity and inclusion programs. This includes our company\-sponsored, employee\-driven Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), which are formed around a shared interest or a common characteristic of diversity. ERGs are open to all employees. They provide a supportive environment to help us better appreciate our similarities and differences and understand how they benefit us all. **Giving Back** We believe our responsibilities extend beyond our corporate walls. That's why we created the Aegon Transamerica Foundation in 1994\. Through a mix of financial grants and the volunteer efforts of our employees, the foundation supports nonprofit organizations focused on the things that matter most to our people in the communities where we live and work. **Transamerica’s Parent Company** Aegon acquired the Transamerica business in 1999\. Since its start in 1844, Aegon has grown into an international company serving more than 23\.9 million people across the globe.\* It offers investment, protection, and retirement solutions, always with a clear purpose: **Helping people live their best lives.** As a leading global investor and employer, the company seeks to have a positive impact by addressing critical environmental and societal issues, with a focus on climate change and inclusion and diversity. * As of December 31, 2023

This is a full\-time, hybrid role based out of our Lower Manhattan, NYC office (2–3 days per week in person, currently pinned to Tuesdays and Wednesdays). **About Full Stack Software at Treeswift** ------------------------------------------ Our team’s primary directive is to serve the application thatTreeswift customers use to make critical business decisions. jobs.title: Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: **The Role** ------------ As an Infrastructure Engineer at Triumph, you'll own the foundation that everything else runs on. Until now, our infrastructure has been built and maintained by the core engineering team alongside everything else — you'll be on the team whose mandate is to make our foundation fast, observable, and bulletproof. Our platform touches gaming, finance, and social at scale, which means there's no margin for downtime. You'll define how we build, ship, and scale from the ground up — CI/CD pipelines, IaC, data layer, orchestration, telemetry, and the glue in between. You’ll be part of a team empowering Triumph to grow and scale towards our next order of magnitude. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Set the standards, tooling, and practices that teams and future hires will build on. * Own and evolve our CI/CD pipelines, making it fast and safe for a growing team to ship continuously. * Take end\-to\-end ownership of scaling our backend systems, identifying bottlenecks before they become incidents and designing for the next 10x rather than the last one. * Drive our database strategy — query optimization, connection pooling, replication and read routing, schema evolution, and keeping our highest\-traffic data paths healthy under load. * Build out observability and telemetry so the team can see, understand, and act on system behavior in real time — metrics, tracing, structured logging, and meaningful alerting. * Partner with backend engineers to harden the systems that power our core business, from incident response to the architectural decisions that prevent the next one. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * 3\+ years of experience operating and scaling large production systems, with a track record of ownership — you don't just build it, you keep it healthy. * Strong Database knowledge, bonus points for Postgres. You understand query planning, indexing, connection management, and what actually breaks at scale (Go and AlloyDB experience is a plus). * Hands\-on experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines. * Fluency with observability and telemetry tooling, and an instinct for what to measure. * Comfort being the first and only person in a function — you're excited to set direction rather than inherit it, and you drive work to completion without a playbook handed to you. * Tenacity, pragmatism, and high agency — you prioritize the most impactful work and drive it to completion. * Adaptable, AI has supercharged development speeds and it’s no different at Triumph. Engineering moves quickly here and infra needs to stay ahead of evolving product needs as we grow. **Why Triumph?** ---------------- * High growth. Build a high\-scale consumer platform that touches gaming, finance, and social with the autonomy to set our infrastructure direction. (16x year over year growth). * High agency. As part of a rapidly growing team, you'll own a large surface area from day one, with significant opportunity for leadership and growth. * High energy. You’ll be joining a team of people who are passionate about the communities on our products and excited to ship new features. * Competitive salary and benefits. $400/mo lunch credit, healthcare, vision, dental, 401k, etc. Our team gathers 5 days a week at Triumph's headquarters at Levi's Plaza in San Francisco. Compensation Range: $200K \- $400K

True Zero recognizes that those outcomes begin and end with our people, and that is what we have built a community of like\-minded, driven, and passionate individuals and innovators who are aligned in a common goal of delivering top\-tier services to our customers. True Zero Technologies is seeking a Security Engineer to support the design, implementation, integration, and enhancement of enterprise cybersecurity capabilities across systems, networks, applications, and cloud environments. This position is responsible for securing enterprise IT infrastructure, integrating security and privacy controls throughout the Secure Systems Development Lifecycle (SDLC), supporting legacy system modernization, and implementing solutions to protect against current and emerging cybersecurity threats. The Security Engineer will collaborate with Information Systems Security Officers (ISSOs), system owners, security architects, Security Operations Center (SOC) teams, and customer stakeholders to deliver secure\-by\-design solutions that align with federal cybersecurity requirements, enterprise architecture standards, and Zero Trust principles. ### **Job Responsibilities** * Enterprise Security Engineering: Design, deploy, configure, maintain, and enhance enterprise cybersecurity solutions across legacy and modernized systems, networks, applications, and cloud environments to protect against emerging threats and advanced persistent threats (APTs). * Secure SDLC and DevSecOps: Integrate security and privacy requirements throughout the Secure SDLC, perform static and dynamic code analysis, evaluate container security, review software dependencies, and apply DevSecOps practices to strengthen application development and deployment pipelines. * Vulnerability Management and Threat Mitigation: Conduct security risk assessments, support vulnerability scanning and continuous penetration testing, analyze technical findings, research emerging threats, and develop engineering\-level mitigation and remediation recommendations. Support threat hunting, forensic analysis, and incident response activities as required. * Cybersecurity Tool Implementation and Integration: Support the design, deployment, configuration, integration, maintenance, and optimization of enterprise cybersecurity technologies, including SIEM platforms, vulnerability scanners, endpoint security tools, and network security solutions. * Security Architecture and Infrastructure Modernization: Contribute to secure enterprise architecture designs, operating system and security tool upgrades, infrastructure modernization, system migrations, and hardened configurations while supporting cloud security, Zero Trust, Supply Chain Risk Management (SCRM), and AI/ML security initiatives. * Federal Cybersecurity Compliance and Engineering Documentation: Implement security controls in alignment with applicable NIST guidance and federal cybersecurity requirements. Develop Detailed Security Designs, Concepts of Operations (CONOPS), Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), engineering analyses, metrics, trend reports, and risk\-based recommendations to support Assessment and Authorization (A\&A), strategic planning, and budget development. * Engineering Collaboration and Technical Support: Participate in Engineering Integrated Product Teams (IPTs), Technical Exchange Meetings (TEMs), and Engineering Technical Reviews (ETRs). Collaborate with security architects, ISSOs, system owners, common control providers, SOC teams, and other enterprise stakeholders to support secure solution delivery, CISA\-directed remediation activities, and emergency incident response. ### **Position Requirements** * Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field. * Minimum of two (2\) years of professional experience in cybersecurity engineering, security product implementation, systems engineering, network security, or related technical disciplines. * Hands\-on experience deploying, configuring, integrating, maintaining, and troubleshooting enterprise cybersecurity products and tools, including SIEM, endpoint detection and response (EDR), vulnerability management, or network security platforms. * Working knowledge of enterprise security architectures, Windows and Linux operating systems, networking fundamentals, system hardening, access controls, and secure infrastructure configurations. * Experience performing vulnerability assessments, analyzing security findings, evaluating technical risks, and implementing cybersecurity mitigation and remediation measures. * Familiarity with Secure SDLC, DevSecOps, static application security testing (SAST), dynamic application security testing (DAST), container security, and software dependency analysis. * Working knowledge of federal cybersecurity frameworks and standards, including NIST SP 800\-37, SP 800\-160, SP 800\-128, SP 800\-207, SP 800\-144, SP 800\-161, and the Risk Management Framework (RMF). * Understanding of cloud security, Zero Trust architecture, cybersecurity incident response, vulnerability management, and enterprise security control implementation. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, technical documentation, and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across cybersecurity, engineering, architecture, and IT operations teams. ### **Preferred Requirements** * Relevant industry certifications such as CompTIA Security\+, CySA\+, SecurityX, Systems Security Certified Practitioner (SSCP), or cloud security certifications from AWS or Microsoft. * Experience implementing and maintaining enterprise cybersecurity technologies such as Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, CrowdStrike Falcon, Microsoft Defender, Tenable, Rapid7, Palo Alto Networks, or equivalent platforms. * Experience with security automation and DevSecOps technologies, including Python, PowerShell, Terraform, Ansible, Git, Jenkins, Docker, SCRM, AI/ML security, and security authorization activities. jobs.title: Data Scientist, Discovery & Recommendations
jobs.description: ### **About Us** Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day. We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. We’re on a quest to empower live communities, so if this sounds good to you, see what we’re up to on LinkedIn and X, and discover the projects we’re solving on our Blog. Be sure to explore our Interviewing Guide to learn how to ace our interview process. ### **About the Team** Twitch is all about community, and our Community team is a core pillar of what makes Twitch, Twitch. Community Discovery \& ML (CDML) helps millions of viewers find the creators and communities they'll love. That covers search, browse, the mobile live and clips feeds, recommended notifications, and the recommendation systems behind them. When a viewer finds a new creator through one of these, it's often the start of a lasting connection. That connection is what keeps viewers, and the creators they watch, coming back. ### **About the Role** We're looking for a data scientist with strong statistics and modeling skills to be the science partner for the machine learning and recommendation systems behind Twitch's discovery products. You will work with product managers, ML engineers and applied scientists to help build what our recommendation systems should optimize for. That means balancing what a viewer does today (a click, a play, minutes watched) against what keeps them coming back: return visits, daily habits, and lasting connections with creators. It also means weighing short\-form clips against long\-form live content, and each surface against the others. This role will draw from a variety of statistical learning techniques, causal inference, optimization and recommender systems evaluation, and it still owns the full path from question to decision. Reporting to the Director of Data Science, you will work from our San Francisco, CA office. ### **You Will:** * Help define the objective functions and success metrics for ranking and recommendations across feeds, search and notifications. Make the trade\-offs explicit between short\-term engagement (clicks, plays, watch time) and long\-term outcomes (return visits, retention, new creator connections), including how short\-form clips and live content add to or take away from each other. * Evaluate ranking, recommendation and feed changes with ML engineers and applied scientists. This covers A/B tests and long\-running holdouts, offline metrics that predict online results, and the cost and value of exploration and cold start. Handle the hard cases: novelty effects, interference between experiments, two\-sided marketplace effects involving creators and viewers, and feedback loops in recommendation data. * Build statistical and ML models that explain viewer behavior and size opportunities, such as propensity, uplift, survival and retention models. Include proxy metrics that predict long\-term retention, so teams can decide in days rather than months. * Turn ambiguous product questions into clear analyses. Quantify the uncertainty, and make recommendations that inform the machine learning and discovery roadmap. * Define the logging and data needed to measure discovery surfaces, and check its quality. * Contribute to the team's standards for experimentation, causal inference and model evaluation, and share what you learn with other data scientists. ### **You Have:** * A BA/BS in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, Data Science or a related quantitative field, or equivalent industry experience. * 3\+ years as a data scientist in a high\-velocity, data\-driven environment, with hands\-on experience applying statistical modeling and machine learning (regression, classification, causal inference, time series), including the assumptions behind each method and when it fails. * Experience designing and analyzing online experiments, including variance reduction, power analysis and the pitfalls of interpreting results. * Expert SQL and proficiency in Python or R. * A track record of using data and models to influence product decisions and leadership. ### **Bonus Points** * An MS or PhD in a quantitative field. * Experience with recommender systems, search ranking or feed ranking, such as offline evaluation (precision and recall, NDCG), exploration versus exploitation, or cold\-start problems. * Experience with multi\-objective optimization or with defining objective functions for ranking systems, including choosing weights between competing goals. * Experience building proxy metrics for long\-term outcomes, or estimating long\-term effects from long\-running holdouts or observational data (e.g., difference\-in\-differences, synthetic control, uplift modeling). * Experience with two\-sided platforms or marketplaces, where changes for viewers also affect creators or supply. * Experience on a consumer content platform: streaming, short\-form video, social or marketplaces. * Familiarity with Twitch, as a viewer or a creator (or both!). ### **Perks** * Medical, Dental, Vision \& Disability Insurance * 401(k) * Maternity \& Parental Leave * Flexible PTO * Amazon Employee Discount *Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.* Job ID: TWR9333 The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign\-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life \& AD\&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits. US, CA, San Francisco $157,300 \- $212,800 USD *Twitch is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.* *Twitch values your privacy. Please consult our* *Candidate Privacy Notice**, for information about how we collect, use, and disclose personal information of our candidates.*

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer, Pricing & Gross-To-Net
jobs.description: California, US residents . **The job details are as follows:** Who We Are We are the first publicly\-traded biotech or pharmaceutical company to take the form of a public benefit corporation. Our public benefit purpose is to provide a brighter future for patients through the development of novel pharmaceutical therapies; and technologies that expand the availability of transplantable organs. United Therapeutics (Nasdaq: UTHR) seeks to travel down the corridors of indifference to develop treatments for rare, deadly diseases. We were founded in 1996 by a family seeking a cure for their daughter’s pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH). Today, we have six FDA\-approved therapies that treat PAH, pulmonary hypertension associated with interstitial lung disease (PH\-ILD) and neuroblastoma, a rare pediatric cancer. Our near\-term pipeline seeks to develop additional therapies for PAH and pulmonary fibrosis (PF). The cure for end\-stage life\-threatening diseases like PAH, PH\-ILD, PF, and many others is an organ transplant, but only a small percentage of donated organs are available to address the vast need. For this reason, we are working to create manufactured organs to address the shortage of kidneys, hearts, lungs, and livers available for transplant. We believe an unlimited supply of tolerable, transplantable organs will eliminate the transplant waiting list and cure end\-stage organ diseases for which transplant is not currently an option. Who You Are You are a hands\-on data engineering expert who thrives on turning complex, highly regulated pricing and gross\-to\-net (GTN) data into reliable, scalable solutions. You bring deep experience building and optimizing data platforms in Microsoft Fabric and Databricks, leveraging Python, PySpark, Spark SQL, SQL Server, and Power BI to deliver trusted forecasting insights. You enjoy owning the full data lifecycle, from integrating upstream ERP, rebate, wholesaler, and specialty pharmacy data sources to developing robust pipelines, semantic models, validation frameworks, and reporting solutions. You are a proactive problem solver who can identify root causes, make sound technical decisions, and execute independently with minimal direction. Most importantly, you're motivated by the opportunity to apply your technical expertise to solve meaningful healthcare challenges, supporting innovative therapies that improve the lives of patients while embracing United Therapeutics' bold, unconventional, and mission\-driven culture. The Senior Data Engineer, Pricing \& Gross\-To\-Net (GTN) will serve as the technical owner of the data pipelines, models, and integrations that power pricing and gross\-to\-net (GTN) forecasting. Partnering directly with management, you will build and maintain notebooks and pipelines in Microsoft Fabric and Databricks, connect upstream systems, and make sure forecast inputs are accurate, traceable, and on time. This role requires the ability to identify problems, choose the right solution, and deliver without step\-by\-step direction. * Design, build, and maintain notebooks and data pipelines in Microsoft Fabric and/or Databricks (Python, PySpark, Spark SQL) that feed pricing and GTN forecasting models * Translate pricing and GTN requirements (gross sales, rebates, chargebacks, Medicaid and 340B, fees, returns) into scalable data models * Develop and maintain Power BI semantic models and dashboards that surface pricing and GTN outputs * Manage job orchestration, performance tuning, and code quality across the pipeline stack * Develop and optimize SQL Server objects (tables, views, stored procedures) using SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS) * Organize and govern data assets in Databricks catalogs (Unity Catalog), including schemas, tables, and access controls * Build validation and reconciliation checks so forecast inputs tie back to source systems * Contribute to building and maintenance of systems that support 340B chargebacks, pricing data, and pricing calculations * Migrate and backfill databases, and onboard and maintain any newly acquired data sets * Map and integrate upstream systems, including ERP (e.g., SAP), contract and rebate platforms, and specialty pharmacy and wholesaler data feeds * Troubleshoot data issues end to end, from source system to final report * Drive technical decisions independently and recommend tools, architecture, and standards * Document systems and establish development standards, including version control, testing, and code review Minimum Requirements * H.S. Diploma or General Education Degree (GED) with 9\+ years of experience in data engineering or data systems development or * Associate’s Degree with 7\+ years of experience in data engineering or data systems development or * Bachelor’s Degree with 5\+ years of experience in data engineering or data systems development * Hands\-on development experience in Databricks, including notebooks and data pipelines * Proficiency in Python (PySpark) and advanced SQL (Spark SQL, T\-SQL), including query optimization * Hands\-on experience with SQL Server and SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS) * Power BI development experience, including semantic modeling, DAX, and Power Query (M) * Strong systems knowledge, including source system architecture, data integration, APIs, and cloud platforms (Azure preferred) * Demonstrated ability to work independently and own deliverables end to end * Databricks development experience, including Unity Catalog (catalogs, schemas, permissions), Workflows, and Delta Lake * Git and CI/CD practices for data pipelines * 10% Travel may be required for meetings and events Preferred Qualifications * Associate Degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, or a related field * Bachelor’s Degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, or a related field * Exposure to pharmaceutical GTN, pricing, or government price reporting (AMP, Best Price, ASP, URA) * SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) development experience * Hands\-on development experience in Microsoft Fabric or Job Location \& Travel This position will be located in the RTP, NC office of United Therapeutics. Currently this job is a hybrid role requiring at least three days per week in the office. In office requirements could increase based on business needs. This position will require candidates to have the ability to travel up to 10%. At United Therapeutics, our mission and vision are one. We use our enthusiasm, creativity, and persistence to innovate for the unmet medical needs of our patients and to benefit our other stakeholders. We are bold and unconventional. We have fun, we do good. jobs.title: Postdoctoral Scholar: Biochemical Network Simulation Software (libRoadRunner), Bioengineering
jobs.description: **Postdoctoral Scholar: Biochemical Network Simulation Software (libRoadRunner), Bioengineering** ================================================================================================= ### **Position Overview** **School / Campus / College:** School of Medicine **Organization:** Bioengineering (SOM) **Title:** Postdoctoral Scholar: Biochemical Network Simulation Software (libRoadRunner), Bioengineering ### **Position Details** #### **Position Description** The Department of Bioengineering at the University of Washington School of Medicine invites applications for a Postdoctoral Scholar with an anticipated start date of January 2027 (flexible). The successful candidate will join on a full\-time basis for a 12\-month, 2\-year, non\-renewable appointment beginning as soon as possible. This position is being offered at a salary of $5,705 to $6,667 per month ($68,460\-$80,004\) per year), plus University of Washington benefits. Postdoctoral scholars are represented by UAW 4121 and are subject to the collective bargaining agreement, unless agreed exclusion criteria apply. For more information, please visit the University of Washington Labor Relations website. The successful candidate will be expected to harden and extend libRoadRunner, our open\-source, high\-performance SBML simulation engine. Responsibilities include: * Harden the core. Find and fix numerical and software defects; expand regression and SBML Test Suite coverage; improve error reporting so failures are diagnosable. * Improve numerical robustness. Work on integrator and solver behavior (CVODE, KINSOL/NLEQ, Gillespie), event handling, stiff and near\-singular systems, conservation laws, and steady\-state convergence. * Add capabilities. Implement new analysis features such as sensitivities and improved steady\-state and continuation support, guided by user needs. * Modernize the build and release. Maintain CMake builds, LLVM upgrades, continuous integration across Linux, macOS, and Windows, and Python wheel distribution. * Use AI assistance well. Use tools such as Claude Code to accelerate development, test generation, and refactoring, while reviewing and verifying everything that ships. * Support the community. Triage GitHub issues, write documentation and examples, and coordinate with downstream projects including Tellurium and libAntimony. * Investigate alternative approaches to JIT compiling. The code currently uses LLVM, but alternative, more lightweight approaches have recently emerged. The Sauro Lab in the Department of Bioengineering at the University of Washington develops methods and open\-source software for modeling and simulating biochemical networks. This position is funded by a dedicated NIH grant for libRoadRunner development. libRoadRunner (https://github.com/sys\-bio/roadrunner) is an open\-source C\+\+ library with Python bindings that compiles SBML models to native code via LLVM and simulates them with deterministic, stochastic, and steady\-state solvers. It is the engine behind Tellurium and is used by modeling groups, tool developers, and educators worldwide. We are looking for someone who enjoys making scientific software correct, fast, and dependable, and who wants to work with AI coding assistants as a normal part of their workflow. #### **Qualifications** Applicants for this Postdoctoral Scholar position must meet the following minimum qualifications: * Ph.D. in computer science, engineering, applied mathematics, physics, or a related field * Modern C\+\+ experience on a non\-trivial codebase. * Working Python, including packaging or bindings. * Experience with Git (GitHub), CMake or a similar build system, and continuous integration. * Numerical analysis background, or a clear willingness to learn it: ODE integration, stiffness, Newton\-type solvers, floating\-point error, and linear algebra. * Willingness to use AI coding assistants daily and to critically verify their output. * Ability to work independently and communicate clearly in writing. * This position is **not** eligible for visa sponsorship. #### **Instructions** Applications will be reviewed immediately in the order received. Applications will only be accepted via Interfolio: https://apply.interfolio.com/198163\. The position will remain open until filled. Applications should include the following materials: 1\. A cover letter of no more than 1 page detailing your interest in the position, relevant qualifications, and experiences 2\. A curriculum vitae 3\. Links to code you have written (GitHub or Similar) 4\. Contact information for at least 2 referees who are prepared to provide letters of recommendation upon request. Note: alternatively, letters of recommendation to be submitted at time of application\* Applicants should articulate how their past experiences and/or future plans in research, teaching, mentoring, patient care, and/or service promote a sense of belonging and foster a welcoming and inclusive environment. Questions about the position may be directed to Herbert Sauro, Professor of Bioengineering, at hsauro@uw.edu. #### **Equal Employment Opportunity Statement** **Equal Opportunity** The University of Washington is committed to fostering an inclusive, respectful and welcoming community for all. As an equal opportunity employer, the University considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, national origin, citizenship, sex, pregnancy, age, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, disability, or veteran status consistent with UW Executive Order No. 81\. **Benefits Information** The University is committed to providing excellent benefits to our faculty. For a summary of available benefits, please see UWHR benefits information. **Privacy Notice** Your application materials may be used for employment consideration and shared in accordance with UW’s Privacy Policy. **Disability Services** The University of Washington is committed to providing access and reasonable accommodation in its services, programs, activities, education, and employment for individuals with disabilities. To request disability accommodation in the application process, contact the Disability Services Office at 206\-543\-6450 or dso@uw.edu.

jobs.description: Posting Information **Department** KFBS Academic \- 330100 **Career Area** Information Technology **Posting Open Date** 11/24/2026 **Application Deadline** 12/02/2026 **Position Type** Temporary Staff (SHRA) **Position Title** STAR Program AI Engineer AWS **Position Number** 20079614 **Vacancy ID** S028298 **Full\-time/Part\-time** Part\-Time Temporary **Hours per week** 12 **Work Schedule** **Position Location** North Carolina, US **Hiring Range** $73\.73 per hour **Proposed Start Date** 12/07/2026 **Estimated Duration of Appointment** 6 months or longer Position Information **Be a Tar Heel!** A global higher education leader in innovative teaching, research and public service, the **University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill** consistently ranks as **one of the nation’s top public universities**. Known for its beautiful campus, world\-class medical care, commitment to the arts and top athletic programs, Carolina is an ideal place to teach, work and learn. One of the best college towns and best places to live in the United States, Chapel Hill has diverse social, cultural, recreation and professional opportunities that span the campus and community. University employees can choose from a wide range of **professional training opportunities** for career growth, skill development and lifelong learning and enjoy **exclusive perks** that include numerous retail and restaurant discounts, savings on local child care centers and special rates for performing arts events. **Primary Purpose of Organizational Unit** At UNC’s Kenan\-Flagler Business School, we think differently; and more importantly, we teach differently. Opening our doors as the Department of Commerce in 1919 and awarding our first degrees to 12 students in 1921 was the beginning. Today, we have become a top\-ranked business school comprised of several professional and academic degree programs that serve over 3,000 students. At Kenan\-Flagler, our greatest assets are our people and our culture. We are rooted in our core values of integrity, inclusion, innovation and impact, and it goes back to our founding. It’s not just something on paper, we live it, we show it. Our mission is to prepare the next generation of business leaders by providing a world class education to our students. We seek to recruit diverse, innovative, and exceptional talent to achieve this goal. **Position Summary** UNC Kenan\-Flagler Business School is seeking a part\-time or fractional AI Engineer to support the STAR Program’s AI Orchestration Track from January through April 2027\. In this pilot, approximately 15 MBA consulting teams will build and run AI agents for real client engagements. Description of tasks * With AWS’s Solutions Architect, build the program umbrella account and the team accounts on Innovation Sandbox on AWS. The architect sets up per\-team Bedrock access, spend caps and usage logging. * Help UNC IT connect sign\-on, and then set up the model gateway, per\-team storage for client files and the team dev container (a GitHub repo per team with agent tooling, Python and Node and credentials, so every student logs in once from a browser with nothing to install). * Stand up the agent harness each team runs (the open\-source option Kenan\-Flagler IT approves), with templates and a working reference agent. * Get the data security approvals in place before anything goes live. * Create dashboards and automated memos for pilot telemetry. * Produce a monthly one\-page report for Kenan\-Flagler IT: spend vs. caps, token usage, access review, exceptions, environment changes. * Once those approvals are met, run the early\-December end\-to\-end dry run, and write quick\-start guides and a support runbook. * Provision and test all team accounts, and staff the orientation help desk on January 7\. * Support the Thursday labs: unblock teams and help them debug agents, prompts, tool calls and deployments. * Monitor spend weekly; manage team keys, client\-data intake and issues, and report them to the faculty lead. * Every week, check security advisories for the sandbox, the agent harness and its dependencies, and apply updates and patches, about 2 hours a week. * At term end, close out access, tear down team accounts and leave the runbook for the next cohort. **Minimum Education and Experience Requirements** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or closely related degree from an appropriately accredited institution; or a Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Project Management or closely related degree from an appropriately accredited institution and one year of experience in IT project management or technical project management related work; or an equivalent combination of education and experience. **Management Preferences** * Experience building and shipping software, with hands\-on with LLM APIs or agent patterns (tool use, retrieval, multi\-step agents) * Experience working AWS: IAM, S3, CloudWatch or Budgets, while building multi\-account setups alongside an AWS architect * Strong with Python, Node.js or TypeScript * Experience with Docker and dev containers Security habits for shared environments such as least privilege, secrets handling, per\-team isolation, or keeping dependencies patched from security advisories * **Special Physical/Mental Requirements** **Campus Security Authority Responsibilities** Not Applicable.

jobs.title: Reservoir Engineer
jobs.description: * 499995 * Grand Forks, North Dakota, United States * EERC * Engineering * Full\-time Staff #### **Salary/Position Classification** * $78,400\- $120,800 annual, Exempt * 40 hours per week * 100% Remote Work Availability: Yes * Hybrid Work Availability (requires some time on campus): Yes #### **Purpose of Position** Are you passionate about solving complex subsurface challenges through reservoir engineering, advanced modeling, and data\-driven analysis? Bring your expertise in reservoir simulation, geoscience integration, and oil and gas development to projects advancing energy innovation and geologic CO₂ storage. We’re looking for a Reservoir Engineer to join our dynamic team at the Energy \& Environmental Research Center (EERC)! Join the EERC, an international leader in energy and environmental research and a nonprofit branch of the University of North Dakota (UND), which gives our employees access to unbeatable benefits and tuition waivers. Learn more about the EERC at undeerc.org. Be a part of cutting\-edge research, engage with professionals who share your passion, and create work you can be proud of. As a Reservoir Engineer, you will contribute to the success of the organization by performing one or more of the following: * Evaluate, interpret and integrate geoscience and engineering data to support subsurface characterization and development. * Use oil and gas industry simulation tools and other software packages to assess and predict the performance of subsurface reservoirs. * Evaluate field injection/production operations, detailed geologic evaluations, machine learning, and/or data analytics. * Interfacing with a diverse team of scientists and engineers to assess uncertainties in oil and gas development and geologic CO2 storage. * Prepare and present technical reports and presentations. * Position requires excellent written, interpersonal, analytical, and communication skills. * Some travel is required. The EERC is recognized as a global leader in developing clean, efficient energy solutions. With a dedicated team, we collaboratively develop innovative technologies to power the world efficiently while safeguarding our air, water, and soil. Trusted by over 1300 clients in 53 countries, our mission is to provide practical, pioneering solutions to the world’s energy and environmental challenges. #### **Required Competencies** * Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, including the ability to clearly communicate technical information and ideas to diverse audiences. * Detail oriented and committed to high\-quality work. * Seen as an expert in technical field. * Strong reading comprehension and critical thinking skills. * Ability to work constructively in a multidisciplinary team. * Ability to work independently in performing everyday tasks with minimal supervision. #### **Minimum Requirements** * B.S. degree in Petroleum Engineering or related engineering, science, or geoscience field. * Experience in using oil and gas industry simulation and other software packages to determine the long\-term performance of subsurface reservoirs and the fate of produced/injected fluids. * Experience with technical writing, such as author or coauthor of published peer\-reviewed article or technical paper. * Prior research experience related to conventional and unconventional reservoirs, CO2 storage, or enhanced oil recovery. * Prior experience in successfully launching, planning, and executing data science projects, preferably in the domains of oil and gas, petroleum geology, engineering, or energy. * Applicants may be required to provide a writing sample. * Cover letter and resume or curriculum vitae outlining how your qualifications and experience meet the requirements of the position and highlighting relevant experience in the field. * Successful completion of a Criminal History Background Check In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the US and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire. ***This position supports visa sponsorship for continued employment.*** #### **Preferred Qualifications** * Advanced degree in petroleum engineering or related engineering, science, or geoscience field. * Two years of experience working in the oil and gas industry or in a research position related to the oil and gas industry. * Experience in conducting reservoir engineering analysis, such as pressure transient analysis, material balance analysis, and decline curve analysis. * Experience in geochemical and/or geomechanical evaluation and modeling. * Experience in artificial intelligence, machine learning, and/or big data analysis using geoscience and/or reservoir engineering data. * Coding proficiency (e.g., Python, R, Matlab). * Experience in designing field or laboratory experiments and/or interpreting results. * Experience in geothermal evaluation and simulation. * Experience in reservoir engineering research and development (R\&D) projects. #### **To Apply** To ensure full consideration, applications must be received by December 9, 2026\.

jobs.title: IT Quality Assurance Tester II
jobs.description: The Software and Data Quality Analyst supports quality assurance and quality control activities across HII projects. This role develops and performs systematic reviews and testing to ensure the accuracy, completeness, consistency, and reliability of datasets, reports, applications, workflows, and other project deliverables. The position works collaboratively with project teams and stakeholders to understand requirements, identify and document discrepancies, verify corrections, and support continuous improvement of quality assurance processes. * Develop and execute quality assurance and quality control plans to evaluate datasets, reports, applications, systems, and other project deliverables against established requirements. * Independently review and validate data, reports, and other outputs for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and adherence to specifications. * Perform systematic testing and QC reviews to identify errors, discrepancies, missing information, unexpected results, and potential issues with data or functionality. * Verify data processing, calculations, business rules, and reporting results against source information, documented requirements, and expected outcomes. * Conduct functional, integration, data validation, and user acceptance testing, as applicable, to ensure systems and deliverables function as intended. * Identify, document, track, and communicate QC findings and defects, including supporting evidence, recommended corrections, and verification of issue resolution. * Collaborate with data engineers, software engineers, data architects, statisticians, stakeholders, and other project team members to clarify requirements, investigate discrepancies, and resolve quality concerns. * Coordinate QA/QC activities throughout project development, testing, and release processes to support timely delivery of accurate and reliable products. * Maintain clear documentation of QC procedures, test results, identified issues, resolutions, and quality review outcomes. * Contribute to the development and improvement of QA/QC standards, procedures, documentation, and training materials. * Serve as a QA/QC resource to project teams, providing guidance and support to promote consistent quality practices. * Identify opportunities to improve the efficiency, consistency, and effectiveness of QA/QC processes, including the use of appropriate tools and automation when applicable. Minimum Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field with two (2\) years of related experience. Preferred Qualifications: Master’s degree in a relevant field with one (1\) year of related experience; or * A combination of education and experience totaling years (5\) years of relevant experience in quality assurance, quality control, data validation, data reporting, or related activities in lieu of a degree. KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS \& ABILITIES (KSAs) * Strong understanding of quality assurance, quality control, and data validation principles. * Ability to independently review datasets, reports, applications, systems, databases, and other deliverables for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and adherence to requirements. * Ability to develop and execute systematic testing and QC procedures, including identifying discrepancies and verifying corrections. * Proficiency in reviewing, comparing, and validating data/information using appropriate tools and methods. * Ability to clearly document defects or other QC findings and recommendations. * Experience with SQL and/or SAS preferred but not required. jobs.title: Storage and Data Protection Engineer

With clients across industries and geographies, we solve complex IT challenges by collaborating with best\-in\-class technology partners and hiring the brightest minds in the business. As a Utah Business and *Salt Lake Tribune* Best Place to Work winner, we pride ourselves on a culture that balances excellence with family values, transparency, and long\-term growth. At VLCM, we "Get IT Right"\-for our customers, our partners, and our people. **JOB DESCRIPTION** VLCM is looking for an experienced Storage Solutions Architect \- Sales Engineer to join our engineering team and help design, implement, and support enterprise storage, backup, recovery, and data protection solutions for our customers. This role will have two strong areas of emphasis: EverPure storage solutions and Cohesity data protection technologies, with the engineer serving as a key technical resource in each area. The position will work directly with customers, as well as VLCM's sales and engineering teams, throughout the solution lifecycle. The ideal candidate has strong hands\-on experience with enterprise storage and data protection environments and is comfortable working directly with customers, from technical discovery and solution design through implementation, troubleshooting, and ongoing support. While EverPure and Cohesity will be important areas of focus, this role will also work across other storage, backup, virtualization, and data center technologies based on customer needs. **WHAT YOU'LL GET TO DO** * Design, deploy, configure, and support enterprise storage and data protection solutions, with a strong emphasis on EverPure storage solutions and on Cohesity data protection technologies. * Lead technical discovery sessions to understand customer infrastructure, business requirements, workloads, performance needs, and data protection objectives. * Architect storage, backup, recovery, replication, and disaster recovery solutions based on customer requirements. * Perform implementations, migrations, upgrades, expansions, and optimization of storage and data protection environments. * Troubleshoot complex storage, backup, recovery, performance, and connectivity issues. * Work closely with VLCM Account Managers, Solution Architects, and other engineering resources during the pre\-sales process, including solution design and technical validation. * Develop scopes of work and assist with estimating the engineering effort required for customer projects. * Provide technical demonstrations, presentations, and proof\-of\-concept support when needed. * Follow vendor and industry best practices for data protection, resiliency, security, and infrastructure design. * Maintain strong technical knowledge of EverPure and Cohesity solutions and stay current on new products, features, best practices, and certifications. * Develop knowledge and expertise across additional storage and data protection technologies supported by VLCM. * Document customer environments, configurations, project work, and recommended solutions. * Serve as a trusted technical resource for customers and take ownership of technical issues through resolution. * Collaborate with other VLCM engineers across data center, virtualization, networking, cybersecurity, and cloud technologies. **WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR** * Strong hands\-on experience with enterprise storage and/or data protection technologies. * Experience with EverPure storage solutions is strongly preferred. * Experience with Cohesity data protection, backup, recovery, and related technologies is strongly preferred. * Experience designing and implementing enterprise storage and data protection solutions. * Strong understanding of storage concepts including SAN, NAS, block, file, replication, snapshots, deduplication, compression, backup, recovery, and disaster recovery. * Experience working with virtualization platforms such as VMware and/or Microsoft Hyper\-V. * Understanding of networking concepts relevant to enterprise storage and backup environments. * Experience troubleshooting complex jobs.title: RTL Lead - Functional Safety

As a Functional Safety RTL Design Engineer, you will turn Velaura's functional safety architecture into silicon: designing, implementing, and proving the hardware safety mechanisms that detect, contain, and respond to faults across our Physical AI System\-on\-Chip (SoC). You will work closely with the Functional Safety Architect, SoC architects, design verification, firmware, and physical design teams, owning safety\-critical RTL from micro\-architecture through tape\-out, certification, and silicon bring\-up. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Own the micro\-architecture and RTL for hardware safety mechanisms across compute, AI/NPU, memory, and interconnect, including ECC/parity, lockstep and redundant execution, end\-to\-end data protection, watchdogs and timeouts, and clock/voltage/temperature monitors. * Design the SoC safety island and fault\-management infrastructure: error aggregation, fault reporting and escalation, safe\-state control, and interfaces to external safety components. * Implement diagnostic and self\-test features, including error\-injection hooks, startup and periodic self\-tests for safety mechanisms, and integration with LBIST and MBIST. * Define the hardware/software interface for safety diagnostics, including how firmware configures, tests, and responds to safety mechanisms. * Translate safety requirements into micro\-architecture specifications and RTL, maintaining traceability from requirement to implementation and verification. * Plan and run fault\-injection and fault\-simulation campaigns to demonstrate diagnostic coverage, and use the results to close gaps against the target safety metrics. * Analyze the safety of internal and third\-party IP, review vendor safety manuals and assumptions of use, and support Development Interface Agreements (DIAs) with IP suppliers. * Ensure
