jobs.title: Full Stack Developer
jobs.description: **Full Stack Developer \- Needed for Reliable, Well\-Crafted Software Development** **Work Type:** **Full\-time, hybrid****Compensation:****$85,000 \- $135,000 base salary plus incentive bonuses, commensurate with experience****Benefits:** **Medical, Vision, Dental, Telemedicine, IRA w/Matching, Corporate Chaplain, Counseling Services, 8 paid holidays, 3 weeks PTO****Location:** **Dallas, TX** ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ **Who are we looking for?** The Full Stack Developer we are looking for is an individual dedicated to the perfection of their craft, someone who is consistent and reliable and takes a systematic approach to every schema, migration, and screen they build. If you are the type who knows there is a right way to build software (tested, documented, and built to hold up under real\-world load) and will hunt down the facts before writing a line of code, then you are going to love this role. You take pride in work that is done right the first time, you would rather deliver one feature that never breaks than five that need a hotfix, and you are searching for an organization that will invest in you and give you a well\-defined platform to put your expertise to work. **Interested? Here is what you will be doing:** As a Full Stack Developer, you will help build software that will change the way IT is delivered. You will work alongside our product lead, with clear priorities and a consistent design system to build from. The software you build will be put to work every day, so you will see firsthand the difference that well\-crafted, reliable work makes. Here are some specifics: * Building, maintaining, and optimizing web applications in React and TypeScript, from the Postgres schema to the screen users click through * Designing schemas, writing migrations, and integrating front ends with our databases, APIs, and third\-party systems * Delivering changes that hold up in production, with 10% or fewer of deployments requiring a hotfix or rollback * Getting code right the first time, keeping rework (code rewritten, deleted, or modified within 2 to 3 weeks of commit) under 10% * Contributing to a team average support response time of under 100 minutes on support tickets * Working with stakeholders to understand what users need, then turning that into wireframes, prototypes, and high\-fidelity mockups * Running research and feedback sessions with users, and using what you learn to improve how our systems look and work * Creating and maintaining a design system and style guide so every app looks and behaves the same way * Simplifying navigation and multi\-step processes so the tools feel fast and intuitive * Testing and debugging so features work across devices and browsers, and hold up under real\-world load * Documenting design decisions, workflows, and technical processes so other teams can pick up the work **A little about Velo...** Velo is one of the fastest growing Cybersecurity \& IT service providers in the United States. As an INC 5000, SMU Hot 100, and MSP 501 company, opportunities at Velo abound. Headquartered in Downtown Dallas, with additional offices in Houston, TX, and Lafayette, LA, you will enjoy being a part of this award\-winning team. Velo offers industry\-leading compensation packages for industry\-leading talent. We serve entrepreneurially led companies as their outsourced IT and cybersecurity department. Our rapid growth allows us to consistently bring on new clients and team members, creating a very active and dynamic work environment. Velo understands the nature of our culture, and the servant\-leadership mindset toward every member of Team Velo is our competitive advantage. Our vision is to empower and develop the potential of entrepreneurial teams by serving 100,000 people daily. With this, our leadership team is here to be uniquely human in an increasingly disconnected world; to serve you and your family so you can effectively serve our clients and your peers. **Position Overview:** * **Highlights:** Perfection of Craft, Systematic Approach to Work, Consistent and Reliable, Fact\-Driven Problem Solver, Detail Oriented Execution * **Job Type:** Software Development * **Work Hours:** Full\-time, hybrid * **Annual Compensation:** $85,000 \- $135,000 base salary plus incentive bonuses, commensurate with experience * **Benefits:** Medical, Vision, Dental, Telemedicine, IRA w/Matching, Corporate Chaplain, Counseling Services, 8 paid holidays, 3 weeks PTO * **Location:** Dallas, TX **Required Experience:** * Deep PostgreSQL experience required, including schema design, query optimization, and migrations on live systems with real data * Strong backend skills required in Go, Node.js, Python, Java, or a similar language * Solid front\-end skills required in React or a comparable framework, plus HTML, CSS, and JavaScript/TypeScript * Sound judgment about correctness required: idempotency, safe retries, failure handling, and the failure modes that only show up under load * A practical eye for UI/UX required, with a portfolio or examples of interfaces you have designed and built * Clear written communication and comfort working with non\-technical stakeholders required **Nice to Have:** * Supabase, row\-level security or other multi\-tenant data models * Experience with MSP, PSA or ITSM tools such as ConnectWise * Integrations with ERP or finance systems like NetSuite If this opportunity is for you – please **Apply Now**!

jobs.title: Control Automation Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** Veolia in North America is the top\-ranked environmental company in the United States for three consecutive years, and the country’s largest private water operator and technology provider as well as hazardous waste and pollution treatment leader. It offers a full spectrum of water, waste, and energy management services, including water and wastewater treatment, commercial and hazardous waste collection and disposal, energy consulting and resource recovery. Veolia helps commercial, industrial, healthcare, higher education and municipality customers throughout North America. Headquartered in Boston, Veolia has more than 10,000 employees working at more than 350 locations across North America. **Job Description** **Position Purpose:** We are seeking a highly skilled and proactive Control Automation Engineer to join our engineering team. In this critical role, you will be responsible for the design, implementation, programming, and lifecycle maintenance of our facility’s automated control systems. You will serve as the technical subject matter expert for our ABB 800xA Distributed Control Systems (DCS), PLCs, HMIs, SCADA systems, and industrial networks. The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between operations, maintenance, and IT, driving continuous improvement initiatives and providing rapid troubleshooting support to minimize production downtime. You will play a vital role in ensuring our manufacturing processes run efficiently, safely, and reliably while integrating modern automation standards. **Primary Duties/Responsibilities:** * **System Maintenance \& Troubleshooting:** Provide daily technical support, diagnostics, and troubleshooting for automated production equipment, prioritizing rapid resolution of DCS and PLC faults to minimize manufacturing downtime. * **DCS \& PLC Programming:** Develop, modify, configure, and optimize logic for ABB 800xA DCS systems, as well as facility PLCs and HMIs, to support new equipment installations, process upgrades, and safety improvements. * **Network \& Integration Management:** Oversee and maintain industrial communication networks and data integration architecture, ensuring robust communication between field devices, control systems, and data collection platforms using OPC DA/UA, Ethernet/IP, Profinet, and Modbus. * **Documentation \& Design:** Regularly read, interpret, and update electrical schematics, Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams (P\&IDs), loop sheets, and technical manuals to ensure all facility documentation remains accurate and up to standard. * **Preventative Maintenance:** Develop and implement robust preventative maintenance procedures, backup protocols, patch management, and disaster recovery plans for all critical automation infrastructure. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with maintenance technicians, process engineers, and capital project teams to design and execute automation upgrades, ensuring seamless handover and comprehensive operator training. * **Safety \& Compliance:** Ensure all automation and electrical control designs comply with industry safety standards (e.g., OSHA, NFPA 70E) and internal company policies. **Work Environment:** * Ability to work in a manufacturing environment, which may include exposure to noise, varying temperatures, and moving machinery. * Willingness to support occasional off\-hours or on\-call emergencies to support critical continuous operations. **Qualifications** **Education/Experience/Background:** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical field (or equivalent combination of education and hands\-on industrial experience). **Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:** * **DCS Expertise:** Must have demonstrated proficiency and hands\-on experience programming, configuring, and troubleshooting **ABB 800xA DCS** systems. * **Automation Platforms:** Strong applied experience working with various PLCs, HMIs, and SCADA platforms in a manufacturing, continuous process, or heavy industrial environment. * **Industrial Networking:** Deep understanding and practical experience with industrial communication protocols, specifically Ethernet/IP, Profinet, Modbus, and OPC DA/UA. * **Technical Literacy:** Proven ability to read, interpret, and redline electrical schematics, P\&ID drawings, and complex technical manuals. * **Problem Solving:** Excellent analytical skills with a proven track record of diagnosing root causes, reducing equipment downtime, and optimizing complex control loops. *Preferred Qualifications:* * **OT Cybersecurity:** Knowledge of Operational Technology (OT) cybersecurity concepts, including network segmentation, secure architecture, firewall configurations, and safeguarding industrial control systems against vulnerabilities. * **Additional PLC Experience:** Experience with Allen\-Bradley/Rockwell (Studio 5000\) or Siemens (TIA Portal) environments. * **Project Management:** Experience leading small to medium capital automation projects from scoping and budget approval through FAT, SAT, and final commissioning. **Physical Requirements:** * Must be able to walk the production floor, climb stairs/ladders, and occasionally lift up to \[Insert Weight, e.g., 30 lbs] when inspecting equipment. \#LI\-DT1 **Additional Information** **Pay:** $85000 per year **Benefits:** Veolia’s comprehensive benefits package includes paid time off policies, as well as health, dental, vision, life insurance, savings accounts, tuition reimbursement, paid volunteering and more. In addition, employees are also entitled to participate in an employer sponsored 401(k) plan, to save for retirement. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer! All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. Disclaimer: The salary, other compensation, and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. The Company reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable law.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: As a Senior Data Engineer, you will design, develop, and maintain a centralized Data Analytics Platform within the AWS ecosystem to support enterprise analytics, data governance, PII management, and business innovation. This is a hands\-on senior engineering position for a seasoned technical expert who leads complex, large\-scale initiatives with minimal oversight, serves as a subject matter expert in data and software engineering, and provides mentorship to team members. The Senior Data Engineer also acts as a technical delivery lead and product\-minded partner to the Portfolio Manager, translating business needs into actionable engineering solutions while driving Agile execution, data quality, and platform reliability. **DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES** **Data Engineering \& Platform Development** * Build and maintain the centralized, trusted source of enterprise data that serves as the foundation for analytics and reporting, following the architecture and patterns set by the Data Architect * Design, develop, and maintain data ingestion and transformation pipelines * Build and support batch and incremental data processing for enterprise source systems * Utilize AWS services such as Amazon S3, Glue and Glue Data Catalog for ETL, Step Functions, Lambda, and Amazon Redshift * Optimize data pipelines for performance, reliability, scalability, and data quality across the data products they lead * Set monitoring, alerting, and observability expectations for the data products they lead, and implement them using CloudWatch * Manage source code, versioning, and CI/CD processes using GitLab * Lead the design of analytics\-ready data models and curated datasets across data products, within the patterns set by the Data Architect * Identify, classify, and manage PII and sensitive data, implementing safeguards such as masking, restricted access, and auditability * Ensure data products comply with privacy, regulatory, and data quality standards * Partner with governance and security teams to operationalize data policies * Implement and validate role\-based access controls using least\-privilege principles * Define and continuously improve the DEV, STG, and PROD environment promotion and release processes for the team, and own releases for the data products they lead **Product Leadership** * Own end\-to\-end delivery of data products from requirements through production release, ensuring they meet business objectives on time and within scope * Translate business requirements and analytics needs into actionable epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria * Partner with the Portfolio Manager on the data engineering backlog * Prioritize work based on business value, risk, technical dependencies, and platform maturity * May serve as Technical Product Owner for a data engineering workstream, owning the backlog, acceptance of completed work, and release readiness **Agile Leadership \& Collaboration** * Drive development execution and continuous improvement through an iterative way of working, relying on an Agile framework * Lead design discussions, code reviews, and technical decision making * Mentor engineers and promote best practices for coding, testing, and delivery * Keep up\-to\-date on relevant data engineering, cloud, analytics, and governance technologies * Special projects and other duties as assigned **SUPERVISION EXERCISED** Provides leadership, mentorship and delegation within the team. **SUPERVISION RECEIVED** Minimal supervision is received from the Engineering Manager and/or other Senior IT Leadership. Partners with the Data Architect on architecture and with the Portfolio Manager on backlog priorities. **QUALIFICATIONS** **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience **Skills and Knowledge** * Strong Python programming experience, including within AWS Glue or similar ETL frameworks * Hands\-on experience with AWS data services (e.g., Redshift, S3, Glue, Step Functions, Lambda) * Strong SQL skills and experience working with analytical data stores * Experience building and supporting production\-grade data pipelines * Working knowledge of Git\-based source control and CI/CD practices (GitLab preferred) * Experience translating business requirements into technical delivery artifacts (epics, stories, acceptance criteria) * Working knowledge of data governance, PII management, and data quality standards * Experience operating in Agile/Scrum environments and leading Agile delivery activities * Strong communication skills (interpersonal, oral, and written) * Strong problem\-solving, organizational, and analytical skills * Highly self\-motivated with the ability to work independently and collaboratively * Proven experience designing analytics\-ready data models (star schema, slowly changing dimensions) **Experience** * 5 to 7 years of professional experience in data engineering, including experience leading delivery of data pipeline or data product initiatives * Demonstrated experience mentoring engineers and leading design discussions and code reviews **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in the insurance or financial services industry, with familiarity with insurance data domains (policy, claims, billing) * AWS Data Analytics or Data Engineer specialty certification * Experience with data pipeline observability and monitoring tools (e.g., CloudWatch, Great Expectations) * Experience with Redshift Datashare or Zero\-ETL integration This job description outlines the responsibilities and qualifications for a Senior Data Engineer at the specialist professional level, with a focus on data engineering. The role is designed for recognized subject matter experts who are ready to lead delivery of data products, guide design across the team, and mentor others. **PHYSICAL DEMANDS / WORKING CONDITIONS** * Predominantly sedentary office position with high frequency of keyboarding/computer work required. * Off\-hour and weekend work may be required. * The physical demands are minimal and typical of similar jobs in comparable organizations. * The work environment is representative and typical of similar jobs in comparable organizations. *The salary range reflected is a good faith estimate of base pay for the position. In addition to base salary, this role is incentive compensation and benefits eligible, and individual salary will ultimately be determined based on individual experience, skills, qualifications and geographic location.*

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** As a Principal Software Developer at Veson Nautical, you will solve complex, real\-world problems and shape the future of the maritime shipping industry. You will work on the Veson Platform: the TypeScript services, APIs and agentic workflows (CoCaptain) that sit alongside IMOS. This is a hands\-on principal developer role. You will design, code, test, ship and support production software, take end\-to\-end ownership of the design and delivery of major components, influence the structure and direction of the codebase, and lead the way we build with AI coding agents. We expect you to be flexible: the work moves across backend, frontend, data, infrastructure and AI engineering. **Responsibilities** * Own the full software development life cycle for the services you build and the ones you inherit: design, code, tests, review, deployment, observability, maintenance and production support. * Design, build and maintain backend services and APIs in TypeScript (NestJS, GraphQL, MongoDB) and front\-end modules in React/Next.js. Most of our code is TypeScript, but the team also owns C\#, C\+\+ and Go services, and you will maintain and extend those when the work calls for it. * Design and build the core business logic our products depend on: lasting, well\-tested solutions where correctness is proven, with clear boundaries between deterministic code and LLM reasoning. * Build AI\-native product features: LLM orchestration, MCP tool contracts, agent skills and workflows for CoCaptain, with the evals, guardrails and observability needed to run them in production. * Work with AI coding agents (Claude Code or equivalent) as a core part of how you deliver, and raise the bar for the team: author and maintain shared skills, rules, CLIs and harnesses, and improve the review and delivery process so quality keeps up with AI\-assisted throughput. * Write RFCs and design docs for cross\-cutting changes (data models, permissions and security, tenancy, integration patterns), and drive them to a decision with Product, Architecture and partner teams. * Break large projects into shovel\-ready pieces for the team, work with Product and Engineering leadership to drive team decisions and contribute to the roadmap and be comfortable turning an un\-roadmapped idea into a scoped, measurable deliverable as priorities shift. * Mentor and level up teammates through design reviews, code reviews and pairing, and help the Connect, Apps and QA Automation teams share tools and conventions. * Promote teamwork and support a vibrant and innovative work atmosphere. **Qualifications** * 8\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including several years as a senior or lead engineer on production systems. * Expert in TypeScript and Node.js, with deep experience designing and operating backend services and APIs (NestJS or similar, GraphQL, REST). * Experience building front\-end modules with React. * Experience with MongoDB or other document databases, and with relational databases (SQL Server, Postgres). * Demonstrated, current fluency with AI coding agents: you can show skills, rules, CLIs, agents or harnesses you have built, and explain how you verify what an agent produces. * Experience shipping LLM\-backed features to production: tool/function calling, MCP, prompt and context design, evaluation, cost and latency management. * Strong testing discipline: unit and integration tests (vitest/jest), end\-to\-end tests (Playwright), fixture\- or property\-based testing of calculation logic. * Comfortable in a polyglot codebase: able to read, debug and change C\#, C\+\+ or Go services when a fix lands outside TypeScript. Expertise in all three is not expected. * Experience with containers and Kubernetes, AWS, and CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI preferred). * Experience with observability and production support: error tracking and log analytics (Sentry, Splunk), dashboards, alerting and on\-call, ideally with observability defined as code. * Comfortable with ambiguity and changing priorities; able to work in an Agile, entrepreneurial environment and communicate clearly with technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills: you can write an RFC that gets a decision, and a review comment that gets acted on. **Nice to Have** * Experience in financial industry or maritime shipping industry * Experience building calculation engines or financial/quantitative libraries where correctness is proven against a reference system. * Deep experience with C\#/.NET and SQL Server (our IMOS core), C\+\+, Go or Python. + Experience with workflow or durable\-execution engines (Inngest, Temporal, Agenda) and event\-driven architectures. * Experience with multi\-tenant SaaS, authorization and permission models, and SOC 2 practices. * Experience with GCP in addition to AWS. * Experience creating and contributing to architecture design and documentation. **About Veson Nautical** We are a team of multi\-cultural, multi\-disciplined professionals that are dedicated to making our clients successful and charting a new, innovative course for the commercial marine industry. Veson Nautical employs a staff of extremely capable creators and innovators all focused on meeting the goals of our clients. We invest extensively in employee development and experience to maintain focus and enthusiasm. The Veson Nautical team is made up of a dynamic blend of engineers, artists, sailors, teachers, brokers, bankers, traders, consultants, and customer service experts. Veson Nautical is a successful, rapidly growing global software company. Our clients are the world’s leading commercial maritime owners, operators and commodity trading companies. Veson’s solutions enable our clients to identify new opportunities and proactively manage their business to make more profitable decisions. With offices in Singapore, Tokyo, London, Houston and headquarters in Boston, USA, Veson Nautical is a dynamic organization with a committed team of professionals. Dedicated to ensuring the highest levels of client satisfaction, Veson Nautical brings decades of experience, technical knowledge, enthusiasm and commitment to clients around the world. The combination of exceptional market growth and leading market position make this a superb opportunity for the right candidate. **\#LI\-Remote** We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.description: Vestwell is the financial technology company powering the new savings economy. Today, Vestwell enables over 790,000 businesses and more than 2\.75 million active savers, with over $57 billion in assets saved across all 50 United States. Vestwell offers a range of products, including workplace\-delivered retirement plans, employer\-offered student loan repayment benefits, and various savings accounts for education, emergencies, and individuals with disabilities. Vestwell's platform serves a diverse clientele, including financial advisers, employers, third\-party administrators, financial institutions, payroll providers, government agencies, and individual savers. jobs.title: Associate Data Engineer, AI Studio
jobs.description: **About Us** Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. **Job Description** **Company Description** As the world's leader in digital payments technology, Visa's mission is to connect the world through the most innovative, convenient, reliable, and secure payments network, enabling individuals, businesses, and economies to thrive. Our advanced global processing network, VisaNet, provides secure and reliable payments around the world, and is capable of handling more than 65,000 transaction messages a second. The company's dedication to innovation drives the rapid growth of connected commerce on any device and fuels the dream of a cashless future for everyone, everywhere. As the world moves from analog to digital, Visa is applying our brand, products, people, network, and scale to reshape the future of commerce. **Job Description** Visa AI Studio is Visa's AI operating system: a single platform for building, deploying, and operating predictive models, foundation models, and AI agents at global scale. It gives every team at Visa a common, self service way to train and experiment, build with generative AI, develop and run production AI agents, manage features and memory, and operate everything with governance and observability built in. Visa AI Studio is the foundation for how AI gets built across the company. This role is for a Data Engineer, with a strong development background, whose primary objective will be to extend our AI as a Service platform to the Public Cloud while enhancing, optimizing our existing codebase and development procedures, as well as developing new solutions. We are seeking for a strong tech leader and architect with a solid background in public cloud and AI/ML production systems. The ideal candidate will have a strong mix of hands\-on technical knowledge and leadership skills, with the ability to contribute technical knowledge and grow leadership skills, supporting the team's progress toward our technical objectives, with guidance from senior engineers. They should be hands\-on, knowledgeable about cloud technologies, business drivers, and emerging AI/ML trends, and experienced with AWS and GCP services. The role demands a proactive learner who can work through ambiguity with support, communicate clearly with stakeholders, and contribute to decisions. The candidate should possess strong interpersonal skills, excellent written and verbal communication, and the ability to manage complex projects and deadlines. A problem\-solving mindset and a hands\-on approach are key to succeeding in this role. This role offers ample opportunities for learning and growth, and the chance to be part of delivering the next big thing for our AI as Services team. If you are experienced and passionate about cloud technology, AI, and machine learning, and are excited about making a significant impact, we would love to hear from you. This is a hybrid position based in Austin, TX, allowing alternating between remote and office work. Expectations are to be in\-office at least two days a week, typically Mondays, Tuesdays and alternating Fridays, aiming for a 50% office presence based on business requirements. **Essential Functions** * Design, build, and operate core components of AI Runtime Services: live model and agent serving, the runtime console, release management, and production reliability, so other teams can deploy and operate safely with minimal platform\-team intervention. * Drive development effort end\-to\-end for on\-time delivery of high\-quality solutions that meet requirements, align with the architectural vision, and comply with applicable standards, across all phases from design through production. * Collaborate with Product Managers, Architects, Analysts, Software Engineers, and Project Managers to plan, document, and manage risks and issues to resolution; present technical solutions and status clearly in business terms. * Embed governance, responsible AI, audit, and monitoring directly into the serving path, including drift, hallucination, and anomaly detection for agentic systems in production. * Partner with the AI Engineering Platform, AI Context Platform, and AI Governance Platform teams to deliver a coherent, end\-to\-end platform experience. * Develop and extend the AI agents and agentic workflows that run across AI Runtime Services, from automating platform operations to powering products like Visa Claw, so the platform's own capabilities keep advancing. * Leverage AI coding agents and LLM\-powered developer tools as part of your own workflow, treating AI\-assisted engineering as a core skill to design, build, and ship platform capabilities faster. * Coach and mentor junior team members, growing the team's talent pipeline. Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager. **Qualifications** **Basic Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree, OR 3\+ years of relevant work experience. * 1 or more years of hands\-on experience delivering robust, scalable solutions on public cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), preferably in an AI/ML production environment. * Expertise in one or more of Golang, Java, Rust, C/C\+\+, or Python, with strong systems and software engineering fundamentals, including distributed systems and API/SDK design. **Preferred Qualifications** * Expertise in Advanced Python; professional cloud certifications. * Basic understanding of core machine learning and deep learning concepts, and the ability to reason about a model or agent across its full lifecycle, from training through production deployment, monitoring, and retirement. * Proven experience designing and developing data\-driven, real\-time and batch systems, with a deep understanding of the trade\-offs across design, architectural, and integration patterns. * Hands\-on fluency with modern AI\-assisted development (coding agents, copilots, LLM\-based tooling) to accelerate day\-to\-day engineering work. * Experience mentoring peers or interns, and contributing to technical design discussions within the team. * Expertise in cloud architecture and service offerings, including core cloud services (compute, storage, databases, networking, AI/ML), AWS EKS, ElastiCache, and CloudWatch. * Rust and/or C\+\+ experience is highly desired for latency\-sensitive serving components. * Experience building internal developer platforms, SDKs, or self\-service tooling used by other engineering or data science teams, such as a runtime console or similar self\-serve capability. **Information for US Applicants** For roles located in the US, the estimated salary range for this position is $86,500\.00 to $ 134,400\.00 USD per year, which may include potential sales incentive payments (if applicable). Salary may vary depending on job\-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location. In addition, this position may be eligible for bonus and equity.Visa has a comprehensive benefits package for which this position may be eligible that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, and Wellness Program.**Work Hours** Varies upon the needs of the department. **Travel Requirements** This position requires travel 5\-10% of the time. **Mental/Physical Requirements** This position will be performed in an office setting. The position will require the incumbent to sit and stand at a desk, communicate in person and by telephone, frequently operate standard office equipment, such as telephones and computers. **Visa is an EEO Employer** Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protect veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

jobs.title: Staff Agentic AI Engineer - Mobility Engineering
jobs.description: **About the Team/Role** ----------------------- We are seeking a seasoned Staff Software Engineer in the WEX Mobility Engineering organization. This role will sit in the Mobility team that caters fleet management and mobility payments solutions to our large customers. Mobility development team spans across USA, Brazil, and India. Our Mobility systems provide SaaS and API solutions to various customers. WEX Mobility products enable credit issuance to fleet companies and their workers in the form of WEX or cobranded credit cards, usable at fueling stations and select other merchants. At WEX, we provide fleet managers and operators with fuel discounts, and flexibility to configure spend controls that restrict fleet members to use their cards at configured merchants, for configured amounts and velocity. In addition, this role will contribute to the design and development of next\-generation intelligent systems leveraging agentic AI, enabling automation, decision\-making, and scalable orchestration across Mobility platforms. **How you’ll make an impact:** ------------------------------ * Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable, and high\-performance object oriented code in our backend services. * Develop public REST APIs using Java and internal gRPC APIs for inter\-service and inter\-system communication. * Craft systems designs, lead design decisions, and drive alignment with other senior engineers. * Write automated unit tests, integration tests, end\-to\-end tests, concurrency tests, load/performance tests. * Analyze existing systems to identify bottlenecks, tech debt, and implement scalability, and stability improvements. * Implement automation for testing, monitoring, healing, and scaling applications, continuous integration and deployment to reduce time to market. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including product managers, designers, and other engineers, to define and implement new features. * Conduct code reviews (comment, approve, seek revisions, merge), mentor junior and mid\-level engineers, and actively promote engineering best practices. * Dive deep and troubleshoot complex issues, devise fixes, author root cause analysis documents, and ensure lasting performance and reliability. * Conduct objective and comparative analyses of competing technologies to advise the team of pros and cons of a technology solution. * Maintain robust documentation (design docs, run books, change management docs, and readiness plans). * Provide live\-site support for production applications by monitoring systems, ensuring rapid incident resolution, and driving continuous improvement. * Drive cross\-team projects as a single\-threaded\-owner (STO) or tech lead, and actively unblock other engineers to make progress. **Agentic AI \& Intelligent Systems :** --------------------------------------- * Design and build agentic AI systems and services, enabling autonomous workflows, reasoning, and task execution within Mobility platforms. * Develop AI agents from scratch, including orchestration, tool usage, memory, and multi\-step decision\-making capabilities. * Implement and scale multi\-agent architectures to support complex, distributed use cases across payments and fleet ecosystems. * Integrate systems using Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar frameworks to enable secure and scalable interaction between AI agents, APIs, and enterprise data sources. * Build and optimize LLM\-powered services (e.g., OpenAI APIs, LangChain) for production\-grade performance, reliability, and cost efficiency. * Implement evaluation frameworks, observability, and guardrails to ensure correctness, safety, and compliance of AI\-driven systems. * Design solutions for context management, memory, and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) to enhance agent effectiveness. **Experience you'll bring:** ---------------------------- * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or Software Engineering * 8\-10 years of professional experience in software engineering * Strong understanding of data structures and algorithms, object\-oriented design, and problem\-solving skills * Expertise in designing and developing internet\-scale services with scalability, availability, security, and reliability design tenets * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, and a collaborative and empathetic mindset * Proficiency in backend development, with expertise in Java or C\#, frameworks like SpringBoot, building and optimizing RESTful APIs, ODATA framework, and SQL **Agentic AI \& MCP Experience:** --------------------------------- * Hands\-on experience building or contributing to AI/LLM\-powered applications or agent\-based systems * Familiarity with agent frameworks, tool\-use patterns, and orchestration of LLM workflows * Experience integrating AI systems with external tools/APIs using MCP or similar protocols * Understanding of prompt engineering, embeddings, and vector\-based retrieval systems * Experience designing systems for scaling AI workloads in production environments **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Master’s degree in computer science or software engineering * 10\+ years of experience in software engineering * Experience with Python, Java, event\-driven architecture and tools like Kafka * Experience working on card payments * Familiarity with cloud\-native architecture (containerization using tools such as Docker and Kubernetes) * Awareness of API security and PCI DSS compliance requirements * Ability to work on existing codebase, contribute improvements, and adapt to legacy systems’ constraints **Nice to Have (AI Focus):** ---------------------------- * Experience building production\-grade AI agents or copilots * Familiarity with multi\-agent systems and distributed AI architectures * Experience with vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, OpenSearch) * Knowledge of AI evaluation techniques, safety practices, and responsible AI principles The base pay range represents the anticipated low and high end of the pay range for this position. Actual pay rates will vary and will be based on various factors, such as your qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. Base pay is one component of WEX's total compensation package. Most sales positions are eligible for commission under the terms of an applicable plan. Non\-sales roles are typically eligible for a quarterly or annual bonus based on their role and applicable plan. WEX's comprehensive and market competitive benefits are designed to support your personal and professional well\-being. Benefits include health, dental and vision insurances, retirement savings plan, paid time off, health savings account, flexible spending accounts, life insurance, disability insurance, tuition reimbursement, and more. For more information, check out the "About Us" section. Pay Range: $140,600\.00 \- $173,100\.00

jobs.title: Track Engineering Design Lead
jobs.description: **This Opportunity** -------------------- WSP is looking for a **Track Engineering Design Lead** to join our team in **Seattle, WA** . This position blends hands\-on track design leadership with strategic collaboration of the transit and rail engineering discipline, ensuring that all technical deliverables, system integrations, and infrastructure projects meet or exceed industry, regulatory, and company standards. The Track Engineering Design Lead helps guide project delivery from planning and design through construction support, testing, commissioning, and long‑term maintenance, while also serving as a subject‑matter expert (SME) for transit and rail engineering across the organization. In addition to track design, this role will include serving as owner’s representative to provide design review and oversight of designs performed by others. The role requires deep expertise in track design, multidisciplinary systems coordination (signals, communications, traction power), regulatory compliance, and field inspection. It also plays a critical role in business development, client engagement, and the long‑term growth of the transit and rail engineering practice. **Your Impact** --------------- **Track Design Leadership \& Technical Delivery** * Lead phases of track design and installation for transit and railroad projects, ensuring alignment with design intent, contract requirements, and operational standards. * Provide technical guidance for track geometry, alignment, special trackwork, systems integration, and constructability. * Coordinate with multidisciplinary engineering teams to ensure seamless integration of track, signal, communications, and traction power systems. * Provide technical design support for field activities, ensuring work is executed safely, on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with agency requirements. * Lead development of solutions for unforeseen field conditions and coordinate design revisions or contract modifications as necessary. * Support PMC teams in reviewing contractor deliverables, cost estimates, change orders, claims, and progress payments. Prepare detailed reports, presentations, and documentation for internal and client review. * **Transit \& Rail Engineering Discipline Leadership** * Provide proactive, strategic leadership for the transit and rail engineering discipline, ensuring technical excellence and regulatory compliance across all projects. * Perform engineering review of permit applications, design plans, specifications, standby plans, contracts, and construction inspections to ensure compliance with FRA, FTA, CPUC, AREMA, and other applicable standards. * Involved from inception to completion on complex transit and rail engineering projects, overseeing budgets, schedules, subcontractors, and performance metrics. * Ensure discipline certifications, accreditations, and technical capabilities are continuously developed and maintained. * Conduct needs analyses and client value assessments to align engineering functions with business strategy and identify skill gaps or operational risks. * Schedule and lead discipline meetings, promoting innovation, technical excellence, and knowledge sharing. Provide strategic oversight of design development and implementation, as well as support to teams delivering major programs * **Project Delivery \& Program Management** * Guide engineering efforts from planning and design through construction support and maintenance. * Monitor external events, risk contingencies, hours, expenses, and contractual obligations to ensure successful project execution. * Lead technical aspects of contract negotiations, presentations, and client meetings. * Develop project scopes, timelines, pricing, and budgetary metrics in compliance with all applicable codes and regulations. * Interpret and summarize engineering data, reports, and regulatory documents to support sound technical conclusions. Provide high‑level strategic advice to clients and multidisciplinary project teams. * **Client Engagement \& Business Development** * Establish and maintain strong client relationships with transit agencies, railroads, and regulatory bodies. * Actively market the organization’s transit and rail engineering capabilities and support pursuit strategies for major infrastructure opportunities. * Develop new business opportunities and cross‑sell additional services across planning, design, strategic consulting, and program/construction management. Meet with public and private entities to discuss engineering challenges, program needs, and project strategies. * **Leadership, Mentorship \& Organizational Growth** * Mentor and guide engineering staff, promoting a culture of technical excellence and professional development. * Provide performance leadership to assigned staff and project teams. * Support long‑term strategy, growth, and pipeline development for the transit and rail engineering practice. * Collaborate across disciplines to deliver “trusted advisor” servi , attention to detail, and ability to prioritize responsibilities in a fast‑paced environment. * Highly proficient with office automation and discipline‑specific design software (MicroStation, AutoCAD, Civil 3D, OpenRail), predictive models, spreadsheets, and engineering tools. * Proven track record of upholding workplace safety and compliance with company health, safety, drug/alcohol, and harassment policies. * Strong ability to adapt to change and demonstrate flexibility to meet business needs. jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Description** --------------- Everything we do within WTW Global Technology has a global focus at its heart. We aim to provide colleagues with consistent technology, experiences and operations wherever possible. The Senior Director – AI Engineering will shape and deliver WTW’s central, enterprise\-wide AI engineering capability as a senior expert within Global Technology. Working closely with Architecture, Information Security, lines of business and business users, this role will provide senior technical advisory, define engineering direction, and establish the shared frameworks, reusable patterns and reference implementations that enable teams across WTW to develop AI solutions safely, consistently and at scale. The role applies deep specialist knowledge of generative AI, agentic systems, enterprise platforms and engineering governance to influence strategic decisions, guide complex technical delivery and solve ambiguous problems across related disciplines. It has end\-to\-end ownership of both build and run activities for central AI engineering capabilities, ensuring solutions are secure, governed, reliable and aligned to measurable business outcomes. We are seeking a proactive and autonomous senior technology leader who combines broad enterprise technology understanding with deep hands\-on expertise in production\-grade generative AI and agentic solutions across enterprise AI platforms, model providers and orchestration frameworks. Relevant experience may include Microsoft Foundry, Copilot Studio, Lyzr, Anthropic Claude, Moveworks or similar technologies. **The Role** * Shape the design, build and ongoing support of WTW’s central AI engineering frameworks, providing reusable foundations for lines of business to build upon. * Define technical direction for production\-grade generative AI and agentic solutions across enterprise AI platforms, model providers and orchestration frameworks, including: o Enterprise AI development and orchestration platforms, including agent frameworks, declarative and custom\-engine agents, plugins, skills, connectors and extensions. o Large language models and model\-provider APIs, including tool use, governed integration patterns and protocols such as the Model Context Protocol. o Moveworks and other agentic automation and employee\-support platforms. * Establish shared patterns, reference architectures, SDKs and reusable components, including prompt libraries, retrieval pipelines and tool/connector catalogues, to accelerate safe AI adoption across the business. * Act as a senior expert advisor to lines of business and business stakeholders, assessing workflow fit, validating use cases and translating business needs into secure, scalable AI solution patterns. * Partner with Architecture and Information Security to embed governance, responsible AI and security controls into the AI platform by design, including identity, data protection, content safety and auditability. * Build and operate context engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) and agent orchestration capabilities, integrating enterprise data sources through secure, governed connectors. * Define and implement large language model operations (LLMOps) practices, including evaluation, testing, prompt and model versioning, monitoring and observability, to ensure quality, reliability and cost efficiency in production. * Serve as a senior technical escalation point for AI services, leading investigation, root cause analysis and remediation of issues impacting production AI solutions. * Influence adoption of new AI capabilities by coordinating technical messaging, implementation guidance and alignment across impacted teams and lines of business. * Create, maintain and govern technical documentation, including design documents, architecture decision records, runbooks and developer guidance for consuming central AI frameworks. * Identify engineering and operational improvement opportunities, articulate recommendations and lead delivery of improvement initiatives across the AI engineering practice. * Guide and mentor AI engineers across WTW by sharing expertise, reviewing solution approaches and setting engineering standards for building on central AI frameworks. * Evaluate emerging AI technologies, tools and platforms, and define adoption strategies and roadmaps for enterprise use. * Maintain a strong information security and responsible AI posture, ensuring risk mitigation and adherence to data protection, model governance and applicable regulatory requirements. * Engage directly with business users and stakeholders to understand workflows, validate AI solutions in real\-world contexts and ensure capabilities deliver tangible business value. **Qualifications** ------------------ **What you'll bring** * Extensive experience of software, platform or AI engineering experience, including significant hands\-on experience building and supporting production generative AI solutions in large enterprise environments. * Deep ent. * Strong stakeholder management and relationship\-building skills, with experience building critical partnerships across technology, business, security, architecture and vendor teams. * Experience working directly with business users or product stakeholders to translate workflow needs into AI solution designs, validate outcomes and ensure solutions deliver practical business value. * Demonstrated technical leadership through mentoring, advisory, design review and influence across teams, often without direct authority. * Proactive, improvement\-focused mindset, with the ability to operate effectively in evolving environments, shape technical recommendations and drive outcomes with minimal supervision. Preferred Qualifications * Experience in financial services, insurance, consulting or another highly regulated industry. * Experience shaping or supporting enterprise\-wide AI transformation initiatives. * Familiarity with enterprise productivity\-platform extensibility, such as Teams apps, message extensions, Microsoft Graph connectors or comparable collaboration and workflow integrations. * Experience supporting adoption of AI capabilities through user validation, feedback loops, enablement and continuous improvement. * Experience contributing to enterprise technology roadmaps, standards or governance forums. **What we offer** Enjoy a benefits package designed to help you thrive, both professionally and personally. You'll receive 25 days of annual leave plus an extra WTW day to relax and recharge. Our comprehensive health and wellbeing offering includes private healthcare, life insurance, group income protection, and regular health assessments, all giving you peace of mind. Secure your future with our defined contribution pension scheme, featuring matched contributions up to 10% from the company. We support your growth and balance with hybrid working options, access to an employee assistance programme, and a fully paid volunteer day to make a difference in your community. On top of these, you can opt into a variety of additional perks including an electric vehicle car scheme, share scheme, cycle\-to\-work programme, dental and optical cover, critical illness protection, and much more. jobs.title: Intermediate Substation Protection & Control Engineer
jobs.description: As an Intermediate Protection and Control Electrical Engineer on our Industrial Commercial Energy team, you’ll independently execute defined P\&C packages for utility substation projects as they move through each project phase. Working under the Senior P\&C lead, you’ll develop protection, control, wiring, communications, and relay design deliverables for distribution\- and transmission\-voltage substations and switchyards. From anywhere in the continental United States, you’ll collaborate with engineers, designers, clients, and construction teams while helping deliver reliable power infrastructure and sharing in the firm you help build. ### **About Wade Trim** Wade Trim has been developing solutions to complex engineering and planning challenges for a century to deliver water and sewer services to residents and businesses, keep traffic flowing smoothly and safely, treat wastewater and stormwater to protect our waterways, distribute reliable power to customers, and provide community spaces to enjoy. We’re 100% employee\-owned, so our 850\+ employee\-owners share in the firm’s success and help set its direction. Our teams are organized by practice, so you’ll collaborate with experts and leaders across offices and markets. We also invest in new ideas through our Office of Applied Technology and Innovation Hub. ### **What You’ll Do** * Independently execute defined P\&C packages for a utility substation project and affected adjacent substations under the direction of the Senior P\&C lead * Develop schematics, AC/DC elementary and three\-line diagrams, panel elevations and wiring, interconnection drawings, protection and control circuits, panel and DICM details, and communications and logic diagrams, including adjacent\-substation relaying modifications * Prepare and update RTU control, status, and analog point lists; wiring, raceway, and cable schedules; signage and nameplate packages; and engineering calculations such as cable sizing, voltage drop, and station service interface support * Work with AutoCAD Electrical designers and drafters, incorporate redlines and review comments, and coordinate with SCADA/communications, senior engineers, designers, and other disciplines through project submittals * Assist with QA/QC reviews and apply engineering standards, client requirements, and utility practices while contributing to P\&C standards, templates, and workflows * Participate in client and project meetings, provide technical support during procurement, construction, factory acceptance testing, and commissioning, maintain excellent client relations, and maintain a safe working environment ### **What You’ll Bring** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering * 4\+ years of substation Protection and Control design experience, including utility substation projects * Experience with distribution\- and transmission\-voltage substations and switchyards * Experience with protective relaying and control design, including schematics, wiring diagrams, panel layouts, and interconnection drawings * Ability to independently produce defined P\&C packages, including cable schedules, protection and control circuits, panel and DICM details, and communications and logic diagrams * Familiarity with utility standards and engineering codes, along with strong writing, organizational, and communication skills and the ability to be self\-motivated and work well with others * Willingness to travel up to 10% ### **Nice to Have** * E.I.T. certification; PE licensure is a plus * Knowledge of IEEE, NESC, NEC, NFPA, and ANSI standards * Experience with AutoCAD Electrical workflows * Experience with Microsoft Office and Bluebeam Revu PDF Editor * Experience with Bentley ProjectWise or SharePoint * Familiarity with relay engineering or power\-system software tools ### **Work Arrangement** This is a full\-time remote opportunity for candidates located in the Eastern or Central time zones within the continental United States. A hybrid work arrangement is preferred for candidates who live within reasonable driving distance of a Wade Trim office### **What We Offer** As an employee\-owner, you’ll share in the firm’s success through profit sharing, an employee stock purchase plan, and a 401(k) with a company match. You’ll have every opportunity to grow through mentoring, the Wade Trim Leadership Academy, and tuition reimbursement. And because life outside of work matters, we offer paid parental leave, paid holidays, vacation and sick time, and a stewardship day, along with medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance and an employee assistance program. Come grow with us! Apply today and help build the infrastructure your community counts on. 3209 **Equal Opportunity** Wade Trim is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We welcome applicants of every background, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need a reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, contact us at **PS@wadetrim.com** We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Full\-time employees who are in pay status for less than 80 nonovertime hours in a month do not earn a monthly accrual of vacation leave. Part\-time employees accrue vacation leave hours in accordance with WAC 357\-31\-165(1\) or the applicable collective bargaining agreement (CBA) on a pro rata basis. Vacation leave accrual will be proportionate to the number of hours in pay status, in the month to that required for full\-time employment. Pay status includes hours worked, time on paid leave and paid holiday. As provided in WAC 357\-58\-175, an employer may authorize a lump\-sum accrual of vacation leave or accelerate the vacation leave accrual rate to support the recruitment and/or retention of a candidate or employee for a Washington Management Service position. Vacation leave accrual rates may only be accelerated using the rates established WAC 357\-31\-165\. **Note:** Most agencies follow the civil service rules covering leave and holidays for **exempt** employees even though there is no requirement for them to do so. However, agencies are required to adhere to the applicable RCWs pertaining holidays and leave. **Military Leave** Washington State supports members of the armed forces with 21 days paid military leave per year. **Bereavement Leave** Most employees whose family member or household member dies, or for loss of pregnancy, are entitled to five (5\) days of paid bereavement leave. In addition, the employer may approve other available leave types for the purpose of bereavement leave. **Additional Leave** Leave Sharing Parental Leave Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) Leave Without Pay Please visit the State HR Website for more detailed information regarding benefits. Updated 01\-07\-2026

jobs.title: Data & AI Security Engineer
jobs.description: **ABOUT THIS POSITION** Waystar is seeking a hands\-on Data and Artificial Intelligence Security Engineer to join our Security Operations team. This role will help build and operate the technical controls that protect sensitive enterprise data and enable the secure adoption of artificial intelligence. The ideal candidate will have experience implementing enterprise data protection technologies, including Microsoft Purview and data loss prevention solutions, along with a practical understanding of modern AI systems. This position will work closely with Security Operations, Data and Engineering, IT, Privacy, Legal, Risk, and application teams to translate security requirements into effective and scalable controls.**WHAT YOU'LL DO** Data Protection Engineering Implement and manage Microsoft Purview capabilities, including data discovery, classification, sensitivity labeling, data loss prevention, and other applicable data security controls. Deploy and operate Cyberhaven or similar data security platforms, including policy development, data lineage, sensitive data detection, enforcement, and alert tuning. Develop an integrated control model across Purview, Cyberhaven, cloud platforms, identity, endpoint security, and security monitoring. Identify sensitive data exposure and improve protection across endpoints, Microsoft 365, cloud, SaaS, and AI services. AI Security Engineering Perform security architecture reviews and threat modeling for AI applications, models, data pipelines, agents, retrieval\-augmented generation, model APIs, and Model Context Protocol integrations. Evaluate risks including prompt injection, sensitive data exposure, excessive agency, insecure tool use, unauthorized model access, and third\-party AI dependencies. Define security requirements and guardrails for enterprise AI systems and approved AI services. Develop and perform security testing for AI applications, integrations, and agent workflows. Monitoring and Response Integrate data and AI security telemetry into existing Security Operations monitoring and response processes. Develop alerts, investigation procedures, and response playbooks for data loss and AI\-related security events. Investigate potential data exposure, policy violations, unauthorized AI use, and anomalous data movement. Measure control effectiveness and continuously tune policies to reduce risk without creating unnecessary business disruption. Governance and Enablement Support AI intake, risk assessment, exception, and review processes with technical analysis and control recommendations. Translate regulatory, privacy, and security requirements into enforceable technical controls. Develop standards and guidance for secure data handling and AI adoption. Educate technical and business stakeholders on data protection and AI security practices. **WHAT YOU'LL NEED** Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Data Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 4\+ years of experience in security engineering, including hands\-on experience with data security, data loss prevention, or information protection. Experience configuring and managing Microsoft Purview or comparable enterprise data protection technologies. Experience with data classification, sensitivity labeling, data lineage, policy enforcement, and data exposure investigation. Working knowledge of generative AI technologies, including large language models, retrieval\-augmented generation, agents, model APIs, and AI integrations. Experience with security architecture reviews, risk assessments, or threat modeling. Ability to communicate technical risks and recommendations to engineering teams, business stakeholders, and leadership. Preferred Skills Hands\-on experience with Cyberhaven or a comparable data detection and response platform. Experience with Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention, Information Protection, Insider Risk Management, or Data Security Posture Management. Familiarity with AI security risks and frameworks such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, NIST AI Risk Management Framework, and MITRE ATLAS. Experience integrating security telemetry with SIEM and Security Operations workflows. Experience with Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform and their native data security capabilities. PowerShell, Python, or other security automation experience. Experience protecting healthcare or other regulated data, including PHI, PII, and PCI data. Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, Microsoft security certifications, or equivalent practical experience. **ABOUT WAYSTAR** Through a smart platform and better experience, Waystar helps providers simplify healthcare payments and yield powerful results throughout the complete revenue cycle. Waystar’s healthcare payments platform combines innovative, cloud\-based technology, robust data, and unparalleled client support to streamline workflows and improve financials so providers can focus on what matters most: their patients and communities. Waystar is trusted by 1M\+ providers, 1K\+ hospitals and health systems, and is connected to over 5K commercial and Medicaid/Medicare payers. We are deeply committed to living out our organizational values: honesty; kindness; passion; curiosity; fanatical focus; best work, always; making it happen; and joyful, optimistic \& fun. Waystar products have won multiple Best in KLAS® or Category Leader awards since 2010 and earned multiple \#1 rankings from Black Book™ surveys since 2012\. The Waystar platform supports more than 500,000 providers, 1,000 health systems and hospitals, and 5,000 payers and health plans. For more information, visit waystar.com or follow @Waystar on Twitter. **WAYSTAR PERKS** * Competitive total rewards (base salary \+ bonus, if applicable) * Customizable benefits package (3 medical plans with Health Saving Account company match) * We offer generous paid time off for our non\-exempt team members, starting with 3 weeks \+ 13 paid holidays, including 2 personal floating holidays. We also offer flexible time off for our exempt team members \+ 13 paid holidays * Paid parental leave (including maternity \+ paternity leave) * Education assistance opportunities and free LinkedIn Learning access * Free mental health and family planning programs, including adoption assistance and fertility support * 401(K) program with company match * Pet insurance * Employee resource groups Waystar is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We celebrate, value, and support diversity and inclusion. jobs.description: **About Wurl, LLC.** At Wurl, our mission is to create innovative technologies and services that help accelerate the shift to streaming. At our core, we are innovators focused on driving the streaming industry forward with technologies that help connect viewers to the right content and ads. Our technology and data\-driven solutions help companies reach new audiences, engage high\-value viewers, and ultimately increase their revenue. In 2022, Wurl was acquired by AppLovin (Nasdaq: APP), a leading marketing platform, giving our employees the best of both worlds: the dynamic environment of a 150\+ person startup as well as the stability of a high\-growth public tech company. We invest in providing a culture that fosters passion, drives excellence, and encourages collaboration to drive innovation. Wurl is a fully\-remote company that has been globally recognized for our people and technology, having been named a Great Place to Work by Fortune in 2022, 2023, and 2024; an Ad Tech Company of the Year finalist by the UK Business Tech Awards in 2023; a BIG Innovation Awards winner in 2024 and 2025; and the “Innovation in Advertising” winner by the StreamTV Awards in 2024\. ### **The Opportunity** Wurl delivers thousands of FAST channels to more than 50 streaming platforms worldwide with ads inserted in real time. We build the playout platform behind those channels, handling live events, ad signaling, and SSAI integration. Wurl is seeking a Software Engineer I to tackle engineering challenges on systems operating at scale. ### **What you’ll do** * **Build the systems that put channels on air.** Develop features in our playout platform, the software that assembles content and ad breaks into continuous linear streams. * **Investigate across the stack.** When viewership or ad impressions drop on a channel, use metrics and logs to trace the issue through playout, ad insertion, and CDN to its root cause. * **Build tools people rely on daily.** Write the Python services and automation that operations and engineering use to run channels. * **Work AI\-native.** Use AI tools to build faster and learn faster, and hold their output to the same standard as your own code. * **Own what you ship.** Your work goes to production and you stand behind it, including shifts in the on\-call rotation. ### **What you bring** * 2\+ years writing production Python: tested, maintainable code that other people rely on. * Solid grounding in REST APIs, HTTP, JSON, and Git. * Experience taking a well\-scoped problem, working out the approach, and delivering it without step\-by\-step guidance. * Experience diagnosing issues in systems you didn’t build. * Clear communication with both technical and non\-technical teammates. ### **What you’ll learn at Wurl** * **Streaming:** how linear playout systems are built, plus HLS, transcoding, live event switching and recordings. * **Ad tech:** server\-side ad insertion and CTV monetization. * **Cloud:** AWS, serverless, and cloud\-native application development. * **Production engineering:** monitoring, reliability, CI/CD, and infrastructure automation at scale. ### **What We Offer:** * Competitive Salary, Equity (ESPP) and Bonus * Strong Medical, Dental and Vision Benefits, 100% paid by Wurl * Remote first policy * Flexible, unlimited Time Off * 10 US Holidays * 401(k) Matching and Roth options * Pre\-Tax Savings Plans, HSA \& FSA * Various subscriptions for mental and physical wellness * OneMedical subscription for 24/7 convenient medical care * Paid Maternity and Parental Leave for all family additions * $1k Work From Home Stipend to set up your Office Few companies allow you to thrive like you will at Wurl. Join us to revolutionize the way the world watches television while enjoying mentorship, collaboration, and innovation. We encourage all applicants, even those who don’t meet 100% of the requirements, to apply. Passion and potential go a long way here at Wurl. AppLovin provides a competitive total compensation package with a pay for performance rewards approach. Total compensation at AppLovin is based on a number of factors including market location and may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Depending on the position offered, equity, and other forms of incentive compensation (as applicable) may be provided as part of a total compensation package, in addition to dental, vision, and other benefits. **Other Types of Pay:** Equity eligible **Health Insurance:** Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Disability **Retirement Benefits:** 401(k) Retirement Plan **Paid Time Off:** Unlimited Discretionary Time Off **Paid Holidays:** 10 paid holidays per year **Paid Sick Leave:** 80 hours per year **Method of Application:** Apply online **Application Window:** The application window is expected to close within 30 days of the posting date.
