jobs.title: AI/ML Engineer & Applied Researcher, Early Stage Projects
jobs.description: Software EngineeringMountain View, CA (HQ) **About the company** X is Alphabet’s moonshot factory where uncomfortably ambitious, world\-changing ideas are developed and taken out into the world. X projects have the potential to transform the lives of billions of people and make the world a radically better place. For X to be successful, we have to repeatedly turn breakthrough technology ideas into products that solve large problems in the world, and create meaningful businesses for Alphabet. **About the team:** You'll join a team at X that provides world\-class computational support to the many different projects, ideas and experiments at the Moonshot Factory. You'll work directly with teams across X to share expert machine learning expertise, advice and hands\-on implementation; from early concept through launch and supporting prototyping, experimentation, technical development and more. **About the role:** Internally, we call this role the "Generally Awesome Engineer" because the problems we tackle at X rarely respect the boundary between a Research Scientist and a Machine Learning Engineer. One month, you might be designing a multi\-agent reasoning harness that critiques early moonshot hypotheses or automates complex engineering workflows across the factory. Next, you might be embedded with a small team of physicists, biologists, or mechanical engineers, adapting foundation models and reinforcement learning to control lab hardware, simulate molecular interactions, or process sparse sensor telemetry. We are looking for someone earlier in their career, ideally coming out of a technical PhD, an early\-stage startup, or preferably both, who lives and breathes modern AI. You don't just follow the state of the art in foundation models and agentic AI; you internalize how the landscape is shifting week by week and immediately translate new capabilities into working systems. Just as importantly, you use AI proactively in your own day\-to\-day workflow: you build with coding agents, automate your own bottlenecks, and prototype at a speed that previously required a five\-person team. **How You'll Make 10x Impact:** * **Architect and ship agentic AI systems:** Design, build, and deploy multi\-agent workflows, tool\-using harnesses, memory/retrieval pipelines, and human\-in\-the\-loop systems that accelerate both individual moonshot projects and factory\-wide discovery. * **Bridge frontier research and real\-world prototyping:** Take newly published papers, open\-weight models, and frontier Alphabet/Google DeepMind capabilities and adapt them via post\-training, fine\-tuning, RL, test\-time compute, or hybrid neuro\-symbolic architectures to messy, non\-obvious real\-world problems. * **De\-risk early moonshot investigations:** Partner with scientists, hardware engineers, and rapid evaluators on 0\-to\-1 investigations to scope technical feasibility, identify the hardest core assumptions, and build fast, scrappy prototypes that deliver clear kill\-or\-continue signals. * **Model AI\-native engineering across the factory:** Push the frontier of AI\-assisted software and research development \- building reusable skills, plugins, and agentic workflows that help engineers and domain scientists across X move 10x faster. * **Own end\-to\-end execution across the stack:** Move fluidly from curating noisy datasets and training models on our on\-prem GPU cluster or cloud infrastructure to building clean backend services, APIs, and interactive prototypes that partners and teammates can use immediately. * **Act as an AI tastemaker for X:** Stay plugged into the bleeding edge across Alphabet, academia, and the startup ecosystem; separate durable technical breakthroughs from passing hype, and bring the best tools and ideas into X. **Minimum Qualifications:** * PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, a quantitative physical/life science, or a related technical field OR a Master's/Bachelor's degree with equivalent high\-velocity experience in an early\-stage startup or applied AI research lab. * Deep theoretical and hands\-on command of modern foundation models (LLMs, multimodal models, diffusion/flow models) and their post\-training/adaptation lifecycle. * Demonstrated experience designing and building agentic AI systems including multi\-agent orchestration, tool use and environment interaction, code execution harnesses, and complex retrieval/memory architectures. * Fluency in AI\-native software development with strong software engineering chops in Python (and modern ML ecosystems such as PyTorch, JAX, or vLLM) paired with daily mastery of AI coding and research agents to build and ship rapidly. * Track record of taking ambiguous, open\-ended real\-world problems from zero to a working prototype with minimal supervision. **Preferred Qualifications:** * The "PhD \+ Startup" combination: Rigorous research training (e.g., publications at NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, CVPR, or domain journals) combined with experience building at an early\-stage startup where you wore multiple hats and shipped under tight constraints. * Experience applying AI/ML to physical, scientific, or hardware\-coupled domains; such as computational chemistry, materials science, synthetic biology, physics simulation, CAD/mechanical design, robotics, or climate/earth systems. * Full\-stack prototyping capability: comfort spinning up cloud infrastructure (GCP, Docker, Kubernetes), GPU cluster workloads, and lightweight web UIs or developer tools when a project needs them. **How You Know You'll Thrive Here:** * **You are unapologetically AI\-fluent—and grounded in reality.** You test new models, agent harnesses, and workflows the day they drop because you genuinely love seeing what's newly possible, but you care about solving real physical and human problems rather than chasing demos. * **You refuse to say "that's not my job description."** Whether a project needs a custom loss function, a data\-cleaning pipeline, an agentic harness, or a script to talk to lab hardware, you jump in and build what the problem requires. * **You have high agency and low ego.** You love working shoulder to shoulder with domain experts who think differently than you do, and you're just as proud of a rigorous experiment that disproves a flawed idea in two weeks as one that launches a multi\-year project. The US base salary range for this full\-time position is $147,000 \- $221,000 \+ bonus \+ equity \+ benefits. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your location during the hiring process. Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include bonus, equity, or benefits. **An Equal Opportunity Workplace** ---------------------------------- At X, we don't just accept difference \- we celebrate it, we support it, and we thrive on it for the benefit of our employees, our products and our community. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact us at x\-accommodation\-request@x.team.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer (Level I / Level II)
jobs.description: ### **About Xnurta** Xnurta is building the AI teammate for retail media. Our platform handles campaign buying, execution and optimization across Amazon, Walmart and Criteo, so advertisers can prioritize smarter and move faster. As a full\-stack engineer, you'll help build the product that makes it happen. ### **What You'll Do** You'll spend most of your time on backend systems (about 70%) and the rest on the frontend (about 30%). The mix shifts with project needs, so you'll move comfortably between both sides of the stack. * Design, test and maintain scalable, reliable systems in production * Build and ship features across the stack, from backend services and APIs to responsive web front ends * Work with product, design and data teams from concept to launch * Take part in code reviews and help shape engineering best practices ### **Levels** * Level I: 1–2 years of professional software engineering with a BS; delivers well\-scoped features with guidance from senior engineers * Level II: 3–5 years of professional software engineering with a BS; owns features end to end, leads design of components, mentors others ### **Must\-Haves** * Strong skills in at least one backend language (Python, Java or Go), and comfortable working in the other two * Strong skills in TypeScript or JavaScript. TypeScript is our standard for new code, and we're gradually migrating legacy JavaScript to it * Hands\-on experience using AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) in your development workflow, including reviewing, testing and refining AI\-generated code * BS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a closely related field (or equivalent practical experience), plus at least 1 year of professional software engineering experience ### **Nice\-to\-Haves** * 2\+ years of professional software engineering experience * A project you can show that was built mostly with an AI coding agent, and you can explain how you directed and checked its work * MS in Computer Science or Computer Engineering * Open\-source contributions you can show (GitHub) * Experience with AWS (e.g., EC2, Bedrock, S3, Iceberg) * Experience with online advertising or retail media technologies ### **Work Arrangement** Hybrid, based in Campbell, CA. We value time together in the office, but there's no fixed number of required days. We'll work out a schedule that fits you and the team. ### **Location \& Compensation** * Location: Campbell, CA (hybrid), full\-time * Base salary range: $100,000–$250,000 per year. jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer / Senior Algorithm Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About Xnurta** Xnurta, powered by SparkX, is an AI\-native retail media and advertising optimization platform for brands, sellers and agencies on Amazon and beyond. We combine multi\-agent AI systems, predictive analytics and deep domain expertise to deliver advertising performance at scale. ### **About the Role** Xnurta is strengthening its AI capabilities for advertising and commerce. We are looking for senior engineers who can independently own important technical problems and turn solutions into production systems. This is a Senior Individual Contributor role; people management is not a requirement. Candidates may specialize in data, model training and optimization, or AI/agentic systems. We expect substantial depth in at least one area and effective collaboration across the others—not mastery of every part of the stack. ### **Specialization Tracks** * Data and Training Data: Data modeling, quality, lineage, feature and sample construction, and feedback\-data management. Example: Turn business events, strategies, actions, and outcomes into trusted, reusable training and evaluation datasets; prevent leakage and training\-serving inconsistencies * Model Training and Algorithm Optimization: Predictive/decision models or large language models; training, fine\-tuning, evaluation, error analysis, and iteration. Example: Improve task effectiveness, budget allocation, or execution quality; design sound offline evaluations and online controlled experiments * AI / Agentic Systems: Tool use, workflow orchestration, state management, permissions, execution reliability, and observability. Example: Build agents that complete real tasks, including retries, idempotency, approvals, failure recovery, and outcome feedback ### **Responsibilities** * Own a critical component end to end. Take responsibility from problem definition and technical design through implementation, testing, and production release. * Solve core problems within your specialization. Improve data quality, train and optimize models, or build reliable AI/agentic systems, working with upstream and downstream teams to complete integration. * Validate improvements through experiments. Establish reproducible evaluations and appropriate baselines. Separate model, data, and engineering issues; connect offline results to real\-world value. * Own production quality. Monitor reliability, effectiveness, latency, and cost per task. Improve observability, diagnosis, and rollback mechanisms. * Build reusable capabilities. Contribute code, data standards, evaluation tools, and documentation that support multiple product lines, collaborating with teams in the U.S. and China. ### **Required Qualifications** * Deep expertise and demonstrated results in at least one specialization above, with the ability to explain the problem, approach, personal contribution, and validation method. * Experience deploying systems into production or delivering technology used by real users, with the ability to resolve data, engineering, and effectiveness issues beyond the prototype stage. * Strong coding skills. Model/data specialists should be proficient in Python and relevant tools; systems specialists should bring strong backend or distributed\-systems engineering skills. No single framework is prescribed. * Sound understanding of data quality, experiment design, and evaluation, including whether an improvement is reproducible, meaningful to the business, and worth its operating cost. * Clear English technical communication and documentation skills, and the ability to collaborate across Product, ML, Data, Engineering, and geographic locations. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Practical experience in model training/fine\-tuning, inference optimization, agent evaluation, tool execution, or learning from outcome feedback. * Experience in advertising, recommendations, search, forecasting, budget optimization, commerce, or enterprise automation. Advertising experience is not a universal prerequisite for this role. * Startup or zero\-to\-one experience, with an interest in understanding user problems directly, testing quickly, and iterating based on evidence. * Strong open\-source, research, or technical work connected to real engineering problems. Publications, degrees, and employer prestige do not substitute for delivery ability. ### **Initial Priorities** * Understand the assigned component's data, system interfaces, current effectiveness, and main bottlenecks. * Deliver a verifiable technical improvement with a clear comparison against the relevant baseline. * Integrate the improvement into production, with monitoring, documentation, and reusable engineering support. ### **Location \& Compensation** * Location: Campbell, CA (hybrid), full\-time * Base salary range: $100,000–$300,000 per year. Final pay depends on level, experience, skills and location. Benefits include medical, dental and vision. Xnurta is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of any protected characteristic.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager / Director of Engineering — AI Systems

We combine multi\-agent AI systems, predictive analytics and deep domain expertise to deliver advertising performance at scale. ### **About the Role** Xnurta is expanding its AI, agentic systems, and modeling capabilities for advertising and commerce. We are looking for a technically strong, hands\-on engineering leader who can turn technical direction into reliable production capabilities with measurable results. This role focuses on technical execution, people leadership, and delivery for a team or a set of core systems. Compared with the CTO role, it does not require the same breadth of company\-wide strategy or organizational leadership. The final level—Senior Engineering Manager or Director of Engineering—will reflect the candidate's demonstrated capabilities and the agreed scope of responsibility. ### **Responsibilities** * Lead delivery of AI systems. Translate product objectives into technical designs, iteration plans, and acceptance criteria. Bring together models, data, agents, and software systems for production deployment. * Stay technically involved. Participate in architecture and code reviews, critical prototypes, and complex troubleshooting. Address bottlenecks in model effectiveness, reliability, performance, and cost. * Establish delivery and quality practices. Implement data validation, offline evaluation, online experiments, monitoring, staged rollouts, and rollback procedures. Distinguish shipping a feature from demonstrating that it works. * Own people management. Hire, set goals, coach, provide performance feedback, and develop technical leaders. Help the team deliver independently and collaborate effectively. * Coordinate across teams. Work with Product, ML, Data, and U.S. and China engineering teams to clarify dependencies and interfaces, resolve blockers, and own quality and delivery within the role's scope. ### **Required Qualifications** * Experience delivering production AI/ML, agentic, or intelligent decision systems. Practical experience across the model training, fine\-tuning, evaluation, or deployment lifecycle, with the ability to assess effectiveness and engineering trade\-offs alongside ML specialists. * Genuine technical people\-management experience, including hiring, coaching, and performance feedback for direct reports. This role does not require the CTO\-level experience of managing 10–15 or more direct reports. * Strong software engineering and architecture skills, with the ability to work deeply on data flows, model serving, task execution, and observability. * Ability to turn ambiguous requirements into a deliverable scope, balance technical quality with business priorities and speed, and remain accountable for outcomes. * Clear English communication for technical discussions, delivery coordination, and business collaboration across distributed teams. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Startup, early\-stage team, or zero\-to\-one product experience, with evidence of taking initiative under resource constraints. * Experience with advertising, recommendations, search, bidding, budget optimization, or other online decision systems. jobs.title: Staff / Principal Data Engineer — AI Data Platform
jobs.description: ### **About Xnurta** Xnurta, powered by SparkX, is an AI\-native retail media and advertising optimization platform for brands, sellers and agencies on Amazon and beyond. We combine multi\-agent AI systems, predictive analytics and deep domain expertise to deliver advertising performance at scale. ### **About the Role** Xnurta is strengthening the data foundation for AI\-driven advertising and commerce products. We are looking for a hands\-on data expert who can work backward from model and product needs to determine what data to acquire, how to structure and validate it, and how to turn it into reusable assets for learning, evaluation, and decision\-making. This role spans the full data lifecycle: acquisition, ingestion, cleaning, modeling, storage, quality, training and evaluation datasets, and downstream applications. The goal is to make trustworthy data a compounding product advantage, connecting business context, decisions, actions, and outcomes rather than simply accumulating logs. This is a senior technical role working with existing data, ML, product, and engineering teams in the U.S. and China. People management is not a prerequisite. Final leveling as Staff or Principal will reflect demonstrated technical scope and impact. ### **Responsibilities** * Define the shared data architecture. Translate AI and business requirements into data models, event schemas, ingestion patterns, and reusable datasets or interfaces. Connect advertising, commerce, and product\-usage data while preserving source definitions and customer boundaries. Prioritize improvements to existing systems rather than assuming a full rebuild. * Own end\-to\-end data delivery. Build and improve pipelines for acquisition, cleaning, normalization, storage, and consumption. Address API constraints, schema changes, duplicate records, late\-arriving data, backfills, and reconciliation so that production applications can depend on the data. * Build training, evaluation, and feedback assets. Partner with ML and agent engineers to capture decision context, strategy/model versions, actions, execution status, human intervention, and outcomes. Develop versioned datasets and reproducible preparation workflows, with appropriate labels, outcome\-maturity rules, and safeguards against leakage and training\-serving inconsistencies. * Enable credible experimentation and measurement. Work with ML, Product, and QA to provide the instrumentation, assignment records, metric definitions, and datasets needed to compare new approaches with existing production algorithms and human\-operated workflows. Support experiment integrity and reproducible analysis; distinguish observational reporting from evidence of causal improvement. * Develop commerce and retail data capabilities. Evaluate customer\-authorized data, platform integrations, and third\-party sources with product and business owners. Assess coverage, freshness, reliability, permitted uses, integration effort, and recurring cost before committing to a source or collection approach. * Make quality, governance, and cost operational. Establish lineage, ownership, validation, observability, access controls, and data\-use boundaries. Track storage, processing, and acquisition costs, including cost per customer or useful dataset. Improve efficiency without compromising reliability or evaluation quality. * Lead through hands\-on implementation and collaboration. Deliver critical components, review designs and code, and mentor engineers. Agree interfaces and responsibilities with U.S. and China teams so shared data capabilities support multiple product lines without unnecessary duplication. ### **Required Qualifications** * A track record of owning production data systems across multiple stages of the lifecycle, from source acquisition and data design to downstream consumption and operational support. * Strong SQL and Python skills, practical data\-modeling expertise, and experience building reliable batch and/or event\-driven pipelines, orchestration, storage, and data interfaces. No single cloud provider, framework, or database is prescribed. * Experience providing data for ML, decision systems, or AI products, including training/evaluation dataset construction, versioning, quality checks, and reproducibility. Able to infer data requirements from the task or model objective rather than relying only on a supplied specification. * Sound understanding of event instrumentation, metric definitions, attribution or delayed outcomes, and the data requirements of controlled experiments. Able to partner with ML and analytics specialists on valid measurement. * Practical judgment on data quality, source permissions, tenant isolation, access, and the cost\-versus\-freshness trade\-off. Shared architecture must not imply unrestricted reuse of customer data for training or across customers. * Ability to move between architecture and implementation, independently resolve ambiguous problems, and explain technical trade\-offs to product and business partners. * Clear English technical communication and documentation skills, with experience collaborating across teams and geographic locations. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience connecting data infrastructure to model development, agent workflows, or optimization platforms, with measurable downstream impact. * Experience in advertising, recommendations, search, commerce, or other systems with decisions, actions, and delayed feedback. Relevant data and AI experience matters more than advertising\-industry tenure. * Experience with experimentation platforms, data observability, feature pipelines, offline replay, or human\-feedback data. * Startup or zero\-to\-one experience, including building useful capabilities with a small team and extending existing infrastructure pragmatically. * Experience evaluating external data providers or combining first\-party and third\-party data under explicit usage permissions. ### **Initial Priorities** * Map the current data lifecycle, consumers, ownership, quality gaps, and costs; propose a prioritized architecture and delivery plan with the existing teams. * Deliver one production\-ready, versioned dataset linking decisions and actions to outcomes, with lineage and quality checks, and validate its usefulness for an agreed model or product use case. * Establish the data instrumentation and reproducible measurement workflow for a pilot comparing production algorithms and human\-operated workflows, alongside ML, Product, and QA. ### **Measures of Success** Relevant measures include completeness and freshness of decision\-action\-outcome records, data reliability, reproducibility of datasets and experiment results, time required to prepare useful data, adoption across product lines, and unit data costs. Targets should follow an agreed baseline. Dataset volume alone is not a sufficient measure of value. ### **Location \& Compensation** * Location: Campbell, CA (hybrid), full\-time * Base salary range: $200,000–$350,000 per year. Final pay depends on level, experience, skills and location. Benefits include medical, dental and vision. Xnurta is an equal opportunity employer. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet. Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all. ***This role cannot offer any sort of visa sponsorship nor support of any kind for visas.*** -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ***This role is located in Austin, TX and candidates must be able to work three days in our Austin, TX office.*** **About the team and the role** -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- eBay’s Global Platform organization builds and operates the shared technology foundations that power our marketplace. Together, we reduce risk, simplify security adoption, and prepare our cloud infrastructure for evolving threats. jobs.title: Machine Learning Operations Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** At Gifthealth, we're revolutionizing the way people experience healthcare by simplifying the process of managing prescriptions and health services. Our mission is to provide a seamless, personalized, and efficient healthcare experience for all our customers. We're a dynamic, innovative, and customer\-centric company dedicated to making a positive impact on people's lives. **Position Summary** We are seeking a Machine Learning Operations (MLOps) Engineer to own the path from a registered model to a production inference workflow, including deployment, scheduled batch scoring, backfills, versioning, and rollback, with near\-real\-time and real\-time scoring to follow. This position plays a key role in supporting the AI/ML Engineering department and reports to the Sr. Manager, AI/ML Engineering, ensuring alignment with organizational goals, operational excellence, and compliance standards. This position has no direct reports. **Key Responsibilities** * Deploy and operate models in production, owning the path from registered model to inference workflow, including scheduled batch scoring, backfills, versioning, and rollback. * Build scoring and data pipelines that are safe to rerun, can be backfilled, and fail loudly instead of quietly producing incomplete output. * Help design, build, and run near\-real\-time and real\-time scoring workflows, an area where our approach is still being defined. * Build monitoring for both the pipeline and the model, including scoring run status, input arrival and freshness, consistency of inputs with training data, and shifts in score distribution. * Set up and tune alerting that identifies when something needs attention, from a failed run to a model that may need retraining, so that issues are found before clinicians are affected. * Write and maintain runbooks, design notes, and clear handoffs so that incident response does not depend on one person. * Contribute to shared defaults that make each new model faster and safer to ship, including automated tests that run on every model or pipeline change and a consistent release process from development to production. * Enable comparison of a new model version against the current version before downstream use cases rely on it. * Provide visibility into the cost of running each model. * Partner with data scientists to move models from development to production, including addressing training/serving skew, drift, and model versioning. * Design for security and access, including secrets management, least\-privilege roles, and logging that never exposes sensitive data. * Work within a Snowflake\-native platform (Snowflake ML Feature Store, Model Registry, and Experiments, dbt, Python, Terraform, GitHub Actions, and TypeScript services for online orchestration). **Qualifications** * **Education**: A bachelors degree is preferred. * **Experience**: Typically 5 years of experience in software, data, or ML infrastructure engineering, as a guide rather than a requirement. * **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**: + **Required** - Has put machine learning models, or comparable data products, into production and kept them running, and can describe a failure caught, a failure missed, and what changed afterward. - Has built scheduled scoring or data pipelines that are safe to rerun, can be backfilled, and fail loudly instead of quietly producing a half\-empty table. - Has built monitoring and alerting covering data quality, freshness, and model behavior, and tuned it until people trusted it. - Matches the solution to the need, with experience using managed platforms and building custom components, and can explain when each was the right call. - Strong Python and strong SQL. - Comfortable with Git\-based workflows, automated testing, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code, ideally Terraform. - Understands machine learning well enough to be a real partner to data scientists, including training/serving skew, drift, model versioning, and why a model that validated well can still fail in production. - Treats security and access as part of the design, including secrets management, least\-privilege roles, and logs that never leak sensitive data. - Documents work, including runbooks, design notes, and clear handoffs. - Uses AI tools effectively, with foundational engineering skills sharp enough to read, audit, and debug every line independently. If an agent writes the code, remains accountable for it and can defend it. + **Preferred** - Experience with Snowflake, especially Snowflake ML (Feature Store, Model Registry, Snowpark), or comparable experience on another ML platform. - Experience deploying and operating services on a cloud provider such as AWS, including containers, APIs, and real\-time model serving. - Experience setting up ML operations at a company or team that did not have them. - Experience in a regulated environment (healthcare, pharmacy, payer, or life sciences is ideal), including PHI under HIPAA and BAAs, access reviews, and audit trails. - Experience with observability for LLM applications. **Work Environment** * **Location**: Columbus, OH or remote (US) * **Schedule**: FT * Small but growing cross\-functional team with high autonomy and minimal ceremony, building new services and practices from the ground up. * Regular collaboration with data scientists and the AI/ML Engineering team to ensure alignment. * Data is PHI. HIPAA, BAAs, masking, and role\-based access are daily working realities. **Key Essential Functions** * Must be able to handle PHI in compliance with HIPAA, BAAs, masking requirements, and role\-based access controls. * Must be able to read, audit, and debug all code, including code produced with AI tools, and be accountable for it. * \[HR to confirm any physical requirements, if applicable] **Employment Classification** **Status:** Full\-time **FLSA:** Exempt **Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Statement** Gifthealth is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, transgender status, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you do not meet every requirement but still feel you would be a great fit for this role, we encourage you to apply! **Disclaimer** This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, or skills required of personnel. Gifthealth reserves the right to modify job duties or descriptions at any time.

experience establishing coding standards and quality practices adopted across a domain * Demonstrated ability to decompose highly complex problems including algorithmic challenges into scalable solutions; deep understanding of system\-wide implications of technical decisions across multiple services * Experience designing integration solutions for complex domain areas; track record of driving integration implementation decisions across teams within architectural standards * Senior\-level experience in a search technology, preferably a Lucene\-based platform (Elasticsearch/Opensearch/Solr), experienced with index design, mapping configurations, publication scenarios, performance optimization, in a medium to large customer\-facing environment. * Experience in operating services in the cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP): IoC, instrumentation and logging, troubleshooting, caching, understanding of networking and security requirements. must haves * Acknowledge the presence of choice in every moment and take personal responsibility for your life. * Possess an entrepreneurial spirit and continuously innovate to achieve great results. * Communicate with honesty and kindness and create the space for others to do the same. * Lead with courage, knowing the possibility of greatness is bigger than the fear of failure. * Foster connection by putting people first and building trusting relationships. * Integrate fun and joy as a way of being and working, aka doesn’t take yourself too seriously. additional notes Authorization to work in the United States is required for this role. **Please note:** Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visa at this time for this role. compensation and benefits package lululemon’s compensation offerings are grounded in a pay\-for\-performance philosophy that recognizes exceptional individual and team performance. jobs.title: Senior ML Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** ----------------------- Today, when you go to your doctor and get referred to a specialist, your doctor sends out a referral and tells you, “They’ll be in touch soon.” So you wait. And wait. Sometimes days, weeks, or even months. Why? Because too often providers are overwhelmed with the painstakingly tedious work required to get paid by insurance companies. Powered by proprietary models, Tennr handles the complex paperwork that gets patients through the door and providers paid, helping operators get patients the right care, at the right time, in the right setting. **Role Description** -------------------- We’re looking for a high\-agency Senior Backend Engineer to bridge the gap between cutting\-edge ML research and real\-world product delivery. You’ll design and build agentic workflows that power complex healthcare processes to solve hairy infrastructure, workflow, and UX challenges in U.S. healthcare. This role involves creating data pipelines, evaluation harnesses, and scalable production\-grade agentic systems. You’ll be responsible for researching the right tools and models, ensuring we always use the best\-fit technology for each workflow.. As part of our ML team, you’ll work hand\-in\-hand with researchers to translate new techniques and insights into production\-ready systems. The ideal candidate has full\-stack engineering experience, hands\-on expertise with LLM APIs, and a proven track record of deploying AI systems into production. You’ll work across the stack \- from data collection to training pipelines to AI agent orchestration to frontend integration \- bringing cutting\-edge AI solutions to life in real\-world healthcare environments. **Responsibilities** -------------------- As a Senior Backend Engineer on the ML team at Tennr, you’ll bridge the gap between cutting\-edge ML research and real\-world product delivery. You’ll help build agentic systems that use LLMs, and vision models, and structured automation to solve hairy infrastructure, workflow, and UX challenges in U.S. healthcare. * Ship full\-stack AI systems end\-to\-end * Design resilient systems for model deployment, evaluation, and monitoring that stay reliable as traffic grows. * Go from ideation to code within hours; iterate quickly on experiments and data. * Collaborate with ML engineers, backend engineers, and cross\-functional teams to integrate models cleanly with data pipelines and product **Qualifications** ------------------ * Proficiency in full\-stack development, with a strong understanding of system design, backend engineering, and observability infrastructure. * A track record of working through the full lifecycle of building, testing, deploying, scaling, and monitoring LLM\-centered software architectures. * Excellent communication and collaboration skills: aligning on interfaces, navigating tradeoffs, and driving cross\-team execution. **Why Tennr?** -------------- * Drive Impact: one of our company values is Cowboy, meaning you set the pace. You won’t just talk about things, you’ll get them done. And feel the impact. * Develop Operational Expertise: learn the inner workings of scaling systems, tools, and infrastructure * Innovate with Purpose: we’re not just doing this for fun (although we do have a lot of fun). At Tennr, you’ll join a high\-caliber team maniacally focused on reducing patient delays across the U.S. healthcare system. * Build Relationships: collaborate and connect with like\-minded, driven individuals in our Hudson Square office 4 days/week * Free lunch! Plus a pantry full of snacks. **Benefits** ------------ * Beautiful new office at 345 Hudson Street * Unlimited PTO * 100% paid employee health benefit options * Employer\-funded 401(k) match * Competitive parental leave Compensation Range: $200K \- $220K
